ingredients.item: AIP taco seasoning and a squeeze of lime (for the meat)
chicken bone broth or stock (plus a splash for the meat)

Add the beef and brown, then add the lime juice, a splash of broth and the taco seasoning.
In a pot, heat the pumpkin, broth and coconut milk over medium until smooth. Stir in the nutritional yeast and salt.
Whisk in the arrowroot a tablespoon at a time so it doesn't clump.
Stir the meat into the sauce.
recipes.title: "Cheesy" Taco Dip (AIP, Paleo)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. The live recipe card didn't load, so this comes from a 2021 web archive copy. Calories are the site's figures per serving (1 serving).
steps: Combine butter, milk and sugar in a small saucepan.
Bring to a boil over medium high heat and let boil for 45 seconds.
Remove from heat and whisk in vanilla & chocolate chips until smooth and shiny.
Immediately pour over a 9x13 cake or brownies.
Let cool completely to set.
recipes.title: 1 Minute Chocolate Frosting

ingredients.item: diced red or orange bell pepper

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Lunch. The ingredient list says pepperonis but the steps say pepperoncini; pepperoncini fits the Greek salad. The site's nutrition is for the whole bowl, so this is 1/4.
steps: Combine the chickpeas and tuna in a large bowl.
Add the cucumber, shallots, pepper, olives, pepperoncini and feta and toss gently.
Whisk the dressing, season, and toss with the salad.
Serve right away or refrigerate up to 3 days. Good over lettuce, in pita, or with crackers.
recipes.title: 10-Minute Greek-Inspired Chickpea Tuna Salad

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Calories, protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Preheat the oven to 500°F.
Cut the vegetables into large pieces and the chicken into cubes, and toss everything on a sheet pan with the oil and seasonings.
Roast 15 minutes until the vegetables char and the chicken is cooked. Serve with rice, pasta or salad.
recipes.title: 15-Minute One-Pan Roasted Chicken and Veggies

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Mexican. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Pulse everything in a food processor, stopping while there are still flecks of parsley.
recipes.title: 2-Minute Spicy Ranch Dressing

ingredients.item: bananas (very ripe will give the best flavor, where the skin is black/brown or almost black/brown)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. The live recipe card didn't load, so this comes from a 2016 web archive copy. Calories and protein are the site's figures per serving (1 serving).
steps: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F. Prepare a 9-in. x 9-in. square baking dish by spraying it with cooking spray or rubbing coconut oil around the sides and bottom so the brownies do not stick.
In a large bowl mash the bananas with a fork until smooth. Add the almond butter and mix until smooth. Add the cocoa powder and optional cinnamon and blend until no visible cocoa powder is seen.
Pour the batter into the prepared baking pan and bake for 20 minutes. Remove from the oven and let cool completely before slicing.
recipes.title: 3 Ingredient Brownies (Whole30 & Paleo)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Anti-Inflammatory. The site is gone, so this comes from a 2019 web archive copy. Calories, protein, weight and the number of cookies are estimates.
steps: Preheat the oven to 350°F. Grind the coconut fine (like instant oatmeal) if it isn't already.
Mash the banana with the vanilla, then stir in the coconut until it looks like coarse mashed potatoes.
Roll about 2 tbsp per cookie onto a parchment-lined sheet and press crosswise with a fork.
Bake about 11 minutes, until just browning at the edges and underneath.
recipes.title: 3-Ingredient Coconut Banana Cookies

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Breakfast. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Mash the banana smooth in a bowl (or use a food processor), then whisk in the eggs.
Stir in the 4 tbsp peanut flour until smooth.
Heat a large skillet over low-medium heat and coat with coconut oil spray.
Scoop 1/4 cup batter per pancake (it's thinner than usual batter).
Cook about a minute until bubbles form, flip, and cook a minute more. Repeat.
Shake the sauce ingredients in a jar and pour over the pancakes.
recipes.title: 3-Ingredient Peanut Flour Pancakes

recipes.notes: From the 40 Aprons roundup Whole30 Slow Cooker Recipes. Calories and protein are the site's figures; serving weight is an estimate.
steps: Stir the salsa and taco seasoning (and salt, if using) in the slow cooker.
Add the chicken and turn to coat.
Cover and cook 5 hours on LOW or 3 hours on HIGH.
Check after 4 hours on LOW (2 on HIGH); keep cooking until the chicken reaches 155°F.
Rest the chicken 5 minutes, then shred it.
Return it to the slow cooker, stir into the salsa, and cook 30 minutes on HIGH or 60 on LOW.
Use in tacos, enchiladas, burritos, salads or bowls.
recipes.title: 3-Ingredient Slow Cooker Mexican Shredded Chicken

ingredients.item: fettuccine (or noodles of choice), to serve

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Pasta. Calories and protein are the site's figures, which appear to be for the sauce and shrimp only; serving weight is an estimate without pasta.
steps: Blend the milk, cream cheese, flour and salt until smooth and set aside.
Melt the butter in a saucepan, cook the garlic about a minute, then add the shrimp.
Cook 3–5 minutes until pink and just cooked through.
Remove the shrimp, leaving the garlic butter in the pan.
Add the milk mixture and stir 4 minutes over medium heat, then simmer about 6 minutes more, stirring, until it thickens.
Remove from the heat and stir in the cheeses.
Cover and let stand about 5 minutes.
Stir in the shrimp and let stand 5 minutes more.
Serve over fettuccine and garnish with parsley.
recipes.title: 30 Minute Cheesy Garlic Shrimp Alfredo

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Anti-Inflammatory. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Sauté the onion in the oil over medium-high 2–3 minutes.
Salt the chicken and brown 2–3 minutes per side.
Add everything else, bring to a full boil, and keep it at a controlled boil 10–15 minutes until the sauce reduces by a third to a half and the chicken is cooked.
recipes.title: 30-Minute Creamy Lemon Garlic Chicken

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Anti-Inflammatory. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Heat the oil in a 12-inch cast iron skillet over medium, add the carrots, broccoli and radishes, cover, and cook about 5 minutes.
Push them aside, press the beef flat in the pan, and season with salt and ginger. Brown 2 minutes per side, then break it up and stir in.
Add the zucchini and squash, cover, and cook about 5 minutes until the beef is done.
Uncover and cook 3–5 minutes until most of the liquid evaporates. Season and serve.
recipes.title: 30-Minute Vegetable and Ground Beef Skillet

recipes.notes: From the BuzzFeed/Tasty list 7 Quick Dinners To Make This Week (pinned on Jessica Lynn's Pasta board). The live site blocks automated reading, so this came from an archived copy. Calories, protein and weight are estimates with rice.
steps: Heat a large wok over high heat. Season the pork, add the oil, and sear the pork until golden on all sides, 6–8 minutes. Set aside. Add the onion, ginger and garlic and cook about 5 minutes until softened.
Whisk the stock, brown sugar, soy sauce, cornstarch, vinegar and pepper flakes, pour into the wok, bring to a boil, then simmer 3–4 minutes. Add the pork and red pepper and toss 2 minutes.
Serve over rice topped with cabbage, peanuts, cilantro and a squeeze of lime.
recipes.title: 30-Minute Vietnamese Caramel Pork Stir Fry

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. The original recipe is no longer online, so this is a similar recipe from Kosher.com. Makes 12–20 balls.
steps: Beat the cream cheese, peanut butter, vanilla sugar and honey together until smooth.
Scoop small balls with a cookie scoop onto a greased baking sheet.
Freeze for 1 to 2 hours, until firm.
Melt the milk chocolate in short bursts, stirring until smooth.
Dip each ball in the melted chocolate with a fork and let the extra drip off.
Return to the freezer for about 15 minutes.
Drizzle with melted white chocolate.
Keep in the freezer until ready to eat.
recipes.title: No-Bake Peanut Butter Cheesecake Balls

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Apps. Makes about 20 tbsp. Calories and protein are the site's figures per tablespoon.
steps: Blend everything in a food processor until smooth.
recipes.title: 5 Minute Creamy Whole30 Ranch

steps: Preheat the oven to 400°F. Halve the squash lengthwise, place on a parchment-lined pan, and rub the flesh with coconut oil.
Roast face up 45–60 minutes until soft.
Scoop out the seeds, flip, and cool 5–10 minutes, then peel off the skin.
Blend the squash with the coconut milk and seasonings until smooth. Refrigerate in an airtight container.
recipes.title: 5-Ingredient Butternut Squash Pasta Sauce (Nightshade-Free)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Breakfast. The page lists 8 flavor variations; this is the classic chocolate chip version. Other ideas: white chocolate cranberry, lemon poppy seed, trail mix (peanuts, raisins, M&Ms), almond coconut. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Stir the peanut butter, oats, flax and honey together in a large bowl, then stir in the mix-ins.
Chill 15–30 minutes so it's easier to roll (slightly damp hands help).
Roll into 12 bites. Keeps a week in the fridge.
recipes.title: 5-Ingredient Peanut Butter Energy Bites

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Calories and protein are my estimates from the ingredients. Servings (24) are my estimate.
steps: In the body of a stand mixer fitted with a paddle attachment, beat cream cheese and butter until light and fluffy, scraping down the sides as needed.
Add the sugar and beat well.
Add in flour, a small bit at a time, beating in on low speed, just until incorporated.
Cover bowl with plastic wrap and place in the refrigerator for at least 45 minutes, and up to 2 hours.
30 minutes prior to baking, preheat oven to 375 degrees (F).
Line a large baking sheet with parchment paper.

Using a cookie scoop, scoop out 1 tablespoon sized balls of dough, roll them into rounds, and place them on the cookie sheet. Lightly press your thumb in the center of each round. Fill each indentation with a 1/2 teaspoon of jam.
Place pan in the oven to bake for 11 to 12 minutes, or until just golden at the edges. They will still be very soft when you remove them from the oven - that's a good thing!
Cool on the baking sheet for 10 full minutes, then very carefully transfer to a cooling rack to cool completely.
recipes.title: 5-Ingredient Raspberry Cheesecake Thumbprint Cookies

ingredients.item: yellow tomatoes (cherry/grape whole; larger ones diced)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Pasta. Makes about 4 cups; servings (1/2 cup), calories, protein and weight are estimates, sauce only.
steps: Preheat the oven to 425°F and line a sheet pan with parchment.
Put the tomatoes, shallots and garlic on the pan.
Toss with the oil and season with salt and pepper.
Roast until the tomatoes wilt and brown in spots, 25–30 minutes.
Purée in a blender until smooth; strain if you want to remove the skins.
Season with more salt and pepper and a pinch of sugar if needed.
Stir in the basil and serve with pasta, poultry or seafood.
recipes.title: 5-Ingredient Roasted Yellow Tomato Sauce

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Anti-Inflammatory. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Froth everything in a milk frother until hot, or microwave in a mug 2 minutes, stirring halfway.
Stir again and serve.
recipes.title: 5-Minute Golden Milk (Turmeric Latte)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Apps. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.

Spread on the sour cream, then the guacamole.
Add the salsa, cheese, tomatoes, olives, green onions and cilantro, and squeeze lime over.
Refrigerate until serving (best the same day). Serve with tortilla chips or Fritos.

Coat a nonstick skillet well with coconut oil over low-medium heat.
Spoon in small pancakes (no more than 2 1/2 inches) and cook about 3 minutes until bubbling and setting, then flip.
For the sauce, simmer the sauce ingredients 3 minutes, stirring. It firms in the fridge, so rewarm to serve.
Top with sliced banana and carob sauce.

ingredients.item: pork or bacon fat, plus more for cooking
dried rosemary, dried thyme, garlic powder, ground ginger

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Anti-Inflammatory. Calories and protein are the site's figures per 2 oz; weight is an estimate.

Shape 8–10 even patties.
Cook in a lightly greased pan over medium 3–4 minutes per side until browned and 165°F inside.
Raw sausage keeps 2 days in the fridge; cooked keeps 3–4 days. Both freeze up to a month.

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Anti-Inflammatory. The live page now blocks access, so this comes from a 2023 web archive copy. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.

Sprinkle with the herbs and salt and pour the coconut milk over.
Cook on high 4–5 hours or low 7–8. Stir and serve, topped with bacon bits if you like.

Add the water, lemon juice and seasonings.
Seal and cook on manual high pressure 14 minutes, then release.
Cool slightly and blend until smooth. Season to taste.

Heat the oil to 375–400°F. Fry the shrimp a few at a time for 1–2 minutes, then drain on paper towels.
Serve warm with salt and a generous squeeze of lime.

Blend everything until smooth, scraping down as needed.

Put about 1 tbsp filling in the center of each wrapper, wet the edges, and fold into a triangle (or bring the corners together), pressing to seal.
Preheat the air fryer to 370°F and lightly spray the basket.
Arrange in a single layer without touching, spray the tops, and cook 8–10 minutes, flipping halfway, until golden and crisp.
Serve hot with dipping sauce.

Soak in a bowl of water 30 minutes, drain, and soak 30 minutes more in fresh water.
Drain and pat completely dry, then toss with the oil, salt and pepper.

Cook 7 minutes, shake, and cook 5–7 minutes more until crisp and golden. Serve right away.

Let the steaks sit out 20 minutes, then season with salt and pepper.
Preheat the air fryer to 400°F and cook the steaks 10–12 minutes, flipping halfway.
Rest 5 minutes and top with a slice of garlic butter.
recipes.title: Air Fryer Ribeye with Garlic Herb Butter

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. The recipe gives no serving count, so 4 is assumed. Calories, protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Brown the beef in the oil in a large skillet over medium-high, about 5 minutes.
Add the pierogis and cook 4–5 minutes until hot.
Stir in the broccoli, salt and pepper and top with the cheese.
Cover on low 4–5 minutes until the cheese melts.
recipes.title: All-in-One Pierogi Skillet

Whisk the almond flour, baking powder, salt and baking soda.
Whisk the melted butter with the Miracle Whip, then whisk in the eggs until smooth.
Stir the wet into the dry just until a batter forms.
Drop scoops onto the sheet and bake about 12 minutes until lightly browned. Cool a few minutes before serving.

Mix the almond flour and salt, then the butter and egg, into a smooth, slightly sticky ball.
Roll as thin as possible (about 1/8 inch) between parchment.
Cut into 1-inch squares and place on the sheets.
Bake 5–10 minutes until golden underneath, then cool so they crisp.

In a large mixing bowl, combine the coconut, sweetened condensed milk, chopped almonds, and chocolate chips.
Scoop the cookie dough into small mounds on the prepare cookie sheets. Wet your hands with water and then shape the mounds into round cookies and slightly flatten the tops of each cookie.
Bake at 325F for 12-14 minutes until golden brown around the edges. Cool the cookies on the baking sheet before serving.
recipes.title: Almond Joy Cookies

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Breakfast. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.

Refrigerate at least 6 hours.
Eat warm or cold.

pack Andes Creme De Menthe Thins ((or Andes baking chips))

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Calories and protein are the site's figures per serving (1 brownie).
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F. Line a 8 or 9-inch square baking pan with aluminum foil.
Combine the melted butter and cocoa powder until fully blended. Set aside.
Beat the eggs and sugar together on medium speed for about 5 minutes, until thickened.
Stir in the salt and vanilla, then the chocolate mixture until blended.
Mix in the baking powder and flour until just combined – do not over mix.
Add half of the brownie batter to the pan. Top with one package of the Andes candy.
Top the candy evenly with the remaining batter.
Bake for 30 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean.
Add chocolate chips to a large bowl.
Heat the heavy cream in a sauce pan over medium until simmering.
pour the hot cream over the chocolate chips and stir until the chocolate is fully melted and well blended.
Pour the ganache over the brownies and top with additional chopped Andes candies.
Allow to set at room temperature or place in the refrigerator to set faster.
Cut into 9 squares and serve.
recipes.title: Andes Mint Brownies

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Smoothies. The recipe is printed on the pin's picture (credited to Juicing-for-Health.com); the pin has no link. The steps are standard juicing steps. Calories, protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Wash and chop everything to fit your juicer (peel the pineapple).
Juice and serve right away, garnished with a pineapple wedge.
recipes.title: Anti-Inflammatory Carrot, Sweet Potato & Pineapple Juice

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Anti-Inflammatory. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Preheat the oven to 400°F and line a large baking sheet. Put the chicken on one side and the broccoli on the other.
Mix 2 tbsp melted coconut oil with 1 tsp turmeric, the onion powder, ginger, salt and pepper and coat the chicken and broccoli. Sprinkle the chicken with the other 1 tsp turmeric.
Bake 20–25 minutes until the chicken reaches 165°F, leaving the broccoli in 5–8 minutes longer for crispness.
Meanwhile cook the cauliflower rice in 1 tbsp coconut oil with salt and coconut aminos over medium 12–15 minutes until lightly browned.
Slice the chicken, top with parsley, and pack with the broccoli and cauliflower rice into 3 containers. Keeps 2–3 days.

optional toppings: yogurt, sliced almonds, or additional cinnamon

steps: Preheat your oven to 350°F (175°C).

Grease a baking dish with a bit of cooking spray or oil, then pour in the mixture and spread it evenly with a spatula.
Bake in the preheated oven for 30-35 minutes, or until the top is set and lightly golden.
Serve with optional toppings such as yogurt, sliced almonds, or extra cinnamon if desired.

Brown the roast in hot oil in a skillet over high heat, turning, about 10 minutes.
Stir the stock, soy sauce, garlic, five-spice and sugar together in the slow cooker.
Add the roast and arrange the onions, carrots and potatoes around it.
Cover and cook on LOW 8–9 hours or HIGH 4 hours.
Slice and serve with the vegetables and sauce, or pack into meal prep containers.

ingredients.item: asparagus, cut diagonally into 1–2 inch pieces

Add the sweet potato and broth to the pan, cover, and cook 7–10 minutes until tender.
Add the asparagus and cook 4–5 minutes.
Return the chicken and season with the salt, pepper and crushed red pepper.

Toast on a grill or in a hot skillet until browned on both sides.
Top the hot toast with the cold tomatoes and serve right away.

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Calories and protein are my estimates from the ingredients.
steps: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F.
Grease an 8 x 8 inch baking pan with coconut oil or line with parchment paper.
In a blender or food processor blend avocado, applesauce, maple syrup and vanilla.*
Add these wet ingredients to a large mixing bowl and whisk in eggs.
In a separate bowl, sift your coconut flour and dutch-processed cocoa powder. Mix in sea salt and baking soda.
Slowly add your dry ingredients to avocado mixture and stir until well-combined.
Stir in chocolate chips.
Add batter to baking dish and spread so top is even.

Season with pepper, drizzle with balsamic glaze, and scatter with basil.

Peel and roughly chop the eggs.
Mash the avocado with the lemon juice and salt (a little chunky is nice), then stir in the eggs.
Serve on toast or over greens.

Fill the avocado shells with the tuna salad and serve.
recipes.title: Avocado Tuna Salad

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Breakfast. EatingWell removed this page, so it comes from a 2022 web archive copy. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Preheat the oven to 350°F and generously spray a large rimmed baking sheet.
Whisk the eggs with the milk, salt and pepper. Pour onto the pan and top with the kale, red peppers, feta, bacon and za'atar.
Bake until just set, 20–25 minutes. Cut into 9 slices.
recipes.title: Bacon & Kale Sheet-Pan Eggs

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Breakfast. Calories, protein, weight and time are estimates (using egg whites).
steps: Preheat the oven to 350°F and generously grease a muffin tin (or use liners).
Put about 1 tbsp diced avocado (about 1/6 of an avocado) in each cup.
Crumble half a bacon slice over each, then sprinkle each with 1/4 tsp ranch seasoning.
Pour about 1/4 cup egg whites into each cup, almost to the top (or 1 scrambled whole egg per cup).
Bake 22–30 minutes until the eggs are cooked through.
recipes.title: Bacon Avocado Ranch Egg Muffins (Paleo, Whole30)

ingredients.item: onion powder, parsley, garlic powder, salt

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Preheat the oven to 400°F and bake the bacon on a sheet about 20 minutes until crisp; drain and chop.
Brown the beef in the oil and stir in the seasonings. Lift out with a slotted spoon.
Microwave the cauliflower rice 5 minutes and mix in the coconut flour and salt.
Sauce: melt the butter in the skillet, stir in the coconut flour over low, then the cream and mustard until thick.
In a 9x13: 1/2 cup sauce, the cauliflower, 4 oz cheddar, the beef, half the remaining sauce, the rest of the cheddar, the rest of the sauce, and the bacon.
Cover and bake 30 minutes, uncover 5 minutes, and rest 15–20 minutes before slicing.
recipes.title: Bacon Cheeseburger Cauliflower Casserole (Low Carb)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Calories are the site's figure; protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Bring a large pot of water to a boil.
Brown the beef with the onion in a large sauce pot over medium-high.
Boil the frozen pierogies 7 minutes, drain.
Stir the cream cheese, ketchup and bacon bits into the beef until melted, then add the milk, salt, pepper and garlic and bring to a boil.
Stir in the cornstarch dissolved in the water until the sauce thickens.
Off the heat, gently fold in the pierogies, cheese and green onions (save some of each to garnish).
recipes.title: Bacon Cheeseburger Pierogies

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Apps. The blog is gone, so this comes from a 2014 web archive copy (originally from Food.com). Calories, protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Pound the chicken to about 1/4 inch.
Mix the cream cheese and green onion, spread over one side, and roll up.
Wrap each with partially cooked bacon and secure with toothpicks.
Bake on a greased sheet at 375°F about 35 minutes, then broil about 5 minutes to crisp the bacon.
Variations: add crumbled blue cheese or a slice of good cheese before rolling.
recipes.title: Bacon Wrapped Cream Cheese Stuffed Chicken

ingredients.item: chicken breasts, butterflied or pounded thin
salt and pepper (or your favorite seasoning blend)

recipes.notes: From Pinterest board Foods I do like. Nutrition is the site's figure per serving. Try adding sundried tomatoes or blue cheese to the guacamole.
steps: Lay the chicken flat and season the outside with salt and pepper.
Spread a quarter of the guacamole on each breast, roll up, and wrap each in 2 slices of bacon.

Grill over indirect medium heat with the lid down until the bacon is crispy and the chicken reaches 160–165°F, 20–30 minutes. Or bake at 400°F on a wire rack set on a pan for 20–30 minutes, broiling the last few minutes to crisp the bacon.
recipes.title: Bacon Wrapped Guacamole Stuffed Chicken

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Breakfast. Makes 16 roll-ups; a serving here is 2. Calories, protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Cook the bacon in a skillet over medium-high, stirring, until crispy, 10–15 minutes. Drain on paper towels.
Meanwhile, melt the butter in another large skillet over medium. Beat the eggs with the water, salt and pepper and scramble 5–8 minutes until cooked through.
Preheat the oven to 375°F. Unroll one package of crescents (keep the other chilled) into 8 triangles.
Put about 1 tbsp each of bacon, egg and cheese in the middle of each triangle and roll up from the wide end, tucking and pinching the sides.
Bake on a baking sheet 12 minutes until golden, filling the second package while the first bakes. Rest 2–3 minutes and serve warm.
Fridge 1–2 days, or freeze on a sheet 20 minutes then bag; thaw overnight and reheat at 350°F.
recipes.title: Bacon, Egg and Cheese Crescent Breakfast Roll-Ups

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Soup. The site's 207 kcal per serving is low for 12 oz of cheddar plus bacon in 8 servings, so calories and protein are my estimates. Weight is an estimate.
steps: Whisk the flour with 1/4 cup broth and set aside.
Crisp the bacon in a large pot over medium and drain, leaving 1 tbsp fat. Sauté the onion and celery with salt and pepper 8–10 minutes, then the garlic 1 minute.
Add the cauliflower and water, cover, and steam 5–7 minutes until tender.
Add the rest of the broth, the milk and hot sauce and bring to a simmer. Whisk in the flour mixture and simmer 3–4 minutes until thick.
Off the heat, stir in 2 cups cheddar a little at a time, then half the bacon. Season, and serve topped with the remaining cheese, bacon and green onions.
recipes.title: Bacon-Cheddar Cauliflower Chowder

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Serves 2–4 as a side. Simply Recipes blocks automated reading, so this comes from a 2019 web archive copy. Calories, protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Preheat the oven to 400°F and snap off the woody ends (peel the bases if you like).
Spread on a foil-lined sheet, coat with the oil, and sprinkle with salt, pepper and parmesan.
Bake 8–10 minutes until the cheese starts to brown.
recipes.title: Baked Asparagus with Parmesan

ingredients.item: ground beef, chicken or turkey (or 3–4 cups lentil filling, seasoned tofu, or beans + sautéed veggies)
optional toppings: sour cream or Greek yogurt, jalapeños, avocado or guacamole, salsa, pico de gallo, crushed tortilla chips

recipes.notes: From Pinterest board Foods I do like. Nutrition is the site's figure per serving (2 pepper halves) with a meat filling.
steps: Preheat the oven to 400°F. Cook your taco filling of choice.
Halve the bell peppers and remove the stems and seeds.
Bake the pepper halves on a baking sheet 8–10 minutes for crisp-tender, or 10–15 for softer.
Fill each pepper to the brim with taco filling and top with cheese.
Bake 10 more minutes, then pile on your favorite toppings.
recipes.title: Baked Bell Pepper Tacos

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. The recipe doesn't give a cauliflower size; 1 head is assumed. Calories, protein and weight are estimates, without the ranch.
steps: Whisk the ranch ingredients, adjust the seasoning, and refrigerate.
Preheat the oven to 450°F. Whisk the batter ingredients smooth and toss the cauliflower in it to coat.
Set a sprayed rack on a foil-lined sheet and spread out the cauliflower. Bake 20 minutes until starting to brown.
Whisk the melted butter, hot sauce and honey, adjusting heat and sweetness to taste.
Toss the cauliflower in the sauce, return to the re-sprayed rack, and bake 10 minutes more. Serve with the ranch.
recipes.title: Baked Buffalo Cauliflower Bites with Dairy-Free Ranch

ingredients.item: boneless skinless chicken breasts, halved lengthwise into 8 cutlets

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Pasta. Nutrition is the site's figure for 1 cutlet (not counting pasta); serving weight is an estimate.
steps: Preheat the oven to 450°F and lightly spray a large baking sheet.
Mix the breadcrumbs and Parmesan. Brush the chicken lightly with butter, dip in the crumbs, and lay on the sheet.
Spray the tops lightly and bake 25 minutes.
Top each piece with 1 tbsp marinara and 1 1/2 tbsp mozzarella.
Bake 5 minutes more until the cheese melts.
recipes.title: Baked Chicken Parmesan (Skinnytaste)

ingredients.item: cilantro, green onion, sweet chili sauce

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Mexican. A serving is 2 tacos. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Whisk the marinade, toss with the chicken, and refrigerate at least 30 minutes.
Sauté the chicken in the olive oil over medium-high 8–10 minutes until cooked.
Preheat the oven to 350°F. Turn a muffin tin upside down, drape the wonton wrappers between the cups to make taco shapes, spray with oil, and bake 10 minutes until crisp.
Whisk the slaw dressing and toss with the coleslaw.
Fill each shell with chicken and slaw and top with cilantro, green onion and sweet chili sauce.
recipes.title: Baked Chicken Wonton Tacos

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. The original recipe is no longer online, so this is a similar recipe from Cuisine & Travel.
steps: Preheat the oven to 400°F. Mix the salt, pepper and paprika in a small bowl.
Spray a baking dish with avocado oil. Season both sides of the chicken generously and lay it in the dish.
Top each piece with minced garlic, then parmesan and parsley. Give the tops a light spray of oil.
Bake 15 minutes, until cooked through (165°F). Garnish with more parsley.
recipes.title: 15-Minute Baked Garlic Parmesan Chicken

ingredients.item: red, yellow and orange bell peppers

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Preheat the oven to 400°F. Cut the tops off the peppers, core them, and trim a sliver off the bottoms so they stand.
Stand them in a sprayed 9x13 and bake 15 minutes; lower the oven to 375°F.

Meanwhile sauté the onion in the oil 3–5 minutes, then the garlic 1 minute. Add the beef, salt, pepper and pepper flakes and cook 5 minutes. Stir in the oregano, basil, 2 tbsp parsley and marinara and simmer 5 minutes.
Mix the ricotta, parmesan, nutmeg and 3 tbsp parsley.
Layer meat sauce, ricotta, then more meat sauce in each pepper.
Cover with foil and bake 20 minutes, then top with mozzarella and bake uncovered 5–10 minutes. Garnish with parsley.
recipes.title: Baked Lasagna Stuffed Peppers

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Apps. The site lists 236 kcal (likely for several sticks), so calories, protein and weight here are my estimates per stick.
steps: Preheat the oven to 400°F.
Set up bowls of flour, eggs beaten with the milk, and the mixed breadcrumbs.
Coat each piece in flour, egg, then crumbs, and set on a parchment-lined sheet.
Freeze about 30 minutes.
Drizzle with the butter and bake 8–10 minutes. Serve with warm pizza sauce.
recipes.title: Baked Mozzarella Cheese Sticks

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Apps. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Preheat the oven to 450°F and line baking sheets with parchment.
Toss the zucchini with the oil.
Mix the crumbs, parmesan, salt and pepper and coat the slices on both sides in batches.
Arrange close together, sprinkle the tops with a little leftover crumb mix, and bake 10 minutes until browned.
Sprinkle the other side with the remaining crumbs and bake 10 minutes more. Serve right away with ranch.
recipes.title: Baked Parmesan Zucchini Chips

ingredients.item: King's Hawaiian sweet dinner rolls, cubed

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Breakfast. Calories, protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Beat the cream cheese, 1/3 cup confectioners' sugar and cinnamon with a paddle on medium until fluffy, 2–3 minutes.
Whisk the milk, pumpkin, eggs, pumpkin spice and vanilla.
Spray a 9x13 dish. Layer half the bread cubes, pour over half the pumpkin mixture, spread on the cream cheese filling, then top with the rest of the bread and pumpkin mixture.
Cover and refrigerate at least 2 hours or overnight.
Preheat the oven to 350°F.
For the crumb topping, rub the cold butter into the flour, brown sugar and cinnamon with your fingers until coarse crumbs form, and sprinkle over the top.
Bake 35–45 minutes until golden.
Serve right away with pecans and a dusting of confectioners' sugar.
recipes.title: Baked Pumpkin Cream Cheese French Toast

ingredients.item: fresh dill (or thyme, rosemary or parsley)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Preheat the oven to 400°F and cut four 14-inch sheets of foil.
Put about 8 asparagus spears in the center of each. Mix the oil and garlic, drizzle 1 tsp over each pile, and season.
Season the salmon, lay it on the asparagus, drizzle each with 1 tsp more garlic oil, season, and top with 2 dill sprigs and 2 lemon slices.
Fold the foil in to seal and bake on a sheet 20–30 minutes until the salmon is cooked.
recipes.title: Baked Salmon and Asparagus in Foil

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Preheat the oven to 450°F and line a rimmed sheet. Lay the salmon skin side down.
Stir the parsley, garlic, oil, lemon juice, Dijon, salt and pepper together.
Brush generously over the tops and sides and add a lemon slice to each.
Bake uncovered 12–15 minutes, to 145°F at the thickest part. Don't overcook.
recipes.title: Baked Salmon with Garlic and Dijon

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Apps. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Preheat the oven to 350°F. Slice the tops off the slab of rolls and set the bottoms back in their box.
Cover the bottoms with Havarti, then a slice of turkey per roll, and replace the tops.
Whisk the butter, Dijon, Worcestershire, poppy seeds and onion and brush over the tops.
Wrap tightly in foil and bake 15–20 minutes until melted and warm.
recipes.title: Baked Turkey Havarti Sliders

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Smoothies. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Blend the banana, almond milk, yogurt, almond butter, flax, honey and almond extract until combined.
Add ice if you like and blend smooth. Serve right away.
recipes.title: Banana Almond Flax Smoothie

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Anti-Inflammatory. Calories and protein are the site's figures per pancake; weight is an estimate.
steps: Mix everything into a thick, smooth batter.
Heat a greased pan or griddle over medium-high and scoop a little under 1/4 cup per pancake, spreading it slightly since they don't spread on their own.
Cook 2–3 minutes until golden underneath, flip, and cook 1–2 minutes more.
recipes.title: Banana Almond Flour Pancakes

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Anti-Inflammatory. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Preheat the oven to 360°F (180°C).
Mash the bananas and mix in the maple syrup, oil and lemon juice.
Mix the flour, arrowroot and baking soda, then stir in the wet ingredients. Gently fold in the blueberries.
Fill a lined or oiled muffin pan (6–8 muffins) and bake about 20 minutes until a knife comes out clean.
recipes.title: Banana Blueberry Muffins (Vegan, Paleo, AIP)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Breakfast. Calories and protein are the site's figures; serving weight is an estimate.
steps: Blend the banana, cottage cheese, almond milk, maple syrup and vanilla until smooth.
Pour into a jar and whisk in the chia seeds. Wait 5 minutes and whisk again.
Refrigerate at least 2 hours or overnight.
Top with crushed vanilla wafers before serving.
recipes.title: Banana Cream Pie Blended Chia Pudding

ingredients.item: bananas, sliced into 1/2-inch coins and frozen

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Anti-Inflammatory. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Let the frozen banana thaw a few minutes in the food processor or blender.
Pulse to break it up, then blend until smooth, scraping down as needed (a few minutes). Add milk only if it won't blend.
Serve as soft serve, or freeze until firm and soften 5 minutes before scooping.
recipes.title: Banana Nice Cream

ingredients.item: optional toppings: banana slices, coconut shreds, chopped walnuts

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Breakfast. Calories and protein are the site's figures; serving weight is an estimate.
steps: Mash the banana in a bowl until no large chunks remain.
Stir in the chia seeds, almond milk and vanilla.
Cover and refrigerate at least 2 hours, preferably overnight.
To serve, squeeze half a SunButter pouch into a jar, add pudding, squeeze the rest on top, and add toppings.
recipes.title: Banana Whole30 Chia Pudding

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Cook the garlic in a lightly greased pan over medium-high until fragrant, then the chicken until cooked and browned.
Boil and drain the pasta.
Whisk the sauce ingredients smooth.
Toss the pasta and chicken with 2/3 of the sauce, warm the rest, and spoon it over each plate. Garnish with parsley.
recipes.title: Bang Bang Chicken Pasta

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Lunch. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Sear the chicken in 1 tbsp oil over medium-high until cooked; set aside.
Wilt the spinach in the same pan with a little salt; set aside.
Cook the cauliflower rice in the remaining oil until tender-crisp and season.
Whisk the sauce.
Pack the cauliflower rice, spinach, chicken and a lime wedge into 4 containers with sauce in small cups. Reheat, then drizzle with sauce and lime.
recipes.title: Bang Bang Chicken with Cauliflower Rice (Meal Prep)

ingredients.item: buffalo or hot sauce, e.g. Frank's (sauce)
coconut aminos or low-sodium soy sauce (sauce)
optional: water to thin, extra hot sauce or chili flakes, lime

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Serves 2–4. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Preheat the oven to 400°F. Mix the sauce ingredients and refrigerate.
Pat the salmon dry, oil it lightly on a baking sheet, and coat with the mixed seasonings.
Brush with some of the sauce (keep the rest) and bake 6–8 minutes.
Brush on the remaining sauce and broil 2 minutes.
recipes.title: Bang Bang Salmon

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Asian. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Brown the pork in a skillet. Meanwhile slice the vegetables and whisk the coconut aminos, arrowroot and ginger.
Cook the cauliflower rice per the package.
Add the garlic to the pork for 2–3 minutes, lower the heat, pour in the sauce, and stir 1 minute until sticky.
Divide the cauliflower rice into bowls and top with the pork and vegetables.
Whisk the mayo and sriracha and drizzle over.
recipes.title: Banh Mi Bowl (Paleo, Whole30)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Anti-Inflammatory. A serving is 1 tbsp. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Blend everything until combined, season to taste, and refrigerate up to 2–3 days.
recipes.title: Basil Balsamic Vinaigrette

ingredients.item: olive oil (amount not stated in the recipe)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. The original recipe card leaves out the olive oil amount; 1/3–1/2 cup is a typical amount for this much pesto. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Pulse the basil, mint, parsley, garlic and almonds in a food processor until coarsely chopped.
Add the parmesan and half the oil and blend again.
Scrape down the sides, then drizzle in the rest of the oil with the motor on low.
Stir in salt and pepper. Makes about 1 cup.
recipes.title: Basil Mint Pesto

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Slow Cooker. Makes about 96 meatballs; a serving here is 4 meatballs with sauce. Calories, protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Put the meatballs, BBQ sauce and grape jelly in the slow cooker.
Cook on HIGH 3 hours.
Keep on WARM until ready to serve.
recipes.title: BBQ and Grape Jelly Crockpot Meatballs

ingredients.item: bell peppers, halved lengthwise and seeded

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Great for leftover pulled pork. Calories, protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Halve the peppers so each half sits flat, and scoop out the seeds.
Fill each half with pork and top with BBQ sauce, a slice of gouda and crisscrossed bacon.
Grill over indirect medium heat 30–40 minutes until the peppers are tender and the bacon is cooked.
recipes.title: BBQ Pulled Pork Stuffed Peppers with Smoked Gouda and Bacon

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Mexican. The site lists ingredients without amounts, so the amounts here are typical ones I filled in. Calories are the site's figure; protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Preheat the oven to 375°F.
Brown the beef with the onion, garlic, chili powder, cumin, salt and pepper.
Layer tortillas, beef, enchilada sauce and cheese in a baking dish.
Repeat, finishing with plenty of cheese.
Bake 20–25 minutes until bubbly, then rest a few minutes before serving.
recipes.title: Beef Enchilada Casserole with Corn Tortillas

ingredients.item: ground mustard, cayenne, ground ginger, cinnamon
low-sodium beef stock, plus more as needed
to serve: basmati rice, warm naan, plain Greek yogurt

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Asian. The last steps are summarized from the site. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Toss the beef with the salt and pepper.
Brown it in the hot oil in a large skillet over medium-high, about 6 minutes, and set aside.
Lower to medium and cook the onion 15 minutes, stirring, until caramelized. Add the garlic 2 minutes, then the spices 1 minute, then the tomato paste.
Deglaze with the vinegar 2–3 minutes, scraping up the browned bits.
Add the stock and return the beef. Cover and simmer gently about 1 1/2 hours, adding stock as needed, until the beef is very tender.
Serve with rice, naan and a spoonful of yogurt.
recipes.title: Beef Vindaloo

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Apps. Calories, protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Sauté the green onion and garlic in 1 tbsp oil in a nonstick skillet over medium 2 minutes, then toss in the chicken and chili powder until warm.
Off the heat, stir in the salsa and olives and season.
Preheat the oven to 350°F. Cut the peppers into 2-inch pieces, seed them, press flat, and arrange close together on a large sheet.
Spoon on the chicken mixture and top with cheddar.
Bake 15 minutes until melted, top with cilantro, and serve right away.
recipes.title: Bell Pepper Chicken Nachos

recipes.notes: From Pinterest board Foods I do like. Calories, protein and weight are estimates for 1 egg ring.
steps: Heat the olive oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat.
Cut the pepper into 1/2-inch rings and remove the seeds. Add the rings to the pan and sauté for a minute.
Crack an egg into the center of each ring, pouring slowly so it seals and doesn't leak.
Season with salt and pepper. Cook 3 minutes, then carefully flip.
Top generously with Parmesan. Cook another minute for runny (over-easy) yolks.
recipes.title: Bell Pepper Egg-in-a-Hole

ingredients.item: yellow curry powder, plus more for dusting
pre-cooked fine German bratwurst (or bockwurst, knockwurst)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Sauté the onion in the oil over medium 4–5 minutes until soft.
Lower to medium-low and cook the garlic and curry powder 1 minute.
Add the ketchup and bring to a gentle simmer (a splatter guard helps).
Stir in the vinegar, brown sugar, Worcestershire, salt, paprika and mustard and cook a few minutes until thick.
Blend smooth and keep warm.
Grill or pan-fry the sausages (simmer first if raw) until crisp on all sides.
Cut into thick pieces, smother with the sauce, and dust with curry powder.
recipes.title: Berliner Currywurst with Authentic Curry Ketchup

ingredients.item: Cups All Purpose Flour (Plus More For Pans)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Calories and protein are my estimates from the ingredients. Servings (16) are my estimate.
steps: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Grease & Flour Three 9 inch pans. (Sister Schubert Roll pans work great if you don't have enough pans around your house!)
Line bottom of pans with parchment paper
Combine flour, sugar, baking soda, cinnamon, and salt. Add eggs and vegetable oil. Blend until combined.
Add carrots and pecans (pecans are optional)
Pour into pans. Bake for 40 minutes.
Cool for 4 minutes, then remove from pans and cool completely.
Frost with cream cheese frosting and enjoy!
Mix all ingredients except for nuts in medium bowl and beat until fluffy with a mixer.
Stir in the nuts.
Spread over each cake layer and enjoy!
recipes.title: Best Carrot Cake Recipe (Based on Paula Deen Carrot Cake)

ingredients.item: olive oil, plus more for cooking

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Anti-Inflammatory. For AIP, skip the pepper. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Mix everything into a smooth dough that holds together.
Divide into 10 balls and roll or press each thin on parchment, dusting with cassava flour if sticky.
Cook in a lightly oiled pan over medium-low 1–3 minutes per side, soft or crisp as you like.
recipes.title: Best Ever 5-Minute Cassava Flour Tortillas

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Pat the pork dry. Stir the lemon juice, garlic, herbs, oil, salt, pepper, Dijon and honey together.
Marinate the pork in half the mixture in a zip bag 30 minutes; keep the rest.
Grill over medium on oiled grates with the lid closed 15–20 minutes, turning every few minutes and brushing with the reserved marinade halfway.
Rest 5 minutes before slicing.
recipes.title: Best Ever Healthy Grilled Pork Tenderloin

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Nutrition is per 2 tbsp of dressing; calories, protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Shake the dry mix ingredients together in a spice jar (makes about 6 tbsp; use it anywhere a ranch packet is called for).
For dressing, whisk 1 tbsp dry mix with the mayo, buttermilk, sour cream and lemon juice and refrigerate.
recipes.title: Best Homemade Ranch (Small-Batch Mix and Dressing)

ingredients.item: light corn syrup or dark corn syrup
packed light or dark brown sugar

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Calories and protein are the site's figures per serving (1 serving).
steps: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Add pecans to the unbaked pie shell.
In a large bowl, stir together the eggs, corn syrup, brown sugar, melted butter, vanilla, cinnamon, and salt. Pour the mixture over the pecans.
Bake for 55-60 minutes or until the center has just a slight jiggle but the edges are stable and set. Cool for at least 2 hours before slicing.
recipes.title: Best Pecan Pie Recipe

ingredients.item: red bell peppers, cored and sliced

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Breakfast. Calories and protein are the site's figures; time and weight are estimates.
steps: Heat the fat in a large skillet over medium-high. Add the peppers and 1/2 tsp salt and sauté 5 minutes, until wilted and starting to brown.
Add the cumin, paprika and thyme and sauté 1–2 minutes until fragrant.
Add the meat, tomatoes and remaining salt, breaking up the meat. Stir in the garlic and simmer 15 minutes over medium-low.
Make 4 wells and crack an egg into each. Cover about 5 minutes to cook gently, basting the whites with sauce if needed.
Top with herbs (and chèvre, feta or cheddar if not Whole30). Good with sautéed greens.
recipes.title: Best Shakshuka with Ground Meat (Paleo, Whole30)

ingredients.item: diced tomatoes and green chiles, drained

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Apps. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Blend the potatoes, cashews, garlic, chiles, jalapeños (not the reserved 1/4 cup), jalapeño juice, broth, coconut milk, lemon juice, garlic powder, nutritional yeast, cumin, salt, tapioca and turmeric until very smooth.
If your blender doesn't heat it, warm in a saucepan over medium-low, stirring constantly.
Season, then stir in the reserved jalapeños and the drained tomatoes and chiles.
Garnish with cilantro and serve warm.
recipes.title: Best Vegan Queso Blanco (Paleo)

ingredients.item: cooked chicken breast or shrimp, bite-size

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Asian. Serves 5–6. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Cook rice to make 4 cups (day-old rice works best).
Stir-fry the onion, garlic, peas and carrots in the sesame oil over medium until tender.
Crack in the eggs and scramble them through the vegetables.
Add the rice, chicken or shrimp and soy sauce, stir to combine, and remove from the heat.
recipes.title: Better Than Take-Out Fried Rice

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Breakfast (originally from Lemon-Sugar). That site now redirects to a spam domain, so the link has been removed; this came from a 2021 web archive copy. Calories, protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Preheat the oven to 400°F and spray a small (about 7x10) casserole dish.
Quarter the biscuits, layer half in the dish, and bake 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, brown the sausage in a heavy skillet over medium-high until cooked. Sprinkle with the flour and stir until absorbed.
Lower to medium and cook 3–5 minutes, stirring often.
Stir in the milk, salt and pepper and stir often until it comes to a slight boil. Adjust the seasoning (more pepper is good). It should be thick but still slightly runny; add milk if needed.
Pour the gravy over the baked biscuits and top with the remaining raw biscuit quarters.
Set on a baking sheet and bake 20–25 minutes until golden, covering with foil for the last 10 minutes if browning too fast.
recipes.title: Biscuits and Gravy Casserole

ingredients.item: biscuits (e.g. Bisquick, baked while the gravy cooks)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate (gravy only).
steps: Brown the sausage in a large skillet and blot off excess grease.
Return it to the pan and stir in the flour to coat.
Gradually add milk over medium heat, cooking and adding until the gravy is as thick as you like.
Season with salt, pepper and cayenne and serve over biscuits.
recipes.title: Biscuits and Sausage Gravy

ingredients.item: black bass fillets, skin lightly scored
oil-cured black olives, pitted and chopped

recipes.notes: From the BuzzFeed/Tasty list 7 Quick Dinners To Make This Week (pinned on Jessica Lynn's Pasta board). Calories, protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Heat the oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat. Season the fish and cook skin-side down until golden and crisp, about 5 minutes. Turn it, add the garlic, olives and rosemary, and cook, stirring the aromatics, until the fish is opaque, about 3 minutes.
Swirl in the orange juice. Divide the radicchio and fish among plates and spoon the warm vinaigrette over.
recipes.title: Black Bass with Warm Rosemary-Olive Vinaigrette

ingredients.item: collard greens, kale or spinach, chopped

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Soup. The site's 200 kcal and 3 g protein are low for a cup of coconut milk and a can of beans in 4 servings, so calories and protein are my estimates. Weight is an estimate.
steps: Cook the onion and pepper in the oil over medium-high about 3 minutes, then the garlic and green onion 1 minute.
Add the squash, beans, Italian seasoning and thyme, then the coconut milk, broth, bouillon, allspice and cayenne. Boil, then simmer 20 minutes.
Stir in the greens for about 4 minutes. Serve with brown rice and avocado.
recipes.title: Black Bean Butternut Squash Stew (Vegan)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Mexican. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Heat the oil, add the tomato paste, flour and spices, and whisk 1 minute. Slowly whisk in the broth, boil, then simmer about 8 minutes until slightly thick. Season.
Preheat the oven to 375°F. Wilt the spinach in a pan 1–2 minutes.
Mix the beans, 3/4 cup cheese, spinach, corn, green onions, cilantro and cumin.
Coat a 9x13 dish with a little sauce. Fill and roll the tortillas and place seam side down.
Pour over the rest of the sauce, sprinkle with the remaining cheese, and bake about 20 minutes.
recipes.title: Black Bean Spinach Enchiladas

ingredients.item: all purpose flour, plus more for rolling
unsalted butter, cold and cut in pieces
egg yolk mixed with 2 teaspoons water

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Calories and protein are the site's figures per serving (1 serving).
steps: Start by making the crust. Pulse the flour and salt a few times in a food processor to combine. Add the cold chunks of butter and shortening to the bowl and pulse about 20 times until the mixture is grainy.

Add the ice water, a little at a time, while continuing to pulse, until the dough just comes together when you pinch it between your fingers. Stop the machine to check it. NOTE: you may not need all of the water, but I always do.

Turn the dough out onto a floured surface and bring it together into a ball. If there is still any remaining dry flour make sure to knead that into the dough to get it all incorporated. If your dough is too sticky, add a touch more flour.
Cut the ball of dough in half, form two flat rectangles, and wrap each one in plastic. Refrigerate the dough for 2 hours (or overnight) before rolling it out.

While the dough is chilling make the filling. This step can also be made the day before if you like. Put the berries into a saucepan. Mix the sugar and Clearjel thickener together and add to pan along with the lemon juice. Starting on low and then increasing the heat to medium high, cook the berries until they start to soften and the sugar has dissolved. Mash the berries with a fork as they soften. Stir almost constantly.
Cook for about 8 minutes, or until it's the consistency of a runny jam. I like to mash most of the berries. Chill the filling until ready to use.
Preheat the oven to 350F

Lay out a sheet of parchment large enough for a baking sheet and lightly flour it. Roll out one of the pieces of dough to (roughly) a 9x13 rectangle. Don't stress, if it's close, that's fine. It helps to let the dough rest for a few minutes to warm up slightly before trying to roll it out.
Spoon the jam over the top, leaving about an inch all around free.
Roll out the top crust, and carefully place over the jam filling, pressing down all around the edges to seal. if you've got excess dough you can roll it up a bit.
Brush with the egg wash and bake for about 40 minutes until golden. Let cool before glazing.

To make the glaze whisk or stir the sugar together with the water, a tablespoon at a time, until you get a glaze consistency. Brush it liberally over the top of the cooled pie. Let dry before slicing.
recipes.title: Blackberry Pie Bars

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Calories and protein are the site's figures per serving (1 serving).
steps: Preheat oven to 350F. Line the bottom of two 6" spring form cake pans with rounds of parchment paper.
In a food processor mince sweet potato. Then in a blender combine all ingredients for cake until smooth.
Divide batter in-between the two cake pans. Bake on 350F for 45-50 minutes then chill in freezer while you make frosting.

For frosting, steam sweet potato cubes, then drain water, and chill in ice bath until cool. Then blend ingredients for frosting together in food processor until smooth and chill until ready to frost. See recipe notes on how to top off the cake. Store in fridge.
recipes.title: Blackout Healthy Paleo Chocolate Cake

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Lunch. Calories and protein are the site's figures per roll; weight is an estimate.
steps: Cook the bacon until crisp and drain.
Dip a rice paper wrapper in warm water until soft and lay it flat.
Layer lettuce, tomato, avocado, 2 slices bacon and mayo, then roll tightly away from you, leaving the ends open.
Slice in half and repeat.
recipes.title: BLT Summer Rolls with Avocado

ingredients.item: fresh raspberries, plus more for the sherbet cups
pink or raspberry lemonade concentrate, thawed

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Drinks (Tasty via BuzzFeed). Calories, protein, weight and servings are estimates.
steps: Line a muffin tin with cupcake liners, put 4–5 raspberries in each, and top with a scoop of sherbet. Freeze at least 2 hours.
Mix the juice concentrates, raspberries and vodka in a large pitcher.
Just before serving, stir in the ginger ale.
Put a sherbet scoop in each mug, fill halfway with punch, and top with champagne. Garnish with mint.
recipes.title: Boozy Bubbly Sherbet Punch

ingredients.item: cooked Italian chicken sausage, out of casing (sausage version)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Breakfast. The recipe gives two mix-in versions (ham & cheddar, or chicken sausage, sun-dried tomato & feta); pick one. Calories and protein are the site's figures per biscuit; serving weight is an estimate.
steps: Preheat the oven to 400°F and line a baking sheet with parchment.
Whisk the yogurt and eggs in one bowl. In another, mix the flour, flaxseed, garlic powder, red pepper flakes, baking powder and salt.
Slowly mix the dry ingredients into the wet.
Mix in your chosen version's vegetables, herbs and meat (for the ham version, 1 cup of the cheddar too), using your hands if needed.
With floured hands, shape 12 one-inch-thick biscuits (about 1/3 cup each) and space them on the sheet (use 2 if needed). Top with the remaining cheese.
Bake 5 minutes at 400°F, then lower to 350°F and bake 20 minutes more without opening the oven, until golden underneath.
recipes.title: Breakfast Protein Biscuits

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Anti-Inflammatory. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Preheat the oven to 400°F and line a baking sheet.
Squeeze the shredded sweet potato dry, then mix everything well.
Roll into 1-inch balls (20–25), flatten slightly, and place on the sheet.
Bake 25–28 minutes, flipping halfway, until 165°F (crisp in a pan or under the broiler if you like).
Serve, or refrigerate or freeze for make-ahead breakfasts.
recipes.title: Breakfast Sausage Sweet Potato Chicken Poppers

ingredients.item: water (to come halfway up the brisket)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. The page is gone, so this comes from a 2014 web archive copy. Calories, protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Pat the brisket dry and season with salt and lots of pepper.
Heat a heavy lidded pot a little bigger than the brisket over high 3 minutes, film with oil, and sear the brisket 4–5 minutes per side until golden.
Push it aside, add the onions, and cook 2–3 minutes until wilted. Season.
Add water halfway up the meat, bring to a boil, then cover and simmer on the lowest heat 5 hours, flipping occasionally, until buttery tender.
Season and serve with potatoes. It's even better the next day: chill, skim the fat, and reheat covered over medium-low at least 20 minutes.
recipes.title: Brisket with Slow-Cooked Onions

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Anti-Inflammatory. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Whisk the broth with the arrowroot and set aside.
Sauté the onion and garlic in the oil over medium 2–3 minutes, then the squash 3–4 minutes.
Add the broth, boil, then simmer 12–15 minutes until the squash is soft. Blend smooth.
Add the broccoli, carrot, salt and pepper and simmer 10 minutes until the broccoli is soft.
Stir in the coconut cream, nutritional yeast and turmeric for a minute, season, and top with bacon.
recipes.title: Broccoli "Cheese" Soup (Paleo, AIP, Whole30)

ingredients.item: dried cranberries or raisins (unsweetened for Whole30)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Anti-Inflammatory. Calories, protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Mix the dressing.
Toss the broccoli, apple, onion, carrots, bacon and cranberries with the dressing.
Chill at least a few hours before serving.
recipes.title: Broccoli Apple Salad (AIP, Paleo, Whole30)

ingredients.item: light garlic-herb spreadable cheese (Boursin or Alouette)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Apps. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Preheat the oven to 350°F and butter an 11x7 (2-quart) dish.
Steam the broccoli and let it cool slightly.
Mix the broccoli, cheese spread, eggs, butter and onion.
Stir in 1 cup cheddar, the cornbread mix and seasonings.
Pour into the dish, top with the rest of the cheddar, and bake 30–35 minutes until golden and a toothpick shows moist crumbs.
recipes.title: Broccoli Cheese Cornbread

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Combine the broth, garlic, water, soy sauce, Worcestershire, bay leaf and peppercorns in a fondue pot and bring to a simmer.
Dip the meat, shrimp and vegetables in the broth until cooked through.
recipes.title: Broth Fondue (Beef, Shrimp & Veggies)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Calories and protein are the site's figures per serving (1 serving).
steps: Preheat the oven to 350°F (180°C). Spray oil in an 8-inch x 8-inch square baking dish. Set aside.
In a large bowl, stir dry ingredients: oats, cocoa powder, baking powder, and salt.
Whisk in wet ingredients: mashed banana, milk, yogurt, coconut oil, vanilla extract, and maple syrup.
Fold in the chocolate chips and chopped pecan or coconut, and stir to combine evenly.
Pour the mixture into the prepared baking dish and add a few more chocolate chips on top, if desired.
Bake on the center rack of the oven until the baked oatmeal is set, not jiggly in the center, and golden brown on top.
After 30-35 minutes, it is a soft, moist baked oatmeal. That's my favorite way, and remove the pan from the oven at this time.
Bake for 40-45 minutes for a dry and firm texture.
Let it cool down completely or for at least 20 minutes before serving. Then, cool completely before storing in the fridge, in its baking dish covered with a piece of foil for up to 4-5 days.
Serve cold or lukewarm with a dollop of Greek yogurt or extra almond milk.
recipes.title: Brownie Baked Oatmeal

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Breakfast. One large serving (or 2 small). Protein is the site's figure; calories and weight are estimates.
steps: Mix the dry ingredients in a 16 oz mason jar.
Add the milk and sweetener and stir hard for about 30 seconds to break up every cocoa clump.
Refrigerate at least 4 hours, preferably overnight.
recipes.title: Brownie Batter Protein Overnight Oats

ingredients.item: cream cheese (2 - 8oz bricks (and 1/4 of another 8oz brick), softened to room temperature)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. The live recipe card didn't load, so this comes from a 2016 web archive copy. Calories and protein are my estimates from the ingredients.
steps: BROWNIE LAYER:

Preheat oven to 350 degrees F. Line bottom of a 9" springform pan with parchment paper and spray paper and sides of pan with cooking spray (I use a baking spray, but you could use regular spray and lightly dust with flour instead).
In a small saucepan, melt butter and chocolate until smooth, over low heat, stirring often.
Turn off heat and whisk in sugar. Set aside to cool for 5-10 minutes, stirring often.
To a mixing bowl, add in melted chocolate mixture, milk and eggs, whisking quickly so the residual heat doesn't cook the eggs.
Use a wooden spoon to stir in flour until just combined. Pour batter into prepared pan in an even layer, and bake for 25 minutes.
CHEESECAKE LAYER:
Remove brownie pan from the oven and set aside.
Reduce oven temperature to 325 degrees F.
Using a stand mixer (or hand mixer), beat all cheesecake ingredients together until mixture is smooth. Take care not to mix too quickly, or air bubbles will form.
Pour cheesecake batter over brownie layer in pan.
Bake for 50 minutes, until center is slightly jiggly (or when an instant read thermometer inserted into the center reads 150.
Remove from oven and cool at room temperature, with the pan on a wire rack for 30 minutes to 1 hour.
Place pan in the refrigerator for 4 hours, or overnight to chill and firm up to that amazing cheesecake consistency.
COOKIE DOUGH LAYER:
In a stand mixer (or hand mixer), cream together butter and both sugars on MED-HIGH speed until light and fluffy.
Beat in sweetened condensed milk and vanilla extract.
Beat in salt and flour. Stir in mini chocolate chips.
Use an offset spatula to gently spread cookie dough over the top of the cooled cheesecake.
This is done most easily when the spring has been undone and the cheesecake is free from the sides of the pan.
If you can't spread the cookie dough, gently press pieces together to "spackle" the cookie dough onto the cheesecake.
FINISH THE CHEESECAKE:
Microwave milk chocolate chips and vegetable oil in 30 second bursts (stirring each time), until nearly melted. Stir to melt remaining lumps.
Drizzle melted chocolate over the top of the cheesecake.

To slice, use a long, thin knife. Dip knife blade into very hot water, shake off excess and slice carefully. Between each slice, use a paper towel to wipe off cake crumbs and reside, then dip knife into the hot water again before slicing.
recipes.title: Brownie Bottom Cookie Dough Cheesecake

ingredients.item: One batch Best Ever Brownies batter -- instant coffee omitted* (http://sugarspunrun.com/best-ever-brownies/)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. The live recipe card didn't load, so this comes from a 2016 web archive copy. Calories and protein are my estimates from the ingredients.
steps: Preheat oven to 325F
Prepare brownie batter according to Best Ever Brownies instructions (or package instructions, if using box-mix).

Spread evenly into the bottom of a greased and floured 9x13 pan (alternatively, line the pan with foil and then lightly spray with cooking spray -- this will make it easy to lift the brownie/cheesecake out of the pan and make clean cuts once its cooled).
Bake on 325F for 20 minutes, or until center is almost set (it should not still be liquid, and the edges will appear somewhat cooked).
As the brownie layer bakes, prepare your cheesecake.

In a stand mixer (or in a large bowl with a hand-mixer), beat together softened cream cheese and sugar, scraping down the sides with a spatula occasionally to ensure it is mixed well. (beat on medium-speed about 1-2 minutes, scraping down side occasionally, it should be creamy and well-mixed).
Add sour cream & mix well, stopping once to scrape down the sides before mixing again.
Add eggs, one at a time, beating until just mixed after each addition (and scraping down the sides after each addition)
Stir in vanilla extract.
Once brownie layer has finished baking (do not turn off your oven), evenly, gently, spread the cheesecake over the brownie layer.
Bake on 325F for 40 minutes, or until center is set (not liquidy, bounces back to the touch).
Allow to cool to room temperature, and then place in refrigerator for at least 6 hours before cutting and serving.
recipes.title: Brownie Cheesecake Bars

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Calories and protein are the site's figures per serving (1 serving).
steps: Preheat the oven to 350°F.
In a large mixing bowl, combine 1 box (18 oz) brownie mix, 1 cup flour, 3 eggs, and ? cup vegetable oil.
Stir the mixture with a wooden spoon or sturdy plastic spoon until fully combined. The dough will be very thick.
Place ½ cup powdered sugar in a small bowl.
Scoop the cookie dough using a cookie scoop and roll each dough ball in the powdered sugar until coated.
Place the cookies 2 inches apart on an ungreased baking sheet.
Bake for 8–10 minutes, until the cookies are set.
Remove from the oven and allow the cookies to cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes.
Transfer the cookies to a wire rack to cool completely.
Serve and enjoy!
recipes.title: Brownie Cookies

ingredients.item: canola or vegetable oil, or melted butter
scoop ice cream or 1–2 tsp heavy cream, to serve

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Calories and protein are my estimates from the ingredients.
steps: Stir the flour, sugar, cocoa, salt and cinnamon in a microwave-safe mug.
Stir in the oil, water and vanilla until smooth.
Microwave on high until cooked but still moist: about 1 minute 40 seconds at 1000 W or 1 minute 10 seconds at 1650 W (start at 60 seconds if unsure).
Cool a minute and top with ice cream or cream.
recipes.title: Brownie in a Mug (Simply Recipes)

ingredients.item: cocoa powder (I used dark chocolate Hershey's)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Calories and protein are the site's figures per serving (2 oz).
steps: Add dry ingredients to mug and stir (use 12 oz. mug or larger because it will rise a bit).
Add wet ingredients to mug and stir until mixed. (except peanut butter)
Put tbsp. of peanut butter in middle of mix and push down a bit so it is submerged into brownie batter. (optional add in)
Microwave for 60 seconds...done!!
Note: if you allow it to cool for 5 minutes it will solidify more if you want it more cakier and less ooey gooey
recipes.title: Brownie in a Mug Recipe

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Calories and protein are the site's figures per serving (1).
steps: Preheat your oven to 350 degrees. In the bowl of an electric mixer, cream together the butter, sugar and brown sugar on medium speed until light and fluffy, about a couple minutes. Reduce the speed to low and mix in one egg at a time, making sure to wipe down the sides of the bowl in between each addition. Mix in the vanilla extract.

Mix in the flour, cocoa powder, baking soda and salt on low speed until a thick batter forms. Fold the chocolate chips in with a rubber spatula. Gently press the brownie batter into a greased or parchment lined 9×9 pan. Its ok if the batter is thick and this may take a moment to gently push it into a flat layer in the pan.
Bake for 35-38 minutes or until a toothpick inserted into the middle comes out clean. Let the brownies cool completely in the pan before frosting.

In the bowl of an electric mixer, cream together the butter and brown sugar on medium-high speed until light and fluffy, about a few minutes. Add in the powdered sugar, flour and vanilla extract and whip until smooth and fluffy, a few more minutes.
Mix in the heavy cream until smooth. If it’s still a little too thick, add in a little bit more heavy cream until creamy enough. Fold the chocolate chips in with a rubber spatula.
Once the brownies are completely cooled, frost with the cookie dough frosting. Enjoy!
recipes.title: Brownies with Cookie Dough Frosting

ingredients.item: boneless, skinless chicken breasts, sliced in half horizontally into thinner pieces (amount not given; about 3 large for 6 servings)
salt and pepper, for the chicken
salt and pepper, for the topping (don't oversalt!)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Recipe from the live Pioneer Woman page (the old link now redirects to thepioneerwoman.com/food-cooking/recipes/a10610/bruschetta-chicken/). The post's printable card is the bruschetta topping; the chicken method comes from the post text, which gives no chicken amount. Servings (6), calories, protein and serving weight are estimates; the site's 169 calories and 3 g protein are for the bread appetizer version, not this dish.
steps: Heat the olive oil in a small skillet over medium-high heat. Add the garlic and stir for about a minute, taking it off before it gets too brown (golden is fine). Pour it, oil and all, into a mixing bowl and let it cool slightly.
Add the tomatoes, balsamic vinegar, basil, salt and pepper to the bowl. Toss to combine, then taste and add more basil or salt if needed (don't oversalt).
Cover and refrigerate the topping for an hour or two if you have the time.
Slice the chicken breasts in half horizontally to make two thinner pieces each, and season them with salt and pepper.
Grill the chicken until cooked through, or sauté it in a skillet if that's easier.
Serve the chicken with a green salad, pile the bruschetta topping on top or alongside, and finish with a sprinkling of fresh Parmesan. Add a chunk of bread on the side if you like.
recipes.title: Bruschetta Chicken (Pioneer Woman)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Lunch. The post's title mentions chicken patties, but the recipe is just the egg salad. Calories are the site's figure; protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Boil the eggs and chill them in ice water so they peel easily.
Mash the avocado in a bowl.
Peel the eggs, discard (or save) the yolks, and dice the whites.
Mix in the cucumber, cilantro, lime juice, coriander and yogurt and season.
recipes.title: Budget Avocado Egg White Salad

ingredients.item: unsweetened coconut milk (refrigerated carton, not canned)
vegan buffalo sauce (e.g. Primal Kitchen dairy-free)
tortillas or wraps, plus your favorite toppings

recipes.notes: From Stacey Homemaker (her card calls it a Buffalo Cauliflower Wrap). Calories are the site's figure for 1 wrap; tortillas and toppings aren't in her ingredient list.
steps: Preheat the oven to 425°F.
Cut all of the florets off the head of cauliflower.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the oat flour, garlic powder, smoked paprika, black pepper, salt and coconut milk. Stir until the lumps dissolve and the batter is smooth.
Add the cauliflower florets to the batter and stir with a large spoon to coat each piece.
Pour the panko into a small bowl. Use tongs to dip each floret into the breadcrumbs, turning to coat every side. Arrange on a parchment-lined tray and bake 15 minutes.
Remove the tray. Carefully move the cauliflower to a large bowl, pour the buffalo sauce over and gently toss to coat. Return the florets to the tray and bake another 10–12 minutes, until crispy.
Fill tortillas or wraps with the cauliflower, your favorite toppings and sauce.
recipes.title: Buffalo Cauliflower Tacos

ingredients.item: hot pepper sauce (e.g. Frank's or Tabasco), to taste

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. The blog has moved, so this comes from a 2014 web archive copy. Calories, protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Melt the oil and butter in a pot over medium, cook the onion until translucent, then the garlic 2–3 minutes.
Stir in the cream cheese until melted, then the wing sauce and a few dashes of hot sauce. Spread a little in a 9x13 and stir the chicken into the rest.
Layer noodles, half the chicken, half the ranch; noodles, the rest of the chicken and ranch; then a final layer of noodles topped with the mozzarella.
Bake uncovered at 350°F about 25 minutes. Serve with ranch or blue cheese and carrot and celery sticks.
recipes.title: Buffalo Chicken Lasagna

steps: Preheat the oven to 400°F and grease a tray.
Pulse the onion, celery, carrot, celery leaves and garlic in a food processor until finely minced.
Mix with the chicken, eggs, panko, cheddar, green onion, blue cheese dressing, hot sauce, pepper and salt. Shape in a loaf pan and turn out onto the tray.
Spread half the buffalo sauce on top and bake 45 minutes.
Pour on the rest of the sauce and bake 15 minutes more, to 165°F inside.
Rest 10 minutes, then top with blue cheese, green onion and a drizzle of dressing.
recipes.title: Buffalo Chicken Meatloaf

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Apps. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Mix the quinoa, beans, panko, egg, salt, pepper and 1/4 cup buffalo sauce.
Scoop 16 balls (2-tbsp scoop), flatten each, put a pinch of blue cheese in the center, and fold to enclose, squeezing to seal.
Air fry in a single layer at 375°F for 8 minutes, turn, and air fry 8 minutes more until crisp.
Toss in the remaining buffalo sauce.
recipes.title: Buffalo Quinoa Bites (Air Fryer)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Calories, protein and weight are estimates, with bun and cheese.
steps: Stir the hot sauce, garlic powder, salt and milk in a large bowl, mix in the turkey and breadcrumbs, then gently fold in the blue cheese.
Shape into 6 patties.
Cook in a sprayed skillet over medium-high about 7 minutes per side until cooked through, melting a cheese slice on top at the end.
Serve on buns with your toppings.
recipes.title: Buffalo Turkey Burgers

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Lunch. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Halve the ciabatta and toast it with a little oil.
Rub the cut sides with the garlic.
Layer on the tomatoes, season, and drizzle with oil.
Add the burrata and pesto, then halve the sandwich.
recipes.title: Burrata Caprese Sandwich

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Calories, protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Pat the roast dry and coat with the Cajun seasoning (score any fat cap). Sear on all sides in a very hot oiled skillet and move to the slow cooker.
Melt the butter in the skillet, scraping up the browned bits, and sauté the garlic, thyme and pepper flakes 2 minutes.
Pour the butter over the roast. Cook on High 3–4 hours or Low 5–6.
Rest the roast under foil. Pour the juices into a saucepan, whisk in the broth mixed with the cornstarch, season, and boil 1 minute to thicken.
Slice and serve with the gravy.
