recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. The site is gone, so this comes from a 2012 web archive copy. Quantities are loose; calories, protein and weight are estimates for 1 lb shrimp and about 3 cups broccoli.
steps: Melt the butter in a nonstick pan and sauté the shrimp about a minute.
Add the garlic and cook together, seasoning with salt, pepper and pepper flakes.
Add the water and broccoli and cook 2–3 minutes, keeping the broccoli crisp and green.
Serve with rice or couscous.

ingredients.item: great northern beans, drained and rinsed

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Soup. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Brown the turkey, drain, and set aside.
Sauté the carrot, onion and celery in the oil in a Dutch oven 3–4 minutes, then the garlic and thyme 1 minute.
Add the squash, beans, turkey and broth, boil, then simmer 15 minutes.
Stir in the cream and kale and simmer 4–5 minutes until wilted.
Top with avocado, cheddar or tortilla chips.
recipes.title: Butternut Squash Chili

ingredients.item: whole turkey, neck and giblets removed
peanut oil for frying, or as needed

recipes.notes: From Pinterest board Foods I do like. Calories and protein are Allrecipes' figures; serving weight is an estimate of carved meat. Fry outdoors, away from the house, and make sure the turkey is fully thawed and dry.
steps: Melt the butter in a large saucepan over medium heat. Add the beer, onion juice, garlic juice, hot sauce, Worcestershire, black pepper and cayenne and mix well.
Inject the marinade into the turkey (legs, back, wings, thighs and breasts) with a marinade injector. Put the turkey in a large food-safe bag and refrigerate 8 hours or overnight.
Put the turkey in the fryer basket and discard leftover marinade. Measure the oil by lowering the turkey into the empty fryer and filling with oil until covered, then remove the turkey.
Heat the oil to 365°F. Slowly lower the turkey in and fry about 3 minutes per pound (about 36 minutes for 12 lb), until the thickest part of the thigh reads 165°F.
Turn off the flame, slowly lift the turkey out letting the oil drain from the cavity, and rest about 20 minutes before carving.
recipes.title: Cajun Deep-Fried Turkey

ingredients.item: cinnamon sugar (about 2 tbsp cinnamon to 1/2 cup sugar)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Calories and protein are my estimates from the ingredients.
steps: Line a Dutch oven (or old cake pan) with heavy foil and grease it with a little butter.
Cut each biscuit into quarters and shake a few at a time in a bag of cinnamon sugar, then drop into the pan.
Melt the butter over the fire, stir in the brown sugar, and pour over the biscuits.
Cover with foil (and the lid), and bake in dying coals at about 350–375°F for 5–10 minutes until puffed and cooked through, avoiding direct bottom heat. A camp stove, camp oven or grill works too.
Cool a bit and pull apart.
recipes.title: Campfire Monkey Bread

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Calories and protein are my estimates from the ingredients.
steps: Heat the oven to 300°F and line a large baking sheet with parchment.
Whisk the sugars, cinnamon, salt and cayenne.
Toss the pecans with the egg white, then with the sugar mixture.
Spread in one layer and bake 20 minutes, stir, then bake about 20 minutes more until fragrant.
Cool on the sheet; the coating hardens as it cools.
recipes.title: Candied Pecans

ingredients.item: vanilla wafers or graham crackers, (for serving)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Calories and protein are the site's figures per serving (1 /10th of recipe).
steps: In a medium bowl, beat the cream cheese until smooth. Add the ricotta, powdered sugar, and cinnamon and beat until combined. Stir in 1 cup of the chocolate chips.

Lay out 2 pieces of plastic wrap perpendicular to each other. Dump the mixture out into the center. Gather the plastic up around the mixture and shape into a ball shape. Refrigerate for 2-4 hours, or overnight.
Place the remaining chocolate chips on a plate. Remove the cheeseball from the plastic wrap onto the chocolate chips. Roll in the chocolate chips to coat.
Serve the cheese ball with vanilla wafers or graham crackers.
recipes.title: Cannoli Cheese Ball

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Calories and protein are the site's figures.
steps: Preheat the oven to 350°F. In a large bowl or standing mixer, beat the sugar, oil, cocoa, eggs and milk. In another bowl, combine the flour, salt and baking powder. Gradually add the dry mixture to the wet until well blended. Fold in the chocolate chips and 1/2 cup of the walnuts.
Spoon two-thirds of the batter into a greased 13x9-inch baking pan. Bake for 12 minutes.

Meanwhile, in a large saucepan, heat the caramels and condensed milk over low heat until the caramels are completely melted. Stir frequently to keep the caramel from sticking or burning. Pour the caramel mixture over the baked brownie layer, then sprinkle the remaining 1/2 cup of walnuts over the top.
Drop the remaining chocolate batter by the teaspoonful over the caramel and walnut layer. Carefully swirl this batter with a butter knife.

Bake the brownies again until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out with moist crumbs, 35 to 40 minutes longer. It's important not to overbake, which will dry out the brownies. Cool the brownies completely on a wire rack, then cut them into squares.
recipes.title: Caramel Brownies

ingredients.item: chopped fresh thyme, oregano and parsley
red bell pepper, roasted and diced
shallot, small bell pepper, celery stalk, finely diced (potato salad)
Creole mustard and yellow mustard (potato salad)

mushroom stock: 1 tbsp grapeseed oil, 1/2 cup onion, 1 cup celery, 1 cup carrots, 1 bunch green onions, 4 garlic cloves, 3 cups mushroom stems, 8 parsley sprigs, 6 thyme sprigs, 6 bay leaves, 1 tsp salt, 1 quart water

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. A restaurant recipe from Chef Danny Trace of Brennan's in Houston, so it's a project. Calories, protein and weight are rough estimates.
steps: Mushroom stock: cook the chopped vegetables, mushroom stems and herbs in the oil over high 5–10 minutes, add the salt and water, boil, then simmer uncovered 1 hour and strain.
Gravy: boil the stock, almond milk and rice 5–7 minutes, blend smooth, and season.
Potato salad: blanch the diced potatoes until tender and chill; sauté the shallot, pepper and celery until tender and chill; mix everything and season.

Preheat the oven to 425°F and a fryer to 350°F. Slice the cauliflower into thick 'steaks', season with Creole seasoning and herbs, and steam-roast in a dish with water halfway up for about 10 minutes until fork tender.
Whisk the soda water, beer, cornstarch, Creole seasoning and half the salt and pepper into a tempura batter. Season the flour with the rest.
Dredge the cauliflower in flour, then batter, and fry 2–3 minutes until golden. Drain and season.
Plate on the potato salad, drizzle with gravy, and top with arugula and roasted pepper tossed in cane vinegar.
recipes.title: Cauliflower "Chicken Fried" Steak with Mushroom Gravy (Brennan's)

ingredients.item: whole plum tomatoes in thick purée
spaghetti or other pasta (or zoodles or spaghetti squash)
fresh basil and grated Parmesan, to serve

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Pasta. Calories and protein are the site's figures; serving weight is an estimate with pasta.
steps: Halve the cauliflower, remove the core, and cut into large chunks.
Pulse in a food processor in batches until crumbly (or finely chop).
Heat the butter in a large heavy pot over low heat and cook the onion until soft, 3–5 minutes.
Add the cauliflower, raise to medium, and cook 10–12 minutes, stirring, until it softens and turns light golden. Add the garlic for 30 seconds.
Stir in the tomatoes, lentils, vinegar, sugar, herbs, red pepper, salt and pepper.
Cover and bring to a gentle boil, then simmer covered on low about 30 minutes. Uncover and cook 15 minutes more until thick and the lentils break down. Season.
Cook the pasta and serve topped with the sauce, basil and Parmesan. The sauce keeps a week in the fridge or 2 months frozen.
recipes.title: Cauliflower Bolognese

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Meal Prep. Makes 5 buns. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Preheat the oven to 400°F. Mix everything except the sesame seeds; it should be wet but not liquid.
Grease a muffin-top pan (or line a baking sheet).
Press 1/2 cup lightly packed mix into each mold, or shape 4-inch discs just over 1/2 inch thick, compacting them so they hold together. Sprinkle with sesame seeds.
Bake 20–25 minutes until golden and cooked through. Loosen with a thin spatula and cool slightly.
recipes.title: Cauliflower Bread Buns

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Lunch. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Preheat the oven to 450°F. Pulse the cauliflower into crumbs about half the size of rice grains.
Microwave in a large bowl 2 minutes, stir, 3 minutes, stir, then 5 minutes, until soft. Cool, then squeeze out as much water as possible in a towel.
Mix with the egg, parmesan and seasoning into a paste and shape 4 squares on a parchment-lined sheet.
Bake until golden and firm, then carefully lift off.
Sandwich the cheddar between 2 'slices' and cook in a skillet (or bake) until melted.
recipes.title: Cauliflower Crusted Grilled Cheese

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Asian. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Pulse the cauliflower florets in a food processor until they look like rice (or chop very finely).
Heat the sesame oil in a large skillet or wok over medium and cook the onion, peas and carrots until tender.
Push them aside, scramble the eggs in the empty space, and mix together.
Add the cauliflower and soy sauce and stir-fry until heated through and tender. Top with green onions.
recipes.title: Cauliflower Fried Rice

recipes.notes: From Pinterest board Foods I do like. Makes 3–4 sandwiches. Read from an archived copy of the Delish page. Calories, protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Cut the cauliflower into florets and pulse in a food processor until it looks like rice (or grate it).
In a medium bowl, mix the cauliflower, eggs, Parmesan and oregano until even, then season with salt and pepper.
Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium heat and spray with cooking spray. Scoop the mixture into two small patties on opposite sides of the pan; these are your "bread" slices.
Press the patties flat with a spatula and cook until golden underneath, about 5 minutes. Flip and cook about 3 minutes more.
Top one slice with cheddar, set the other slice on top, and cook until the cheese melts, about 2 minutes per side.
Repeat with the remaining mixture.
recipes.title: Cauliflower Grilled Cheese

ingredients.item: dried basil, dried oregano, garlic powder
suggested Greek toppings: olive oil, feta, mozzarella, kalamata olives, red onion, cherry tomatoes, parsley

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Calories, protein and weight are estimates for the crust only (half each).
steps: Pulse the dry florets in a food processor into 'snow'.
Microwave covered 4–5 minutes, cool on a towel, then wring out as much water as you can.
Preheat the oven to 450°F with a cookie sheet inside.
Mix the cauliflower with the cheeses and seasonings, then the egg, and press into a 1/4-inch crust on oiled parchment.
Slide onto the hot sheet and bake 8–11 minutes until golden.
Add toppings and bake 5–7 minutes more.
recipes.title: Cauliflower Pizza Crust

ingredients.item: flour (spelt, white, oat, gluten-free or almond)
fine breadcrumbs or almond flour, for rolling

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Sides. Makes about 25 tots; a serving is 5. Calories, protein and weight are my estimates.
steps: Line a baking sheet with parchment (or grease the air fryer tray).
Steam the cauliflower until very soft, drain, and cool.
Preheat the oven to 425°F (or the air fryer as close as it goes).
Mix the baking powder, garlic powder, salt, flour and oregano.
Squeeze the cauliflower dry in a towel, mash smooth, and mix in the dry ingredients (add a little water if too dry).
Shape into tots and roll in the crumbs.
Bake about 25 minutes until crisp, or air fry about 10 minutes, shaking halfway.
recipes.title: Cauliflower Tater Tots (Oven or Air Fryer)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Anti-Inflammatory (EatingWell). Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Brown the cauliflower with the salt in the oil over medium-high about 2 minutes.
Add the water, cover, and cook 3–5 minutes until tender.
Add the chickpeas and sauce and heat 1–2 minutes.
Off the heat, stir in the butter and top with cilantro.
recipes.title: Cauliflower Tikka Masala with Chickpeas

ingredients.item: star anise, plus more to garnish

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Anti-Inflammatory. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Bring everything to a boil in a pot, then cover and simmer on low 5–10 minutes.
Remove the star anise and blend 1 minute until smooth.
Serve in mugs garnished with star anise.
recipes.title: Chai Spiced Coconut Milk (Dairy-Free)

ingredients.item: decaf chai tea concentrate (found in the tea section of grocery stores)*

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Calories and protein are my estimates from the ingredients.
steps: In a medium mixing bowl, stir together yogurt, honey, and vanilla. Add chai tea concentrate and whisk together until smooth.
Fill popsicle molds with yogurt mixture and place in freezer for four hours, or until completely frozen.**
When ready to serve, run popsicle molds under warm water to loosen the popsicles. Remove and serve immediately.
recipes.title: Chai Tea Latte Popsicles

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Soup. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Brown the beef in a 3-quart saucepan, drain, and set aside.
Sauté the onion, carrots, celery, basil and parsley in 1 tbsp butter about 10 minutes, then press in the garlic for 1 minute.
Add the broth, potatoes and beef, boil, then cover and simmer 10–12 minutes until tender.
Melt the remaining butter in a small skillet, stir in the flour, and cook 3–5 minutes until bubbly. Stir into the soup and boil 2 minutes.
Lower the heat, add the cheese, milk, salt and pepper, and stir until melted. Off the heat, stir in the sour cream.
recipes.title: Cheeseburger Soup (Taste of Home)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Apps. Calories, protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Blend the sauce ingredients in a food processor and season.
Heat the oil in a large skillet or Dutch oven over medium-high.
Gently mash the avocados and fold in the tomato, onion, cilantro, lime juice, salt and pepper.
Spoon filling onto each wrapper, fold the bottom over, tuck in the sides, roll up, and seal the edge with water.
Fry in batches 2–3 minutes until golden, drain, and serve right away with the sauce.
recipes.title: Cheesecake Factory Avocado Egg Rolls (Copycat)

ingredients.item: garlic powder, sweet paprika, dried thyme, dried oregano

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Preheat the oven to 400°F.
Cut a deep pocket into the side of each breast, not all the way through.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a cast iron skillet over medium-high. Mix the seasonings.
Rub the chicken with the remaining oil and the seasoning, stuff each with mozzarella and 3 asparagus spears, and secure with toothpicks.
Sear about 4 minutes per side, then bake 12–15 minutes to 165°F.
Rest 5–8 minutes, remove the toothpicks, and finish with lemon.
recipes.title: Cheesy Asparagus Stuffed Chicken Breasts

ingredients.item: eggs, poached or cooked as you like

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Calories, protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Prick the potatoes and bake at 425°F for 30 minutes, then at 350°F for 30–40 minutes more. Cool 5 minutes.
Split each open, push the flesh apart, and fill with black beans and fontina (return to the oven briefly to melt).
Toss the arugula with the oil, lemon, salt and pepper, pile it on top, and finish each with an egg.
recipes.title: Cheesy Black Bean Stuffed Sweet Potatoes with Arugula + Poached Eggs

ingredients.item: grated Pepper Jack or mozzarella, plus extra for topping
Frank's Red Hot sauce, plus extra to taste
toppings: green onion, ranch or blue cheese dressing, crumbled blue cheese or feta, pickled red onion, sour cream

recipes.notes: From Pinterest board Foods I do like. Nutrition is the site's figure for 1 pepper half.
steps: Preheat the oven to 400°F.
Put the shredded chicken (rotisserie or leftover works) in a medium-large bowl.
Halve the bell peppers and scoop out the stems and seeds.
Lay the pepper halves on a baking sheet and bake 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, seed and finely mince the jalapeño, if using.
Add the yogurt, cream cheese, grated cheese, jalapeño and hot sauce to the chicken. Mix well and season with salt and pepper.
Stuff the peppers to the brim and top with a little extra cheese.
Bake another 10–15 minutes until hot and melty (10 for crisp peppers, 15–20 for soft).
Finish with your choice of toppings.
recipes.title: Cheesy Buffalo Chicken Stuffed Peppers

ingredients.item: diced rotisserie or other cooked chicken

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Preheat the oven to 350°F and grease a 9x13 (an 8x8 works too).
Mix everything except the corn flakes and butter right in the dish.
Sprinkle with the corn flakes and drizzle with the butter.
Bake 30–35 minutes until hot through.
recipes.title: Cheesy Chicken Broccoli and Rice Casserole

ingredients.item: tortilla strips, avocado, extra cheese, sour cream, cilantro, pico de gallo

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Soup. Serves 6–8. Calories, protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Sauté the onion in the oil in a large pot over medium-high 5 minutes, then the garlic 1 minute.
Add the stock, chicken, enchilada sauce, beans, tomatoes, chiles and cumin and bring to a simmer.
Whisk the masa harina into 2 cups of the hot broth and stir it back into the soup.
Stir in the cheeses until melted and season.
Serve with lots of toppings.
recipes.title: Cheesy Chicken Enchilada Soup

ingredients.item: boneless skinless chicken breasts, thin or pounded

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Preheat the oven to 375°F.
Score one side of each breast with shallow cuts, season both sides with the garlic powder, onion powder, Italian seasoning, salt and pepper, and rub in the oil. Lay in a baking dish cut-side up.
Mix the tomatoes, garlic, red onion, oregano, salt and pepper and spoon over the chicken. Top with the mozzarella.
Bake 25–30 minutes, then broil about 2 minutes to brown the cheese. Garnish with basil.
recipes.title: Cheesy Chicken Mozzarella Bake

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Pasta. The live site blocks automated reading, so this came from an archived copy. Calories and protein are the site's figures; serving weight is an estimate.
steps: Brown the beef and sausage together in a large skillet over medium-high heat and drain.
Combine the meat, marinara, mushrooms and tomatoes in the slow cooker. Cover and cook on LOW 6–8 hours.
Stir in the tortellini, sprinkle with the mozzarella and cheddar, cover, and cook 15 minutes more on LOW until the tortellini is tender.
recipes.title: Cheesy Crockpot Tortellini

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Apps. Calories, protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Halve the loaf lengthwise.
Mix the garlic into the butter and spread over both cut sides.
Sprinkle with parmesan, then mozzarella and oregano.
Bake at 350°F about 10 minutes, then broil until the cheese starts to brown. Cool slightly and slice.
recipes.title: Cheesy Italian Garlic Bread

ingredients.item: grated cheddar, plus a little more

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Calories, protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Cook the bacon crisp and drain.
Mix the cream cheese and cheddar and microwave on low in 10-second bursts until smooth.
Wilt the spinach in a pan with a couple teaspoons of water.
Spread half of each tortilla with the cheese mixture, add spinach, crumbled bacon and a little more cheddar, and fold.
Cook on a hot griddle 10–15 seconds per side until crisp (it burns fast).
recipes.title: Cheesy Spinach & Bacon Quesadillas

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Calories, protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Sauté the onion in the butter over medium-low about 4 minutes. Raise to medium, stir in the flour 2 minutes, then whisk in 1 cup cold milk.
At a simmer, add the rest of the milk, the soup, salt and pepper and cook until thick. Set aside.
Boil the noodles 1 minute less than the package says and drain.
Mix the noodles, sauce, tuna, peas and 2/3 of the cheese. Preheat the oven to 350°F.
Spread in an oiled 9x13, top with the rest of the cheese, and sprinkle with the breadcrumbs mixed with the oil.
Bake 35 minutes until browned and bubbly.
recipes.title: Chef John's Tuna Noodle Casserole

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Sauté the garlic and shallot in 2 tbsp of the butter over medium until soft. Add the cream and reduce by half.
Lower the heat and whisk in the rest of the butter 2 tbsp at a time until smooth. Stir in the Old Bay.
Gently fold in the crab without breaking up the lumps, finish with parsley, and serve as soon as it's warm (don't raise the heat or the butter will separate). Great over steak or fish.
recipes.title: Chesapeake Crab Butter Sauce

ingredients.item: + 1 tablespoon all-purpose flour (**see notes for measuring**)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Calories and protein are the site's figures per serving (1 cookie).
steps: Brown the butter over medium heat in a large stainless steel pan. While it cooks, it will foam, pop, and crackle. This is normal! Stand nearby, watch, and stir it occasionally so it doesn’t burn. When the bottom is covered in brown bits of butter and it smells nutty, remove the pan from the heat.

You should have just slightly under 1 cup of browned butter (184 grams). Pour it into a glass measuring cup and let it chill in the fridge, stirring it every 20 minutes, for about 45-60 minutes, until a thermometer reads 70–75°F. It should feel cool and remain completely liquid.
Preheat the oven to 350°F(180°C). Line two baking trays with parchment paper and set them aside.

Spread the pumpkin puree onto a plate. Press a stack of paper towels into it and soak up the extra liquid. Then scrape the pumpkin into a pile and re-spread it around the plate. Use a new stack of paper towels to keep absorbing the extra liquid until the pumpkin feels pretty dry, like soft playdough, and now measures roughly 1/3 cup (68-75 grams).
When the butter is cool, whisk in the brown sugar and granulated sugar for 1 minute. It should look like wet sand.
Whisk in the egg yolks, vanilla, and dried pumpkin puree.

Fold in the flour, pumpkin spice, salt, cream of tartar, and baking soda until just combined. Set the bowl of dough in the fridge for 5 minutes to firm up. If the dough is still soft, you can chill it for longer!

Meanwhile, in a small bowl, combine the cinnamon and the sugar. Scoop the dough into 3 tablespoon-sized balls and roll each dough ball in the cinnamon sugar. Place them on the prepared baking sheet, spaced 2-3 inches apart.
Bake the cookies one tray at a time for 10-12 minutes or until the edges are golden brown and the middle is puffy and slightly underbaked. Let the tray cool completely on a wire rack, then enjoy!
Store leftover cookies in an airtight container at room temperature for 2-3 days. If you choose to freeze the cookie dough balls, let them come to room temperature before baking.
recipes.title: Chewy Pumpkin Snickerdoodle Cookies

ingredients.item: Dutch processed cocoa powder ((or substitute natural unsweetened baking cocoa))

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Calories and protein are the site's figures per serving (1 serving).
steps: Line two baking sheets with parchment paper and SPRAY with nonstick spray.

In a large bowl, whisk together powder sugar, cocoa powder, and salt. Stir in egg whites and vanilla extract until the batter is completely moistened. It will be very, very thick. Stir in the chocolate chips.

Spoon the batter on the sprayed parchment lined sheets, about 1 tablespoon per scoop (Using a small cookie scoop makes this very easy!) You will end up with about 12 mounds per sheet. Let the cookie sheets rest for 30 minutes before baking*, meanwhile preheating oven to 350ºF.
Bake for 10-12 minutes until tops are glossy and lightly cracked. The edges will be set and the middle slightly undercooked.
Let the cookies cool for 10 minutes on the baking sheet before gently transferring them to a cooling rack to finish cooling.
recipes.title: Chewy, Fudgy Flourless Chocolate Cookies

ingredients.item: green onions (whites minced, greens in 1-inch pieces)
red pepper flakes and sesame seeds (optional)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Asian. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Prepare the noodles per the package and whisk the sauce ingredients.
Cook the chicken in the oil in a wok or deep 12-inch pan over medium-high about 6 minutes (shrimp about 1 1/2 minutes per side). Set aside.
Sauté the pepper and carrots 1–2 minutes, then the garlic, green onions and sprouts 1 minute.
Push the vegetables aside and scramble the eggs in the center.
Add the chicken, noodles and sauce and toss 1–2 minutes. Serve with cilantro, peanuts, pepper flakes and sesame seeds.
recipes.title: Chicken (or Shrimp) Pad Thai

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Pasta. Calories and protein are the site's figures; serving weight is an estimate.
steps: Preheat the oven to 350°F and grease a 9x13 dish (or two 8x8 dishes to freeze one).
Season and bake the chicken 25–30 minutes to 165°F, then cut into pieces (or use 3 cups cooked chicken).
Cook the pasta 1–2 minutes short of al dente and drain.
Mix the pasta, chicken, Alfredo, garlic salt, Italian seasoning and cheese.
Spread in the dish and top with extra cheese.
To bake now: cover loosely with foil and bake 20 minutes, then uncover 5–10 minutes until bubbly.
To freeze: cool, wrap in plastic and foil, label, and freeze up to 2–3 months.
From thawed: bake covered at 350°F 25–35 minutes, uncovering for the last 5–10. From frozen: bake covered 60–75 minutes, uncovering for the last 10–15.
recipes.title: Chicken Alfredo Freezer Meal

ingredients.item: shredded fiesta blend (or mozzarella or Swiss), divided
red pepper flakes (optional), plus more to garnish
frozen spinach, thawed and squeezed dry

recipes.notes: From the Beauty and the Foodie roundup Low Carb Slow Cooker Meals (pinned on Jessica Lynn's Slow Cooker board). She suggests adding garlic to the sauce. Calories and protein are the site's figures; serving weight is an estimate.
steps: Mix 1 cup of the shredded cheese with the ricotta, oregano and red pepper flakes.
Spray a 4 1/4-quart slow cooker. Peel the zucchini and slice into flat 'noodles' with a cheese slicer or vegetable peeler.
Cover the bottom with zucchini, spread with half the ricotta mix, then half the spinach, half the chicken and half the Parmesan. Pour half the Alfredo over.
Repeat the layers, ending with Alfredo, and sprinkle with the remaining 1/4 cup cheese.
Cook on LOW 3 hours (or bake at 350°F for 45 minutes in a 7x11 dish). Rest 5–10 minutes and garnish with red pepper flakes.
recipes.title: Chicken Alfredo Spinach Lasagna with Zucchini Noodles

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Mix the rice with the lime juice and cilantro.
Divide the lettuce among 4 bowls and top with the rice, beans, chicken, cheese, salsa and avocado.
Add 1 tbsp yogurt to each and serve.
recipes.title: Chicken and Black Bean Burrito Bowl

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Lunch. Calories, protein, weight and servings are estimates.
steps: Cook the pasta al dente.
Whisk the oil, vinegar, lemon juice, salt and pepper.
Toss everything together. Eat warm or cool (cool before packing for lunches).
recipes.title: Chicken and Pea Pasta Salad

ingredients.item: whole milk, heavy cream or half-and-half
fresh basil or parsley, to garnish

recipes.notes: From the BuzzFeed/Tasty list 7 Quick Dinners To Make This Week (pinned on Jessica Lynn's Pasta board). Serves 6–8. Calories, protein and weight are estimates for 6 servings.
steps: Preheat the oven to 400°F and spray a medium casserole dish (10-inch round or 9x13).
Cook the pasta al dente and drain.
Meanwhile, soften the onion and garlic in the butter over medium heat 3–4 minutes without browning.
Melt in the cream cheese, lower the heat, and stir in the sour cream, milk, Parmesan, 1 cup mozzarella, salt, pepper and red pepper flakes until smooth. Turn off the heat.
Combine the pasta, chicken, spinach and tomatoes in a large bowl.
Stir in the sauce to coat.
Pour into the dish (drizzle in a little extra half-and-half if it looks dry).
Top with the remaining mozzarella.
Bake uncovered 20–25 minutes until bubbly and starting to brown. Garnish with basil or parsley.
recipes.title: Chicken and Spinach Pasta Bake

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Makes 8–10 servings (two pans). Calories, protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Cook the shells (don't overcook) and lay them out separately.
Preheat the oven to 350°F and grease two 9x13 dishes.
Mix everything except the mozzarella and sauce, then stir in 1 cup mozzarella. Fill the shells (a zip bag with the corner snipped makes it easy).
Spread half the sauce in the dishes, add the shells, and top with the rest of the sauce. Cover tightly with foil (freeze one pan here if you like).
Bake covered 40 minutes, uncover, sprinkle with the remaining mozzarella, and bake 5–10 minutes more.
recipes.title: Chicken and Spinach Stuffed Shells

ingredients.item: cassava flour tortillas (or your favorite tortillas)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Mexican. The original recipe is no longer online, so this is a similar recipe from Downshiftology. The original pin only linked to a home page, so this is a similar quick, healthy version.
steps: Preheat a grill (or grill pan) to medium-high.
Rub the chicken with 1 tsp oil and season with garlic powder, paprika, cumin, salt and pepper. Grill 4–6 minutes, until cooked through.
Meanwhile, sauté the onion and pepper in 1 tsp oil over medium heat for 3–4 minutes.
Rest the chicken 1–2 minutes, then slice into strips.
Fill each tortilla with chicken, peppers and onion, avocado, salsa verde, sour cream, cheese and cilantro, and roll tightly.
If you like, grill the burritos 1–2 minutes per side. Slice in half and serve.
recipes.title: Chicken and Avocado Burritos

ingredients.item: salt, black pepper, oregano, chili flakes (garlic sauce)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. A hearty pizza with three avocados; calories, protein and weight are rough estimates for a quarter, with a little garlic oil.
steps: Shake the garlic sauce ingredients in a jar and refrigerate (keeps a week).
Preheat the oven to 425°F and roll the crust out on a flat pan.
Spray or brush the crust with oil, then top with mozzarella, chicken and onion.
Bake 25–30 minutes until golden.
Top with sliced avocado and tomatoes, drizzle with garlic oil, and serve right away.
recipes.title: Chicken Avocado Pizza with Garlic Oil

ingredients.item: cooked boneless skinless chicken breast, cubed or shredded
frozen spinach, thawed and squeezed dry

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Casseroles. Calories and protein are the site's figures; serving weight is an estimate.
steps: Preheat the oven to 375°F.
Thaw and squeeze the spinach. Blanch the broccoli in boiling water 1–2 minutes until bright green.
Mix the chicken, bacon, spinach, broccoli, garlic, ranch and half the cheese, then spread in a 9x13 dish. (Add 1–3 tsp ranch seasoning for extra flavor.)
Top with the remaining mozzarella and cheddar.
Bake about 15 minutes, until hot and bubbly.
recipes.title: Chicken Bacon Ranch Casserole

recipes.notes: From Pinterest board Foods I do like. Your pin note: leave out the broccoli and maybe use zucchini instead. Cook the shells 1–2 minutes less than the package says so they finish in the oven. Chopped cooked bacon is a good addition. Calories, protein and weight are estimates (with spaghetti sauce).
steps: Preheat the oven to 350°F.
In a large bowl, mix the Alfredo sauce, chicken, broccoli and cheeses.
Spoon the mixture into the cooked shells.
Grease a 13x9 baking dish.
Spread the spaghetti sauce evenly over the bottom of the dish.
Arrange the shells in the dish.
Cover with foil and bake 35 minutes until heated through.
recipes.title: Chicken Broccoli Alfredo Stuffed Shells

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Meal Prep. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Preheat the oven to 350°F.
Sauté the onion in the butter about 5 minutes and set aside.
Brown the chicken in the same pan 6–7 minutes (it needn't be cooked through).
Mix the broth, rice, chicken, onion, salt, pepper and 1 cup cheddar in a covered baking dish or Dutch oven. Bake covered 35–40 minutes.
Meanwhile blanch the broccoli 5 minutes, then chill in ice water and drain.
Stir the casserole, top with the broccoli and remaining cheese, and bake 5 minutes more.
recipes.title: Chicken Broccoli Rice Casserole

ingredients.item: chicken breasts, cooked and thinly sliced

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Preheat the oven to 375°F and spray a pie pan or line a baking sheet.
Unroll the dough into one rectangle, pinching the seams, and sprinkle with Italian seasoning.
Layer the Swiss, chicken and ham.
Roll up from the long side like cinnamon rolls, pinch the seam, and cut into 8–10 rolls.
Bake 18–20 minutes until golden. Serve with honey mustard mixed from the honey and Dijon.
recipes.title: Chicken Cordon Bleu Crescent Rolls

ingredients.item: arrowroot flour dissolved in 1/2 cup water
toppings: cilantro, green onion, lime, avocado or guacamole, pico

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Casseroles. Calories, protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Preheat the oven to 400°F.
Toss the chicken, frozen cauliflower rice, onion and peppers (and tomatoes if using) in a large casserole dish.
Whisk the broth, coconut cream and fajita seasoning in a large skillet over medium-high heat and simmer about 8 minutes to reduce.
Stir the arrowroot into the water until dissolved, then whisk it into the sauce; it thickens right away.
Pour the sauce into the dish, toss to coat, and spread in an even layer.
Bake 35–40 minutes, until the vegetables on top look baked.
Garnish with toppings. If not dairy-free, add a little cheese for the last 5 minutes.
recipes.title: Chicken Fajita Casserole (Whole30)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Preheat the oven to 400°F and spray a 9x13 dish.
Brown the chicken with the salt and pepper in a nonstick skillet over medium-high 8–10 minutes, breaking it into small pieces.
Lower the heat, add the garlic 1 minute, then the pasta sauce 3 minutes.
Halve the zucchini lengthwise and scoop out the centers, leaving 1/4-inch shells. Set cut side up in the dish.
Pack in the filling, sprinkle with parmesan then mozzarella, cover with foil, and bake 35 minutes. Top with basil.
recipes.title: Chicken Parmesan Zucchini Boats

ingredients.item: pico de gallo or fresh salsa, and sliced radishes, to serve

recipes.notes: From the 40 Aprons roundup Whole30 Slow Cooker Recipes. The recipe is written for an Instant Pot with slow cooker directions in its notes; the slow cooker times here are approximate, based on 40 Aprons' shredded chicken. Calories and protein are the site's figures; serving weight is an estimate.
steps: Put the chicken, salsa, taco seasoning and salt in the slow cooker and cook until the chicken shreds easily (about 4–5 hours on LOW or 2–3 on HIGH). Or cook in an Instant Pot on Manual High 18 minutes and quick release.
Shred the chicken with two forks or a mixer and stir it back into the juices.
For the crema, blend the avocados, coconut milk, garlic, lime juice and salt until smooth. Chill at least 30 minutes if you can.
Spoon the chicken into lettuce leaves and top with crema, pico de gallo and radishes.
recipes.title: Chicken Tacos in Lettuce Wraps with Avocado Crema

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Calories, protein and weight are estimates, for the patty only.
steps: Preheat the oven to 356°F (180°C).
Process everything in a food processor until broken down and well combined.
Shape about 1/2 cup at a time into patties and set on a lined tray.
Bake 40 minutes. Serve with red onion, tomato, avocado and baby spinach.
recipes.title: Chickpea Sweet Potato Veggie Burgers
recipes.totalTime: 40 min (plus cooking the potato and quinoa)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Budget Meals. The recipe lists parsley without saying where it goes, so I put it on top. The live page doesn't load, so this comes from a 2020 web archive copy. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Cook the tuna, chickpeas, basil, tomato paste, 1 tbsp lemon juice, 1 clove garlic and red pepper in 1 tbsp oil over medium 4–5 minutes, stirring.
Toss the cabbage with the other garlic clove, 1 tbsp lemon juice, 1 tbsp oil and a pinch of salt.
Build each bowl with 1/2 cup cabbage, about 4 tbsp tuna and chickpeas, 1/4 cup olives, 1/2 avocado, jalapeño and 2 tbsp hummus. Top with sesame seeds and parsley.
recipes.title: Chickpea Tuna Meal Prep Lunch Bowls

ingredients.item: canned diced tomatoes and green chilies
canned kidney or black beans, rinsed

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Pasta. The browser couldn't open the live site, so this came from an archived copy. Servings, calories, protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Preheat the oven to 350°F.
Sauté the onion in the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat about 3 minutes. Add the beef, season, and cook until no longer pink (drain if you like).
Meanwhile, cook the pasta firm al dente and drain.
Add the tomato sauce, tomatoes, beans, chili powder, cumin, cayenne and water to the beef and simmer 5 minutes.
Stir in the pasta.
Spread in a 9x13 pan, sprinkle with cheese, and bake 30 minutes until bubbling.
Serve topped with sour cream and green onions.
recipes.title: Chili Pasta Bake

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Calories, protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Whisk the sweet chili sauce, pineapple juice and honey. Save 1/4 cup and pour the rest over the chicken; marinate 30–60 minutes in the fridge.
Grill about 5 minutes per side until done.
Brush with the reserved sauce and grill 1 minute more per side.
recipes.title: Chili Pineapple Grilled Chicken

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Apps. The site lists 5 kcal, which is low for two cans of tomatoes over 10 servings, so calories, protein and weight are my estimates.
steps: Pulse the onion and jalapeño in a food processor or blender until finely diced.
Add everything else and blend a few seconds more.
Refrigerate a couple of hours for the best flavor. Serve with salty tortilla chips.
recipes.title: Chili's Copycat Salsa

ingredients.item: slow cooker chipotle pulled pork (separate recipe in the box)
butter or iceberg lettuce, leaves separated
lime, juiced (aioli), plus wedges to serve

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. The archive copy didn't show the aioli amounts, so those are approximate. Calories, protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Mash the avocado and whisk in the mayo, lime juice, garlic, salt and pepper. Thin with water until drizzly.
Pile pork into the lettuce cups and top with sliced avocado.
Drizzle with the aioli and finish with cilantro and lime.
recipes.title: Chipotle Pulled Pork Lettuce Wraps with Avocado Aioli (Whole30)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Calories and protein are the site's figures, without the roll; weight is an estimate.
steps: Stir the brown sugar, ketchup, vinegar, Worcestershire, mustard, onion powder, salt and pepper together.
Stir in the ham.
Heat in a large skillet over medium until warmed through, 15–20 minutes.
Keep warm in a slow cooker and serve on Kaiser rolls.
recipes.title: Chipped Ham Barbecue Sandwiches

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Calories and protein are my estimates from the ingredients. Servings (8) are my estimate.
steps: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees. Line a baking sheet with a silpat mat or parchment paper.
Place the unrolled crescent rolls onto baking sheet.
Spread a layer of peanut butter on each triangle; top with chocolate chips. Roll from the bottom of the triangle to the point.
Place in the oven and bake for 10-11 minutes or until golden brown.
recipes.title: Chocolate and Peanut Butter Filled Crescent Rolls

ingredients.item: boxed fudge brownie mix (plus what the box calls for)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Calories and protein are my estimates from the ingredients.
steps: Preheat the oven to 350°F and spray a 9-inch springform pan.
Make the brownie batter per the box for chewy brownies, spread in the pan, and bake 35 minutes until set.
Beat the cream cheese until fluffy, then mix in the condensed milk, eggs and vanilla. Fold in the chocolate chips and pour over the brownie.
Lower the oven to 300°F and bake about 50 minutes until the center is set and the edges are golden.
Cool completely and refrigerate leftovers.
recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Brownie Cheesecake

ingredients.item: salted caramel (or 10 oz caramel squares + 3 tbsp heavy cream)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Calories and protein are my estimates from the ingredients.
steps: Preheat the oven to 325°F and line an 11x7 pan with nonstick foil.
Beat the butter and sugars, add the egg, yolk and vanilla, then mix in the dry ingredients on low and add the chocolate chips.
If using caramel squares, microwave them with the cream until smooth.
Press half the dough into the pan, pour on the caramel, cover with peanut butter cups, then spread the rest of the dough over the top.
Bake about 30 minutes until golden. Cool completely before cutting.
recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Cookie Bars Stuffed with Salted Caramel and Peanut Butter Cups

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. The live recipe card didn't load, so this comes from a 2021 web archive copy. Calories and protein are the site's figures per serving (1 serving).
steps: Preheat oven to 350.
Line a 9x9-inch square baking pan with parchment paper or aluminum foil and spray with nonstick spray.
Whisk together flour, baking soda and salt for crust.
Cream together butter, brown sugar and sugar until fluffy.
Add egg and vanilla and whip to incorporate.
Add flour mixture and mix until incorporated.
Fold in chocolate chips.
Press 2/3 of the mixture into the bottom of the prepared pan to form an even layer.
Combine filling ingredients and beat until blended.
Spread filling over the cookie dough layer and level.
Crumble remaining crust dough over the filling layer.
Bake for 40 minutes, or until cheesecake is set and cookie dough has browned.
Allow to cool completely and chill before slicing.
recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Cookie Cheesecake Bars

ingredients.item: fudge brownie mix, baked and cooled

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. The archived page cuts off during the wrapping step, so the dipping step is the usual method. Calories and protein are my estimates from the ingredients.
steps: Beat the butter and sugars until creamy, then the milk and vanilla, then the flour and salt. Stir in 1 cup mini chips.
Drop scant tablespoon balls onto a foil-lined sheet and freeze about an hour.
Cut the brownies into 1-inch squares, flatten each in your palm, and wrap around a dough ball, rolling smooth.
Melt the Candiquik, dip each bomb to coat, set on the foil, and sprinkle with the remaining chips. Let harden; store in the fridge.
recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Cookie Dough Brownie Bombs

ingredients.item: (16 oz) refrigerated Pillsbury™ Ready to Bake!™ Chocolate Chip Cookie Dough (24 Count)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. The live recipe card didn't load, so this comes from a 2021 web archive copy. Calories and protein are the site's figures per serving (1 Serving).
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F. Spray 9-inch spring form pan with cooking spray.
Place 6 cookies in freezer. Press remaining cookie dough in bottom of pan. Set aside.

In large bowl, beat cream cheese and sugar with electric mixer on medium speed, until smooth and creamy. Add eggs one at a time, beating and scraping sides of bowl after each addition. Beat in whipping cream and sour cream; until well mixed. Pour cream cheese filling evenly over cookie dough. Crumble frozen cookies over filling.

Bake 55 to 60 minutes, or until set around edge and center is almost set, but just slightly jiggly. Turn oven off; leave door slightly open. Let cheesecake cool for 30 minutes in oven. Remove cheesecake from oven. Run metal spatula along side of pan to loosen. Refrigerate cheesecake 2 hours or until well chilled.
Remove side of pan before serving.
recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Cookie Dough Cheesecake

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Calories and protein are my estimates from the ingredients.
steps: In a large mixing bowl, combine butter, brown sugar, sugar, flour, and powdered sugar, and beat until well-combined.
Fold in chocolate chips.
Scoop the dough into 1-inch balls and place them on a lightly greased baking sheet.
Refrigerate for 2-3 hours.
Pulse the cookies in a food processor until they are very fine crumbs.
In a large bowl, combine cookie crumbs, sugar, and melted butter.
Press into the bottom of a lightly greased 9-inch springform pan.
In a large mixing bowl, combine cream cheese and sugar, beating until smooth.
Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition.
Beat in vanilla.
Pour filling evenly over crust.

Scatter the cookie dough balls evenly over the filling, and carefully press them into the cheesecake filling, adjusting the filling so that the cookie dough balls are completely covered. You can also gently rap the pan on the counter to shift the dough balls around.
Bake at 325 degrees for 50-60 minutes, or until the center is still slightly jiggly, but almost set.
Allow to cool completely on a wire rack.
Remove cheesecake from springform pan to a serving plate.
Microwave the fudge topping for 45-60 seconds, or until melted and smooth.
Pour over the cheesecake.
Sprinkle with chocolate chips. Cut and serve. Enjoy!
recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Cookie Dough Cheesecake

ingredients.item: (2 sticks) unsalted butter, softened (filling and frosting)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Calories and protein are my estimates from the ingredients.
steps: Preheat the oven to 350°F and line 24 muffin cups.
Beat the butter and brown sugar about 3 minutes until fluffy, then the eggs one at a time.
Whisk the flour, baking powder, baking soda and salt, and add alternately with the milk. Mix in the vanilla and fold in the chocolate chips.
Fill the liners and bake 18–20 minutes. Cool 5–10 minutes in the pan, then on a rack.

Cream the butter and brown sugar, add the vanilla, then the flour and salt, and add milk until it's cookie dough consistency. Fold in the mini chips. Chill half as the filling; thin the rest with more milk for frosting.
Cut a cone out of each cupcake center, fill with cookie dough, replace the top, and frost.
recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Cookie Dough Cupcakes

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Calories and protein are the site's figures per serving (1 serving).
steps: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F.
Mix all ingredients together until well combined and pour into the pie shell.
Bake 45 to 55 minutes until crust is baked and top is golden and crackled. (Check the pie around 35 minutes and if the crust is over-browning, cover it with a crust protector or foil.)
Serve right away if you want it warm and gooey. For a firmer texture, allow to cool for a few hours before slicing. Serve on its own or with ice cream!
recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Cookie Pie

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Calories and protein are the site's figures per serving (1 serving).
steps: Preheat oven to 300F degrees. Line a 9 x 9 inch baking pan with aluminum foil, leaving enough overhang on the sides. Spray with non-stick cooking spray. Set aside.
Using a food processor, pulse Oreo cookies and butter together until crumbly.
Press cookie crumbs onto bottom of prepared pan. Set aside.
Using an electric or stand mixer, beat cream cheese until light and fluffy.
Add condensed milk and beat until smooth.
Add eggs and vanilla extract. Mix well.
In a small bowl, coat 1/2 cup of mini chocolate chips in the flour. Mix coated mini chocolate chips into cream cheese mixture.
Pour cream cheese mixture into baking pan. Sprinkle the remaining (non-coated) mini chocolate chips on top of cream cheese mixture.
Bake for 1 hour or until cheesecake springs back when touched. Let cool at room temperature. Chill in fridge for at LEAST 1 hour before cutting into squares.
recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Oreo Cheesecake Bars

ingredients.item: applesauce, (or yogurt such as coconutmilk yogurt)
peanut butter OR allergy-friendly alternative - nut-free recipe here
plus 2 tbsp flour – you can use spelt, (white, sorghum, oat, almond, even or buckwheat (50g))
granulated sugar of choice or xylitol
up to 2 tbsp milk of choice, (only if needed)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Calories and protein are my estimates from the ingredients.
steps: Preheat oven to 350 F. Grease an 8-inch pan, or line with parchment. Gently heat nut butter if not already stir-able, then stir in the applesauce and vanilla extract. In a separate bowl, stir baking soda, salt, flour, sugar, and chocolate chips. Pour the dry ingredients into the wet and keep stirring—it will seem very dry at first, so you’ll need to break up the nut butter and stop occasionally to scrape it off your spoon. If needed, slowly add up to 2 tbsp milk of choice as you stir. Don’t add more milk; it will eventually get gooey like cookie dough. Transfer the batter to the prepared pan. Smooth down evenly. (I press a second sheet of parchment on top to smooth, then remove this sheet.) Press some chocolate chips into the top if desired. Bake 10 minutes. When you take the peanut butter bars out, the top will look set but they will still be very undercooked underneath. This is okay! Leave them to cool for at least 20 minutes, during which time they will firm up. (They also firm up even more overnight.)View Nutrition Facts
recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Peanut Butter Bars

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Calories and protein are the site's figures per serving (1 slice).
steps: To prepare the crust, blend graham cracker crumbs, granulated sugar, brown sugar and melted butter in a bowl until fully combined. Press mixture into a 9″ pie plate, covering bottom completely and pushing the crumbs about 1-2 inches up the side of the pie plate. Place the pie crust into the freezer while preparing the filling.
Whip the 1 1/2 cups heavy cream until it holds peaks. Set aside in the refrigerator while preparing the rest of the filling.

In a large bowl, beat cream cheese until smooth. Add sugar and mix until blended. Add peanut butter and vanilla, mixing well. (Scrape the sides of the bowl as needed to ensure that the ingredients are fully blended.)
Fold whipped cream into the peanut butter mixture, blending well.
Fold in mini chocolate chips, blending until mini chocolate chips are evenly disbursed throughout the filling.
Pour chocolate chip peanut butter filling into the prepared pie crust. Place filled pie into the freezer until firm.

If serving pie more than 1/2 an hour after final preparation, store in the freezer. Thaw for 20 minutes before serving for a frozen, ice cream-like consistency. (If you are having difficulty cleanly removing the pie crust from your pie plate, submerge the very bottom of the dish in some hot tap water – about 1/2 inch water in your kitchen sink – to loosen the crust being careful not to get water in the pie itself.) Or thaw for longer in the refrigerator for a gooey, soft pie.
recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Peanut Butter Pie

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Calories and protein are the site's figures per serving (1 cookie).
steps: Preheat oven to 325F (163C).
Mix vanilla whey and applesauce until smooth.
Add almond flour and baking powder. Mix well.
Fold in chocolate chips.
Spoon onto a parchment-lined baking sheet.
Bake for 8-10 minutes.
Let cool slightly, and enjoy! Store any extras in the refrigerator.
recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Protein Pillow Cookies

ingredients.item: chocolate chips (semi sweet or milk chocolate)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. The live recipe card didn't load, so this comes from a 2021 web archive copy. Calories and protein are my estimates from the ingredients. Servings (8) are my estimate.
steps: Place chocolate chips in 1 cup microwave safe bowl. Melt chips in the microwave at half power for 2 minutes, or until melted, stirring after each 30 seconds. Add ½ c. Greek yogurt to melted chocolate chips. Add 1/8 c. sugar if desired. Place mixture in a Ziploc bag and snip about ½ inch of the corner off.
Repeat the same process with the peanut butter chips.

Pipe alternating layers of chocolate Greek yogurt mixture and peanut butter Greek yogurt mixture in the Popsicle molds. Tap on the counter top a few times to help get the air bubbles out of the popsicles.
Cover popsicles with lids and freeze for 4-6 hours or until firm.
recipes.title: Chocolate Greek & Peanut Butter Greek Yogurt Popsicles

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Smoothies. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Blend everything until smooth and serve right away. Use speckled (not black) bananas for sweetness.
recipes.title: Chocolate Peanut Butter Banana Breakfast Shake

ingredients.item: good quality, dark chocolate (70-80%), very finely chopped
unflavored vegetable shortening or coconut oil (optional, as needed)
mini peanut butter cups (I used Trader Joe’s, but you can also chop up larger peanut butter cups instead)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Calories and protein are my estimates from the ingredients. Servings (16) are my estimate.
steps: In a microwave, double boiler, or chocolate melter, gently melt chocolate on the lowest possible heat setting. Stir regularly, removing from heat as needed. The goal here is to keep the temperature under 90 degrees, above which the chocolate will lose its temper. Be patient, keep stirring, and even with on and off low heat the chocolate will melt eventually.Meanwhile, melt peanut butter chips in a microwave safe bowl by microwaving on medium power in 20 second intervals, stirring until melted. The chips should be smooth and ‘drizzleable’. If yours seem too thick, stir in a 2-3 teaspoons of melted shortening or coconut oil to thin it out.Pour melted chocolate onto a baking sheet lined with parchment paper or a silicone baking mat. Spread into an even layer (it will not cover the entire pan, just spread it until it’s as thick as you want your final bark to be). Drizzle lines of melted peanut butter chips on top of chocolate. Run a toothpick or skewer through the two kinds of chocolate in a circular motion to form decorative swirls.Sprinkle evenly with peanut butter cups. Let sit, uncovered at room temperature, for 1 to 2 hours or until set. Break or cut into serving size pieces.
recipes.title: Chocolate Peanut Butter Cup Bark

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Calories and protein are the site's figures per serving (1 square (1/18th of recipe)).
steps: Line a 9x5 inch loaf pan with waxed paper and lightly grease the paper. .
In a large saucepan over medium heat, bring the cream to a boil. Remove from heat and immediately add the chocolate chips. Let sit 5 minutes to melt.
Add the peanut butter and whisk until completely smooth, then pour into the prepared pan. Smooth the top and sprinkle with the peanut butter cups.
Refrigerate until firm, about 4 hours.
Lift out by the edges of the waxed paper and use a sharp knife to cut into 18 squares. (Pro tip: heat up your knife to cut more quickly and evenly into the fudge).
recipes.title: Chocolate Peanut Butter Fudge

ingredients.item: heavy cream, whipped to stiff peaks (filling)
box chocolate instant pudding, family size

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. The post only lists ingredients and links to cookiedoughandovenmitt.com for the method, so the steps here are the usual layered-dessert method. Calories and protein are my estimates from the ingredients.
steps: Mix the crushed pretzels, sugar and melted butter, press into a 9x13 pan, and bake at 350°F about 10 minutes. Cool.
Beat the cream cheese, peanut butter, butter, sugar and vanilla until smooth, fold in the whipped cream, and spread over the crust.
Whisk the pudding with the milk until thick and spread over the peanut butter layer.
Warm the hot fudge slightly and spread or drizzle over the pudding, then top with the whipped topping.
Drizzle with warmed peanut butter and chill a few hours before cutting.
recipes.title: Chocolate Peanut Butter Layer Dessert

ingredients.item: almond flour, (I use Bob's Red Mill)
egg whites, (about 3 large eggs, room temperature)
Tbsp. whole milk, (if needed to thin out mixture)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Calories and protein are the site's figures per serving (1 serving).
steps: Line two baking sheets with parchment paper. Set aside.
In a medium bowl sift together almond flour, confectioners sugar and cocoa powder. Set aside.

Beat egg whites in the bowl of a standing mixer using a whisk attachment until soft peaks form. (about 3 minutes) Slowly add granulated sugar and vanilla and continue to beat on high for 2 minutes until stiff peaks form. Add almond flour mixture to egg whites and fold in slowly by hand until well incorporated.

Scoop macaron mixture into a pastry bag fitted with a #806 tip. Pipe quarter size circles (1 - 1 1/2 inch) on parchment lined baking sheets about 1 inch apart. After piping leave out to rest on your counter at room temperature for 2 hours.
Preheat oven to 300 degrees. Bake macarons for 15-17 minutes. I only baked one tray at a time. Cool on tray before frosting.

In the bowl of a standing mixer fitted with a paddle attachment cream peanut butter and butter on high speed, about 2 minutes. Add vanilla extract. Turn mixer to low and slowly add confectioners sugar. Beat for 2 minutes scraping down the bowl after 1 minute. Add the milk one teaspoon at a time until the frosting is at a good piping consistency and continue to beat until incorporated. Scoop the buttercream frosting into a pastry bag fitted with the #806 tip and pipe the buttercream onto the flat side of one of the macaron shells, and then sandwich together.
recipes.title: Chocolate Peanut Butter Macarons

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. The live page didn't load the recipe, so this comes from a 2015 web archive copy. The live page is gone. The archived page cuts off after the first layer, so the last step is the usual method. Calories and protein are the site's figures.
steps: Mix the protein powder and PB2, then stir in the almond milk until smooth, then the peanut butter.
Melt the chocolate chips over low heat.
Spread a thin layer of chocolate in each of 8 silicone baking cups and freeze about 15 minutes until hard.
Add a spoonful of the peanut butter mixture to each cup, cover with the rest of the chocolate, and freeze until set. Peel out of the silicone cups to serve.
recipes.title: Chocolate Peanut Butter Protein Cups

ingredients.item: chocolate protein powder (she uses She Activates)
coconut flour or whole wheat flour
toppings: fresh fruit, whipped cream, butter, light maple syrup

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Breakfast. The Brooke & Daron link now redirects to their new site, Our Farmer House. Calories and protein are the site's figures, without toppings; weight is an estimate.
steps: Preheat the waffle iron.
Whisk everything until smooth (it's like thick pancake batter).
Grease the iron, pour in the batter, and cook per your waffle maker.
Add toppings.
recipes.title: Chocolate Protein Waffle

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Calories and protein are my estimates from the ingredients.
steps: Preheat the oven to 350°F. Sift the dry ingredients together.
Heat the brown sugar, water and margarine in a large pan over medium-high until boiling. Off the heat, stir in the chocolate chips until melted.
Stir in the eggs, then the dry ingredients (add a little flour if the dough is runny).
Roll into large balls on a lined or greased sheet and bake 10–11 minutes. Press each down with the bottom of a cup while warm.
Beat the frosting ingredients smooth, adjusting milk or sugar. Pipe and spread onto the cooled cookies and sprinkle with crushed Reese's.
recipes.title: Chocolate Reese's Peanut Butter Cup Cookies

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Smoothies. The original recipe is no longer online, so this is a similar recipe from Yay! For Food. The original Instagram photo had no written recipe.
steps: Blend everything in a high-powered blender until smooth.
Taste and adjust: more milk to thin it, more cocoa for stronger chocolate flavor.
Serve right away.
recipes.title: Healthy Chocolate Banana Smoothie

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Tasty via BuzzFeed. Makes 30–40 bites. Calories and protein are my estimates from the ingredients.
steps: Crush the graham crackers finely and mix with 1/4 cup confectioners' sugar, salt and melted butter until like wet sand. Press into a parchment-lined 9x9 dish and freeze 10 minutes.
Stir the cream cheese, 1 cup confectioners' sugar and vanilla until smooth, spread over the crust, and freeze 1 hour.
Lift out, peel off the parchment, and cut into small cubes.
Melt the chocolate in 20-second bursts, dip each cube, and set on parchment to harden.
recipes.title: Chocolate-Dipped Cheesecake Bites

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Breakfast. Calories and protein are the site's figures; serving weight is an estimate.
steps: Preheat the oven to 425°F and line a baking dish with parchment.
Toss the hash browns with salt, pepper and the ghee and press into the bottom of the dish.
Bake the crust 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, cook the chorizo in a skillet over medium-high heat; halfway through, add the peppers and onion and cook until the chorizo is done and the peppers crisp-tender, about 5 minutes more.
Whisk the eggs, almond milk, onion and garlic powders, salt and pepper.
Layer the chorizo and peppers over the crust and pour the eggs over.
Bake at 350°F about 25 minutes until set.
recipes.title: Chorizo Hash Brown Bake (Whole30)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Breakfast. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Mash the banana with a fork and divide between 2 jars or small bowls.
Add to each: 1/2 cup oats, 1 tbsp chia, a pinch of salt, 1 date in small pieces, 1–2 tbsp each chocolate chips and nuts, and 3/4 cup milk (maple syrup optional; it's quite sweet without).
Stir well or shake with the lid on. Refrigerate at least 6 hours (up to 2–3 days). Eat cold or gently warmed.
recipes.title: Chunky Monkey Overnight Oats (Vegan)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Calories and protein are the site's figures per serving (9 g).
steps: Preheat the oven to 350°F.
Combine ½ cup sugar and 2 tablespoons cinnamon in a small bowl. Set aside.
Beat the cream cheese till smooth. Add the sugar, egg, and vanilla and beat till smooth and creamy. Set aside.
Spray a 9x13 inch pan with non-stick spray, then sprinkle half of the cinnamon sugar mixture evenly in the bottom of the pan.
Unroll the dough and carefully lift it into the pan on top of the cinnamon sugar. Trim an inch or so off each of the sides so the crescent dough fits better.
Spread the cream cheese mixture evenly over the dough. Unroll the second can of dough trimming the long sides an inch or so and place it on top of the filling.
Sprinkle the remaining cinnamon sugar on top of the dough. Bake for about 30 minutes or until light brown.
recipes.title: Churro Cheesecake Bars

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Calories and protein are my estimates from the ingredients.
steps: Blend everything until smooth.
Churn in an ice cream maker (about 15 minutes). It's light, a little crumbly, and not very sweet.
recipes.title: Cinnamon Almond Milk Ice Cream (Paleo)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Calories and protein are my estimates from the ingredients.
steps: Preheat the oven to 350 F. Grease 8 inch springform pan and line the bottom with parchment paper, set aside.
To make cinnamon streusel crumb, first in a bowl, whisk together dry ingredient. Then add melted butter and vanilla and stir until the mixture is evenly moist, set aside, too.
To make the cake in a large bowl, cream together 4 tbsp butter with 1/2 cup sugar until light and fluffy, then add egg and beat well. Finally, add vanilla and sour cream and beat again.
In another bowl, stir together 1 cup flour, baking soda, salt, and baking powder and add to the butter mixture, stir until just combined.

Spread half the batter at the bottom of the pan ( it will be very thin layer). Spread the apple chunks evenly over the batter, then sprinkle about 1 cup of the cinnamon streusel crumbs over the apples. Spread the remaining batter over the crumbs and on top spread the rest of the cinnamon streusel.
Bake 35-40 minutes or until a tester inserted in the center comes out clean.
Before remove the ring of springform pan run a thin knife around the cake.
To make the glaze, whisk together powdered sugar with apple cider and drizzle over the cake.
recipes.title: Cinnamon Apple Crumb Cake

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Calories and protein are the site's figures per serving (1 serving).
steps: Heat oven to 375 degrees. Spray a muffin pan (12 muffin cups in the muffin tin) with nonstick cooking spray. Or you can also use parchment paper liners or muffin liners.
In a medium bowl add the sugar, oil, and eggs and stir with wire whisk until combined well.
Add in the mashed bananas and vanilla extract. Whisk until combined.
Add in the flour, baking soda, cinnamon, and salt. Stir together with a rubber spatula just until combined and no flour streaks remain in the batter.
Divide the muffin batter evenly among the muffin tins - each muffin cup will be almost to the top, a little over 3/4 full.

Bake for 16 to 21 minutes or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean and the muffins are high and rounded on top. The tops of the muffins should not look wet (that means they're not fully cooked), and they should spring back when lightly pressed with your finger.
Remove the muffin pan from the oven and let them cool for 5 minutes inside the pan and then remove the muffins to a cooling rack. Let the muffins cool enough so that you can touch and hold them.

Dip The Muffins : Combine the sugar and cinnamon in a small bowl. Put melted butter in a separate small bowl. Dip muffin tops into melted butter and then into the cinnamon sugar mixture. Serve warm or let cool completely.
recipes.title: Cinnamon Banana Bread Muffins

ingredients.item: gluten-free super oats or granola (or 3/4 cup oats + 1/4 cup pumpkin, flax or chia seeds)
vanilla protein powder, plus more to coat

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Snacks. A serving is 2 bites. The live recipe card doesn't load, so this comes from a 2015 web archive copy. Calories, protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Mix the dry ingredients in a large bowl.
Add the nut butter, syrup and extracts and mix well with your hands (add more syrup or nut butter if it's crumbly).
Roll into bite-size balls (26–27).
Freeze 5–10 minutes, roll in extra protein powder or cinnamon, and return to the freezer. Keep frozen or refrigerated.
recipes.title: Cinnamon Bun Oatmeal Energy Bites

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. The live recipe card didn't load, so this comes from a 2021 web archive copy. Calories and protein are my estimates from the ingredients.
steps: Preheat the oven to 350F.
In the bowl of a mixer, cream together the butter and sugar, scraping down the sides occasionally. Add the vanilla and egg, mix in.

In a separate bowl, mix together the flour, baking powder and salt. Add one half of it to the mixer, and when mostly combined, add the milk. Once the milk is mostly incorporated, add the rest of the flour.
To make filling: in a small bowl, pinch together the softened butter, flour, sugar and cinnamon until soft crumbs form.

To make topping: add the butter, flour, brown sugar and cinnamon to a food processor and pulse until coarse crumbs form (You can cut in with forks or a pastry cutter, but I am not patient enough for that!).

Grease a 9x9 baking pan. Pour in ½ of cake batter, and spread to all four corners. Sprinkle the filling over top, then pour in remaining cake batter, and spread carefully across the top, disturbing the filling layer as little as possible (an offset spatula works well for this).
Sprinkle the topping over the top and press lightly so it adheres.
Bake in preheated oven for 45-50 minutes, until a toothpick inserted comes out clean. Cool to warm on wire rack before serving.
recipes.title: Cinnamon Crumb Coffee Cake

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Breakfast. A serving is 1 slice with glaze. Calories, protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Beat the glaze ingredients together in a medium bowl; set aside.
Heat a large skillet over medium-high.
Whisk the eggs, cream, cinnamon, nutmeg and vanilla in a wide bowl.
Dip each slice to coat both sides (no need to soak) and cook in the buttered pan, flipping when golden.
Spread a spoonful of glaze on each warm slice and dust with powdered sugar if you like.
recipes.title: Cinnamon French Toast with Cream Cheese Glaze

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Calories and protein are the site's figures per serving (1 serving).
steps: Grease a microwave safe bowl with cooking spray. In a small bowl, add the protein powder, baking powder, coconut flour, cinnamon, and mix well.

In a small bowl, add the protein powder, baking powder, coconut flour and cinnamon, and mix well. Add the maple syrup, egg, milk, and vanilla extrac. If the batter is too crumbly, continue adding milk of choice until a very thick batter is formed.
Transfer the mixture to a microwave safe mug and sprinkle the brown sugar and extra cinnamon and swirl over the top.
Microwave for 60 seconds, or until just cooked in the centre. Top with glaze and enjoy!
recipes.title: Cinnamon Mug Cake

ingredients.item: optional extra icing: 3/4 cup powdered sugar + 3 oz cream cheese + 1 1/2 tbsp milk

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Breakfast. The site lists 395 kcal and 7 g protein, which is low for two large cans of cinnamon rolls plus icing over 8 servings, so calories, protein and weight are my estimates.
steps: Preheat the oven to 350°F.
Cut each cinnamon roll into sixths.
Drizzle the melted butter into a 9x13 pan and spread the roll pieces evenly over it.
Whisk the eggs, milk, cinnamon and vanilla and pour over the rolls.
Bake 30–35 minutes until golden on top and set in the center.
Whisk the reserved icing with the powdered sugar, cream cheese and milk until smooth, and pour over the casserole.
recipes.title: Cinnamon Roll French Toast Casserole

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Calories and protein are the site's figures.
steps: Place egg whites in a small bowl; let stand at room temperature for 30 minutes. Sift almond flour, 1-1/4 cups confectioners' sugar and cinnamon together twice.
Preheat oven to 325°. Beat egg whites on medium speed until soft peaks form. Gradually add sugar, 1 tablespoon at a time, beating on high until stiff peaks form. Fold in almond flour mixture.

With a pastry bag, pipe 1-in.-diameter cookies 2 in. apart onto parchment-lined baking sheets. Bake until lightly browned and firm to the touch, 9-12 minutes. Keeping cookies on the parchment, transfer to wire racks; cool completely.

For filling, in a small bowl, beat cream cheese and butter until creamy. Beat in vanilla. Gradually beat in confectioners’ sugar until fluffy. Refrigerate until mixture firms to a spreading consistency, about 10 minutes.
Spread about 1/4 teaspoon filling onto the bottom of each of half of the cookies; top with remaining cookies. Sprinkle with additional cinnamon. Store in airtight containers in the refrigerator.
recipes.title: Cinnamon Roll Macarons

ingredients.item: (90g) whole wheat flour or gluten-free* flour
(28g) coconut oil or unsalted butter, melted and cooled slightly
(14g) Greek yogurt cream cheese, well softened ((see Notes!))
liquid stevia ((or adjusted to taste – and see Notes!))

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Calories and protein are my estimates from the ingredients.
steps: Whisk together the oats, flour, cinnamon, baking powder, and salt in a medium bowl. In a separate bowl, whisk together the coconut oil, egg, and vanilla. Stir in the maple syrup. Add in the flour mixture, stirring just until incorporated. Chill the cookie dough for 30 minutes.
Preheat the oven to 325°F, and line a baking sheet with parchment paper or a silicone baking mat.

Drop the cookie dough into 15 rounded scoops onto the prepared sheet, and flatten to ⅜" tall using a small spatula. Bake at 325°F for 11-14 minutes. Cool on the pan for 10 minutes before transferring to a wire rack to cool completely.

Just before serving, prepare the drizzle by stirring together the cream cheese, milk, and stevia in a small bowl. Transfer the mixture to a zip-topped bag, cut off a tiny piece of one corner, and drizzle on top of the fully cooled cookies.
recipes.title: Cinnamon Roll Oatmeal Cookies

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Breakfast. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Mix the liquids in a large bowl.
Mix in everything else.
Divide into jars, or keep in one covered container, and refrigerate overnight.
Top with whipped cream if you like. Eat hot or cold.
recipes.title: Cinnamon Roll Overnight Oats

ingredients.item: milk (a little more if too thick)
OR pancake batter from a mix (e.g. Bisquick)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Breakfast. This is a treat breakfast: calories, protein and weight are estimates, including the filling and glaze.
steps: Filling: Mix the butter, brown sugar and cinnamon, scoop into a small zip bag, and let it rest 10–15 minutes to thicken slightly.
Batter: Whisk the flour, baking powder and salt, then whisk in the milk, oil and egg just until moistened (or make a boxed mix).
Glaze: Melt the butter and cream cheese together, whisk smooth, then whisk in the powdered sugar and vanilla.
Heat a sprayed skillet or griddle over low. Pour about 1/2 cup batter, snip a corner of the bag, and squeeze a spiral of filling on top.
When bubbles appear, flip carefully and cook 1–2 minutes more. Keep warm in the oven while you make the rest.
Spoon warm glaze over each pancake.
recipes.title: Cinnamon Roll Pancakes

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Breakfast. The post gives no yield, so 12 muffins is assumed. Calories, protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Preheat the oven to 400°F.
Blend everything except the raisins until combined.
Pour into a sprayed muffin tin, divide the raisins among the cups, and dust the tops with cinnamon.
Bake 15–20 minutes until a toothpick comes out mostly clean and the edges are golden.
Cool 10 minutes before removing. Store airtight. Good warm with a little butter or maple syrup.
recipes.title: Cinnamon Roll Protein Muffins (Blender)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Calories and protein are my estimates from the ingredients.
steps: Cream the sugar and butter, then the egg and vanilla. Sift in the flour, baking powder, salt and cinnamon and beat just until combined. Press the crumbly dough together and chill 30 minutes.
Roll 1/4–1/2 inch thick, cut rounds, and place on parchment.
Bake at 350°F for 7–8 minutes. Cool 2 minutes on the sheet, then on a rack.
Beat the frosting ingredients until creamy, pipe onto the cookies, and sprinkle with cinnamon sugar.
recipes.title: Cinnamon Roll Sugar Cookies

ingredients.item: butter (very cold, cut into small pieces)
buttermilk (or ⅓ cup milk mixed with ½ tsp lemon juice)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Calories and protein are the site's figures per serving (1 scone).
steps: Preheat oven to 400ºF
In a large mixing bowl, combine flour, baking powder, baking soda, and salt.
Cut in butter until mixture is crumbly.
Separate the egg white and yolk. Set the egg white aside.
In a smaller bowl, mix egg yolk, honey, and buttermilk (or milk/lemon juice mixture).
Add wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
On a floured work surface, form the dough into a ball.
Roll or pat the ball into a half-inch-thick disc, roughly 8 inches in diameter.
Cut dough into eight equally-sized pieces.
Transfer the dough to a greased baking sheet (a pie spatula makes this very easy).
Whisk the egg white until froth forms and brush over the tops of the scones.
Mix turbinado and cinnamon together and sprinkle over egg-white-topped scones.
Bake in preheated oven for 10 to 12 minutes.
While scones bake, mix powdered sugar, milk, and vanilla until a thin glaze forms.
Drizzle glaze over scones after they come out of the oven.
recipes.title: Cinnamon Scone

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Calories and protein are my estimates from the ingredients. Servings (12) are my estimate.
