steps: Heat milk until it reaches 105 degrees either on the stovetop or in the microwave. Stir in yeast packet and sugar and let it sit until the top becomes thick and frothy, about 3 minutes. Pour mixture into bowl of stand mixer and add melted butter, beaten egg and salt. Mix until combined. Add half of the flour and mix on low speed. Once combined, add the rest 1/4 cup at a time until the dough is sticky but workable and doesn't get stuck on your hands. Once dough is together, knead for another 5 minutes on low speed.

Work dough with your hands to form a ball. Grease a large bowl, or use the same bowl, and place dough in. Cover and set dough in a warm place until doubled in size, about 1 hour. I like to turn my oven on to 200 degrees, turn it off and place the bowl in there.

Once doubled in size, roll the dough out on a lightly floured surface into a large rectangle(ish) shape. Combine cinnamon and sugar in a small bowl. Brush on melted butter and cover in cinnamon sugar mixture. Cut dough length-wise into 5 long strips. Stack them on top of each other. Cut 6-7 sections across your stacks.

Grease a 9x5" loaf pan and loosely stagger your stacks in the pan. If they aren't snug to the edges of the pan, don't worry about it. It will bake up fine. If there is extra cinnamon sugar that spilled off while transferring the stacks into the pan, don't waste it! Sprinkle it on top of the dough in the pan. Cover dough with plastic wrap and allow to sit for 45 minutes to an hour until it doubles again in size.

Preheat oven to 350 degrees and bake for 22-27 minutes or until very lightly browned on top. Remove from oven, run a knife around the edges and allow to cool in pan for 20 minutes. During this time, whisk glaze ingredients together in a small bowl and set aside (add more cream/milk for desired consistency). Flip pan over and very carefully remove loaf and set on a large plate or platter. Drizzle glaze on top and serve! Bread is best served warm and fresh the same day.
Cinnamon Sugar Pull Apart Bread will stay soft and fresh for up to 2 days stored in an airtight container at room temperature.
recipes.title: Cinnamon Sugar Pull Apart Bread

ingredients.item: (98 g) coconut oil or unsalted butter, melted

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Calories and protein are my estimates from the ingredients.
steps: Preheat the oven to 350°F and line a mini muffin pan with 24 liners.
Mix the dry ingredients, then separately the wet ingredients, and stir together just until combined.
Fill the liners almost full (there's enough for about 6 more) and bake 11–13 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean. Cool on a rack and rest at least an hour.
Mix the cinnamon and sugar, peel off the liners, and roll the donut holes in it no more than 8 hours before serving. Keeps 2 days airtight.
recipes.title: Cinnamon Sugar Pumpkin Donut Holes (Paleo, Grain-Free)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Breakfast. Six Sisters removed the page, so this comes from a 2019 web archive copy. Calories, protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Preheat the oven to 350°F and spray a 9x13 pan.
Beat the eggs, oil, applesauce, both sugars and vanilla in a large bowl. Mix in the flour, baking powder, baking soda, cinnamon, salt and nutmeg.
Fold in the zucchini and pour into the pan.
Bake 35–40 minutes, until a toothpick comes out clean.
While it cools, mix the frosting and spread over the cake. Dust with cinnamon sugar if you like.
recipes.title: Cinnamon Zucchini Cake with Cream Cheese Frosting

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Soup. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Brown the beef, drain most of the fat, and put the beef in the slow cooker.
Sauté the onion until tender-crisp, add the garlic 2–3 minutes, and add to the slow cooker.
Add the broth, tomatoes, Worcestershire, ketchup, sugar and Italian seasoning. Cook on low 8–10 hours.
Add the dry macaroni for the last 20–25 minutes (or stir in cooked macaroni to heat).
Instant Pot: brown the beef and onion, add the garlic, drain, add everything but the macaroni, and cook on Soup 10 minutes. Release, add the dry macaroni, and cook on Soup 10 minutes more.
recipes.title: Classic Beef and Tomato Macaroni Soup

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Lunch. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Mash the eggs with the mayo and mustard using a fork, then season.
Serve on bread, croissants or a salad.
recipes.title: Classic Egg Salad

ingredients.item: all-purpose flour (We love Bob’s Red Mill for great quality!)
milk (optional: try subbing 1/4 cup of milk with coffee to enhance the flavor.)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Calories and protein are the site's figures per serving (1 serving).
steps: grease bottom and sides of pan (I use 2 round 10inch pans or 1 9 by 13). preheat oven to 350 degrees. I would even suggest lining the bottom with parchment paper and then spraying.
Combine flour, cocoa, baking soda, baking powder, and salt. Set aside.
In a separate bowl beat butter for 30 seconds or so. slowly add sugar.
Add eggs 1 at a time beating after each one. Beat in vanilla.
Add dry ingredients beating after each addition.
Add 1/2 of the milk, beat. Then add the other 1/2. Beat just until everything is combined nicely.
Spread batter about into pans making them about 2/3 full. You may have remaining batter (I sometimes make a few cupcakes.)

Bake for 30-35 minutes for round pans, 5 min longer or so for the 9 by 13 pan. Watch it though! a knife coming out clean from the center means it is done. NOTE: Many readers are finding they need to increase the baking time. This is probably due to the difference in ovens, pans, and elevation. Always go by the way the cake looks and if the cake is done in the center.
recipes.title: Classic Homemade Chocolate Cake Recipe

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Sides. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Cook the rotini until al dente, drain, and rinse with cold water.
Combine with the tomatoes, mozzarella, pepperoni, pepper and olives.
Toss with the dressing, then stir in the parmesan.
Refrigerate at least an hour before serving.
recipes.title: Classic Italian Pasta Salad

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Preheat the oven to 350°F and line a baking sheet with foil.
Gently mix the beef, onion, breadcrumbs, milk, eggs, tomato paste and seasonings just until combined.
Shape a loaf by hand (or pack into a greased loaf pan and turn out onto the sheet).
Bake 40 minutes. Mix the ketchup and vinegar, spread over the top and sides, and bake 10 minutes more until cooked through.
Rest 10 minutes before slicing.
recipes.title: Classic Meatloaf

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Despite the link's name, this is an oven Dutch-oven recipe. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Preheat the oven to 350°F.
Season the roast well and sear in the oil in a Dutch oven over medium-high, about 4 minutes per side. Set aside.
Sauté the celery, onion and garlic 5 minutes, then add the herbs, broth, wine and tomato paste. Bring to a simmer and return the roast.
Cover and bake 2 hours. Add the carrots, flip the roast, and bake 1 hour more until fall-apart tender.
Move the meat out, boil the liquid on the stove, stir in the arrowroot slurry, and reduce to a gravy.
recipes.title: Classic Oven Pot Roast with Red Wine

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Preheat the oven to 325°F.
Season the roast with the salt, pepper and thyme.
Brown it deeply in the hot oil 4–5 minutes per side.
Add the carrots, potatoes, garlic and broth, cover, and bake 3–3 1/2 hours until tender.
recipes.title: Classic Pot Roast with Vegetables

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Pasta. Calories and protein are the site's figures; serving weight is an estimate.
steps: Cook the pasta and preheat the oven to 350°F.
In a large bowl, mix half the basil, oregano, garlic and onion powders with all the honey, vinegar, water and tomato sauce.
Cook the turkey in the oil in a large skillet with the other half of the spices.
Combine the pasta, sauce, Parmesan and turkey, mix well and season.
Spread in a baking dish and top with the mozzarella.
Bake about 30 minutes until the cheese melts.
Garnish with more Parmesan and fresh basil.
recipes.title: Clean Eating Baked Italian Ziti

ingredients.item: split chicken breast, cooked, skin removed, cubed

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Lunch. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Combine the salad ingredients in a large bowl.
Whisk the dressing and drizzle over.
recipes.title: Clean-Eating Cobb Salad

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Smoothies. Serves 1 as a meal or 2 as a snack. The blog's account is suspended, so this comes from a 2021 web archive copy. Calories, protein and weight are estimates, with the protein powder.
steps: Blend everything until smooth.
recipes.title: Cocoa Green Smoothie with Almond Butter

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Calories and protein are the site's figures per serving (1 bliss ball).
steps: Soak the pitted dates in a small bowl in hot water for 15 minutes if needed, then drain well. If you have moist dates on hand, you can skip this step.
Add the dates along with all of the other ingredients to your food processor. Pulse a few times, then blend until a sticky texture forms.
This might take 1-2 minutes. If your mixture is still crumbly at this point, add some more coconut milk or a splash of water.
Using wetted hands, grab little chunks of the almond coconut mixture and roll them into little balls. Depending on your preferred size, you may end up with more or fewer bliss balls.
Once you have created all of the balls, put shredded coconut in a small bowl and roll the bliss balls until evenly coated.
Enjoy immediately or store in the fridge for half an hour before serving to let the balls get firmer.
The coconut almond bliss balls can be kept in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 1 week or in the freezer for 2-3 months.
recipes.title: Coconut Almond Bliss Balls

ingredients.item: Dark Chocolate (or semi sweet baking chocolate chips)
Coconut Milk (preferably canned at room temperature )
Coconut Milk (preferably canned at room temp )
Whipping Cream (cold; see notes for options)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Calories and protein are my estimates from the ingredients.
steps: Preheat the oven to 340°F (170°C). Grease and line an 8x8inch (20x20 cm) square baking tin with baking paper, leaving some overhang for easy removal.
Melt the butter and dark chocolate together using a double boiler or microwave. Once smooth, stir in the powdered sugar, light brown sugar, vanilla and warm milk.
Whisk until the sugars are dissolved. Add the flour, cocoa powder, baking powder, and salt, then whisk until the batter is smooth and well combined.
Pour the batter into the prepared tin and bake for 25–30minutes, or until the brownies are set in the center and slightly risen. Let them cool completely in the tin.Prepare the coconut layer.
In a saucepan, combine 270ml (1+1/8 cup) coconut milk, sugar, and cornstarch. Stir constantly over medium heat until the mixture comes to a boil and thickens.
Remove from heat and stir in vanilla extract, butter, and stir until combined.
Transfer into a clean bowl and stir in the shredded or desiccated coconut. Cover the with plastic wrap in contact with coconut cream.
Let the mixture cool in the fridge, then add the remaining 60ml (1/4cup) coconut milk to loosen the consistency slightly. it should be soft and spreadable.
Once the brownie base is fully cooled, spread the coconut mixture evenly over the top.
In a separate bowl, using an electric whisk to whip cold whipping cream, vanilla and powdered sugar until stiff peaks form. Gently spread the whipped cream over the coconut layer.
Sprinkle with shredded coconut and chill in the fridge for at least 1 hour before slicing and serving. Enjoy!
recipes.title: Coconut Cream Brownies

ingredients.item: maple syrup (or to taste, or stevia)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Breakfast. The original link is dead, so this comes from a 2020 web archive copy. Calories are the site's figure; protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Stir the oats, coconut milk, yogurt, cinnamon, salt, sweetener and vanilla in a jar. Cover and chill overnight.
Toast the coconut and almonds in a dry pan over medium heat until golden, 3–5 minutes (can be done the night before). Sprinkle over the oats before eating.
recipes.title: Coconut Cream Pie Overnight Oats

ingredients.item: coconut milk (organic if possible to avoid additives)
heavy cream (substitute with additional coconut milk for dairy-free)
Tbsp maple syrup (increase to 3 Tbsp if you want them sweeter, or are not dipping in chocolate)
shredded coconut, plus additional for sprinkling onto chocolate coating, if desired
dark chocolate for coating, less if drizzling (substitute Enjoy Life Chocolate Chips for dairy-free)
coconut oil (if using less chocolate, reduce this accordingly)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. The live recipe card didn't load, so this comes from a 2021 web archive copy. Calories and protein are my estimates from the ingredients.
steps: Combine first 4 ingredients in a mixing bowl. Add a pinch of sea salt, or more to taste.
Stir in the shredded coconut.
Ladle or pour the mixture into popsicle molds and freeze for a few hours, or until set.

With frozen pops still in the freezer, prepare the chocolate “shell” coating by melting chocolate and coconut oil in a small sauce pot over low heat, stirring constantly until just melted (or in the microwave for 15 second intervals, stirring between each).
Once melted, remove from heat immediately and stir in a pinch of salt.
Remove pops from molds and place on a cookie sheet or cutting board lined with wax paper. Place board and pops in the freezer.

Removing one pop at a time from the freezer, hold it over the pot of melted chocolate and use a small ladle to drizzle or pour the chocolate over the pop. Quickly transfer the pop back to the lined board in the freezer. Sprinkle with additional flaked coconut if desired.
Repeat until all pops are coated and in the freezer to set.

Store pops in freezer until ready to eat (cover if storing longer than a few hours). Allow to sit at room temperature for a few minutes before serving – just long enough for the creamy coconut to soften, but the crispy chocolate shell to remain frozen. Enjoy!
recipes.title: Coconut Cream Popsicles

ingredients.item: honey (if you like it sweeter, add more honey)
pastured eggs (don't try to sub the eggs, it won't work without them!)
cinnamon (+ extra for dusting the top of the muffin)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Calories and protein are the site's figures per serving (1 muffin).
steps: Pre-heat the oven to 350°. Soften the coconut oil by slightly heating it and combine with all the remaining muffin ingredients. Blend in a food processor or bowl, mix until smooth.

Place batter in a muffin tin lined with muffin liners. The muffins will rise a very small amount, so you can fill the muffin liner about 3/4 full–almost to the top. Before you place the muffins into the oven sprinkle each muffin top with a bit of cinnamon.

Bake for about 20-30 minutes or until a toothpick inserted comes out clean and the tops are slightly browned and hardened. Let the muffin cool before eating. If you try to eat it without letting it cool, it may crumble. It needs time to set for it to not be crumbly.
recipes.title: Coconut Flour Cinnamon Muffins

ingredients.item: red or green chili (e.g. Anaheim), chopped
full-fat canned coconut milk or cream
arrowroot or cornstarch mixed with 1 tbsp water

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Lunch. The site also gives an Instant Pot version. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Pound the chicken even and season both sides.
Brown in the coconut oil in a large skillet over medium-high, 5–7 minutes per side. Set aside.
Sauté the onion a few minutes, then the chili.
Add the stock, coconut milk, lime juice, cilantro and chili flakes, boil, then simmer 10 minutes (thicken with the starch slurry if you like).
Return the chicken, cover, and cook 5–10 minutes until done. Serve over rice or cauliflower rice with extra cilantro.
recipes.title: Coconut Lime Chicken (Dairy-Free)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Calories and protein are the site's figures per serving (1 serving).
steps: The night before place the bowl of your ice cream maker in the freezer to freeze all the way through.
Measure out 1/2 cup of coconut milk and set aside.
Add remaining coconut milk, sugar, and salt to a small saucepan. Place over medium heat and whisk until sugar is dissolved. Add the vanilla extract.
Stir in the cornstarch to the reserved 1/2 cup coconut milk until well combined.
Add cornstarch/coconut milk mixture to the saucepan and bring to a boil, stirring frequently.
Boil for 5 minutes, stirring frequently, until the cornstarch is completely cooked and ice cream base has thickened. Transfer to a shallow container, cover, and refrigerate for at least 4 hours.
Add chilled ice cream base to frozen ice cream bowl and churn according to manufacturer's instructions. Churn until it becomes thick and resembles soft serve.
You can serve now or transfer to a pint-size container and store in the freezer until ready to serve. Allow 5-10 minutes to thaw when removing from the freezer.
Serve with toasted coconut, optional
recipes.title: Coconut Milk Ice Cream

ingredients.item: Golden Barrel Coconut Oil (measured as a liquid)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Calories and protein are my estimates from the ingredients.
steps: In a microwaveable bowl or measuring cup, combine the 1-1/4 cups chocolate chips and coconut oil and microwave in 30 second increments until smooth. This should take around 1 - 1-1/2 minutes. Set aside.
Preheat the oven to 350°F and line a 9x9 baking pan with foil or parchment paper and spray with non-stick spray. Set aside.
In a large bowl, combine sugar and eggs and beat with a mixer for 2-3 minutes until light in color and smooth. Add in chocolate mixture and vanilla and mix well.
Fold in the oat flour and salt until just combined. Fold in the 1/2 cup chocolate chips and pour into the pan.
Bake for 50 minutes then let them cool completely before cutting.
recipes.title: Coconut Oil Brownies

ingredients.item: yellow bell pepper, thin strips (or red, yellow and orange)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Pasta. The original site is gone, so this came from an archived copy. Calories, protein and weight are estimates; it's a big 4-serving batch.
steps: Cook the pasta al dente in salted water and drain.
Season the chicken with salt and pepper and cook in 1 tbsp oil in a skillet over medium heat until golden and done. Move to a large bowl.
Add the remaining oil and sauté the onion 2 minutes, then the garlic and bell pepper 2 minutes, then the broccoli and asparagus until tender. Add the tomatoes at the very end.
Add the vegetables to the chicken.
In the same pan, melt the butter over medium heat, stir in the flour and cook 1–2 minutes.
Slowly whisk in the half and half, add the red pepper flakes, and simmer until it bubbles and thickens. Turn off the heat and stir in the cheese until melted.
Toss the pasta with the sauce, then the chicken and vegetables. Serves 4.
recipes.title: Confetti Chicken Pasta

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. The original site (lemon-sugar.com) now shows spam, so the link is left off; the recipe comes from a 2026 web archive copy. The archived page cuts off after the first brownie steps, so the bake time, assembly and ganache are the usual method. Calories and protein are my estimates from the ingredients.
steps: Preheat the oven to 350°F and prepare three 8-inch round pans with spray and parchment.
Stir the sugar and oil together, then the eggs one at a time, then the vanilla.
Whisk the dry ingredients and stir in, in three batches, just until absorbed. Divide among the pans and bake until set (about 25 minutes). Cool completely.
Beat the filling ingredients into a fluffy cookie-dough frosting.
Stack the brownie layers with cookie dough filling between them.
Heat the cream and corn syrup, pour over the chocolate, let sit, then stir smooth with the vanilla. Pour over the cake and garnish with chocolate chips.
recipes.title: Cookie Dough Brownie Cake

ingredients.item: (8 Tbsp; 113g) unsalted butter, softened to room temperature
and 1/4 cups heat-treated all-purpose flour* (spooned & leveled)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Calories and protein are my estimates from the ingredients.
steps: Line a large cookie sheet with parchment paper or a silicone baking mat. Set aside.

In a large bowl using a handheld or stand mixer with a paddle attachment, beat the butter, granulated sugar and brown sugar together on medium speed until light and creamy. Add the milk and vanilla extract and mix until combined. Turn the mixer off and add the flour and salt. Mix on low speed at first, then turn the mixer up to medium speed and mix until combined. The dough will be thick and crumbly, just keep mixing until it comes together. Mix in mini chocolate chips.

Roll the dough into balls, about 2 teaspoons of dough per sandwich. The amount of dough per sandwich may vary; it depends how thick you want each dough filling. Sandwich balls between two pretzels and place on prepared baking sheet. Freeze for 20 minutes.

While the pretzel bites are chilling, break up the chocolate and melt with the shortening for about 1 minute in microwave, stirring every 20 seconds. The shortening is used to thin the chocolate out. Dip the pretzel bites halfway into the melted chocolate and place bites back on baking sheet. Refrigerate the dipped bites for at least 10 minutes to allow the chocolate to set. Cover and store pretzel bites in the refrigerator for up to 5 days.
recipes.title: Cookie Dough Pretzel Bites

recipes.notes: From Pinterest board Foods I do like. Calories, protein and weight are estimates (about 2 tbsp nacho cheese per wrap).
steps: Brown the beef and onion in a large skillet over medium-high heat; drain. Stir in the taco seasoning, water and garlic, bring to a boil, then simmer on low 5 minutes.
Warm the nacho cheese in the microwave. Microwave the tortillas 20 seconds to soften.

Lay a tortilla flat, spread a heaping 1/2 cup of meat in the center and drizzle with a couple tablespoons of nacho cheese. Top with a tostada shell, a thin layer of sour cream, lettuce, tomato and shredded cheese.
Fold the tortilla edges up over the filling, working your way around.
Repeat to make 6 crunchwraps.
Spray a large nonstick skillet and heat over medium to medium-low. Cook each crunchwrap seam-side down 1–2 minutes until golden, flip and brown the other side. Serve right away.
recipes.title: Copycat Crunchwrap Supreme

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Cook and drain the pasta.
Melt the butter in a large pot over medium-high, whisk in the flour 1 minute, then lower to medium and add the milk, cream, salt, mustard and pepper.
Whisk until bubbling, lower to low, and stir in the cheddar until melted.
Stir in the pasta and let sit 5 minutes to thicken. Season to taste.
recipes.title: Copycat Panera Mac and Cheese

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Sides. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Whisk the mayo, sour cream and buttermilk together.
Whisk in the spices (thin with more buttermilk if you like).
Refrigerate in a jar about 30 minutes for the flavors to develop. Makes about 1 1/4 cups.
recipes.title: Copycat Popeyes Blackened Ranch

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Apps. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Preheat the oven to 450°F and line a baking sheet with parchment.
Whisk the flour, sugar, baking powder, garlic powder and salt. Whisk the melted butter with the buttermilk and stir into the dry ingredients to make a thick dough. Fold in the cheddar.
Scoop 1/4-cup portions onto the sheet.
Bake 10–12 minutes until golden.
Brush with the garlic butter topping. Makes 11.
recipes.title: Copycat Red Lobster Cheddar Bay Biscuits

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Breakfast. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Preheat the oven to 400°F. Cut the potatoes into 1/2-inch cubes.
Line a baking sheet with parchment (or rub it with 1 tbsp oil). Spread out the potatoes and toss with the remaining oil, paprika, garlic powder, salt and pepper.
Roast 40–45 minutes until golden and crispy, stirring halfway.
Near the end, whisk the eggs with a pinch of salt and pepper.
Melt the butter in a large skillet over medium-low and gently scramble the eggs until mostly set but still soft (they finish cooking when reheated).
Divide the potatoes and eggs among 4 freezer-safe containers and top each with 1/4 cup salsa and about 1/4 cup cheese.
Chill in the fridge, then freeze, or keep refrigerated up to 4–5 days.
recipes.title: Country Breakfast Bowls (Freezable)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Apps. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Stir everything except the green onions together until combined.
Garnish with green onions and serve with vegetables, chips or pita.
recipes.title: Cowboy Dip

ingredients.item: refrigerated crescent rolls or dough sheet

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Apps. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F and spray a large cookie sheet.
Unroll the dough (pinch the seams) and cut into 24 squares (6 by 4).
Mix the cream cheese, crab, green onion and cayenne.
Put about 1 tsp filling near one corner of each square, fold that corner over and tuck it under the filling, and roll toward the opposite corner. Brush with egg white.
Bake 10–15 minutes until golden. Serve warm.
recipes.title: Crab-Filled Crescent Wontons

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Calories and protein are my estimates from the ingredients.
steps: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F. Spray muffin cup pan with baking spray. Set aside.
In a large bowl, mix flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda, nutmeg and salt together. Add zucchini, milk, melted butter, orange zest and egg. Fold in cranberries.
Fill muffin cups 2/3 full. Bake for 17-19 minutes until toothpick comes out clean.
Cool on wire rack 5 minutes, then remove from pan and cool completely.
For the glaze, whisk together the powdered sugar and orange juice until smooth. Dip tops of cooled muffins in glaze, and allow to set. ENJOY.
recipes.title: Cranberry Orange Zucchini Muffins

ingredients.item: fat-free cream cheese (227 grams, room temperature (1 brick))

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Calories and protein are the site's figures per serving (1 serving).
steps: Using a hand mixer, blend the cream cheese, Cool Whip, and caramel sauce until well combined.
Mix in white chocolate chips.
You can eat immediately, or refrigerate for about an hour to allow to firm up a bit. Serve with apple slices.
recipes.title: Cream Cheese Caramel Apple Dip Recipe

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Calories and protein are my estimates from the ingredients.
steps: Cream the cream cheese and butter.
Beat in the brown sugar, vanilla and Dream Whip.
Beat in the milk, flour and powdered sugar until smooth, adjusting the thickness.
Stir in the mini chips and chill about 15 minutes to thicken if you like. Frosts about 24 cupcakes.
recipes.title: Cream Cheese Cookie Dough Frosting

ingredients.item: lemon, juiced, plus zest for garnish
diced tomatoes, torn basil and lemon zest, to garnish

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Pasta. Calories and protein are the site's figures; serving weight is an estimate.
steps: Blend the lemon juice, garlic, salt, paprika, parsley, basil and olive oil in a food processor until smooth, then add the avocado.
Process until smooth and creamy and season with pepper and more salt. Press plastic wrap right onto the sauce to keep air out.
Boil the pasta in well-salted water until just al dente.
Drain, toss with a little olive oil, and toss with the sauce in a serving dish.
Top with plenty of Parmesan and garnish. Serve right away.
recipes.title: Creamy Avocado Pasta

ingredients.item: avocado or extra virgin olive oil

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Anti-Inflammatory. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Combine everything in a large bowl, mashing the avocado first or as you mix, depending on the texture you like.
Dress with the oil, lemon, salt and pepper, taste, and stir again.
recipes.title: Creamy Avocado Tuna Salad

ingredients.item: Knorr Rice Sides, Creamy Chicken (plus what the package calls for)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Calories, protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Cook the chicken in the oil in a skillet until cooked through, about 4 minutes per side, adding the garlic for the last 30 seconds. Set aside.
Make the rice in the same skillet according to the package.
Stir in the chicken, garlic and tomatoes, then sprinkle with mozzarella and basil.
recipes.title: Creamy Bruschetta Chicken with Rice

ingredients.item: boneless skinless chicken breasts, pounded even
salt and black pepper, plus more

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Mix the herbs with the salt and pepper. Season the chicken on one side, put it herbed side down in the hot oil in a nonstick skillet over medium-high, and season the tops.
Cook 8–12 minutes, turning, until done. Rest 5 minutes and dice.
Cook the pasta, saving 1/2 cup water.
In a large deep skillet melt the butter over medium, whisk in the flour 1 minute, then the garlic 30 seconds.
Slowly whisk in the milk, then the cream, season well, and bring to a boil until thick.
Lower to medium-low and stir in the Neufchâtel and parmesan until melted.
Toss in the pasta, chicken, asparagus and bacon, thinning with pasta water as needed.
recipes.title: Creamy Chicken Asparagus Pasta

ingredients.item: fine sea salt and black pepper
chives or green onions, to garnish

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Casseroles. Calories are the site's figure; the site's 8 g protein looks low for 3 cups of chicken, so protein and weight are my estimates.
steps: Preheat the oven to 425°F. Toss the potatoes in a 9x13 dish with the oil, garlic and onion powders, salt and pepper and spread out.
Roast about 35 minutes until fork-tender but holding their shape. Lower the oven to 375°F.
Meanwhile, cook the bacon in a large deep skillet until crisp; drain and reserve 3 tbsp fat.
Wipe out the skillet, add the fat over medium heat, and cook the onion 3–4 minutes. Add the garlic and thyme for 1 minute.
Sprinkle in the starch and stir 30 seconds.
Slowly whisk in the broth, then the coconut milk, mustard and nutritional yeast. Simmer 1–2 minutes until it coats a spoon. Season.
Add the chicken to the potatoes, pour the sauce over and stir gently. Crumble the bacon, stir in half and sprinkle the rest on top.
Bake at 375°F 10–15 minutes until bubbling. Garnish with chives. Keeps 4 days in the fridge.
recipes.title: Creamy Chicken Potato Casserole (Dairy Free)

ingredients.item: chipotle peppers in adobo, plus a little sauce

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Mexican. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Blend everything in a food processor until smooth.
Taste and add more lime or salt if needed.
recipes.title: Creamy Chipotle Sauce

ingredients.item: brownie mix for an 8-inch pan (the blogger used Krusteaz gluten-free double chocolate)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Calories and protein are my estimates from the ingredients.
steps: Preheat the oven to 325°F and grease a 9-inch springform pan.
Stir the brownie mix, water, oil and egg together, spread in the pan, and bake 45–50 minutes until a pick shows moist crumbs. Cool completely.
Beat the cream cheese and sugar smooth, then the vanilla.
Whip the cream to soft peaks, fold into the cream cheese, and stir in the chocolate chips.
Spread over the cooled crust and chill at least 4 hours.
recipes.title: Creamy Chocolate Chip Cheesecake with Brownie Crust

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Snacks. Calories, protein and weight are estimates per 2 tbsp.
steps: Peel the cucumber, halve it, scrape out the seeds, pat dry, and chop.
Blend the cucumber, coconut cream, oil, garlic, lemon juice and salt until smooth.
Stir in the dill.
recipes.title: Creamy Cucumber Dill Dressing & Dip (AIP, Paleo, Whole30)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Anti-Inflammatory. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Sauté the onion, garlic and dried herbs in the oil over medium 2–3 minutes.
Add the pork and salt and cook until no longer pink.
Lower the heat, add the squash and coconut milk, and cook 12–15 minutes until the squash softens.
Add the spinach a cup at a time and cook 5–7 minutes.
Stir in the tapioca slurry until thickened, season, and serve.
recipes.title: Creamy Garlic Pork and Spinach (AIP)

ingredients.item: canned coconut milk (light or full fat)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Calories, protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Heat a large skillet over medium-high with 1 tbsp coconut oil and sear the chicken about 3 minutes per side (not cooked through). Set aside.
Add the rest of the oil and sauté the garlic, asparagus and mushrooms about 10 minutes.
Return the chicken and add the coconut milk, lemon juice and zest.
Cover over medium-high until bubbling, then lower to medium-low and cook 3–5 minutes until the chicken is done.
Salt to taste and serve with rice, pasta or zoodles.
recipes.title: Creamy Lemon Chicken with Asparagus and Mushrooms (Paleo)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Serves 12 as a side. The link's 'beer bacon mac' now goes to this updated bacon-crumb version. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Preheat the oven to 400°F (200°C).
Melt the butter, whisk in the flour, then slowly whisk in the milk (hold some back) until thick.
Add the spices and simmer gently, stirring, 7–10 minutes until no floury taste remains.
Off the heat, stir in the cheddar and parmesan and season.
Combine with the pasta, loosening with the reserved cooking water so it's very creamy.
Pulse the bread, bacon and sage into crumbs (with the extra parmesan) and scatter over the top.
Bake about 20 minutes until golden and crisp. Rest 5 minutes.
recipes.title: Creamy Mac and Cheese with Bacon Crumbs

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Sear the chicken in the butter in a large skillet over medium, 5 minutes per side. Set aside.
Sauté the onion and garlic 2–3 minutes, then the red peppers 1–2 minutes.
Add the broth, cream cheese and crushed red pepper and stir until smooth.
Return the chicken to warm through, stir in the basil, simmer 2 minutes, and season. Slice and serve with the sauce.
recipes.title: Creamy Roasted Red Pepper Chicken Skillet

ingredients.item: avocado oil, plus more to garnish (soup)
cannellini or navy beans, with liquid (soup)
chicken bone broth or vegetable stock (soup)
fresh herbs, cracked pepper, chili flakes, to serve

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Soup (feedfeed). The steps use tomato paste but the ingredient list doesn't give an amount; 2 tbsp is my guess. Nutrition is my estimate and includes a whole grilled cheese per serving; the soup alone is about 275 kcal.
steps: Preheat the oven to 400°F. Core the tomatoes and arrange them cut side down on a sheet with the onion, carrots, garlic and tomato paste. Drizzle with oil and season with some of the salt and the Italian seasoning.
Roast about 40 minutes until lightly charred. Warm the broth.
Blend the roasted vegetables with the beans and their liquid and the rest of the salt, then blend in the hot broth. Adjust the seasoning.
Mix the mayo with the grated garlic and spread it on the outside of each bread slice. Press parmesan onto the mayo, then fill half the slices with the cheddar and mozzarella and top with the rest.
Bake on a parchment-lined sheet 10–15 minutes, flipping halfway.
Serve the soup with a drizzle of oil, herbs, pepper and chili flakes, alongside the grilled cheese.
recipes.title: Creamy Roasted Tomato Soup with Sheet Pan Grilled Cheese

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Soup. Calories are the site's figure; protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Cook the onion in the oil over medium until slightly soft, then the garlic 1 minute.
Add the sausage and cook, breaking it up, until no longer pink.
Stir in the tomato paste, tomatoes, seasonings, cream cheese and broth.
Stir in the cream and parmesan, cover, and simmer on low 5 minutes.
Garnish with parsley and more parmesan.
recipes.title: Creamy Sausage Soup

ingredients.item: salt and pepper (omit pepper for AIP)
coconut milk (or heavy cream for keto)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Anti-Inflammatory. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Season the chicken and sear it in 1 tbsp ghee over medium-high 4 minutes per side; set aside.
Add the rest of the ghee and cook the onion, garlic, red pepper, salt and pepper 5 minutes.
Add the coconut milk, broth and lemon juice, boil while scraping the pan, then simmer 4–5 minutes until thick.
Wilt in the basil, return the chicken, and heat 1 minute.
recipes.title: Creamy Skillet Chicken with Garlic & Basil

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Pasta. Calories and protein are the site's figures (it serves 2 generously); serving weight is an estimate with the pasta.
steps: Pound the chicken to half thickness and season both sides with salt, pepper and oregano. Heat the oil in a large frying pan over medium heat.
Cook the chicken 5 minutes per side, then remove. Lower the heat to medium-low and cook the garlic 2–3 minutes.
Add the whole tomatoes with a sprinkle of salt and pepper and cook about 6 minutes until they blister and burst.
Whisk the cream, tomato paste and broth, smash any unburst tomatoes, and pour it in.
Bring to a simmer, stir in the Parmesan until melted, return the chicken and simmer 3 minutes. Top with basil ribbons.
Optional: toss in 8 oz cooked pasta with 1/4 cup pasta water.
recipes.title: Creamy Tomato Basil Chicken

ingredients.item: coconut oil, plus more if needed

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Season the chicken with salt, pepper, garlic and onion powder and cook in the coconut oil over medium-high 5–7 minutes per side until browned and cooked. Set aside.
Cook the onion until soft, then the garlic 45 seconds.
Whisk in the tapioca, then the broth and coconut milk, then the mustard, nutritional yeast, Italian seasoning, salt and pepper. Simmer until it starts to thicken.
Add the spinach and sun-dried tomatoes and simmer until wilted.
Return the chicken and simmer 2 minutes. Serve over cauliflower rice, zoodles or potatoes.
recipes.title: Creamy Tuscan Chicken (Paleo, Whole30, Keto)

ingredients.item: white or Japanese sweet potato, peeled, 3/4-inch cubes (about 3 cups)
boneless skinless chicken thighs or breasts
toppings: cilantro, avocado, green onions, jalapeños, lime wedges

recipes.notes: From the 40 Aprons roundup Whole30 Slow Cooker Recipes. The site also gives stovetop and Instant Pot methods. Calories and protein are the site's figures; serving weight is an estimate.
steps: Put the sweet potatoes, onion, garlic, jalapeño, spices, salt, pepper and green chiles in a 6-quart slow cooker.
Lay the chicken on top and pour in the broth. Cover and cook on LOW 5–6 hours or HIGH 3–4 hours, until the chicken reaches 165°F and the sweet potatoes are tender (check breasts early).
Remove and shred the chicken. Mash some of the sweet potatoes in the pot to thicken the broth.
Stir in the coconut cream, nutritional yeast and lime juice, return the chicken, and cook on HIGH 10–15 minutes more. Adjust the seasoning and serve with toppings.
recipes.title: Creamy White Chicken Chili with Sweet Potato

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Serves 6–8. Calories, protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Preheat the oven to 350°F and whisk the soup with the milk.
Separate the crescents, spoon chicken and cheese onto each, roll up and seal.
Set in a 9x13, pour the soup over, and bake uncovered 30 minutes.
recipes.title: Crescent Chicken Bake

ingredients.item: sweet potatoes, peeled and cut lengthwise into fries

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Anti-Inflammatory. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Cut into even fries (microwave the potatoes 3–4 minutes first if using a fry cutter).
Soak in cold water 1 hour, then dry completely.
Toss with the cornstarch, then the seasonings.
Air fry in a single layer, sprayed with oil (spray any white cornstarch spots), at 380°F 23–25 minutes, shaking once at 10 minutes. Cook longer for extra crisp. Cool before serving.
recipes.title: Crispy Air Fryer Sweet Potato Fries

ingredients.item: chipotle dipping sauce, ranch or ketchup

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Apps. The chipotle sauce is a separate recipe on the site. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Preheat the oven to 400°F and oil a sheet pan with 1 tbsp oil.
Squeeze lime over the avocado slices (optional) and season. Dredge in flour, then egg, then panko.
Lay in a single layer and drizzle or spray with the remaining oil.
Bake about 15 minutes until golden and crisp. Serve with dipping sauce.
recipes.title: Crispy Baked Avocado Fries

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Breakfast. Calories, protein and weight are estimates, including the syrup.
steps: Syrup: Mix the 2 tbsp water and cornstarch; set aside.
Bring the berries, sugar and 1 cup water to a boil in a saucepan.
Lower the heat, add the cornstarch mixture and simmer about 10 minutes.
Strain, or carefully blend, for a smooth syrup. Keeps 3 weeks in the fridge.
Waffles: Heat the waffle iron.
Whisk the flour, baking soda, sugar and salt in a large bowl and make a well in the center.
Add the buttermilk, egg, butter and vanilla to the well and mix until smooth.
Beat the egg whites until stiff in another bowl and gently fold into the batter.
Spray the hot iron, pour in 1/2–3/4 cup batter, and cook until brown, 4–5 minutes.
Serve right away with the syrup, or freeze and reheat.
recipes.title: Crispy Belgian Waffles with Fresh Blackberry Syrup

recipes.notes: Example recipe — delete it once you've added your own.
steps: Mash the beans with cumin, chili powder and a pinch of salt.
Warm the tortillas, spread each with beans and sprinkle with cheese, then fold.
Cook in a lightly oiled skillet over medium heat 2–3 minutes per side until crisp.
Fill with avocado and salsa and serve with lime.
recipes.title: Crispy Black Bean Tacos

ingredients.item: crumbled gorgonzola or blue cheese, to top (the site lists 24 oz, likely a typo)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Apps. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Whisk the dressing ingredients except the blue cheese, stir it in, and chill.
Whisk the buffalo sauce ingredients.
Mix the quinoa, beans, panko, egg, salt, pepper and 4 tbsp buffalo sauce and squeeze into 30–35 small balls.
Fry half at a time in the oil over medium-high about 5 minutes until golden on all sides, then gently toss with the buffalo sauce.
Toss the lettuce and carrots, season, and top with green onions, fries, the quinoa bites, blue cheese and dressing.
recipes.title: Crispy Buffalo Quinoa Bites Salad with Cheesy Ranch

ingredients.item: vegetables (e.g. zucchini, squash, spinach, grape tomatoes, sweet potatoes)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Anti-Inflammatory. For AIP, skip the tomatoes. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Preheat the oven to 350°F and spray a 9x13 glass dish.
Slice the zucchini and squash and dice the sweet potatoes small. Toss the vegetables with the oil and salt.
Put the chicken in the dish and sprinkle generously with the mixed seasonings.
Arrange the vegetables around the chicken.
Bake about 1 hour until the skin is crisp and the chicken reads 165°F near the bone.
recipes.title: Crispy Chicken Thighs and Vegetables One-Pan

ingredients.item: olive oil, kosher salt, black pepper, nonstick spray
oil-packed sun-dried tomatoes, drained and chopped

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Preheat the oven to 350°F and line a rimmed sheet with sprayed foil.
Butterfly and pound the chicken to about 1/4 inch.
Mix the filling smooth, spread over 3/4 of each breast, roll up like a burrito, and lay seam side down.
Drizzle with oil, season, and bake 15 minutes.
Mix the panko topping, pile it on the chicken, and bake 10–15 minutes more until golden and 165°F inside. Rest 5 minutes.
recipes.title: Crispy Chicken with Goat Cheese & Sun-Dried Tomatoes

ingredients.item: wild salmon fillets, fresh or thawed

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Anti-Inflammatory. The live page didn't load the recipe, so this comes from a 2021 web archive copy. Calories, protein and weight are estimates for 6 oz fillets.
steps: Heat the coconut oil in a skillet (cast iron is good) over medium-low.
Put the coconut milk in one shallow dish and the coconut flour, shredded coconut, salt and pepper in another.
Dip the fish in the milk, then coat with the coconut mixture.
Fry 2–3 minutes per side until golden and flaky. Serve with lemon.
recipes.title: Crispy Coconut Pan-Fried Salmon

ingredients.item: chicken wings, in flats and drums

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Preheat the oven to 425°F.
Pat the wings very dry.
Mix the salt, spices and baking powder, and toss the wings in it.
Spread on a parchment-lined sheet (or a rack on a sheet).
Bake 25 minutes per side.
recipes.title: Crispy Oven Baked Chicken Wings

ingredients.item: shredded cheddar (or Monterey or pepper jack)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Mexican. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Brown the beef and drain. Season with salt, pepper, chili powder, cumin, garlic powder and water.
Add the beans, corn, pepper and onion and sauté 2–3 minutes.
Sprinkle each tortilla with cheese, add a line of rice at one end, a few dollops of sour cream and some beef filling, and roll up like a burrito.
Cook seam side down in an oiled skillet over medium-high, brushing the tops with oil and turning every minute or two until crisp all over.
Serve with salsa or a creamy cilantro sauce.
recipes.title: Crispy Southwest Wrap

recipes.notes: From the Meal Prep on Fleek roundup 31 Slow Cooker Meal Prep Recipes. SkinnyMs blocks automated reading, so only the link is saved. Open it, copy the recipe, and use Add details to paste it in.
steps: Add chicken breasts to the slow cooker, then pour the salsa, balsamic vinegar, and garlic (if using) on top.
Cover and cook on low for 6 hours or on high for 4 hours.
Shred the chicken with a fork and mix it with the salsa mixture.
Add salt to taste.
recipes.title: Crock Pot 3-Ingredient Balsamic Chicken

recipes.notes: From the Meal Prep on Fleek roundup 31 Slow Cooker Meal Prep Recipes. The page froze the browser and the archived copy has no recipe card, so only the link is saved. Open it, copy the recipe, and use Add details to paste it in.
steps: Add chicken breasts to the slow cooker, then pour the salsa, balsamic vinegar, and garlic (if using) on top.
Cover and cook on low for 6 hours or on high for 4 hours.
Shred the chicken with a fork and mix it with the salsa mixture.
Add salt to taste.
recipes.title: Crock Pot Balsamic Salsa Chicken

ingredients.item: shaved or chipped deli ham (smoked or Black Forest)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Ask the deli to shave the ham so thin it falls apart. Feeds a crowd of 16–18. Calories, protein and weight are estimates, including a bun.
steps: Mix the chili sauce, barbecue sauce, brown sugar and dry mustard in a medium slow cooker.
Gently stir in the ham.
Heat until bubbly (about 4 hours on Low), then keep on Warm until serving.
Serve on buns.
recipes.title: Crock Pot Barbequed Ham Sandwiches

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Breakfast. The page is gone, so this comes from a 2019 web archive copy. The original also says 'or Warm for 8 hours', but several commenters had runny eggs that way, so cook on Low and check the center is set. Calories, protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Cut the bacon into small pieces, cook and drain (or use precooked bacon).
Layer in the slow cooker: half the hash browns, half the bacon, half the onion, half the peppers, half the cheese.
Repeat the layers with the rest.
Beat the eggs and milk and pour over. Season the top with salt and pepper.
Cook on LOW about 4 hours, until the eggs are fully set in the center.
recipes.title: Crock Pot Breakfast Casserole (Bacon & Hash Brown)

recipes.notes: From the Beauty and the Foodie roundup Low Carb Slow Cooker Meals. Nutrition is the site's figure for an 8 oz serving.
steps: Slice the chicken breasts in half lengthwise.
Grease the slow cooker and add the garlic and oil.
Season the chicken on both sides and lay it in the slow cooker.
Pour the wine over and cover.
Cook on HIGH 3 hours or LOW 7.
Stir the arrowroot into the cold water until smooth.
Remove the chicken and keep warm.
Stir the arrowroot mixture into the liquid and add the mushrooms.
Return the chicken and stir to coat.
Cover and cook 1 hour more.
Serve sprinkled with parsley.
recipes.title: Crock Pot Chicken Marsala

ingredients.item: herbes de Provence (or several sprigs fresh herbs)

recipes.notes: From the 40 Aprons roundup Whole30 Slow Cooker Recipes (pinned on Jessica Lynn's Slow Cooker board). Serves 4–6. Calories and protein are the site's figures; serving weight is an estimate.
steps: Layer everything in the slow cooker in the order listed, chicken bone-side down on the vegetables. Add water to cover the vegetables and come halfway up the chicken (3–4 cups).
Cook on LOW 6–8 hours.
Remove the chicken and cool slightly. Discard the skin and bones, shred the meat and return it to the soup. Adjust the seasoning, reheat and serve.
recipes.title: Crock Pot Chicken Soup

ingredients.item: sweet potatoes, peeled and finely chopped
chipotles in adobo, chopped (or 1 tbsp adobo sauce)
garnish: cilantro, jalapeños, shredded cheese, tortilla chips

recipes.notes: From the Meal Prep on Fleek roundup 31 Slow Cooker Meal Prep Recipes. Serves 4–5. Calories and protein are the site's figures; serving weight is an estimate.
steps: Brown the meat in a large skillet over medium-high heat, 6–8 minutes, and move it to the slow cooker with a slotted spoon. Sauté the onion and garlic in the same pan about 2 minutes.
Add the peppers and cumin and cook 1 minute more, scraping the pan. Add to the slow cooker.
Add the sweet potatoes, chili powder, paprika, chipotle and tomato paste and mix. Add the tomatoes and broth (2 cups for thicker chili) and the pepper.
Top with a bay leaf if using, cover, and cook on HIGH 3–3 1/2 hours until the sweet potatoes are tender. Remove the bay leaf, salt to taste, and keep on WARM 10 minutes.
Refrigerate leftovers up to 3 days.
recipes.title: Crock Pot Chipotle Sweet Potato Chili

ingredients.item: medium shrimp, peeled, deveined, tails off
arrowroot or cornstarch + 1 tbsp water (optional thickener)
toppings: green onion, sour cream, avocado, jalapeño, lime

recipes.notes: From the Meal Prep on Fleek roundup 31 Slow Cooker Meal Prep Recipes. Nutrition is the site's figure for 1 taco on a corn tortilla, no toppings; serving weight is an estimate.
steps: Thaw frozen shrimp in cold water about 10 minutes and pat dry.
Optional: sauté the garlic, onion and pepper in the oil 3–4 minutes, then add to the slow cooker (or add them raw to save time).
Add the tomatoes, salsa, salt, pepper, cumin, chili powder, paprika and cilantro and stir.
Lay the shrimp on top and stir gently.
Cover and cook on LOW 1 1/2–2 hours or HIGH 60–90 minutes (check after 45 minutes on HIGH), until the shrimp are opaque. Switch to WARM.
If it's too thin, remove the shrimp, stir in the slurry and cook uncovered on HIGH 10–15 minutes, then return the shrimp.
Add a squeeze of lime and serve in warm tortillas with toppings.
recipes.title: Crock Pot Fire-Roasted Shrimp Tacos

ingredients.item: beef, thinly sliced (flank steak is ideal)
white or brown rice, to serve

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Asian. Calories, protein and weight are estimates, including the rice.
steps: Put the beef in the crock pot. Mix the broth, soy sauce, brown sugar, garlic and sesame oil and pour over.
Cook on Low 5–6 hours.
Stir 1/4 cup of the sauce into the cornstarch and stir it back in. Add the broccoli and cook 30 minutes more.
Cook the rice and serve the beef and broccoli over it.
Freezer meal: bag the beef with the sauce, put it in a gallon bag with a bag of broccoli, and freeze. Thaw before cooking (or add 2 hours on Low).
recipes.title: Crock Pot Freezer Meal: Chinese Beef and Broccoli

ingredients.item: minced dry onion or onion powder

recipes.notes: From the Beauty and the Foodie roundup Low Carb Slow Cooker Meals. The live site blocks automated reading, so this came from an archived copy. Calories are the site's figure; protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Mix all the meatloaf ingredients thoroughly by hand.
Line the slow cooker with criss-crossed double-folded foil, leaving flaps for lifting, and spray it.
Shape the mixture into a loaf in the slow cooker. Cover and cook on LOW 6 hours or HIGH 3 hours.
Spread with ketchup, sprinkle with mozzarella, and cook until melted, about 5 minutes.
Lift out, garnish with parsley, cut into 10 slices and serve warm.
recipes.title: Crock Pot Italian Zucchini Meatloaf

ingredients.item: part-skim shredded mozzarella or provolone (about 2 cups), divided
Parmesan and fresh basil or parsley, for serving

recipes.notes: From the Meal Prep on Fleek roundup 31 Slow Cooker Meal Prep Recipes. Nutrition is the site's figure for 1/6 without toppings; serving weight is an estimate.
steps: Slice the eggplant and zucchini lengthwise into thin 1/4-inch 'noodles'. Lay on towels, salt lightly, let stand 15 minutes and pat dry.
Optional but recommended: grill (2–3 minutes per side) or broil (5–8 minutes, brushed with oil) the slices to drive off moisture. Skipping this leaves extra liquid you can scoop off.
Spray a 6-quart slow cooker and spread 1/2 cup sauce on the bottom. Beat the cottage cheese with the eggs.
Layer 1: eggplant, a third of the cottage cheese, a third of the peppers and onions, a third of the mozzarella, 1/2 cup sauce.
Layer 2: zucchini, a third of the cottage cheese, a third of the peppers and onions, a third of the mozzarella, 1/2 cup sauce.
Layer 3: eggplant, the rest of the cottage cheese and vegetables, zucchini, 1/2 cup sauce and the rest of the mozzarella.
Cover and cook on HIGH 2–3 hours until the eggplant is tender. Turn off and let stand 30–60 minutes uncovered so the liquid absorbs. Serve with Parmesan and herbs.
recipes.title: Crock Pot Low Carb Lasagna

ingredients.item: Hawaiian black or red sea salt (or pink salt)

recipes.notes: From the Beauty and the Foodie roundup Low Carb Slow Cooker Meals. Calories and protein are the site's figures; serving weight is an estimate.
steps: Set the slow cooker to HIGH, line the bottom with the raw bacon and sprinkle with the garlic.
Trim a little fat from the roast if you like.
Poke holes all over the roast with a sharp knife.
Rub the salt all over the roast.

Set the roast fat-side down in the slow cooker and add the liquid smoke. Cook on HIGH 4–6 hours then LOW 2 hours (or LOW 8–10 hours for bone-in). Shred the pork, stir with the bacon, and cook on LOW 30 minutes.
For the cauliflower rice, steam the cauliflower 20 minutes (or microwave 5), then process with the broth, garlic powder and salt until rice-like.
Serve the pork over the cauliflower rice.
recipes.title: Crock Pot Luau Pork with Cauliflower Rice

ingredients.item: fresh peaches, peeled and sliced (canned works too)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Calories and protein are my estimates from the ingredients.
steps: Grease a 3- or 4-quart slow cooker well.
Mix the sugars, baking mix, oats and cinnamon, then stir in the peaches and spoon into the slow cooker.
Cover and cook on low 3 hours. Serve warm with vanilla ice cream.
recipes.title: Crock Pot Peach Cobbler

recipes.notes: From the Beauty and the Foodie roundup Low Carb Slow Cooker Meals, read from an archived copy. Nutrition is the site's figure for 1 of 8 slices (with olives, mushrooms, pepper, onion and garlic); serving weight is an estimate.
steps: In a 6-quart slow cooker, mix the sausage and beef with the sauce and onions.
Spread half the sauce mixture in the slow cooker and top with half the spinach.
Add the pepperoni and half the toppings, then half the mozzarella.
Repeat the layers, ending with mozzarella.
Cook on LOW 4–6 hours. Cool slightly and cut into 8 slices.
recipes.title: Crock Pot Pizza (Low Carb)

ingredients.item: boneless pork stew meat (or chicken), chopped

recipes.notes: From the Beauty and the Foodie roundup Low Carb Slow Cooker Meals. Calories and protein are the site's figures; serving weight is an estimate.
steps: Set the slow cooker to HIGH and melt 2 tbsp butter in it.
Stir in 4 cloves of the garlic and 2 tbsp cilantro.
Melt the remaining butter in a large frying pan over medium-high heat with the remaining garlic and cilantro.
Brown the pork on all sides (not cooked through).
Add the pork and pan butter to the slow cooker.
Stir in the salsa verde.
Cook on HIGH 2 hours then LOW 3–4 hours more, or LOW 6–8 hours.
Serve in lettuce cups, grain-free tortillas or over cauliflower rice.
recipes.title: Crock Pot Pork Chile Verde

ingredients.item: baby back pork ribs (about 2 racks), cut in twos

recipes.notes: From the Beauty and the Foodie roundup Low Carb Slow Cooker Meals. Nutrition is the site's figure for 2 ribs; serving weight is an estimate including bone.
steps: Cut the ribs into twos so they fit in the slow cooker.
Line a baking dish with foil, add the ribs and sprinkle with garlic powder, salt and paprika. Broil on low 12–15 minutes to lightly brown.
Meanwhile, heat all the sauce ingredients in a small saucepan over medium-low until combined. Reserve 1/3 cup for serving.
Let the ribs cool slightly.
Spoon a couple tablespoons of sauce into the slow cooker.
Layer the ribs in, spooning sauce over each layer.
Cover and cook 5 hours on HIGH or 8 hours on LOW.
Lift the ribs out gently with tongs or a spatula; they fall off the bone.
Cut into pairs or single ribs and serve with the reserved sauce.
recipes.title: Crock Pot Pork Ribs with Killer Barbecue Sauce

recipes.notes: From the Beauty and the Foodie roundup Low Carb Slow Cooker Meals (Low Carbing Among Friends). Calories and protein are the site's figures; serving weight is an estimate.
steps: Brown the tenderloin in batches in 1 tbsp bacon fat in a nonstick pan, seasoning both sides with Montreal chicken seasoning. Set aside.
Cook the mushrooms in bacon fat over medium-high heat with the lid ajar, seasoning as they release water.

Put the mushrooms, onion and green pepper in the slow cooker and the pork on top. Blend the cream cheese, water, cream, garlic, salt, seasoning, pepper, onion salt, paprika and cornstarch in a food processor and pour over, stirring a little so it reaches the vegetables.
Cook on LOW 7–8 hours (overnight works), thinning the gravy with water if needed. Shred the pork.
recipes.title: Crock Pot Pulled Pork in Mushroom Gravy

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Apps. Calories, protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Put the cream cheese, American cheese, butter, chiles, cumin and jalapeño in a greased slow cooker.
Cover and cook on Low 1 hour.
Stir well, adding milk a tablespoon at a time to the consistency you like.
Keep on Warm and top with cilantro. Serve with chips.
recipes.title: Crock Pot Queso Blanco Dip

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Slow Cooker. Calories are the site's figure for 2 tacos; protein, servings and weight are estimates. Commenters found it salty and soupy; try half broth, half water, or less liquid.
steps: Put the chicken, taco seasoning, ranch seasoning and broth in the slow cooker.
Cook on LOW 4–6 hours.
Shred the chicken with a fork and let it soak up the broth.
Serve in taco shells with lettuce, salsa and sour cream.
recipes.title: Crock Pot Ranch Chicken Tacos

ingredients.item: dried pinto beans, sorted, rinsed and soaked overnight

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Mexican. The site has moved to choosingreal.com (same author); this comes from a 2020 web archive copy. Calories, protein and weight are estimates per 1/2 cup.
steps: Put the soaked, drained beans in the slow cooker with the water, onion, garlic and seasonings.
Cook on high 3–4 hours.
Mash to the consistency you like.
Cool and freeze in containers. Makes about 8 cups.
recipes.title: Crock Pot Refried Beans

ingredients.item: smoked turkey sausage, halved lengthwise, 1/2-inch slices

recipes.notes: From the Meal Prep on Fleek roundup 31 Slow Cooker Meal Prep Recipes. Serves 4–6. Calories, protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Put the peppers and onion in the slow cooker and top with the chicken and sausage.
Add the water and tomatoes.
Cover and cook on LOW 5–6 hours or HIGH 2 1/2–3 hours.
Stir in the rice mix (switch to HIGH if on LOW), cover and cook about 45 minutes, until the rice is tender and most of the liquid is absorbed.
Serve in bowls.
recipes.title: Crock Pot Skinny Chicken Jambalaya

recipes.notes: From the Beauty and the Foodie roundup Low Carb Slow Cooker Meals. Calories and protein are the site's figures; serving weight is an estimate.
steps: Grease the slow cooker.
Whisk 1 1/4 cups Swerve, the flour, 3 tbsp cocoa, salt and baking powder in a large bowl.
Stir the cooled butter with the eggs, yolks, vanilla and stevia in another bowl.
Mix the wet ingredients into the dry until combined.
Pour into the slow cooker.
Top with the chocolate chips.
Whisk the remaining 2 tbsp cocoa and remaining Swerve with the hot water.
Pour over the chocolate chips.
Cover and cook on LOW 3 hours.
Cool slightly before serving.
recipes.title: Crock Pot Sugar-Free Chocolate Molten Lava Cake

ingredients.item: low-carb sugar substitute (she used 1/2 cup Pyure)

recipes.notes: From the Beauty and the Foodie roundup Low Carb Slow Cooker Meals. Nutrition is the site's figure for 1 of 12 slices; serving weight is an estimate.
steps: Mix the almond flour, coconut flour, cinnamon, baking powder, baking soda, salt and xanthan gum.
In a large bowl, beat the eggs, oil, sweetener and vanilla.
Add the dry ingredients to the wet.
Fold in the zucchini and nuts.
Spread into a prepared 8x4 loaf pan (silicone works well).
Set the pan in the slow cooker on a rack or crumpled foil so it sits at least 1/2 inch off the bottom.
Cover and cook on HIGH about 3 hours.
Cool completely, wrap in foil and refrigerate; it's best served cold.
recipes.title: Crock Pot Zucchini Bread (Gluten Free)

ingredients.item: bell peppers, tops and seeds removed

recipes.notes: From the Delish roundup 12 Slow-Cooker Flat Belly Foods, read from an archived copy. Delish lists nutrition for the whole recipe; the per-serving numbers divide it by 4. Serving weight is an estimate.
steps: In a large bowl, mix the beef, beans, tomatoes, 1 cup cheese, rice, corn, cumin, chili powder, garlic powder and oregano. Season with salt and pepper.
Stuff the peppers and stand them open-side up in the slow cooker. Cover and cook on HIGH 3 hours.
When the peppers are tender, top with the remaining cheese, cover, and cook on LOW 5–10 minutes until melted.
Garnish with cilantro and serve with sour cream.
recipes.title: Crock-Pot Stuffed Peppers

recipes.notes: From the Meal Prep on Fleek roundup 31 Slow Cooker Meal Prep Recipes (listed there as potato soup). Nutrition is the site's figure for 1 cup.
steps: Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and cook the garlic, onion and pepper until softened, about 5 minutes.
Combine the vegetables, tomatoes, broth, salt and red pepper flakes in the slow cooker. Cover and cook on LOW 8 hours.
Blend until smooth with an immersion blender and serve garnished with basil.
Top with Parmesan, croutons, yogurt or grilled cheese croutons if you like.
recipes.title: Crock-Pot Tomato Soup

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Slow Cooker. Calories, protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Put everything in the slow cooker.
Cover and cook on LOW 8 hours.
Serve.
recipes.title: Crockpot 3 Ingredient Chicken & Sweet Potatoes

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Mexican. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Spray a 6-quart slow cooker.
Sauté the onion and pepper in the oil 3–4 minutes, then brown the turkey. Add the garlic and spices for 1–2 minutes.
Put the turkey in the slow cooker with the quinoa, beans, corn, salsa, tomatoes, stock and enchilada sauce. Stir.
Cook on high 2 1/2–3 1/2 hours until the liquid is absorbed.
Stir in the cilantro, lime juice and cheese until melted. Serve with sour cream, pico de gallo or avocado, or roll into tortillas and crisp in a pan.
recipes.title: Crockpot Cheesy Enchilada Quinoa

ingredients.item: toppings: shredded cheese, salsa, cilantro, red onion, guacamole, sour cream or yogurt
tortillas, burrito bowls or salad, to serve

recipes.notes: From the 40 Aprons roundup Whole30 Slow Cooker Recipes. Calories and protein are the site's figures; serving weight is an estimate without tortillas.
steps: Spray the slow cooker with oil and add the chicken, onion and peppers.
Whisk the lime juice, oil, garlic, taco seasoning and salt, pour over and toss to coat.
Cover and cook on HIGH 2–3 hours or LOW 4–6 hours, until the chicken is cooked through and firm.
Serve in tortillas, over burrito bowls or salad, with your toppings.
recipes.title: Crockpot Chicken Fajitas (40 Aprons)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Soup. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Put everything except the biscuits in the slow cooker.
Cook on low 6–8 hours or high 3–4 until the chicken is done and the potatoes are tender.
Shred the chicken and stir it back in.
Bake the biscuits per the package and serve each bowl topped with a biscuit.
recipes.title: Crockpot Chicken Pot Pie

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Slow Cooker. Nutrition is the site's figure for 1 taco (6 oz).
steps: Put everything except the tortillas and toppings in the slow cooker and mix so the salsa and spices cover the chicken.
Cover and cook on HIGH 3 hours or LOW 6 hours.
Shred the chicken with two forks, stir, and cook 1 more hour with the lid slightly ajar so some liquid cooks off.
Toast the tortillas in a skillet 20–30 seconds per side, with a little oil if you like.
Fill with chicken and top with mashed avocado, sour cream, lime and cilantro. Serve right away.
recipes.title: Crockpot Chicken Tacos

ingredients.item: boneless skinless chicken breasts (6–8 oz each)
toppings: queso fresco, red onion, cilantro, avocado, sour cream

recipes.notes: From the 40 Aprons roundup Whole30 Slow Cooker Recipes. Nutrition is the site's figure for 1 taco with sauce, no toppings.
steps: Stir the salsa, taco seasoning and salt (if your seasoning has none) in the slow cooker.
Add the chicken, turn to coat, and cover.
Cook on LOW 5–6 hours or HIGH 3–3 1/2 hours.
Shred the chicken with a hand mixer or two forks, return it to the slow cooker and stir.
Cook uncovered 60 minutes on LOW or 30 on HIGH.
For the sauce, blend the avocado, jalapeño, cilantro, water, garlic, vinegar and salt until very smooth.
Stack the tortillas between damp paper towels and microwave 20–30 seconds to warm.
Fill the tortillas with chicken, drizzle with sauce, add toppings and serve.
recipes.title: Crockpot Chicken Tacos with Avocado-Cilantro Sauce

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Soup. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Brown the beef and sausage over medium until mostly cooked.
Add the onion, pepper and garlic and cook until the onion is translucent.
Put it in a 6-quart slow cooker with the beans, tomatoes, tomato paste, tomato sauce, Worcestershire, broth, hot sauce and seasonings. Stir.
Cook on low 4–6 hours or high 2–3, stirring occasionally.
Serve with cheese, sour cream or chips.
recipes.title: Crockpot Chili (Beef & Sausage)

ingredients.item: garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, dried oregano

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Soup. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Put everything except the cream cheese and toppings in the slow cooker, stir, and press the chicken under the liquid.
Cook on high 3–5 hours or low 5–8 until the chicken shreds easily.
Shred the chicken and set aside.
Whisk the softened cream cheese into the chili until smooth.
Return the chicken, season, add 1–2 tbsp lime juice if you like, and serve with toppings.
recipes.title: Crockpot Creamy Chicken Taco Chili

ingredients.item: optional sides: 4 cups spinach and 2 cups mushrooms sautéed with 1 tsp garlic powder

recipes.notes: From the Meal Prep on Fleek roundup 31 Slow Cooker Meal Prep Recipes (pinned on Jessica Lynn's Slow Cooker board). Calories and protein are the site's figures; serving weight is an estimate.
steps: Mix the ricotta, Gruyère, Parmesan, egg, thyme, garlic, salt and pepper. Spoon into the raw pasta shells.
Put the onions in the slow cooker, cover with the broth and butter pats, and lay the stuffed shells on top, layering as needed.
Sprinkle with 1/2 cup mozzarella, cover, and cook on HIGH 3–4 hours or LOW 5–6 hours.
For the last 20 minutes, stir in the cream and top with the remaining mozzarella and breadcrumbs.
If using, sauté the spinach and mushrooms with garlic powder for the side.
Serve the shells (or pack into meal prep containers), garnished with parsley if you like.
recipes.title: Crockpot French Onion Stuffed Shells

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Slow Cooker. Calories are the site's figure; protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Whisk the soup and milk (with the pepper and garlic powder) until smooth.
Add the green beans and stir to coat.
Grease the slow cooker and pour in the green bean mixture.
Stir in half the fried onions.
Cook on LOW 4 hours or HIGH 2 hours.
Top with the rest of the fried onions just before serving.
recipes.title: Crockpot Green Bean Casserole

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Put the chicken in the middle of the slow cooker, the green beans on one side, and the potatoes mounded high on the other.
Whisk the lemon juice, oil, oregano, salt, pepper, onion powder and garlic and pour over everything.
Cook on High 4 hours or Low 7 without lifting the lid. Use fresh lemon juice; bottled won't turn out right.
recipes.title: Crockpot Lemon Chicken, Potatoes and Green Beans

recipes.notes: From the 40 Aprons roundup Whole30 Slow Cooker Recipes. Check for tenderness early; the site's times list LOW as shorter than HIGH. Calories and protein are the site's figures; serving weight is an estimate.
steps: Peel, seed and cube the squash.
Put the squash in the slow cooker and add the water.
Cover and cook 3–4 hours on LOW or 4–5 hours on HIGH (as written on the site).
Add salt and mash without draining the cooking water.
Serve warm topped with herbs.
recipes.title: Crockpot Mashed Butternut Squash

ingredients.item: Sweet Baby Ray's original BBQ sauce

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Asian. The site says 4 servings, which is 3/4 lb of chicken each; it stretches to 6. Calories, protein and weight are estimates for 4.
steps: Cook the chicken covered on High 3 hours or Low 6.
Drain the juices, and leave the chicken whole or cube it and return it to the crockpot.
Mix the BBQ sauce, marmalade and soy sauce, pour over, and cook covered on High 30 minutes more.
Serve with rice.
recipes.title: Crockpot Orange Chicken (Marmalade & BBQ)

ingredients.item: miniature chocolate-covered peanut butter cup candies (unwrapped and cut in half)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. The live recipe card didn't load, so this comes from a 2021 web archive copy. Calories and protein are my estimates from the ingredients.
steps: Spray a 5- to 6-quart oval slow cooker with cooking spray. In large bowl, beat cake mix, water, eggs, 1/2 cup peanut butter and the butter with electric mixer on low 30 speed seconds, then on medium speed 2 minutes, scraping bowl.
Remove 2/3 cup of the batter to medium bowl; stir in 1/2 cup chocolate syrup to make chocolate fudge batter.
Spoon 1/2 of the peanut butter batter into the slow cooker, followed by all of the chocolate fudge batter. Top with remaining peanut butter batter. Swirl with a knife in a circular motion.

Cover; cook on High heat setting 1 hour 45 minutes to 2 hours 15 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center of loaf comes out clean. Turn off slow cooker; uncover, and remove ceramic base from cooker to cooling rack. Let cool 15 minutes.

In medium bowl, beat 3 tablespoons peanut butter and 2 tablespoons milk with whisk until smooth. Add powdered sugar; mix until smooth. If necessary, gradually add additional 1 tablespoon milk until glaze is desired consistency. Spread peanut butter glaze over cake; drizzle with the chocolate syrup. Sprinkle peanut butter cups over top of cake.Gluten Free
Use a gluten free cake mixDairy Free
Use a dairy free milk alternative, and a dairy free pb cup candy or eliminate the candy. Also use vegetable oil instead of butter when mixing the cake.
recipes.title: Crockpot Peanut Butter Cup Cake

recipes.notes: From the Meal Prep on Fleek roundup 31 Slow Cooker Meal Prep Recipes. Calories and protein are the site's figures; serving weight is an estimate.
steps: Heat the oil in a large skillet over high heat. Season the steak with salt and pepper and sear on all sides.
Put the whole steak in the slow cooker.
Sauté the onions, garlic and peppers in the same skillet until softened, then add to the slow cooker.
Add everything else and cook on LOW 5–6 hours or HIGH at least 3 hours. (Bringing the broth and tomatoes to a boil first speeds it up.)
Shred the beef and serve as a stew or over cauliflower rice.
recipes.title: Crockpot Ropa Vieja (Cuban Beef Stew)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Slow Cooker. Nutrition is the site's figure for a 10 oz bowl.
steps: Mix the garlic, coconut aminos, honey, ketchup and rice vinegar in a small bowl.
Stir the cornstarch and water until smooth, then whisk it into the sauce.
Put the chicken in the slow cooker and pour the sauce over, shifting the pieces so it coats the bottom and sides too.
Cover and cook on HIGH 3–4 hours or LOW 4–6 hours, until tender, easy to shred and at least 165°F.
Shred the chicken right in the slow cooker. Sprinkle with sesame seeds and scallions and serve warm over rice.
recipes.title: Crockpot Sesame Chicken

ingredients.item: chunk or crushed pineapple in juice

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Calories are the site's figure; protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Put the frozen chicken in the slow cooker and pour the chili sauce and pineapple with its juice over it.
Cook on High 4–6 hours or Low 7–9.
About 45 minutes before serving, slice the chicken 3/4 inch thick and stir it back in. For a thicker sauce, stir in the cornstarch mixed with 2 tbsp cold water.
Put the vegetables on top and cook on High until tender-crisp. Serve over rice.
recipes.title: Crockpot Sweet Chili Pineapple Chicken

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Sides. Calories, protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Put the sweet potatoes and water in the crockpot and cook on High about 5 hours, stirring occasionally, until tender.
Mash right in the crockpot and mix in the salt, butter, maple syrup and brown sugar until smooth.
Cover the top with large marshmallows, cover, and let sit a few minutes until melted.
Swirl gently and serve warm.
recipes.title: Crockpot Sweet Potato Casserole with Marshmallows

ingredients.item: chili seasoning blend: 5 tbsp chili powder, 2 tbsp cumin, 2 tbsp garlic powder, 2 tbsp oregano, 1 tbsp paprika, 1 1/2 tbsp onion powder, 1 tsp black pepper, 2 tsp salt

recipes.notes: From the 40 Aprons roundup Whole30 Slow Cooker Recipes. The site also gives an Instant Pot method (10 minutes). Calories and protein are the site's figures; serving weight is an estimate.
steps: Brown the turkey over medium-high heat.
Add the turkey and the rest of the ingredients to the slow cooker. Cook on LOW 6–8 hours or HIGH 3–4 hours.
Adjust the seasoning and top with jalapeños, red onion and avocado as you like.
Mix the leftover chili seasoning blend and store it in a sealed jar.
recipes.title: Crockpot Whole30 Chili

recipes.notes: From the 40 Aprons roundup Whole30 Slow Cooker Recipes (pinned on Jessica Lynn's Slow Cooker board). Calories and protein are the site's figures; serving weight is an estimate.
steps: Cook the bacon in a large skillet until crisp; remove and reserve the grease.
Brown the sausage slices in 1 tbsp bacon grease over medium heat, 5–7 minutes per side.
Add the onion and garlic and cook until the onion is translucent, 4–5 minutes, adding more grease if needed.
Put the potatoes in the slow cooker with the onion mixture and sausage. Pour in the stock and stir in the red pepper flakes, plenty of salt and the Italian seasoning.
Cover and cook until the potatoes are fork-tender, about 3 hours on HIGH or 6 on LOW.
Stir in the coconut milk and kale. Cover and cook on HIGH about 15 minutes, until the kale wilts but stays bright green.
Stir in the bacon, season with pepper and serve.
recipes.title: Crockpot Zuppa Toscana (Whole30)
