ingredients.item: Fat-free or low-fat frozen whipped topping, thawed

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Calories and protein are my estimates from the ingredients. Servings (8) are my estimate.
steps: Preheat your oven to 350 degrees.
Spray an 8″ square glass baking dish with oil.
In a large bowl, combine the pumpkin, eggs, milk, vanilla, sweetener and spices.
Spread the mixture evenly into the glass baking dish.
Bake 40 minutes or until a knife inserted into the center comes out clean.
recipes.title: Crustless Low Carb Pumpkin Pie Recipe

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Sides. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Combine the cucumber, red onion, cilantro and corn in a bowl.
Add the lemon juice and seasonings, toss, adjust to taste, and refrigerate until serving.
recipes.title: Cucumber Corn Salad

ingredients.item: monk fruit (use honey, maple or sugar)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Calories and protein are the site's figures per serving (1 serving).
steps: Prepare Your Base: In a mixing bowl, combine the canned coconut milk, vanilla extract, and monk fruit sweetener. Stir until well combined and smooth.
Pour and Freeze: Pour the mixture into the Ninja Creami Deluxe container, and freeze for at least 24 hours.
Churn and Serve: Once frozen, insert the container into the Ninja Creami machine. Select the "Ice Cream" setting and let the machine do its magic.
Enjoy: Scoop into bowls, add your favorite toppings, and enjoy a refreshing homemade coconut ice cream!
recipes.title: Dairy Free Ninja Creami Vanilla Coconut Ice Cream

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Smoothies (The Daniel Plan). The page is gone, so this comes from a 2017 web archive copy. Calories, protein and weight are estimates; most of the calories come from the full-fat coconut milk.
steps: Blend everything until smooth.
recipes.title: Daniel Plan Pumpkin Pie Smoothie

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Calories and protein are my estimates from the ingredients.
steps: Preheat the oven to 350 F, and lightly grease an 8x8" pan. You can line it with parchment, too, if you want to be able to remove the brownies all at once.
In a saucepan over medium-low heat, or in a microwave-safe bowl, melt the butter.
Once melted, add the sugar and cook for another minute.
Remove from heat and add the cocoa and salt. Stir to combine.
Add the vanilla, and then the eggs one at a time. Whisk fully so that the mixture is smooth and glossy.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the baking soda and flour. Add to the wet ingredients, mixing until just combined.
Stir in the dark chocolate. If your mixture is still warm and you don't want the dark chocolate to melt, wait 5-10 minutes for it to cool before mixing the chunks in.
Spread the mixture into the prepared pan and cook for 25-30 minutes - the top should have a thin crust, but the center will still be quite moist.
Let cool 20 minutes before cutting and serving.
recipes.title: Dark Chocolate Chunk Brownies

ingredients.item: creamy nut butter of your choice
baking chocolate (I use dark chocolate chips but you can also use semi sweet chocolate chips)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Calories and protein are the site's figures per serving (2 Bites).
steps: Cover a baking sheet with parchment paper. Slice each banana into thin slices and arrange half the pieces on the baking sheet.
Spread peanut butter onto each banana slice, then cover each slice with another slice. Place in the freezer for about 30 minutes or until frozen.

Place the coconut oil in a microwave safe bowl and microwave until melted. Stir in the chocolate, and continue to microwave until smooth. Use a fork or spoon to cover each banana bite in chocolate, then place back on the sheet. Freeze for one hour and enjoy!
Store in freezer and thaw for a few minutes before eating.
recipes.title: Dark Chocolate Peanut Butter Banana Bites

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Apps. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Peel and halve the eggs lengthwise and pop the yolks into a bowl.
Mash the yolks with the avocado until smooth, then stir in the rest.
Spoon into the whites and dust with paprika.
recipes.title: Deviled Avocado Eggs

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. The live recipe card didn't load, so this comes from a 2016 web archive copy. Calories and protein are the site's figures per serving (1 serving).
steps: Combined the crust ingredients in a bowl.
Line the inside of an 8×8 spring form baking tin with baking paper and press the crust mix firmly into the tin and up the sides, then place in freezer.

Blend filling ingredients in a blender remove the crust from freezer and pour the filling over the top. Swirl in the melted peanut butter and line the pb cup around the outside. Place in fridge overnight.
recipes.title: Double Peanut Butter NO-BAKE Protein Cheesecake – by Karmen

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Calories, protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Preheat the oven to 450°F.
Cut the butter into the flour with a fork, then stir in the milk to form a dough.
Knead 5–6 times on a floured board, pat 1/2 inch thick, and cut out biscuits.
Bake on a greased sheet 8–12 minutes. Makes about 8.
recipes.title: Easy 3-Ingredient Homemade Biscuits

ingredients.item: brown sugar, date sugar or coconut sugar

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Breakfast. Makes 8–10 buns. The site lists 125 kcal, which is too low for a pound of dough plus butter and sugar over 8 buns, so calories, protein and weight are my estimates.
steps: Preheat the oven to 350°F.
Gently heat the butter, nuts and all but 2 tbsp of the sugar until smooth and slightly thick.
Roll the dough very thin (just under 1/8 inch) on a floured surface, adding flour if sticky.
Sprinkle with the cinnamon and the remaining sugar, cut into long strips, and roll each up tightly.
Spread half the butter mixture in an 8x8 pan, add the rolls, and spread the rest on top.
Bake 25 minutes. Flip the buns out of the pan to serve, sticky side up.
recipes.title: Easy 5-Ingredient Sticky Buns

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Asian. Makes about 3 cups; nutrition is my estimate per 2 tbsp with regular coconut milk.
steps: Whisk everything in a saucepan, bring to a simmer, and cook 2–3 minutes, stirring so it doesn't scorch.
Cool slightly and refrigerate in a covered jar for several weeks.
recipes.title: Easy 5-Minute Thai Peanut Sauce

ingredients.item: rolled or quick oats (certified gluten-free if needed)
unsweetened plain almond or coconut milk

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Meal Prep. Makes 18; a serving is 3 meatballs. The site's 371 kcal per serving is high for these ingredients split 6 ways, so calories and protein are my estimates. Weight is an estimate.
steps: Preheat the oven to 400°F and line a baking sheet.
Mix everything thoroughly with your hands.
Scoop 1 1/2-tbsp portions, roll into balls, and space them on the sheet.
Bake 25–30 minutes and cool.
Freeze in a labeled gallon bag and use like store-bought frozen meatballs.
recipes.title: Easy Baked Freezer Meatballs (Gluten-Free, Dairy-Free)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Anti-Inflammatory. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Preheat the oven to 400°F and line a large baking sheet.
Cut the parsnips into fries about 1/4 inch thick.
Toss on the sheet with the oil, vinegar and seasonings.
Bake 30–35 minutes, flipping halfway, until crisp. Serve with aioli or AIP ketchup.
recipes.title: Easy Baked Paleo Parsnip Fries

ingredients.item: frozen chopped spinach, thawed and squeezed dry
light sour cream or Greek yogurt
baguette slices, crackers, chips or veggies, to serve

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Apps. Makes 4–5 cups. Calories, protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Preheat the oven to 350°F.
Soften the garlic cloves (about 10 seconds in the microwave) and squeeze them from their skins.
Stir everything together and spread in an 8x8 dish.
Bake 20–25 minutes until bubbly. Serve warm.
recipes.title: Easy Baked Spinach Artichoke Dip

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Breakfast. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Preheat the oven to 350°F.
Toss the frozen potatoes, ham and cheese in a large bowl, then spread in a sprayed 9x13 dish.
Whisk the eggs, milk, salt and pepper (same bowl is fine).
Pour over the potatoes and pat down with the back of a spoon.
Bake uncovered 1 hour until set in the center and golden at the edges.
recipes.title: Easy Breakfast Casserole (Ham, Hash Brown & Cheddar)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Mexican. Add chicken or steak for more protein. Calories, protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Whisk the chipotle cream sauce.
Cook the rice in 1 1/2 cups water, cool, and stir in the salsa.
Divide the rice into bowls and top with lettuce, corn, beans, tomatoes, avocado and cilantro.
Drizzle with the sauce.
recipes.title: Easy Burrito Bowls

ingredients.item: optional toppings: nut butter, granola, sliced banana, apple or pear

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Breakfast. Calories, protein and weight are estimates (assuming 2% yogurt).
steps: Whisk the oats, chia seeds and chai spice in a large bowl.
Mix in the yogurt, milk and maple syrup.
Divide among 3 jars and refrigerate at least 4 hours or overnight.
Add toppings in the morning.
recipes.title: Easy Chai Spiced Overnight Oats

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Calories and protein are the site's figures per serving (1 brownie).
steps: Preheat oven to 325°F. Line a 9×9″ pan with foil and spray with non-stick cooking spray. Set aside.

In a large bowl, add the boxed brownie mix, 6 Tablespoons butter, 1/4 cup buttermilk, 2 teaspoons vanilla, 1 egg and 1/2 cup chocolate chips. Stir for 2 minutes, or until smooth. Add a Tablespoon or two more of milk if needed to thin the batter.
In a medium bowl, add the 8 ounce package cream cheese, 1/3 cup sugar, 1 egg and 2 teaspoons vanilla. Mix with an electric mixer until smooth and creamy. Refrigerate for 10 minutes if gets too thin.

Layer and swirl. Place half of the brownie batter in the pan and then spread the cream cheese mixture evenly on top. Then add 9 scoops of the brownie batter on top of cream cheese filling. Swirl with a knife to create a marble effect. Top with the remaining 1/4 cup chocolate chips.
Bake cheesecake brownies for 35-45 minutes, or until a toothpick comes clean. Remove from the oven and allow to set for at least 30 minutes before cutting. Remove foil from pan then slice.
Enjoy with a cold glass of milk! :)
recipes.title: Easy Cheesecake Brownies

ingredients.item: shredded cooked boneless, skinless chicken breast

recipes.notes: From Pinterest board Foods I do like. Nutrition is the site's figure for 1 wrap.
steps: Stir the chicken with the Italian seasoning, salt and pepper in a medium bowl.
Stir in the marinara and basil.
Optional: microwave the filling 60–90 seconds if you want it piping hot (skip if making ahead).
Lay a tortilla flat, sprinkle 1/4 cup cheese down the center and top with a heaping 1/2 cup of the chicken.
Fold in the short ends, then the long sides, to close the wrap.
Repeat with the remaining tortillas.
Heat a dry nonstick skillet over medium heat and cook the wraps until golden, about 1 1/2–2 minutes per side.
Serve with warm marinara for dipping.
recipes.title: Easy Chicken Parmesan Wraps

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Calories and protein are my estimates from the ingredients.
steps: Line an 8"x8" baking pan with aluminum foil and spray with cooking spray.
Prepare the brownie mix according to the package directions and bake as directed.
Allow brownies to completely cool, approximately 1.5 hours.
Remove the brownies from the pan, and cut into triangles. (Cut in three rows, then cut in alternating diagonals, as in the photo shown above).
Unwrap the candy canes, and use a sharp knife to gently cut/break the candy canes into 1.5" long pieces.
Press the sharper end of the candy cane into the bottom of the brownie triangles.
Spoon out approximately 1/2 of the tub of icing into a bowl.
Add green food colouring until you're happy with the colour.
Spoon the green icing into a zip lock bag.
Seal the bag and cut off a small corner of the bag with sharp scissors.
Starting at the top of the brownie triangles, gently squeeze out the icing in a curvy zigzag as you go down the tree.
Add your favourite sprinkles and a small star sprinkle at the top.
Enjoy!
recipes.title: Easy Christmas Tree Brownies

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Sides. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Preheat the oven to 350°F and grease or line a muffin tin.
Whisk the oil, eggs, milk and butter, then stir in the dry ingredients just until combined.
Fill 12 cups 3/4 full and bake 15–20 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean.
Cool 1–2 minutes, move to a rack, and serve warm with butter.
recipes.title: Easy Cornbread Muffins

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Lunch. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Process the avocado, green onions and lime juice until the onions are finely chopped.
Add the buttermilk, celery salt, Tabasco and cumin and process smooth.
Adjust the seasoning. Serve right away or chill; keeps several days.
recipes.title: Easy Creamy Avocado Sauce

ingredients.item: green onion and sesame seeds, for garnish (optional)
cooked rice and vegetables, for serving

recipes.notes: From Pinterest board Foods I do like. For heat, add red pepper flakes or Sriracha to the sauce; chopped onion and bell pepper can go in with the sauce. Calories, protein and weight are estimates, not counting rice.
steps: Cut the chicken into bite-size chunks and cook in the slow cooker on MEDIUM about 1 1/2 hours, stirring halfway (or 2–3 hours on LOW). No need to add anything.
Meanwhile, mix the BBQ sauce, marmalade and soy sauce until well blended.
Drain the chicken juices from the slow cooker, pour in the sauce, and stir to coat the chicken well.
Cook on MEDIUM another 2 hours (or about 3 on LOW) until done. The sauce thickens as it cools.
Serve over rice, topped with sesame seeds and green onion, with broccoli and carrots on the side.
recipes.title: Easy Crockpot Orange Chicken

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Mexican. Calories, protein, weight and servings are estimates.
steps: Lay the trimmed chicken in a single layer in a glass baking dish and sprinkle with taco seasoning.
Spread the onions and peppers on top and drizzle with oil.
Sprinkle with cheese.
Bake at 375°F 35–45 minutes until the chicken is cooked through.
recipes.title: Easy Fajita Chicken Bake

ingredients.item: egg whites, aged 1 day at room temperature, covered
optional powdered or paste food coloring

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. The buttercream method is the standard Swiss meringue method; the archived page cuts off partway through it. Calories and protein are my estimates from the ingredients.
steps: Pulse the powdered sugar and ground almonds together in a food processor.
Whip the egg whites, adding the granulated sugar a tablespoon at a time once foamy, until glossy and stiff enough to hold the bowl upside down.
Fold in the almond mixture (and coloring) until the batter flows off the spatula like a ribbon and a test dollop slowly flattens. Don't overmix.
Pipe 1-inch rounds onto parchment-lined sheets and let them sit 60 minutes to form a skin.
Bake at 300°F in the middle of the oven 10–12 minutes, until they don't wobble when touched. Cool completely before removing.
For the buttercream, whisk the egg whites and sugar over simmering water until the sugar dissolves, whip to stiff glossy peaks, then beat in the butter a piece at a time and the vanilla.
Pipe filling on one shell and sandwich with another.
recipes.title: Easy French Macarons with Vanilla Swiss Meringue Buttercream

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Soup. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Cook the onion in the oil over medium 2–3 minutes, then the garlic 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and simmer 5–6 minutes until they start to break down.
Off the heat, add the basil, salt and pepper and blend.
Rewarm briefly without boiling and serve with olive oil and cracked pepper.
recipes.title: Easy Fresh Tomato Basil Soup (Vegan)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Brown the beef, onion and garlic over medium and drain the fat.
Stir in the beans, tomato paste, Rotel, chili powder, salt, sugar and cumin.
Simmer uncovered over medium-low 20 minutes.
Spoon over Fritos and top with cheddar and your favorite toppings.
recipes.title: Easy Frito Chili Pie

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Calories and protein are my estimates from the ingredients.
steps: Preheat oven to 335 degrees Fahrenheit. Grease a 8x8 baking pan with butter and line with parchment paper so that it is slightly overhanging the edges on one side.

Melt butter in small sauce pan over medium heat. Add chocolate pieces to melt, using a whisk to stir the chocolate into the melted butter. Whisk in the espresso powder. Set the chocolate mixture aside to cool.

In a separate bowl, beat the eggs and powered sugar. Do not over beat, because that will create more air in the egg which causes leavening. Add the condensed milk and vanilla extract and mix to incorporate.
Stir chocolate mixture into condensed milk. Use a spatula to fold in the flour, salt and chocolate chips.

Pour the batter into the prepared baking pan. Bake in a preheated oven for 37-39 minutes. Use a toothpick to check the center of the brownie. The toothpick will not be completely clean, but will not have runny batter.
Allow the brownies to cool for 2 hours in the pan on a wire rack before cutting. Store the brownies at room temperature in an airtight container for 3-4 days.
recipes.title: Easy Fudgy Condensed Milk Brownies Recipe

ingredients.item: frozen cauliflower rice (or cooked white rice)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Casseroles. Calories and protein are the site's figures; serving weight is an estimate.
steps: Preheat the oven to 375°F and grease an 8x8 or 9x9 baking dish.
Brown the beef in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the onion and garlic and cook until translucent.
Stir in the cauliflower rice, zucchini, tomato paste, tomatoes and spices and simmer 5 minutes until slightly thickened.
Remove from the heat and stir in the eggs and half the cheese.
Spread in the dish, top with the remaining cheese, and bake 15–20 minutes until golden.
recipes.title: Easy Ground Beef Casserole

ingredients.item: all-purpose flour, plus more for dusting

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Pasta. Calories and protein are the site's figures; serving weight is an estimate.
steps: Preheat the oven to 425°F.
Poke each potato 6 times with a fork, rub with oil, season with salt, and bake about 1 hour until fork-tender.
While still warm, peel and break up the potatoes, then run them through a food mill (or break into very tiny pieces with a spoon).
On a large surface, mix the potatoes with the flour and egg until it forms a slightly tacky ball.
Flour the surface, take a handful of dough, and roll into a rope 1–1 1/2 inches thick.
Cut into 1 1/2-inch pieces, flour well, and set on a floured sheet.
Repeat with the rest of the dough.
Bring a large pot of water to a boil with 1 tbsp sea salt.
Cook the gnocchi in batches; they're done when they float, about 2 minutes.
recipes.title: Easy Homemade Gnocchi

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Apps. Calories are the site's figure; weight is an estimate.
steps: Shake everything together in a lidded jar.
Shake again before each use; it separates.
recipes.title: Easy Homemade Italian Dressing

ingredients.item: handful of walnuts or sugar-free chocolate chips ((optional))

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Calories and protein are my estimates from the ingredients.
steps: Preheat your oven to 350 degrees and grease or line an 8x8 baking dish or small round pan.
In a large bowl, mix everything together until well combined (start with your wet ingredients and then slowly mix in the dry).
Pour the batter into your baking dish, and bake for about 25 minutes. The center should be pretty moist when you pull them out of the oven as they will continue to bake in the pan.
Allow them to cool for about 10 minutes before slicing. Enjoy!
recipes.title: Easy Keto Brownies Made With Almond Flour

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Mix the marinade in a bowl and add the chicken. Marinate at least 30 minutes.
Preheat the oven to 375°F and line a baking pan with parchment.
Bake the chicken 35–40 minutes until cooked through.
recipes.title: Easy Lemon Oregano Chicken

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Mexican. Makes 10 pizzas. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Brown the beef, crumbling it, and drain. Stir in the taco seasoning and water.
Fry the tortillas one at a time in the oil over medium-high until golden and slightly crisp; drain on paper towels.
Spread a tortilla with a little enchilada sauce, then refried beans and taco meat, and sprinkle with cheese. Top with a second tortilla, more sauce and cheese.
Bake at 400°F about 10 minutes until bubbly.
Top with olives, tomato, green onion and sour cream, and cut into wedges.
recipes.title: Easy Mexican Pizza (Taco Bell Copycat)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Mexican. Calories, protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Put everything in a medium nonstick skillet and bring to a boil.
Cover, reduce to low, and simmer 25 minutes.
Let stand covered 10 minutes, then fluff with a fork.
recipes.title: Easy Mexican Rice

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Anti-Inflammatory. Calories and protein are the site's figures per cracker; weight is an estimate.
steps: Preheat the oven to 350°F and line a large baking sheet with parchment.
Whisk everything smooth and spread in an even layer over almost all the parchment.
Bake 20 minutes, then score into crackers (10x7 rows).
Bake 25–30 minutes more until golden and crisp, removing edge crackers early if they darken.
Cool completely and break apart.
recipes.title: Easy No-Roll Cassava Flour Crackers

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Preheat the oven to 325°F.
Mix the dry ingredients, make a well, add the wet ingredients, stir them together, then stir in the flour to form a dough.
Drop large scoops onto a parchment-lined sheet and flatten to 1 1/2 inches.
Bake about 20 minutes until lightly browned.
recipes.title: Easy Paleo Almond Flour Biscuits

ingredients.item: cooked sweet potato (bake ~45 min at 400°F, peel, then measure)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Breakfast. The recipe gives no serving count, so 8 is assumed. Calories, protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Preheat the oven to 350°F.
Brown the sausage, drain, and set aside on a paper towel.
Cook the onions and peppers in a large oven-safe skillet or Dutch oven until soft.
Add the mushrooms and cook until tender.
Stir in everything else except the eggs, including the sausage. Season with salt and pepper.
Beat the eggs, pour into the skillet, and gently mix in with a fork.
Bake 30 minutes until the eggs are cooked, then broil about 5 minutes to brown the top.
Cool 1–2 hours before slicing.
recipes.title: Easy Paleo Breakfast Casserole (Sweet Potato & Sausage)

recipes.notes: From Pinterest board Foods I do like. The recipe doesn't give servings or nutrition; 10 servings and the calorie, protein and weight figures are estimates (80/20 beef).
steps: Preheat the oven to 350°F.
In a large bowl or mixer, combine all the meatloaf ingredients.
Press the mixture into a greased pan (she used 2 bread pans).
Bake 1 hour, or until no longer pink inside.
Top with the tomato sauce mixed with Italian seasoning.
Serve right away.
recipes.title: Easy Paleo Homestyle Meatloaf

ingredients.item: BBQ rib rub (store-bought or your own)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. The recipe links to a separate rub. The site lists 361 kcal and 21 g protein, which is low for half a rack each, so calories, protein and weight are my estimates.
steps: Preheat the pellet smoker to 225°F per its start-up instructions (foil on the bottom helps cleanup).
Remove the silver skin from the underside of the ribs.
Season each side with 2–3 tbsp rub, leaving some meat showing.
Smoke directly on the grates without opening for at least 4 hours. Baby backs take 4–5 hours, spare ribs 6–7.
They're done when the rack bends and the bark cracks when lifted with tongs.
Optional: brush with a thin coat of BBQ sauce and smoke 30 minutes more to set it.
recipes.title: Easy Pellet Smoker Ribs

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Sides. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Divide the mustard seeds, peppercorns and coriander among the jars.
Heat the water, salt and sugar until dissolved; at a boil add the vinegar and turn off the heat after a minute.
Fill the jars loosely with the peppers and tuck in the garlic.
Pour the very hot brine over, covering the peppers and leaving about an inch of headspace.
Close, cool completely on the counter, and store somewhere cool and dark (or in the fridge).
recipes.title: Easy Pickled Banana Peppers (Garlic & Spice)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Anti-Inflammatory. Calories, protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Cook the cauliflower rice in the coconut oil over medium-low with the salt and 1–2 tsp coconut aminos 4–5 minutes until soft.
Cool and divide between two bowls.
Top with the tuna and vegetables and drizzle with the rest of the coconut aminos.
recipes.title: Easy Poke Bowl (Paleo, Whole30, AIP)

ingredients.item: Kodiak Power Cakes Buttermilk Flapjack Mix
*Optional: raw turbinado cane sugar for sprinkling on top before baking

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Calories and protein are the site's figures per serving (1 serving).
steps: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F.
Place 12 cupcake liners in a muffin pan.
Whisk all ingredients together in a large mixing bowl until smooth.
Divide the batter evenly between the muffin cups.
Sprinkle the tops with a little raw turbinado sugar, if desired.
Bake for 16 minutes or until a toothpick comes out clean.
recipes.title: Easy Protein Pumpkin Muffins

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Breakfast. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Preheat the oven to 375°F and lightly grease two 8x8 pans.
Unroll the dough into its 16 strips and brush each with melted butter.
Whisk the pumpkin, milk, brown sugar, cinnamon and nutmeg.
Spread the filling over each strip, roll up, pinch the seams, and set 1 inch apart in the pans.
Bake 16–18 minutes until golden.
Meanwhile, beat the cream cheese smooth, gradually beat in the powdered sugar, then the pumpkin spice and vanilla.
Brush the hot rolls with the frosting right away and serve.
recipes.title: Easy Pumpkin Cinnamon Rolls (Crescent Dough)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Lunch. Calories are the site's figure; weight is an estimate.
steps: Whisk the vinegar, mustard, garlic, salt and pepper, then slowly whisk in the oil until emulsified.
recipes.title: Easy Red-Wine Vinaigrette

ingredients.item: jalapeño or serrano, seeded and chopped

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Apps. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Pulse everything in a food processor 5 times for chunky salsa or up to 10 for restaurant style.
Makes about 5 1/2 cups. Serve at room temperature or chilled; keeps 7 days in the fridge.
recipes.title: Easy Restaurant-Style Salsa (Keto)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Sides. Serves 4–5. Calories are the site's figure; protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Preheat the oven to 450°F and line a baking sheet with foil.
Toss the zucchini with the oil and spread in a single layer.
Season generously with salt, pepper and paprika.
Roast 10–15 minutes until fork tender.
recipes.title: Easy Roasted Zucchini

ingredients.item: sliced red and yellow bell peppers
cilantro, lime wedges, sliced chilies, to serve

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Asian. The site lists 400 kcal, which is low for two cans of coconut milk over 4 bowls, so calories, protein and weight are my estimates. Use light coconut milk to cut it by about a third.
steps: Sauté the onion in the coconut oil over medium 3–4 minutes, then the garlic and ginger 1–2 minutes.
Stir in the curry paste 1 minute, then the broth and coconut milk, and bring to a gentle simmer.
Stir in the soy sauce, lime juice and brown sugar.
Cook the noodles separately and drain.
Simmer the peppers and snap peas 3–4 minutes, then add the spinach and noodles for 2 minutes. Adjust the seasoning.
Serve with cilantro, lime and chilies.
recipes.title: Easy Thai Red Curry Noodle Soup

ingredients.item: medium egg noodles, cooked and drained

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. A serving is about 1 cup. Calories, protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F and mix the soup, milk, peas, tuna and noodles in a 2-quart casserole.
Mix the breadcrumbs with the butter.
Bake the casserole 30 minutes until hot and bubbling, stir, sprinkle with the crumbs, and bake 5 minutes more until golden.
recipes.title: Easy Tuna Noodle Casserole

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Mexican. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Cook the turkey in a large skillet, breaking it up.
Stir in the spices, lime juice, salt, pepper, water, salsa and beans. Boil, then simmer 3–5 minutes until thick.
Off the heat, stir in the tortilla strips and top with cheese. Cover until melted.
Top each serving with yogurt and cilantro.
recipes.title: Easy Turkey Burrito Skillet

ingredients.item: unsweetened almond milk and/or vegetable broth

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Sides. Serves 8–10. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Preheat the oven to 375°F and slice the potatoes evenly (a mandoline helps).
Blend the cashews, milk/broth, nutritional yeast, garlic, onion powder, salt, pepper and lemon until creamy, about a minute. Makes about 3 cups.
In a 9x13, layer a little sauce, half the potatoes, half the sauce, then repeat. Sprinkle with thyme.
Cover and bake 40 minutes, uncover, and bake 30 minutes more until fork tender.
Rest 5–10 minutes. Leftovers keep 5 days; reheat covered at 350°F 20–30 minutes.
recipes.title: Easy Vegan Scalloped Potatoes (Cashew Cream)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Asian. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Cook the vermicelli per the package (usually 5–8 minutes in boiling water), drain and rinse.
Thinly slice the vegetables and warm your protein.
Blend the sauce ingredients smooth (use less oil for a thicker sauce).
Divide the noodles into bowls, layer on the vegetables, egg and meat, and drizzle with sauce.
recipes.title: Easy Vermicelli Bowls with Garlic Herb Sauce

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Breakfast. Calories and protein are the site's figures; serving weight is an estimate.
steps: Sauté the onion in the oil in a medium skillet until translucent, 1–2 minutes.
Add the sausage and cook through, breaking it up.
Meanwhile, chop the broccoli and pepper and shred the potato.
Grease a baking pan and spread in the potato, pepper and broccoli.
Add the cooked sausage.
Whisk the eggs with the almond milk, salt and pepper.
Pour over and distribute with a fork.
Bake at 350°F 25–30 minutes until set.
recipes.title: Easy Whole30 Breakfast Casserole (Sausage & Potato)

ingredients.item: add-ins: chocolate chips, M&Ms or nuts

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Calories and protein are my estimates from the ingredients.
steps: Beat the butter and brown sugar on low just under a minute.
Stir in the vanilla, milk, flour and salt, then mix on low about 30 seconds.
Stir in add-ins. Chill 30 minutes if you like it firmer.
recipes.title: Edible Cookie Dough for One (Brown Sugar)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Breakfast. Calories, protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Preheat the oven to 350°F. Brown the sausage in a medium skillet over medium-high until cooked through, then cut into 1/2-inch pieces.
Whisk the egg whites and eggs, then the milk, salt and pepper. Stir in the spinach.
Grease or line 6 muffin cups and divide the egg mixture among them.
Divide the cheese and sausage among the cups.
Bake 20 minutes until firm in the center. Run a knife around each and serve warm. Keeps 3–4 days; reheat in the microwave.
recipes.title: Egg Muffins with Sausage, Spinach and Cheese

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Lunch. Serves 1 as a small meal or 2 as a side. Calories, protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Stir everything together just enough that some of the avocado and egg turns creamy. Season and eat.
recipes.title: Egg, Avocado and Tomato Salad

ingredients.item: or 1 ½ cups Chocolate chips (or semi-sweet chocolate)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. The live recipe card didn't load, so this comes from a 2021 web archive copy. Calories and protein are the site's figures per serving (1 piece).
steps: Preheat the oven to 350°F or 180°C for at least 10 minutes

Take 8x8 inch pan, lightly butter or spray with cooking oil spray. Line it with parchment paper with sides up. So it will be easy to lift after it bakes. Again butter or spray the parchment paper. Keep it aside.
Take butter and chocolate in a bowl. Melt in the microwave for 40 seconds. (You can melt them by using double boiler method). Once melted, stir to make it smooth. Keep it aside.
Take apple sauce and sugar in large enough bowl. Whisk it till sugar dissolves.
Then add water, vanilla extract and melted chocolate. Whisk it well till it gets incorporated well.
Then sift the dry ingredients (flour, baking powder, baking soda, and salt). Again mix until everything is incorporated well.
Pour the batter into prepared pan. Even it out with a spatula and tap the pan on the countertop a few times to get rid of air bubbles.

Bake it into the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes. Baking time: 25-27 mins - a toothpick inserted comes out with little sticky moist batter (not crumbs). Meaning you’ll get a super gooey brownie (won’t hold the piece properly).28-30 mins - a toothpick inserted comes out with few moist crumbs with little sticky batter. Meaning you’ll get a moist, fudgy brownie (the my kind).
Let the brownie cool completely in the pan on the wire rack. As it cools it will deflate a bit. But don’t worry it is perfectly fine.
Most important: Pop it into the refrigerator for 1 hour before cutting.
Then remove brownie out of the pan with the help of parchment paper.
And cut them into 9 or 16 equal pieces or as per your desired size and serve.
recipes.title: Eggless Chocolate Brownie Recipe

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Heat-treat the flour (microwave to 165°F) to make it safe to eat raw. Calories and protein are my estimates from the ingredients.
steps: Beat the butter and sugars with a hand mixer.
Mix in everything except the chocolate chips.
Stir in the chocolate chips and enjoy right away, or chill.
recipes.title: Eggless Edible Chocolate Chip Cookie Dough for One

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Breakfast. Makes 5 pancakes. Calories, protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Mix everything in a bowl without overmixing (small lumps are fine, big flour lumps aren't). Rest 5 minutes.
Heat an iron skillet or nonstick pan 30–40 seconds on low-medium, lower the heat, and pour a large ladle of batter into the center; let it spread on its own.
Cook about 30 seconds until bubbles appear and the bottom is golden, flip, and cook 30 seconds more.
Repeat with the rest of the batter.
Serve warm with butter and honey, maple syrup or caramel sauce.
recipes.title: Eggless Pancakes

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Dry the wings very well and rub with the salt, chili powder, garlic and baking powder.
Lightly oil the air fryer rack and arrange the wings with space between them.
Air fry at 410°F for 20 minutes (or 400°F for 22); add 5 minutes for extra crispy.
Check that they're deep golden; give them 3–5 more minutes if not.
If saucing, rest 5 minutes first so they stay crisp.
recipes.title: Extra Crispy Air Fryer Chicken Wings

ingredients.item: rice or cauliflower rice, green onion, sesame seeds

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Asian. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Cook the ginger in the oil over medium 30 seconds, add the pineapple juice, hot sauce and coconut aminos, and boil over medium-high.
Whisk 2 tsp of the sauce with the 1 tsp tapioca and whisk it in. Boil 2–3 minutes, then simmer 1 minute until shiny. Set aside.
Shake the chicken with the 3 tbsp tapioca, salt and pepper.
Fry in two batches in 1 tbsp oil each over medium-high until golden on both sides.
Toss with the sauce and pineapple and serve over rice with green onion and sesame seeds.
recipes.title: Firecracker Pineapple Chicken

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Mexican. A serving is 2 tacos. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Preheat the oven to 375°F. Mix the spices and sprinkle over the fish (use half for milder tacos).
Bake about 10 minutes until flaky.
Blend the avocado, yogurt, lime juice, cumin and salt until smooth.
Fill warm tortillas with cabbage, fish and crema.
recipes.title: Fish Tacos with Avocado Crema

ingredients.item: refrigerated flaky buttermilk biscuits (5 count each)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Apps. Pillsbury's figure is 100 kcal per serving, but it doesn't match one piece, so calories, protein and weight here are my estimates per piece.
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F and lightly grease cookie sheets.
Separate each of the 10 biscuits into 4 layers and lay them out.
Top each with 1 tsp pizza sauce, 2 pepperoni and about 2 tsp cheese.
Bake 7–9 minutes until golden.
recipes.title: Flaky Biscuit Pizza Snacks

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Makes 10–12. Calories, protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Preheat the oven to 450°F and line a baking sheet.
Whisk the flour, sugar, baking powder and salt, and cut in the butter until pea-size and smaller.
Mix in the buttermilk just until combined.
Pat into a 6x9 rectangle on a floured surface, fold in thirds like a letter, and pat out again.
Cut with a 2-inch cutter and bake 10–12 minutes until golden.
recipes.title: Flaky Buttermilk Biscuits

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Calories and protein are my estimates from the ingredients.
steps: Preheat the oven to 350°F and line or grease 12 muffin cups.
Blend everything except the chocolate chips until smooth.
Divide among the cups and press about four chips into each.
Bake 18–20 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean. Cool completely.
recipes.title: Flourless Brownie Muffins (Chickpea)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Preheat the air fryer to 180°C (356°F).
Season the chicken with salt and pepper and rub with the coconut milk.
Blend the oats, cauliflower and spices into fine crumbs.
Dip each piece in crumbs, then egg, then crumbs again.
Air fry 4 at a time for 20 minutes at 180°C, then 5 minutes at 200°C (392°F) to crisp.
recipes.title: Flourless Crispy Southern Fried Chicken (Air Fryer)

ingredients.item: unsweetened almond or other non-dairy milk
optional toppings: honey, maple syrup, berries, banana, dark chocolate chips

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Breakfast. Calories and protein are the site's figures per 7-inch waffle; weight is an estimate.
steps: Blend the oats into flour in a blender or food processor.
Add the egg, milk, applesauce, peanut butter, baking powder, salt and cinnamon and blend.
Add the vinegar and vanilla and blend into a thick, smooth batter, scraping down as needed. Rest 15–20 minutes.
Preheat the waffle iron to medium-high and grease it.
Pour in half the batter and cook about 5 minutes until brown. Repeat (makes two 7-inch waffles).
Serve with toppings. Keeps 2–3 days in the fridge or 3 months frozen.
recipes.title: Flourless Peanut Butter Oat Waffles

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Breakfast. Calories and protein are the site's figures per waffle; weight is an estimate.
steps: Preheat the waffle iron and coat lightly with nonstick spray.
Combine the flour, sugar, baking powder and salt in a large bowl and make a well in the center.
Whisk the eggs into the milk.
Pour the butter, milk mixture and vanilla into the well and whisk just until blended (a little lumpy is fine).
Cook in the iron until golden and crisp, about 2–3 minutes depending on your iron.
Serve right away or cool on a rack. Freeze leftovers airtight.
recipes.title: Fluffy Homemade Waffles

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Breakfast. Calories and protein are the site's figures per waffle; weight is an estimate.
steps: Whip the 3 egg whites to stiff peaks in a stand mixer; set aside.
Whisk the dry ingredients in a large bowl.
Stir the milk, pumpkin, butter, egg yolk and vinegar together in a small bowl.
Stir the pumpkin mixture into the dry ingredients.
Gently fold in the egg whites.
Cook in the waffle maker right away.
recipes.title: Fluffy Pumpkin Waffles

ingredients.item: smoked turkey or chicken sausage, sliced into coins
baby red potatoes, cut in 1/2-inch pieces
parmesan and fresh parsley, to serve

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F or the grill to medium-high (450°F). Lay out 4–6 two-foot sheets of heavy foil and spray them (or line a sheet pan).
Toss the sausage, potatoes, green beans, corn and garlic with all the seasonings.
Divide among the foil, top each with a tablespoon of butter, and seal.
Grill 25–30 minutes, flipping halfway, or bake 30–40 minutes until the potatoes are tender.
Open carefully and top with parmesan and parsley.
recipes.title: Foil Pack Garlic Butter Sausage & Veggies

ingredients.item: Yukon gold or red potatoes, 1/4-inch dice
shredded Pepper Jack cheese (or your choice)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Breakfast. Makes 16–20 burritos. Calories, protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Whisk the eggs, milk and a big pinch of salt and pepper. Scramble in a lightly oiled large pan over medium heat 4–6 minutes until cooked through; set aside.

Meanwhile, heat the 2 tbsp oil in another large pan over medium-high and sauté the onion 3 minutes. Add the potatoes and pepper and cook, stirring often, 7–10 minutes until the potatoes are tender. Stir in the beans, chiles, salt and cumin and cook 2 minutes more.
Lay a tortilla on a sheet of plastic wrap. Add about 1/4 cup eggs, a big spoonful of the potato mixture, and a few tablespoons of cheese.
Fold in two opposite sides, then the ends, and wrap tightly in the plastic. Freeze up to 3 months.
To reheat, unwrap and microwave on a plate 60–90 seconds. Serve with salsa.
recipes.title: Freezer Breakfast Burritos (Potato & Black Bean)

ingredients.item: avocado, salsa, sour cream, cilantro, to serve

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Mexican. A serving is 1 sweet potato half. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Scrub and prick the sweet potatoes and bake at 400°F 45–90 minutes until soft.
Cool slightly, halve, and scoop out the flesh, leaving a thin wall. Mash with the enchilada sauce, salt, chili powder and cumin, then stir in the beans, corn and 3/4 cup cheese.
Refill the skins and top with the remaining cheese (freeze now if making ahead).
Bake 10–15 minutes until the cheese is bubbly. Top with avocado, salsa, sour cream or cilantro.
recipes.title: Freezer to Oven Enchilada Stuffed Sweet Potatoes

ingredients.item: crushed peanuts, red pepper flakes, sesame seeds, to garnish

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Lunch (via Yummly). The archive copy had no method, so the steps are a standard summer-roll method. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Whisk the sauce ingredients, thinning with warm water to a dipping consistency.
Dip a wrapper in warm water until just pliable and lay it flat.
Lay 4 shrimp halves cut side up on the lower third, then lettuce, vegetables, a few noodles, avocado and herbs.
Fold the bottom over, fold in the sides, and roll up snugly. Repeat.
Serve with the peanut sauce, topped with peanuts, pepper flakes and sesame seeds.
recipes.title: Fresh Shrimp Summer Rolls with Easy Peanut Dipping Sauce

ingredients.item: fresh tomatoes, chopped, with their juices

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Pasta. Calories and protein are the site's figures for the sauce only; serving weight is an estimate.
steps: Tie the herbs together with kitchen twine. Core and dice the tomatoes, saving their juices.
Heat the butter and oil in a heavy pan over medium heat until foaming. Cook the onion 5–6 minutes until soft, then the garlic 1–2 minutes.
Add the tomatoes, liquid (if using), salt and pepper, stir, and set the herb bundle on top.
Bring to a boil, then simmer on medium-low, stirring occasionally, 20–25 minutes until the liquid cooks off and the tomatoes fall apart.
Optionally blend to your preferred texture. Makes 1 1/2–2 cups.
Toss with 1 lb cooked pasta, or refrigerate up to 3 days or freeze up to 6 months.
recipes.title: Fresh Tomato Pasta Sauce

ingredients.item: coconut sugar ((feel free to use more for a sweeter FroYo Bite))

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. The live recipe card didn't load, so this comes from a 2021 web archive copy. Calories and protein are the site's figures per serving (1 cup).
steps: Line a 6-cup muffin tin with silicone or parchment cupcake liners, or add directly to nonstick muffin tin.
In a small bowl, stir together crushed almonds, coconut sugar, and coconut oil. Spoon a small amount into the bottom of each muffin cup.
In a medium bowl, mix together yogurt and honey. Spoon 2 tablespoons into each muffin cup, covering the crust.
Top with fresh chopped berries. Freeze until firm, about 6 hours. To serve, remove from silicone wrapper and allow to set at room temperature for 8-10 minutes. Enjoy!
recipes.title: FroYo Berry Bites

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. The live page no longer loads, so the recipe came from an archived copy (web.archive.org, February 2017). Servings (4 pops), calories (267) and protein (8 g) are the site's; time and serving weight are estimates.
steps: In a blender or smoothie maker, combine the banana, Greek yogurt, honey, vanilla extract and peanut butter. Blend on medium until smooth and fully combined.
Set four 3-ounce plastic cups on a plate and fill each about 3/4 full with the mixture. Insert a short wooden craft or popsicle stick into the center of each cup.
Put the plate in the freezer and let the pops set for 2 hours, or until completely frozen.
Once the pops are frozen, melt the chocolate chips in a microwave-safe bowl, stirring until smooth.
Remove the pops from the freezer and dip the top of each pop in the melted chocolate, then in the crushed peanuts.
Return the pops to the freezer for 10 to 15 minutes, until the chocolate and peanuts have set.
recipes.title: Frozen Chocolate Peanut Butter Banana Greek Yogurt Pops

ingredients.item: dark chocolate, divided (4 oz melted, the rest chopped)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. The original recipe is no longer online, so this is a similar recipe from Food Faith Fitness. Don't overbake. Keeps up to 1 week in the fridge or 3 months frozen.
steps: Heat the oven to 325°F and line an 8×8-inch pan with parchment paper.
Whisk the yogurt, coconut sugar and eggs together in a large bowl.
Microwave 4 oz of the chocolate with the coconut oil for about 1 minute, until smooth, then whisk it into the egg mixture.
Whisk in the cocoa powder, cornstarch, baking soda and salt, then stir in the remaining chopped chocolate.
Spread the batter in the pan and bake 22–23 minutes, until a toothpick in the center comes out clean.
Move the pan straight to the fridge for 15 minutes.
Let cool completely on the counter before slicing.
recipes.title: Healthy Greek Yogurt Brownies

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Apps. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Shake everything together in an airtight jar.
Pour into a small bowl, spooning up the herbs with the oil, and serve with crusty bread.
recipes.title: Garlic & Herb Olive Oil Bread Dip

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Sides. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Toss the broccoli in a zip bag with the oil, lemon, garlic, salt and pepper and let stand 30 minutes.
Preheat the grill to medium (300–350°F) for 10–15 minutes.
Grill in a grill basket 8–10 minutes, turning once or twice, until bright green and crisp-tender with a little char.
Top with shaved parmesan and serve right away.
recipes.title: Garlic and Parmesan Grilled Broccoli

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Anti-Inflammatory. Serves 4–6. Calories, protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Blend everything until smooth, adding water until thick enough to dip vegetables in.
recipes.title: Garlic Artichoke Dip (Paleo, Vegan, AIP)

ingredients.item: baby carrots, tops trimmed to 2 inches

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Sides. Calories, protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Preheat the oven to 375°F and oil a baking sheet.
Toss the carrots on the sheet with the oil, balsamic, garlic, thyme, salt and pepper.
Roast 35–40 minutes until tender and garnish with parsley.
recipes.title: Garlic Balsamic Roasted Carrots

ingredients.item: vegetable oil, divided, plus more as needed

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Asian. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Stir-fry the mushrooms, snap peas, carrots and pepper in 1 tbsp oil over high about 5 minutes until crisp-tender; set aside.
Cut the steak into 2-inch strips and toss with the cornstarch.
Sear half the beef in 1 tbsp oil without stirring 1 minute, stir 40 seconds more, and remove. Repeat.
Add the broth, soy sauce, sesame oil, garlic, ginger, brown sugar and pepper flakes to the pan, scrape up the bits, and boil until reduced by a third, 5–8 minutes.
Meanwhile boil the ramen (no seasoning packets) exactly 2 minutes, drain, and rinse briefly.
Toss the vegetables, beef and noodles in the sauce and top with green onions and sesame seeds.
recipes.title: Garlic Beef and Veggie Ramen

ingredients.item: black pepper, sea salt, pinch of cayenne

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Asian. Calories and protein are the site's figures, without rice; weight is an estimate.
steps: Sauté the onion, ginger, garlic and spices in the oil over medium 3–4 minutes.
Add the broccoli and broth and cook about 10 minutes until tender but not soft.
Whisk the sauce, pour it in with the chickpeas, and bring to a simmer for a few minutes until thick.
Season and serve with rice.
recipes.title: Garlic Broccoli Stir Fry with Chickpeas

ingredients.item: cauliflower, grated (or a bag of riced cauliflower)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Calories, protein, weight and servings are estimates.
steps: Rice the cauliflower and microwave it covered on a plate with 1/2 cup water for 4 minutes.
Mix the chicken, cheese, grated garlic, Italian seasoning, bouillon, pepper flakes, half the herbs and black pepper, and form medium balls.
Brown the meatballs in 2 tbsp butter over medium-low 8–10 minutes until cooked, basting with the pan juices. Set aside.
Melt the last 1 tbsp butter in the pan and add the lemon juice, stock, hot sauce, minced garlic and remaining herbs. Simmer 3–4 minutes to reduce and season.
Divide the cauliflower rice into containers, top with meatballs, and drizzle with sauce (or pack it separately). Reheat in the microwave.
recipes.title: Garlic Butter Chicken Meatballs with Cauliflower Rice (Meal Prep)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Pasta. Calories, protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Cook the pasta in boiling salted water and drain well.
Season the shrimp with salt and pepper.
Melt 2 tbsp butter in a large cast iron skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the garlic, oregano and red pepper flakes 1–2 minutes until fragrant.
Cook the shrimp in batches until pink, 2–3 minutes, and set aside.
Melt the remaining 6 tbsp butter, then stir in the pasta, arugula and Parmesan until the arugula wilts, about 2 minutes. Stir in the shrimp.
Serve right away, garnished with parsley.
recipes.title: Garlic Butter Shrimp Pasta

ingredients.item: parsley, minced, plus more to garnish

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Anti-Inflammatory. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Microwave the potatoes with 1/4 cup water 5–6 minutes until barely tender.
Brown them in 2 tbsp ghee in a large skillet over medium-high with salt and pepper, about 6 minutes, stirring.
Push them aside, add the garlic, rosemary and parsley for the last minute, then move everything to a bowl and cover.
Add the remaining ghee and sear the seasoned steak in batches, undisturbed 2 minutes, then about 2 more until browned.
Toss with the potatoes and top with parsley.
recipes.title: Garlic Butter Steak Bites and Potatoes (Whole30)

ingredients.item: refrigerated biscuits (or dough cut into 20 pieces)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Apps. The site lists 40 kcal, which is low for a biscuit with cheese and butter, so calories, protein and weight are my estimates.
steps: Preheat the oven to 400°F and line a baking sheet (or butter an 8x8 pan).
Flatten each biscuit slightly, add a cheese cube and a pinch of parmesan, wrap, and pinch to seal.
Set seam side down an inch apart and bake about 10 minutes until golden.
Mix the butter, Italian seasoning and garlic powder, brush over the hot bombs, and sprinkle with parmesan.
recipes.title: Garlic Herb Cheese Bombs (Parmesan)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Apps. The site lists 206 kcal, which is high for one biscuit bite, so calories, protein and weight are my estimates.
steps: Preheat the oven to 400°F and line a cookie sheet with parchment.
Wrap each biscuit around a cheese cube, pinching to seal, and set seam side down at least an inch apart.
Bake about 10 minutes until golden.
Mix the butter, garlic powder, parsley and salt and brush over the bombs right away. Serve warm.
recipes.title: Garlic Herb Cheese Bombs (Parsley Butter)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Sides. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Simmer the butter and garlic in a small saucepan 2–3 minutes, stirring, without letting the garlic burn.
Heat the cauliflower rice in a large skillet over medium-high, pour in the garlic butter, sprinkle with parmesan, and stir until tender. Season.
recipes.title: Garlic Parmesan Cauliflower Rice

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. The site blocks automated reading, so this comes from a 2016 web archive copy. Calories, protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Preheat the oven to 425°F. Cut the potatoes into 1-inch wedges, toss with the oil, salt and pepper, cover with foil, and bake 45–60 minutes until just done.
Melt the butter over medium-low, add the garlic about a minute (don't let it brown), then melt in the cheese.
Grill the wedges on oiled grates over medium about 5 minutes per side, basting with the garlic butter (watch for flare-ups), until marked on all sides. Sprinkle with parsley.
recipes.title: Garlic Parmesan Grilled Potato Wedges

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Sides. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Preheat the oven to 375°F and grease a 1 1/2-quart dish.
Salt the zucchini in a colander 10 minutes, then squeeze out as much water as you can.
Mix with the onion, garlic, eggs, 1/2 cup parmesan, mozzarella and cheddar and press into the dish.
Bake uncovered 20 minutes.
Toss the panko with the butter and remaining parmesan, sprinkle on top, and bake 5–10 minutes more until golden.
recipes.title: Garlic Parmesan Zucchini Casserole

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. The site lists 24 g protein, which is low for a whole breast, so calories, protein and weight are my estimates.
steps: Mix the marinade and pour over the chicken in a gallon zip bag.
Refrigerate 4–24 hours.
Season lightly with salt and grill, bake or pan-cook as you like.
recipes.title: Garlic Ranch Chicken Marinade

ingredients.item: German whole-grain mustard (or 1 tsp dry mustard)
pretzel rolls, cubed and lightly toasted (dippers)
cocktail sausages and blanched cauliflower or broccoli (dippers)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Calories and protein are the site's figures, including dippers; weight is an estimate.
steps: Bring the beer to a low boil in a large saucepan over medium, then lower to a simmer.
Toss the cheeses with the cornstarch.
Add the cheese a handful at a time, stirring constantly until melted.
Stir in the mustard, hot sauce and Worcestershire and move to a warm fondue pot. Serve with the dippers.
recipes.title: German Beer Cheddar Fondue

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. This page reposts Sally's Baking Addiction's recipe and only lists the ingredients, so the steps are the usual method for this cake. Calories and protein are my estimates from the ingredients.
steps: Mix the flour, sugar, salt and yeast. Heat the water, milk and butter until warm, then stir into the flour with the egg to form a soft dough. Knead about 5 minutes.
Cover and let rest 10 minutes, then roll into a long rectangle.
Spread with the softened butter and sprinkle with cinnamon sugar. Cut into long strips and coil them into one giant spiral in a greased 9-inch round pan.
Cover and let rise about an hour, then bake at 350°F about 25–30 minutes until golden.
Whisk the glaze and drizzle over the warm cake.
recipes.title: Giant Cinnamon Roll Cake

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Anti-Inflammatory. Calories and protein are the site's figures per brownie; weight is an estimate.
steps: Preheat the oven to 350°F. Soak the dates in very hot water 15 minutes, drain (keep 1/4 cup liquid), and process to a smooth paste with the liquid.
Process in the eggs one at a time, then the coconut oil and vanilla, then the cocoa, then the flour, salt and baking soda. Rest 5 minutes.
Spread in a parchment-lined 12x8 pan and press chocolate chips into the top.
Bake 40–45 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean. Cool 20 minutes before cutting. Keeps 3 days in the fridge or 3 months frozen.
recipes.title: Gluten Free Chocolate Date Brownies

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Breakfast. Makes 5–6 waffles. Calories and protein are the site's figures for 1/6 of the recipe; weight and time are estimates.
steps: Preheat and lightly oil the waffle iron (a thin brush of oil, not cooking spray).
Whisk the almond flour, arrowroot, baking powder, cinnamon, nutmeg and salt in a large bowl.
Add the pumpkin, milk, maple syrup, eggs, oil and vanilla and whisk well.
Cook in the waffle iron (usually 1/3–1/2 cup batter each; don't overfill).
Repeat with the remaining batter.
Store leftovers airtight in the fridge or freezer.
recipes.title: Gluten-Free Almond Flour Pumpkin Waffles

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Pasta. The browser couldn't open the live site, so this came from an archived copy. Calories and protein are the site's figures; serving weight is an estimate.
steps: Heat the oil and butter in a deep skillet over medium heat and cook the garlic 30 seconds.
Add the tomatoes, tomato paste, broth and Italian seasoning and stir.
Stir in the gnocchi and cook, stirring often so it doesn't stick, until cooked through, 5–7 minutes. The sauce thickens as the gnocchi releases starch.
Stir in the mozzarella, Parmesan and basil until melted, season and serve right away.
recipes.title: Gnocchi with Tomato Sauce

ingredients.item: oil-packed sun-dried tomatoes, drained and chopped
red lentil pasta (or other short pasta)
Parmesan, nutritional yeast, toasted pine nuts or seeds, to top

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Anti-Inflammatory (Half Baked Harvest). Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Cook the onion in the oil over medium 5–10 minutes until soft and caramelized. Add the garlic, herbs, turmeric, salt and pepper for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes with their juices, crushing them, then the sun-dried tomatoes and vinegar. Simmer 10–15 minutes (purée if you like).
Stir in the greens for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile boil the pasta al dente and drain.
Serve the pasta with plenty of sauce and your toppings.
recipes.title: Golden Sun-Dried Tomato Red Lentil Pasta

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Anti-Inflammatory. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Blend everything until completely smooth.
recipes.title: Good Digestion Smoothie

ingredients.item: Russet or Yukon Gold potatoes, peeled and quartered

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Sides. A fan site, not Gordon Ramsay's own. Calories are the site's figure; protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Put the potatoes and garlic in cold salted water, bring to a boil, and cook 15–20 minutes until tender.
Drain well, return to the hot pot, and let steam dry 2 minutes. Add the butter and start mashing.
Gradually mash in the hot milk to the consistency you like, season well, and serve right away.
recipes.title: Gordon Ramsay-Style Perfect Mashed Potatoes

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Breakfast. Makes 8 muffins or 1 small cake. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Preheat the oven to 355°F (180°C).
Grease and/or line a muffin tin (silicone works best, lightly greased).
Mix everything in a medium bowl until smooth.
Fill the cups 3/4 full.
Bake 10–20 minutes depending on the depth of your tin, then cool completely before removing. Keeps 3–4 days.
recipes.title: Grain-Free Coffee Protein Muffins

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Two chops per serving. Calories, protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Pound the chops to 1/4 inch.
Set up three shallow bowls: flour; eggs whisked with the milk, salt and pepper; panko.
Dredge each chop in flour, then egg, then panko, shaking off the excess.
Fry in batches in 2 tbsp hot oil over medium-high, about 5 minutes per side until golden, adding oil as needed.
Serve with lemon wedges, noodles and sweet-and-sour cabbage.
recipes.title: Grandma's Easy German Schnitzel

ingredients.item: beef broth or water, more as needed

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Soup. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Cook the beef, onion and garlic in a Dutch oven over medium-high until no pink remains. Drain.
Add the marinara, broth, tomatoes, tomato paste, pepper, Italian seasoning, bay leaf, salt and pepper and bring to a boil.
Add the macaroni, cover, and simmer on medium-low 10 minutes, stirring.
Uncover and simmer 5–10 minutes until tender.
Discard the bay leaf, top with cheese, cover, and rest 5 minutes.
recipes.title: Grandma's Goulash (American Goulash)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Snacks. A serving is half a wrap. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Spread the flatbread with peanut butter.
Lay the apple matchsticks lengthwise down the center and sprinkle with the raisins, cranberries, granola and cinnamon.
Roll up from a long side, cut in half, and serve, or wrap tightly and refrigerate for lunch boxes.
recipes.title: Granola Crunch Apple-Peanut Butter Sandwich Wraps

ingredients.item: optional spinach, kale or other veggies

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Calories, protein and weight are estimates with dairy cheese.
steps: Cook the pasta in salted water until al dente and drain (don't rinse).
Meanwhile stir the milk, cheese and salt in a small pot until melted.
Add the yogurt and warm on low just until hot.
Stir in the pasta and any veggies.
recipes.title: Greek Yogurt Mac & Cheese

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Calories and protein are my estimates from the ingredients.
steps: Stir everything together. Serve with apple or banana slices.
recipes.title: Greek Yogurt Peanut Butter Honey Dip

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Sides. This pin was just a recipe image with no website, so the link goes to the pin. Calories, protein and weight are estimates per 2 tbsp.
steps: Stir everything together, then add water a tablespoon at a time until it's as thin as you like.
recipes.title: Greek Yogurt Ranch Dressing

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Breakfast. The live page no longer shows quantities, so this comes from a 2023 web archive copy. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Add everything to a high-speed blender.
Pulse to combine, scraping down the sides as needed, then blend on high until thick and creamy.
Serve right away, garnished with fresh mint, or refrigerate for later that day.
recipes.title: Green Keto Smoothie

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Combine the vinegar, Worcestershire, sugar and garlic in a zip bag, add the steak, and marinate 30 minutes at room temperature.
Season and grill to your liking.
Rest 10 minutes under foil, then slice thinly against the grain.
recipes.title: Grilled Balsamic Flank Steak

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Calories are the site's figure; the site lists 10 g protein, which is low for 4 oz of drumstick, so protein and weight are my estimates.
steps: Whisk the BBQ sauce, jelly, garlic and pepper.
Marinate the chicken in half of it in a zip bag at least 1 hour (or overnight). Refrigerate the rest for basting.
Grill at 350°F about 30 minutes, turning and basting every 10 minutes, until 185–190°F inside.
recipes.title: Grilled BBQ Chicken Drumsticks (Grape Jelly Glaze)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Toss the chicken with the oil and spices in a zip bag.
Whisk the balsamic, ketchup, honey and garlic. Add half to the bag and keep the other half covered.
Marinate in the fridge 30 minutes to 4 hours.
Discard the used marinade and grill the chicken 3–5 minutes per side until cooked.
Warm the reserved sauce 30–45 seconds and brush over the chicken.
recipes.title: Grilled Honey Balsamic Chicken

ingredients.item: olive oil, plus more for grilling
parsley or chives and lemon slices, to serve

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Calories are the site's figure; protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Mix the soy sauce, lemon juice, honey, oil and garlic in a zip bag, add the salmon, and refrigerate 1–24 hours.
Take it out 30 minutes before grilling. Lift the salmon from the marinade and simmer the marinade 3–5 minutes until syrupy.
Heat the grill to medium, oil the grates, and drizzle the salmon with oil.
Grill flesh side down 3 minutes, flip, baste, close the lid, and cook 3–4 minutes more, basting again (120°F medium-rare, 130°F medium).
Serve with herbs, lemon and the extra sauce.
recipes.title: Grilled Honey Garlic Salmon

ingredients.item: fresh sage, finely chopped, plus more to serve

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: At least 2 1/2 hours ahead (ideally the night before), pound the chops to 1/2 inch, salt generously and let sit 30 minutes.
Whisk the marinade ingredients, combine with the chops in a zip bag, and refrigerate at least 2 hours.
Heat the grill to about 350°F (medium-high).
Grill 2 minutes per side, then lower to medium and grill 2–4 minutes more per side to 145°F.
Rest 5 minutes and sprinkle with fresh sage.
recipes.title: Grilled Pork Chops with Lemon and Sage (Paleo, Whole30, Low FODMAP)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. The site lists 380 kcal and 15 g protein, which is low for a quarter rack each, so calories, protein and weight are my estimates.
steps: Pat the ribs dry on a rimmed sheet.
Mix the rub, coat the ribs lightly with oil, and sprinkle with the rub.
Set up the grill at 350°F for indirect heat with hickory or pecan wood.
Cook with the lid closed (rotate if stacking two racks) about an hour and on until the meat reaches 195–205°F.
Rest about 15 minutes before slicing.
recipes.title: Grilled Pork Spare Ribs (Dry Rub)

ingredients.item: salt, pepper, optional red pepper flakes

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Heat a grill or grill pan over medium.
Blend the oil, vinegar, water, herbs, garlic, salt and pepper into a sauce, adding water if needed.
Rub the steak with the salt, pepper, cumin and garlic powder.
Grill about 5 minutes per side for medium-rare, then rest.
Slice thinly against the grain and serve with the chimichurri.
recipes.title: Grilled Sirloin Steak with Chimichurri

ingredients.item: rice vinegar or apple cider vinegar (sauce)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Budget Meals. The site's 275 kcal per serving is low for 1 lb of beef plus oil in 4 servings, so calories and protein are my estimates. Weight is an estimate.
steps: Whisk the sauce ingredients.
Sauté the broccoli in the oil over medium with a little salt and pepper 5–6 minutes until crisp-tender. Set aside.
Brown the beef with salt and pepper and drain some of the fat.
Return the broccoli, pour in the sauce, and stir 1–2 minutes until thick and coating.
Top with green onion. Good over rice or cauliflower rice.
recipes.title: Ground Beef & Broccoli (Paleo, Gluten-Free)

ingredients.item: toppings: black olives, radishes, avocado, cilantro, green onion

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Budget Meals. The site's 164 kcal per serving is too low for 1 lb of beef in 4 servings, so calories and protein are my estimates without toppings. Weight is an estimate.
steps: Brown the beef with salt and pepper in a large skillet over medium. Set aside, leaving about 2 tbsp fat.
Cook the onion and garlic 3–4 minutes, then the cauliflower rice 7–8 minutes until tender. Stir in the cilantro and lime.
Return the beef, pour in the enchilada sauce, and stir to coat.
Serve in bowls with the toppings.
recipes.title: Ground Beef and Cauliflower Rice Enchilada Bowls

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Budget Meals. Serves 4–5. Calories, protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Preheat the oven to 400°F. Toss the sweet potatoes in a large baking dish with 2 tbsp oil, 1/2 tsp garlic powder, 1/2 tsp rosemary, salt and pepper, and bake 30 minutes.
Meanwhile brown the turkey in 1 tbsp oil with 1 tsp garlic powder, 1/2 tsp rosemary, salt and pepper.
Slice the zucchini and quarter the slices.
Stir the turkey and zucchini into the sweet potatoes and bake 10 minutes.
Stir in the last 2 tbsp oil, top with Parmesan, and bake 10 minutes more.
recipes.title: Ground Turkey Sweet Potato Bake

ingredients.item: salt, black pepper, pinch of chili flakes

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Heat the oil in a cast iron skillet over medium-high and cook the turkey and garlic about 5 minutes, breaking it up.
Add the onion and pepper and cook until soft.
Add the sweet potato, chili flakes, salt and pepper, cover, and cook, stirring now and then, until tender (add a splash of water if needed). Preheat the oven to 400°F meanwhile.
Top with mozzarella, bake until melted, and garnish with parsley.
recipes.title: Ground Turkey Sweet Potato Skillet

recipes.notes: From Pinterest board Foods I do like. Nutrition is the site's figure for 1 wafflewich.
steps: Preheat a waffle iron to medium and spray it lightly with nonstick spray.
Split each biscuit into two layers and stretch each to 5–6 inches across.
Top one half with cheese, ham and a heaping tablespoon of scrambled egg. Cover with the other half and pinch the edges to seal.
Cook in the waffle iron, pressing firmly, 4–5 minutes until golden and cooked through. Keep finished ones in a warm oven. Serve warm.
recipes.title: Ham, Egg, and Cheese Biscuit Wafflewiches

recipes.notes: From the 40 Aprons roundup Whole30 Slow Cooker Recipes. The site also gives an Instant Pot method. Calories, protein and weight are estimates (80/20 beef).
steps: Mix all the seasonings in a small bowl.
Prep the onion, parsnips, green beans and celery.
Put the raw ground beef in the slow cooker, break it up, and stir in the seasoning mix.
Add the onion, parsnips, green beans, celery and whole potatoes. Pour the broth around everything and add the coconut aminos.
Cook on LOW 6 hours or HIGH 3 hours.
Break the potatoes into bite-size chunks with a masher or spoon, break up any large pieces of beef, season and serve.
recipes.title: Hamburger Soup (Paleo + Whole30)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Calories are the site's figure; protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Simmer the marinade ingredients in a small saucepan, then cool.
Cut the steak and pineapple into 12 cubes each and the peppers and onion into 1-inch squares.
Marinate everything in a zip bag in the fridge at least 2 hours, flipping halfway.
Thread onto 4 skewers, alternating pepper, steak, onion, pepper and pineapple, and set on a broiler-safe tray.
Broil on high about 6 inches from the heat 5 minutes per side (to 145°F for medium), or grill.
Sprinkle with scallions and pepper.
recipes.title: Hawaiian Steak Kabobs

ingredients.item: boneless skinless chicken breasts, pounded 1/2 inch and cut into 1-inch pieces

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Asian. The site lists 407 kcal and 20 g protein, which is low for nearly a chicken breast each plus the sauce, so calories, protein and weight are my estimates.
steps: Bring the sugar, vinegar, soy sauce, garlic powder, onion salt and ketchup to a boil, then stir in the cornstarch slurry until thick.
Shake the chicken with the cornstarch in a zip bag and sauté in the oil over medium about 5 minutes.
Add the peppers and onion and sauté until the chicken is cooked and the vegetables are tender.
Stir in the sauce and serve with rice.
recipes.title: Healthier Sweet and Sour Chicken

ingredients.item: lemon juice or apple cider vinegar (slaw)
optional garnishes: pickles, cilantro, avocado, pumpkin seeds

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Lunch. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Toss the sweet potatoes with the oil, salt and pepper and air fry at 380°F (or roast) until tender.
Meanwhile brush the chicken with oil, season with the rub, and air fry at 400°F (or pan-fry) until cooked; brush with BBQ sauce.
Stir the slaw dressing into the coleslaw mix.
Divide the slaw, sweet potatoes and chicken among 4 bowls and add garnishes.
recipes.title: Healthy BBQ Chicken Bowls with Sweet Potatoes

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Sides. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Stir everything together in a small bowl, taste, and add salt if needed.
recipes.title: Healthy Big Mac Sauce (Greek Yogurt)

ingredients.item: dark chocolate chips (53% cacao, divided, see note 1)
oat flour (just blend regular oats in a blender)
unsweetened vanilla almond milk (or whatever milk you have on hand)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Calories and protein are the site's figures per serving (1 serving).
steps: Heat oven to 350°F (176°C). Line an 8x8-inch pan with parchment paper, leaving an overhang. Lightly spray with cooking spray.

Add 1 cup of chocolate chips to a large bowl. In a microwave-safe bowl, melt the coconut oil. Pour the hot oil over the chocolate chips and stir until melted. If needed, microwave in 10–15 second bursts, stirring between each, until smooth. Let cool slightly.
Whisk the Greek yogurt into the melted chocolate. Add vanilla, salt, baking soda, and sugar; whisk until completely smooth.
Blend oats into a fine powder. Measure out 3/4 cup after blending. Stir into the batter along with the remaining 1/2 cup chocolate chips.

Spread batter evenly into the prepared pan (it will be thick). Bake for 28–32 minutes or until a fork inserted in the center comes out clean. Do not overbake; slightly underbaking gives a fudgier result. Let brownies cool completely in the pan on a wire rack.

Optional Frosting: In a microwave-safe bowl, combine chocolate chips and milk. Microwave in 15-second bursts, stirring between each, until smooth. Stir in Greek yogurt, then whisk in powdered sugar. Briskly whisk until completely smooth. Let sit at room temp for 10 minutes to thicken before spreading over cooled brownies.
Cover the pan and refrigerate for at least 6 hours, or overnight. These brownies are best cold. Once chilled, lift out using the parchment and cut into squares.
recipes.title: Healthy Brownies

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Budget Meals. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Mix the bruschetta ingredients and chill.
Preheat the oven to 375°F. Season the chicken and sear in the oil in an oven-safe skillet over medium, 5 minutes per side.
Finish in the oven 10–15 minutes until 165°F inside.
Meanwhile boil the vinegar and honey, then simmer until reduced by about half and thick but pourable.
Top the chicken with the bruschetta and drizzle with the glaze.
recipes.title: Healthy Bruschetta Chicken with Balsamic Glaze

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Lunch. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
