steps: Spread the wrap with the yogurt and sprinkle with blue cheese.
Toss the chicken in the buffalo sauce and layer it with the remaining ingredients.
Fold in the sides, roll up tightly, and cut in half.
recipes.title: Healthy Buffalo Chicken Wrap

ingredients.item: boneless skinless chicken breasts or thighs
cilantro, lime, red onion, avocado, to garnish

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Soup. Calories and protein are the site's figures per 1.75 cups; weight is an estimate.
steps: Fry the tortilla strips in 1 tbsp oil in a Dutch oven over medium until golden; set aside.
Add the other 1 tbsp oil and the garlic for 30 seconds.
Add the chicken and spices and brown about 5 minutes.
Add the broth, tomato sauce, corn and beans, bring to a boil, then cover and simmer on low 20 minutes.
Shred the chicken, return it, and serve with the tortilla strips and garnishes.
recipes.title: Healthy Chicken Tortilla Soup

ingredients.item: cashews, soaked 1–2 hours and drained well
+ 1 tsp honey (or rice malt syrup or 4–5 soaked Medjool dates)
cacao nibs or dark chocolate chunks

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Calories and protein are my estimates from the ingredients.
steps: Process everything except the cacao nibs in a food processor 2–3 minutes, scraping down, until very smooth.
Let it cool a few minutes if it warmed, then pulse in the cacao nibs 4–5 times.
Eat with a spoon. Keeps 4–5 days in the fridge.
recipes.title: Healthy Chocolate Chip Cookie Dough (Raw, Vegan Option)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Calories and protein are my estimates from the ingredients.
steps: Preheat oven to 400ºF. Spray a 12-cup muffin tin with cooking spray and set aside.
Layer grated zucchini in paper towels to get excess moisture off.
Cream butter and sugar in a mixing bowl. Add applesauce and egg and combine.
Sift together flour, baking powder, salt and cinnamon in a separate bowl. Pour vanilla extract into the cup of milk.

Add about 1/3 of flour mixture to mixing bowl and mix on low until just combined. Don't overmix. Add half of the milk and mix until just combined. Add another 1/3 of the flour mixture and mix until barely combined. Add the remaining milk and blend. Finish the rest of the flour mixture, making sure to not overmix.

Fold in zucchini and chocolate chips and divide batter into muffin cups. Bake in preheated oven for 15-20 minutes, or until tops are barely golden brown and spring back when touched. Let cool and remove from pan. Enjoy!
recipes.title: Healthy Chocolate Chip Zucchini Muffins

ingredients.item: honey or maple syrup (or a few stevia drops)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. The archived page cuts off during the dipping step, which is the usual method. Calories and protein are my estimates from the ingredients.
steps: Roast the peanuts at 350°F about 5 minutes, until just golden. Cool.
Blend until smooth and oily, then blend in the honey and salt.
Stir in enough almond meal for the mixture to form a ball, and freeze 15 minutes.
Scoop small balls onto a parchment-lined sheet and freeze about 30 minutes until set.
Melt the chocolate with the coconut oil, dip the balls, and freeze until the coating sets.
recipes.title: Healthy Chocolate Peanut Butter Balls (Paleo, Keto, Dairy-Free)

ingredients.item: coconut flour, sifted (or oat or almond flour; see notes)
vanilla or cinnamon protein powder (paleo-friendly if needed)
egg whites (vegan: 1 flax egg = 1 tbsp flax + 3 tbsp water)
milk to thin the frosting; cinnamon for dusting

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Breakfast. The live link now goes to a category page, so this comes from a 2018 web archive copy. With oat or almond flour you need much less milk. Calories, protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Mix the sifted coconut flour, protein powder, cinnamon and baking powder in a bowl.
Stir in the egg whites (or flax egg).
Add the milk a tablespoon at a time until a thick batter forms.
Cook in a hot waffle iron (or frying pan) until crispy.
Meanwhile, mix the melted coconut butter and protein powder, adding milk slowly until it's like frosting.
Top the waffle with the frosting and a dusting of cinnamon.
recipes.title: Healthy Cinnamon Roll Protein Waffle (Paleo / Vegan Options)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Lunch. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Mix the yogurt, mayo, sour cream, honey, vinegar, poppy seeds, mustard, salt and pepper.
Stir in the chicken, celery, cranberries, almonds and green onions.
Chill at least 30 minutes if you can.
recipes.title: Healthy Cranberry Almond Chicken Salad

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Lunch. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Mash the eggs with the yogurt, mustard, vinegar, paprika, salt and pepper until creamy.
Stir in the celery, onion and herbs (add a spoonful more yogurt if needed). Keeps 2–3 days.
recipes.title: Healthy Greek Yogurt Egg Salad

ingredients.item: red pepper flakes, salt and pepper (sauce)
green onion and sesame seeds, to garnish
white rice or cauliflower rice, to serve

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Asian. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Whisk the orange juice, zest, coconut aminos, vinegar, pepper flakes, salt and pepper.
Cook the ginger and garlic in 1/2 tbsp oil over medium about a minute, add the juice mixture, and bring to a boil over high.
Whisk 2 tsp of the hot sauce into 1 tsp tapioca until smooth, whisk it into the pan, boil 2 minutes, then simmer on medium-low 3–4 minutes until glossy. Set aside.
Toss the chicken with the 3 tbsp tapioca, salt and pepper in a zip bag.
Fry in two batches in 1 tbsp oil each over medium-high, 2–3 minutes per side, until golden and crisp.
Toss with the sauce and orange segments and garnish. Serve over rice.
recipes.title: Healthy Homemade Orange Chicken (Paleo)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Meal Prep. A serving is 2 tbsp. Calories are the site's figure; weight is an estimate.
steps: Blend everything until smooth and pour over salad.
recipes.title: Healthy Lemon Basil Vinaigrette

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Calories and protein are the site's figures per serving (1/2 cup).
steps: To a blender add greek yogurt, raspberries, lemon juice, lemon zest, and honey.
Blend until smooth.
Serve immediately or for a more solid consistency place in an air tight container and put in freezer for 1-2 hours. Serve!
recipes.title: Healthy Lemon Raspberry Frozen Yogurt

ingredients.item: cilantro, guacamole, sour cream, to serve

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Mexican. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Brown the peppers and onion in a little oil in a hot skillet with some of the chili powder and cumin, stirring and resting so they char. Set aside, then roast the corn the same way. Salt the vegetables.
Preheat the oven to 400°F and grease a 9x13 pan. Thin the refried beans with a little water.
Spread a little sauce in the pan, then layer half the tortilla strips, all the beans, half the vegetables, half the sauce and half the cheese. Repeat with the rest.
Cover with foil and bake 15–20 minutes until bubbling. Serve with toppings.
recipes.title: Healthy Mexican Casserole with Roasted Corn and Peppers

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Calories and protein are my estimates from the ingredients.
steps: Warm the peanut butter, honey, coconut oil and cocoa gently in a saucepan just until melted.
Stir in the vanilla and oats.
Drop by spoonfuls onto a lined plate and let set. Store airtight in the fridge.
recipes.title: Healthy No-Bake Cookies

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Breakfast. The recipe gives no yield, so about 6 waffles is assumed. Calories, protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Mash the bananas. Mix in the wet ingredients, then the dry.
Cook in the waffle iron per the manufacturer's directions.
recipes.title: Healthy Paleo Pumpkin Protein Waffles

ingredients.item: vanilla protein powder, depending on your brand

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Recipe from the live Blissfully Blessed blog post. The site gives no servings or nutrition, so servings (1), calories, protein (assuming 1 scoop of protein powder) and serving weight are estimates.
steps: Add the ice, almond milk, protein powder, cocoa powder, peanut butter, Truvia and vanilla to a blender. The author doesn't measure exactly, so adjust the amounts to taste.
Blend until smooth and enjoy.
recipes.title: Healthy Peanut Butter Cup "Milkshake"

ingredients.item: low-sodium chickpeas ((15 ounces) , rinsed and drained (or 1 1/2 cups cooked chickpeas))
rolled oats (or substitute quick-cooking oats; do not use instant)
pure maple syrup (or substitute honey or light agave nectar)
milk (any kind you like—use almond milk or other nut milk to keep the recipe vegan)
semisweet chocolate chips (plus additional 2 tablespoons for sprinkling on top (use dairy free if needed))

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. The live recipe card didn't load, so this comes from a 2021 web archive copy. Calories and protein are the site's figures per serving (1 (of 10)).
steps: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F. Lightly grease an 8-inch cast-iron or ovenproof skillet or 8x8-inch baking pan with nonstick spray.

In the bowl of a food processor fitted with a steel blade, place the chickpeas, oats, peanut butter, maple syrup, vanilla extract, cinnamon, baking powder, salt, and milk. Blend until mostly smooth. Remove the lid and scrape down the sides of the bowl, then blend for an additional 2 minutes until very well combined and smooth. The batter will be very sticky and thick. Fold in 1/3 cup chocolate chips.

Scrape the mixture into the prepared skillet and sprinkle the remaining 2 tablespoons chocolate chips over the top. If using a skillet, bake for 25 to 30 minutes until the top is dry to the touch and a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean with just a few crumbs clinging to it. If using an 8x8-inch pan, begin checking for doneness at 20 minutes. Do not overbake or the cookie will taste dry. Place on a wire rack to cool. Slice and serve.
recipes.title: Healthy Peanut Butter Skillet Cookie

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Soup. Calories and protein are the site's figures per 1.5 cups; weight is an estimate.
steps: Sauté the onion, carrots and celery in the oil 5 minutes.
Add the potatoes, broth and seasonings (not the milk), boil, then simmer 30 minutes until tender, stirring often.
Stir in the room-temperature milk and blend until smooth.

Instant Pot: sauté the vegetables, scrape the bottom, add everything but the milk, and cook 10 minutes on high pressure with a quick release. Slow cooker: 6 hours high or 8 low. Finish with milk and blend either way.
Top with bacon, chives or cheese.
recipes.title: Healthy Potato Soup (Whole30)

ingredients.item: crushed tomatoes or tomato purée (not sauce)
to garnish: Greek yogurt and cilantro

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Asian. The site lists 278 kcal and 26 g protein, which is low for 6 oz of chicken each, so calories, protein and weight are my estimates.
steps: Sauté the onion, jalapeño and garlic in the oil over medium about 5 minutes and move to the slow cooker.
Stir in the tomatoes, ginger, lemon juice and spices.
Add the chicken, spoon the sauce over, and cook on Low 6–7 hours or High 2–3.
Shred the chicken and return it, stir in the coconut milk, and cook uncovered on High 15–20 minutes to thicken. Season.
Serve with brown rice or naan, topped with yogurt and cilantro.
recipes.title: Healthy Slow Cooker Chicken Tikka Masala

ingredients.item: red or green bell pepper, diced
red wine or apple cider vinegar
hamburger buns, or 4 medium sweet potatoes

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Slow Cooker. Nutrition is the site's figure for 1 sloppy joe without bun or potato; serving weight is an estimate for the filling.
steps: Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium heat and cook the onion until soft, about 3 minutes. Add the garlic for 1 minute.
Add the beef and brown, about 5 minutes. Drain the fat and move the beef and onions to a 4-quart slow cooker.
Add the remaining ingredients and stir until the tomato paste is evenly mixed in. Cook on LOW 6–7 hours or HIGH 3–4 hours.
Serve warm on whole wheat buns or in roasted sweet potatoes.
For sweet potatoes, start an hour before serving: rub with coconut oil and salt, poke a few holes, and bake at 400°F on a foil-lined sheet about 1 hour until soft inside.
recipes.title: Healthy Slow Cooker Sloppy Joes

ingredients.item: unsalted butter (melted (or substitute melted coconut oil to make vegan/dairy free))
freshly squeezed lemon juice (from about 1/2 small lemon)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Calories and protein are the site's figures per serving (1 (of 16) without glaze).
steps: Place a rack in the center of your oven and preheat to 375 degrees F. Line an 8x8-inch baking pan with parchment paper so that the paper overhangs two sides like handles.

In a medium bowl, combine the oats, flour, brown sugar, ginger, and salt. Pour in the melted butter and stir until it forms clumps and the dry ingredients are evenly moistened. Set aside 1/2 cup of the crumble mixture, then press the rest into an even layer in the bottom of the prepared pan. Press very firmly so the crust holds together (you can also use the back of a measuring cup to help press it into an even later).

Scatter half of the strawberries over the crust. Sprinkle the cornstarch evenly over the top, then sprinkle on the lemon juice and 1/2 tablespoon of the granulated sugar. Scatter on the remaining berries, then the remaining 1/2 tablespoon sugar. Sprinkle the reserved crumbs evenly over the top. You will have some fruit showing through.

Bake the bars for 35 to 40 minutes, until the fruit is bubbly and the crumb topping smells toasty and looks golden. Place the pan on a wire rack to cool completely (you can speed this process along in the refrigerator).

While the bars cool, prepare the glaze: In a medium bowl, briskly whisk together the powdered sugar, vanilla, and milk until smooth. Feel free to add more milk if a thinner consistency is desired. Using the parchment-paper handles, lift the bars from the pan. Drizzle with glaze, slice, and serve.
recipes.title: Healthy Strawberry Oatmeal Bars

ingredients.item: solid white tuna in water, well drained

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Calories and protein are the site's figures per cake, without aioli; weight is an estimate.
steps: Whisk the aioli ingredients and refrigerate at least 30 minutes.
Press the tuna in a strainer to remove as much liquid as possible. Sauté the onion in a little oil about 8 minutes until soft.
Whisk the mayo, lemon juice, salt and pepper, then add the cilantro and jalapeños.
Mix in the tuna, eggs, onion and almond flour until it holds together.
Heat a teaspoon of oil in a large nonstick skillet, then lower to medium. Pack 1/3-cup portions and turn them out as patties.
Cook about 3 minutes per side until golden and crisp, adding oil between batches. Serve with the aioli.
recipes.title: Healthy Tuna Cakes with Sriracha Aioli

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Lunch. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Drain the tuna very well, pressing on the lids, and flake into a bowl.
Stir in everything else and refrigerate.
Serve cold in a sandwich or over lettuce.
recipes.title: Healthy Tuna Salad (Greek Yogurt)

ingredients.item: frozen chopped spinach, thawed and squeezed dry

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Pasta (a Weight Watchers recipe, 1 roll per serving). The original site now redirects to an unrelated, unsafe page, so this came from an archived copy and the link points to the archive. Calories, protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Cook the noodles per the package, drain, rinse, and lay flat on wax paper.
Heat the oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat and cook the turkey, onion and pepper, stirring, until browned and the juices evaporate, about 10 minutes.
Stir in the marinara and water, bring to a boil, then simmer uncovered about 5 minutes until slightly thickened.
Preheat the oven to 375°F. Mix the ricotta, spinach, basil, Parmesan, egg and nutmeg.
Spread the ricotta mixture along each noodle and roll up from a short end.
Spread half the turkey sauce in an 8x12 dish, add the rolls seam-side down, and top with the rest of the sauce.
Cover with foil and bake 30 minutes. Uncover, sprinkle with mozzarella, and bake about 10 minutes more until golden.
recipes.title: Healthy Turkey and Spinach Lasagna Rolls

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Preheat the oven to 375°F.
Mix the 2 tbsp oil, garlic, rosemary and thyme, season, and rub it over the pork in a baking pan.
Roast 30–35 minutes.
Blend the basil, garlic, pine nuts, lemon juice and 1/2 cup oil smooth and season with salt.
Spread some pesto over the pork and roast 12–15 minutes more. Serve with the remaining pesto.
recipes.title: Herb Roasted Pork Loin with Pesto

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Calories and protein are the site's figures per slice; weight is an estimate.
steps: Pat the roast dry, salt all over with 2 tsp salt, cover and leave at room temperature 2 hours.
Preheat the oven to 500°F with a rack in the lower third.
Mix the oil, garlic, herbs, salt, pepper, onion powder and paprika into a paste and rub it over the roast, fat side up, in a roasting dish. Insert an oven-safe thermometer in the center.
Roast 20 minutes at 500°F, then lower to 325°F and roast to 122–125°F for medium-rare (about 15 min per lb).
Drizzle with the pan juices, tent with foil and rest 20 minutes (it climbs to about 130–135°F).
Remove the strings and slice 1/2 inch thick. Optional: whisk 2–3 tsp flour into the heated pan juices, thinning with broth, for a quick gravy.
recipes.title: Herb-Crusted Sirloin Tip Roast
recipes.totalTime: 3 hr 30 min (incl. 2 hr resting at room temp)

ingredients.item: plant-based protein powder, chocolate or vanilla
optional toppings: coconut whip, cacao nibs, berries, dark chocolate

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Breakfast. Protein is the site's figure. The site lists 200 kcal, which is too low with 3 tbsp maple syrup, so calories and weight are my estimates.
steps: Whisk the milk, protein powder, cocoa, vanilla, maple syrup and salt until smooth.
Stir in the chia seeds.
Rest 5 minutes, then stir again so it doesn't clump.
Cover and refrigerate at least 2 hours or overnight.
Stir and add toppings. Keeps 4–5 days in the fridge.
recipes.title: High Protein Chocolate Chia Pudding (Vegan)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Lunch. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Preheat the oven to 400°F.
Mix the cottage cheese, marinara, almond flour, pepper, onion, olives, Italian seasoning, salt and pepper in an oven-safe bowl.
Level it out, sprinkle with mozzarella, and top with pepperoni.
Bake 5–8 minutes until melted and bubbling. Garnish with parmesan and basil.
recipes.title: High Protein Cottage Cheese Pizza Bowl

recipes.notes: From Pinterest board Foods I do like. Nutrition is the site's figure for 1 ball.
steps: Line a tray that fits in your freezer with parchment paper.
In a food processor, process the almonds into a fine crumb.
Add the chickpeas and process until fully broken down.
Add the peanut butter, honey and vanilla and process until smooth.
Remove the blade and stir in the chocolate chips, if using.
Roll the mixture into small balls (about 30) and place on the tray.
Freeze at least 20 minutes before serving.
recipes.title: High Protein Energy Balls

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Breakfast. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Preheat the oven to 350°F.
Mix everything except the banana chips in a small bowl.
Line a muffin tin and lightly spray the liners.
Fill cups about 2/3 full until the batter is used up.
Top each with a few banana chips.
Bake on the center rack 12 minutes, until the chips are golden. Keeps 3 days airtight or 3 months frozen.
recipes.title: High Protein Peanut Butter Banana Muffins

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Breakfast. The original Fit Blog link now redirects to Diabetes Strong. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Blend the yogurt, protein powder and almond milk.
Mix in the oats, pumpkin, sweetener and spices.
Refrigerate overnight.
Stir until even and top with the walnuts.
recipes.title: High Protein Pumpkin Overnight Oats

ingredients.item: peaches, fresh, frozen or canned, plus more to top

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Breakfast. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: In a pint jar, stir the yogurt, milk, sweetener and vanilla until smooth. Stir in the oats, chia and salt, then the peaches.
Cover and refrigerate overnight or at least 4 hours.
Top with more peaches and walnuts if you like. Keeps 5 days in the fridge.
recipes.title: High-Protein Peach Overnight Oats with Greek Yogurt

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Breakfast. Calories and protein are the site's figures; serving weight is an estimate.
steps: Whisk the chia seeds, protein powder, pumpkin spice and salt until no protein clumps remain.
Whisk in everything else, let sit 5 minutes, then whisk again.
Cover and refrigerate at least 1 hour, or overnight, to thicken.
Stir well, taste, and add more maple syrup if you like.
Serve with more yogurt, whipped cream, diced apple or banana, and crushed nuts.
recipes.title: Higher Protein Pumpkin Chia Pudding

ingredients.item: pure maple syrup (real, not pancake syrup)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. The site lists 24 g protein, which is low for 2 lb of thighs over 4 servings, so calories, protein and weight are my estimates.
steps: Preheat the oven to 450°F and line an 8x8 pan with 2 layers of foil.
Whisk the Dijon, maple syrup, vinegar, salt and pepper.
Turn the chicken in the sauce in the pan and bake uncovered 40 minutes.
Rest 5 minutes and move the chicken to a plate, keeping the liquid.
Right away, whisk the cornstarch into the hot pan juices to thicken, drizzle over the chicken, and sprinkle with rosemary.
recipes.title: Holy Yum Chicken (Maple Dijon Thighs)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. The site is gone and its archive copy only listed ingredients (it pointed to justaspoonfulof.com for the method), so the steps are a standard baked mac method. Calories, protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Preheat the oven to 350°F and grease a 9x13. Cook the macaroni until just al dente and drain.
Melt the butter, whisk in the flour 1 minute, then slowly whisk in the milk with the salt and sugar and cook until thickened.
Stir in the Velveeta until melted, then the sour cream, cottage cheese, cheddar and Swiss.
Fold in the macaroni and spread in the dish.
Toss the crushed Ritz with the melted butter, sprinkle on top, and bake about 30–35 minutes until bubbly and golden.
recipes.title: Homemade Baked Macaroni and Cheese (Five Cheese, Ritz Topping)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Snacks. Serves 2–4. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Preheat the oven to 400°F and line a baking sheet.
Slice the potatoes about 1/16 inch thin and pat dry.
Toss with the oil and salt (or brush each side on the sheet).
Spread in a single layer, not touching, and bake 10 minutes. Flip each chip and bake 7–9 minutes more, removing any that finish early.
Cool 2–5 minutes.
recipes.title: Homemade Baked Potato Chips

ingredients.item: (1 stick / 113 g) unsalted butter, (melted, then cooled)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Calories are the site's figures per serving (1 brownie).
steps: Preheat the oven to 350°F and spray an 8x8-inch pan with non-stick spray.
Sift (or whisk) together granulated sugar, cocoa powder, flour, salt, and baking powder in a large bowl.
Melt butter and set aside to cool.
In a medium bowl, beat two eggs and vanilla extract with a hand-held mixer.
Add the egg mixture and melted butter to the dry ingredients. Stir until just incorporated.
Pour batter into the prepared pan and bake for 20-22 minutes.
recipes.title: Homemade Brownie Mix

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Asian. The last steps are summarized from the site. The site lists 420 kcal, which is high for 1/8 of this dough, so calories, protein and weight are my estimates.
steps: Whisk 3 1/4 cups flour with the salt.
Stir the yeast and sugar into the warm water and let it get foamy, 5–10 minutes (start over if it doesn't).
Mix in the oil, milk and yogurt, then the flour a cup at a time, then 3–4 tbsp more flour a spoonful at a time. The dough should stay a little sticky.
Knead 2 minutes with a dough hook (7–8 by hand) until smooth.
Let rise in an oiled, covered bowl in a warm spot 60–90 minutes until doubled.
Divide into 8 balls, roll each into an oval, sprinkle with nigella seeds, and cook in a very hot cast iron skillet until bubbly and charred in spots on both sides.
Brush with melted butter right away.
recipes.title: Homemade Butter Naan

ingredients.item: crab meat or imitation crab (mix with a little mayo if you like)
bamboo rolling mat and plastic wrap

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Asian. This is Allrecipes' how-to article, which gives the technique more than exact amounts; the quantities are a standard set for 4 rolls. Calories, protein and weight are estimates per roll.
steps: Lay plastic wrap over a bamboo mat (strips running side to side) and set a nori sheet on it.
With wet fingers, spread about 1 cup rice thinly over the nori, leaving a small strip bare at the top. (For rice-outside rolls, flip it over.)
Lay the fillings across the center without overpacking.
Lift the mat up and over, pressing the filling into a firm tube, and roll until about an inch of nori shows. Seal the edge with a little water and squeeze the mat snugly around the roll.
Slice in half with a sharp knife, then each half into thirds.
recipes.title: Homemade California Roll Sushi

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Drinks. A serving is 3 tbsp of mix (makes about 32). Calories, protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Process everything in a food processor until powdery.
Store airtight in a cool, dry place up to 6 months.
For one cup, stir 3 tbsp mix into 1 cup boiling water.
recipes.title: Homemade Chai Tea Latte Mix

ingredients.item: extra sharp cheddar (or other cheese), room temp
ice water (use as little as possible)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Snacks. Calories, protein, weight and servings are estimates.
steps: Preheat the oven to 350°F.
Pulse the cheese in a food processor into small pieces, then add the flour, salt and butter.
Add water a teaspoon at a time just until the dough comes together.
Wrap and chill until slightly firm.
Roll 1/8 inch thick between parchment, cut 1-inch squares, and poke a hole in each center.
Bake on an ungreased sheet about 20 minutes until lightly golden (check at 15). Cool on the sheet to crisp.
recipes.title: Homemade Cheez-It Crackers

ingredients.item: good curry powder, plus more to sprinkle
French fries or crusty rolls, to serve

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. The site's 26 kcal is for 2 tbsp of sauce only; calories, protein and weight here are my estimates for a bratwurst with its share of sauce, without fries.
steps: Curry ketchup: cook the onion in the oil until soft (not browned), add the garlic 1 minute, then the curry powder, paprika, cloves and cinnamon 30 seconds. Add everything else, simmer, and blend smooth. Makes 1 1/2 cups; keeps a month in the fridge.
If the sausages are raw, poach them in barely simmering water first.
Grill or pan-fry the sausages until they have a thick, crisp brown crust.
Slice into bite-size pieces, top with curry ketchup and a sprinkle of curry powder, and serve with fries or rolls.
recipes.title: Homemade Currywurst with Curry Ketchup

ingredients.item: sharp or extra sharp cheddar, shredded

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Snacks. The post also shows how to make a fish cutter from an aluminum can. Calories, protein, weight and servings are estimates.
steps: Cut the butter into the flour with a pastry blender (or pulse in a food processor) to coarse crumbs. Mix in the salt, then the cheese.
Add the water a tablespoon at a time, form a dough, divide in two, and chill 20 minutes.
Preheat the oven to 340°F (170°C) and line baking trays.
Roll one portion at a time 1/8 inch thick between wax paper and cut fish shapes. Add eyes with a toothpick and a smile with a fork if you like. Re-roll the scraps.
Bake 15–17 minutes until crisp and golden at the edges. Cool 10 minutes on the tray, then on a rack. Store airtight.
recipes.title: Homemade Goldfish Crackers

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or kosher salt

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Makes about 5 tbsp; a serving is 1 tbsp. Calories and protein are the site's figures.
steps: Whisk everything together in a bowl.
Store in a small jar in a cool, dark cupboard for at least 3 months.
Use about 1 tbsp per pound of ground beef.
recipes.title: Homemade Ground Beef Seasoning

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Budget Meals. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Brown the beef in a large sauté pan over medium, add the onion, and cook until the beef is done. Drain if needed.
Add the spices, broth, milk, tomatoes and macaroni and stir.
Bring to a simmer, cover, and cook on low until the macaroni is al dente, stirring once halfway.
Stir in the cheese until melted and let it sit 5 minutes to thicken.
recipes.title: Homemade Hamburger Helper (Cheeseburger Macaroni)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Pulse the flour, salt and yeast in a food processor, then pulse in the oil.
With the machine running, pour in the warm water and run until a dough ball forms.
Let rise in a greased, covered bowl until doubled.
Roll handfuls into hand-size circles, add sauce, cheese and meat, fold into half-moons, and seal the edges.
Bake on an ungreased sheet at 450°F for 12–15 minutes.
To freeze, cool, wrap in plastic and bag. Reheat from frozen wrapped in a paper towel, about 1 1/2 minutes in the microwave.
recipes.title: Homemade Hot Pockets (Freezer Friendly)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Apps. Serves 4–6. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Melt the butter in a medium skillet over medium, whisk in the flour, and cook until a smooth bubbling paste.
Whisk in the milk, bring to a boil over high, then lower to a simmer and let it thicken about 30 seconds.
Whisk in the cayenne and salt, take off the heat, and stir in the cheese until smooth.
Serve right away; it firms up as it sits. Makes about 2 cups.
recipes.title: Homemade Nacho Cheese Sauce

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Calories and protein are my estimates from the ingredients.
steps: Preheat the oven to 350°F. Stir the sugar, peanut butter and egg together until smooth.
Scoop 1-inch balls onto a parchment-lined sheet, roll in sugar if you like, and shape into small logs. Press a criss-cross with a fork and pinch in the middles.
Bake 12 minutes and cool 1–2 minutes on the tray.
Beat the butter and peanut butter smooth, then the powdered sugar, then milk a tablespoon at a time.
Spread about a tablespoon of filling on the bottom of one cookie and top with another.
recipes.title: Homemade Nutter Butters

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Pasta (a SELF article). Servings, calories, protein and weight are estimates. The article gives the method in prose; the final cooking line is a general guideline, not quoted.
steps: Mound the flour on a clean counter or board and make a wide well in the center for the eggs, salt and oil.
Whisk the eggs and oil in the well with a fork, gradually pulling in the surrounding flour until a dough forms.
Knead 8–10 minutes, until smooth and elastic and it springs back when poked.
Cover and rest 30–60 minutes.
Cut the dough into sections and work with one at a time. Stretch into a rectangle, roll 2–3 times, fold like a letter, flip, and keep rolling.
Roll until thin enough to see your fingers through it, 5–10 minutes, dusting with flour if it sticks.
Cut into linguine or your favorite shape, then cook in boiling salted water until tender (fresh pasta takes just a few minutes).
recipes.title: Homemade Pasta Without a Machine

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Anti-Inflammatory (Oh She Glows). Calories, protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Put the potatoes and green beans in a pot and cover with vinegar. Boil, then cook on medium 5 minutes. Let sit off the heat 30 minutes.
Lay the potato rounds flat on a greased baking sheet, drizzle with oil, and toss. Sprinkle with salt and pepper.
Bake at 425°F 30–35 minutes, then flip.
Add the green beans with a drizzle of oil and salt and bake 10–15 minutes more, watching so nothing burns.
recipes.title: Homemade Salt & Vinegar Potato Chips (and Green Beans)

ingredients.item: Tbsp half and half, (then more if needed)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Calories and protein are the site's figures per serving (1 serving).
steps: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper or silicone liners.

Place 1 sheet of puff pastry on a lightly floured surface and cut into 6 equal rectangles. In a small bowl whisk together jam with cornstarch then spoon 1 1/2 Tbsp jam over top of 3 of the rectangles, leaving about 1/2-inch rim around all edges uncoated.

In a small bowl whisk together egg with 1 Tbsp water. Lightly brush rim (section around edges not covered with jam) with egg mixture (I just used my fingertip to brush because only a small amount is needed).

Layer remaining puff pastry rectangles over jam coated puff pastry and press edges to seal, transfer to refrigerator while preparing second batch and repeat process with remaining sheet of puff pastry.
Brush tops of each strudel lightly with egg wash. Bake until golden brown, about 20 minutes. Let cool on a wire rack until warm then drizzle icing over top.
For the icing, whisk together all ingredients in a small bowl until well blended. Add more half and half to thin as needed. Transfer to a small resealable bag and cut tip from one corner to drizzle.
recipes.title: Homemade Toaster Strudels

ingredients.item: ripe fresh tomatoes (or about 2 1/2 28-oz cans peeled tomatoes)
yellow or sweet onion, peeled and halved

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Pasta. Makes about 6 cups. The site lists 47 kcal per 1/4 cup; this card uses 1/2-cup servings (94 kcal).
steps: Peel and roughly chop the tomatoes.
Put the tomatoes, salt, onion halves and butter in a large Dutch oven and bring to a boil over medium-high heat until the tomatoes release their juices.
Lower to a steady simmer and cook uncovered about 45 minutes until thickened, mashing big pieces with a wooden spoon.
Taste and adjust the salt.
Remove the onion and serve with pasta, or can or freeze it.
recipes.title: Homemade Tomato Sauce (Butter & Onion)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Breakfast. Calories, protein, weight and time are estimates.
steps: Mix everything together in a bowl.
Heat the waffle iron and cook the waffles. Makes 16.
recipes.title: Homemade Waffles (No Milk, Apple or Pumpkin Butter)

ingredients.item: heavy cream (extra cold, can place in the freezer for 10 to 15 minutes)
powdered sugar (depending on how sweet you want your whipped cream)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. The live recipe card didn't load, so this comes from a 2023 web archive copy. Calories and protein are the site's figures per serving (1 serving).
steps: Chill the mixing bowl and whisk attachment in the freezer for 5 to 10 minutes.
Pour heavy whipping cream into mixing bowl and beat on medium to medium high speed with the whisk attachment until the cream gets bubbly and starts to thicken.
Add the powdered sugar and vanilla extract.
Continue beating on medium-high speed until stiff peaks form being careful not to over beat.
Use whipped cream immediately or cover and store in an airtight container in the fridge for a day or two.
recipes.title: Homemade Whipped Cream

ingredients.item: optional: 1–2 seeded jalapeños, 1 cup fresh corn

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Apps. Serves 4–6. Calories, protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Lightly toss everything together.
Cover and refrigerate about an hour to let the flavors marry (or dig in right away). Great with lime tortilla chips.
recipes.title: Homemade Yellow Pear Tomato Salsa

ingredients.item: chipotle seasoning (e.g. McCormick Grill Mates), divided

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Heat oil in a large skillet over high.
Rub the chicken with oil, salt, pepper, garlic powder and 1 tbsp chipotle seasoning.

steps: Place almond flour and confectioners sugar into food processor, pulse about 20 times. Sift into bowl large bowl, discarding any large pieces. Do not push large pieces through sifter. Then add 75g of egg whites into the bowl. Thoroughly mix together to form a paste. Feel free to be aggressive with your mixing. When combined, cover and set aside.

Add remaining 75g of egg whites into a stand mixer, and set aside. Meanwhile, add white sugar and water into a small pot, and turn on medium-high. Once mixture heats to 110°C (230°F) turn on stand mixer to high and beat egg whites.

When sugar mixture reaches 118°C (244°F) and egg whites have reached stiff peaks (but not dry), slowly drizzle the sugar mixture into the beating egg whites, ensuring that the stream is slow and is drizzling down the side of the bowl.
Continue to beat the meringue until it reaches the ‘bird beak’ stage. Add food coloring, if desired, at this point and quickly mix into meringue, without overmixing.

Add a large dollop of meringue (about 1/3) into the almond mixture paste. Work meringue dollop into paste to loosen up the paste to make it easier to work with. Do not be afraid of being aggressive at this point, we do not need to worry about knocking the air out of this small amount.

Add the rest of the meringue into the bowl, and fold it into the paste mixture to combine. Be gentle and careful not to overmix or over-deflate the meringue. The mixture is ready to be piped when it ribbons off your spatula. If it is coming off in large V shaped chunks it still needs to be folded further.

Add mixture into a piping bag with medium to large sized round tip. Pipe small circles of batter onto a cookie sheet fitted with a silicone baking mat or parchment paper. Ensure piping bag is held straight up and perpendicular to baking sheet. Using a stencil or a macaron mat makes this process much easier and fool proof, I try to make my macarons around 1½” in diameter.
Tap the baking sheet multiple times against counter to remove any air bubble from the macarons. If some air bubbles still remain, use a tooth pick to gently poke them out.

Preheat oven to 300°F, or 275°F for convection oven. While oven is preheating, allow the macarons to sit and form a skin. This skin will ensure the macarons bake up and not out, giving them those classic “feet”. This skin should form anywhere from 8 minutes to an hour. You know the macarons are ready to be baked when you can touch them lightly without having the batter stick to your finger. Keep checking them to see if they have formed a skin– overly dried macarons are just as much of a problem as under-dried macarons!

Bake for 15-20 minutes. Your bake time will depend on the size of your macarons. Check at 15 minutes, and if they are not ready then keep checking every minute. The macarons are ready when the tops are firm and do not move around their base at all.

Allow the macarons to cool completely before attempting to remove them from the sheets/mats/parchment. When cooled, find “perfect pairs” of macaron halves and set aside to be filled with your choice of filling. After filing, place into the fridge overnight to mature and meld together.

recipes.title: Lamb Curry with Spinach (Saag Gosht)

ingredients.item: toppings: avocado or guacamole, cilantro, hot sauce

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Preheat the oven to 400°F. Toss the vegetables with the oil and spices and roast on a large sheet 20 minutes. Lower the oven to 350°F.
Sauce: cook the onion in the oil over medium-high about 5 minutes, add the garlic and spices 30 seconds, then the tomato sauce and water. Simmer 20 minutes and season.

In a sprayed 2-quart round dish or springform: 1/2 cup sauce, a tortilla, about 1/2 cup refried beans, 1/4 of the vegetables, 1/2 cup sauce and some cheese. Repeat 3 more times, ending with the remaining sauce and cheese.
Bake 20–30 minutes until the cheese is golden at the edges. Rest 5–10 minutes and add toppings.
recipes.title: Layered Roasted Veggie, Sweet Potato & Black Bean Tortilla Pie

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Calories, protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Preheat the oven to 400°F and spray a baking dish.
Cook the garlic in the oil over medium 1 minute without burning, then add the broth, lemon zest and juice, oregano and thyme and pour into the dish.
Season the chicken and add it to the dish with the lemon wedges and thyme sprigs.
Bake 30–40 minutes, basting now and then, until cooked through.
Rest 5 minutes, slice, and drizzle with the pan sauce.
recipes.title: Lemon and Thyme Chicken Breasts

ingredients.item: dried rosemary, dried thyme, garlic powder

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Preheat the oven to 425°F and line a large sheet pan.
Mix the herbs, spices, salt, pepper, lemon zest and juice.
Brush the chicken with 1 tbsp oil and rub with half the herb mixture; put it on one side of the pan.
Toss the potatoes with 1 tbsp oil and the rest of the herb mixture and put them on the other side.
Roast 20 minutes. Toss the green beans with the last 1 tbsp oil, salt and pepper and add them to the pan.
Roast 20–25 minutes more, until the chicken is 165°F. Rest 5 minutes and garnish with lemon.
recipes.title: Lemon Chicken Sheet Pan Dinner

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Put everything in a gallon freezer bag (a wide-mouth jar holds it upright), seal, turn to coat, and freeze flat.
Bake: thaw, pour into a baking dish, and bake at 350°F 35 minutes.
Grill: thaw and cook in a cast iron skillet or on the grill until no longer pink.
Slow cooker: cook from frozen on Low 6–8 hours or High 4–6.
recipes.title: Lemon Garlic Dump Chicken (Freezer Meal)

ingredients.item: red pepper flakes and/or fresh thyme (optional)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Calories, protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Preheat the oven to 425°F.
Put the sweet potatoes and broccolini on separate sheet pans with oil; season the potatoes with salt, pepper and cumin and the broccolini with salt and pepper. Roast the potatoes 15 minutes.
Melt the butter with the lemon juice, garlic powder, pepper flakes, thyme, salt and pepper, and brush it over the salmon on a sprayed foil-lined sheet.
Toss the potatoes and return them to the oven with the broccolini and salmon for 12–15 minutes, checking at 8 minutes.
Divide into containers for meal prep, or serve.
recipes.title: Lemon Roasted Salmon with Sweet Potatoes and Broccolini

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Anti-Inflammatory. The live page shows a bot check, so this comes from a 2020 web archive copy. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Trim the wing tips and marinate the wings in a zip-top bag (set in a dish) overnight to 2 days, turning every 8 hours or so.
Pat dry, toss with 2 tbsp oil, and let come to room temperature 30–60 minutes. Season well.
Oven: bake upside down on a sprayed sheet at 375°F 10 minutes, flip, bake 10 more, then broil until browned and 165°F.
Grill: on an oiled grate over medium, about 8 minutes per side until 165°F.
recipes.title: Lemon, Garlic & Rosemary Chicken Wings

ingredients.item: chives (or shallot or green onion), chopped

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Lunch. Calories and protein are the site's figures per 1-cup serving.
steps: Boil 4 cups water, add the rinsed lentils, and simmer covered over medium-low about 20 minutes until firm-tender.
Whisk the dressing.
Put the spinach, chives and tomatoes in a large bowl.
Drain the lentils and add them hot (they'll wilt the spinach a little), then the dressing and capers. Season.
recipes.title: Lentil Salad with Capers and Balsamic-Dijon Dressing

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Calories, protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Mix the spread and refrigerate.
Mix the beef with the salt, pepper, oregano and ketchup and shape 6 patties.
Cook in a little butter on a grill or skillet over medium 3–4 minutes per side without pressing them; add the cheese after flipping.
Set each burger on a lettuce leaf, add 2 tomato slices and a spoonful of spread, and wrap with another leaf.
recipes.title: Lettuce Wrapped Cheeseburgers

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Budget Meals. The recipe doesn't say when to add the basil, so I put it in at the end. Calories, protein, weight and servings are estimates.
steps: Sauté the garlic and onion in the oil until the onion is translucent.
Add the whole tomatoes with salt and pepper and cook about 10 minutes until they soften.
Add the vinegar and let it reduce a few minutes, then add the broth and chicken and simmer on low 5 minutes.
Toss in the pasta and the basil, and serve topped with shaved Parmesan.
recipes.title: Light & Easy Bruschetta Chicken Pasta

ingredients.item: nonfat Greek yogurt or light sour cream

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Stir the chicken, rice, enchilada sauce, chiles, broth, onion, cumin and salt together in a sprayed slow cooker.
Cook on Low 5–6 hours or High 3–4.
Serve in bowls topped with avocado, pico, queso fresco and yogurt.
recipes.title: Light Crock Pot Fiesta Chicken & Rice Bowls

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Pasta. The original site is gone, so this came from an archived copy. Serves 5–6. Calories, protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Preheat the oven to 375°F.
Cook the pasta al dente.
Brown the sausage in the butter over medium heat 12–14 minutes, adding the garlic for the last 30 seconds. Slice the sausage and pour the butter and garlic into a large bowl.
Put the spinach in the colander and drain the pasta and its water over it so the spinach wilts.
Add the pasta, spinach, sausage and tomatoes to the bowl.
Stir in the tomato sauce, yogurt, milk, 1 cup mozzarella and the spices. Pour into a casserole dish, top with the remaining cheese, and cover with foil.
Bake covered 30 minutes, then uncovered 10 minutes. You can assemble it a day ahead and refrigerate.
recipes.title: Light Pasta Bake with Chicken Sausage, Spinach & Tomatoes

ingredients.item: red bell pepper, seeded and sliced

recipes.notes: From the MyFitnessPal roundup 15 Slow Cooker Recipes Under 375 Calories. Calories and protein are the site's figures; serving weight is an estimate.
steps: Put the peppers, jalapeño, shallot, halved lime and chicken in the slow cooker. Stir the coconut milk and tamari together, pour over and stir to coat. Cook on HIGH 2 hours or LOW 4.
Pulse the cauliflower in a food processor in two batches until it's the size of rice.
Coat a large nonstick pan with coconut oil spray, add the cauliflower and cook over medium-high heat, stirring, until softened, about 2 minutes.
Serve about 3/4 cup cauliflower rice topped with chicken, vegetables and sauce, garnished with scallions.
recipes.title: Lime-Chili Chicken with Cauliflower Rice

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Sides. The site calls it low carb, but the honey in the dressing adds sugar. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Whisk the dressing ingredients and refrigerate.
Combine the broccoli, cauliflower, half the bacon, cheese and onion.
Toss with the dressing, top with the rest of the bacon, and serve.
recipes.title: Loaded Broccoli Cauliflower Salad

ingredients.item: pork sausage, hot or regular, casing removed (such as Jimmy Dean)
Kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper
Pale Ale beer or your favorite type of beer
Rotel tomatoes (1 can), do not drain

recipes.notes: Rotel tomatoes should not be drained. Servings, serving weight, calories and protein are estimates.
steps: Brown the sausage in a medium skillet over medium heat, seasoning with salt and pepper to taste. Use a wooden spatula to crumble and turn the sausage as it cooks.
Once the sausage is cooked through, add the beer and let it cook down and reduce for 3-4 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Stir in the Velveeta and shredded pepper jack. It should take about 3-5 minutes for all the cheese to melt in.
Once melted, stir in the tomatoes, beans, and cilantro.
Serve immediately with homemade chips.
recipes.title: Loaded Cowboy Queso (Velveeta Rotel Dip)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Preheat the oven to 400°F.
Bring the water and milk to a boil, take off the heat, and stir in the potato flakes.
Mix the beef, onion, brown sugar and Worcestershire by hand, then the breadcrumbs and egg.
Press into an 8-inch square dish, spread the potatoes over, and top with the cheese and bacon.
Bake covered 30 minutes, then uncovered 10. Cool a few minutes before slicing.
recipes.title: Loaded Potato & Meatloaf Casserole

recipes.notes: From the Beauty and the Foodie roundup Low Carb Slow Cooker Meals. Calories and protein are the site's figures; serving weight is an estimate.
steps: Brown the beef in the oil over medium heat, breaking it up.
Drain and add to the slow cooker with everything except the salt and pepper. Stir well.
Cook on HIGH 4 hours or LOW 8 hours.
Season with salt and pepper and serve.
recipes.title: Low Carb Bolognese in the Slow Cooker

ingredients.item: coconut oil, melted (or extra virgin olive oil)
egg (or 2 egg whites for lower fat)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Breakfast. The pinned 'low carb breakfast sandwich' link now goes to this microwave bread recipe for the sandwich. Calories and protein are the site's figures for the bread; weight is an estimate.
steps: Whisk the egg and oil in a small microwave-safe bowl.
Stir in the almond flour, baking powder, salt and pepper until fully combined.
Microwave on high 60 seconds. If the center isn't set, microwave 30 seconds more.
Cool 2 minutes in the bowl, loosen with a small spatula, and slice in half. Fill with your breakfast sandwich fillings.
recipes.title: Low Carb Breakfast Sandwich Bread (90-Second Almond Flour)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Mexican. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Preheat the oven to 350°F.
Cook the cauliflower with the taco seasoning in a frying pan about 5 minutes until tender.
Add the chicken, cream cheese and most of the enchilada sauce and cook on medium-low until smooth.
Spread in a 2-quart casserole, top with the remaining sauce and cheese, and bake 20 minutes until bubbly.
recipes.title: Low Carb Cauliflower Enchilada Casserole

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Breakfast. Calories, protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Preheat the oven to 350°F.
Whisk the almond flour, protein powder, tapioca flour, cocoa, baking soda and salt.
In another bowl, whisk the eggs, pumpkin, almond milk, maple syrup and vanilla.
Whisk the wet into the dry until well combined.
Fill 12 lined muffin cups nearly to the top.
Bake 25 minutes.
Cool 5 minutes in the pan, then on a rack.
Store in the fridge up to a week.
recipes.title: Low Carb Chocolate Protein Muffins

ingredients.item: Monterey or Pepper Jack cheese, finely chopped or shredded

recipes.notes: From the Beauty and the Foodie roundup Low Carb Slow Cooker Meals. Calories and protein are the site's figures; serving weight is an estimate.
steps: Put the chicken in the bottom of a 6-quart slow cooker.
Add the remaining ingredients.
Cook on HIGH 3–4 hours or LOW 6–8 hours.
Remove and shred the chicken, then return it to the pot.
Serve hot.
recipes.title: Low Carb Crock Pot Mexican Chicken Soup

ingredients.item: celery, diced (amount not given; about 1/2 cup)

recipes.notes: From the Meal Prep on Fleek roundup 31 Slow Cooker Meal Prep Recipes. Calories and protein are the site's figures; serving weight is an estimate with zucchini noodles.
steps: Put the carrots, celery, bell pepper, garlic and onion in the bottom of the slow cooker.
Set the beef on top and add the remaining ingredients except the zucchini noodles.
Cook about 4 hours on HIGH or 6–8 hours on LOW, until the beef is tender.
Shred the beef into the sauce and serve over zucchini noodles.
recipes.title: Low Carb Crockpot Beef Ragu

recipes.notes: From the Beauty and the Foodie roundup Low Carb Slow Cooker Meals. The live site blocks automated reading, so this came from an archived copy. Calories and protein are the site's figures; serving weight is an estimate.
steps: Grease a 6-quart slow cooker insert and line with parchment, leaving plenty up the sides. Grease the parchment.
Whisk the almond flour, sweetener, coconut, nuts, protein powder, baking powder, cinnamon, cloves and salt.
Stir in the carrots, eggs, coconut oil, almond milk and vanilla. Spread in the slow cooker and cook on LOW 3–3 1/2 hours.
Cool completely, then lift out by the parchment.
Beat the cream cheese with the powdered sweetener until smooth, then beat in the vanilla and cream. Spread over the cooled cake.
recipes.title: Low Carb Slow Cooker Carrot Cake

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Drinks. The page lists ingredients but no steps, so these are standard mojito steps. The live page has no recipe text, so this comes from a 2023 web archive copy. Calories are the site's figure; weight is an estimate.
steps: Muddle the berries, mint and sweetener in a glass.
Add crushed ice and the vodka, then top with club soda and a splash of cranberry juice. Stir.
recipes.title: Low-Calorie Mint Blueberry Vodka Mojito

ingredients.item: bone broth, vegetable stock or water

recipes.notes: From the Beauty and the Foodie roundup Low Carb Slow Cooker Meals. Calories and protein are the site's figures; serving weight is an estimate.
steps: Preheat a 6-quart slow cooker on HIGH (or halve the recipe). Pat the steaks dry, season both sides, and brown 2–3 at a time in a hot pan with 1/4 cup ghee. Move to the slow cooker.
Cook the diced onion and garlic in the remaining ghee until fragrant and lightly browned.
Add the tomatoes, broth and spices, cook briefly, and pour over the meat.
Add the cinnamon sticks and bay leaves, cover, and cook 3 hours.
Push the meat to one side, add the diced rutabaga, and cook 1 hour more.
Add the diced zucchini, stir into the juices, remove the bay leaves and cinnamon, and cook 2 hours more until the vegetables are fork-tender.
Garnish with parsley or cilantro and season to taste.
recipes.title: Low-Carb Autumn Beef & Vegetable Stew

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Calories and protein are the site's figures.
steps: Gather all ingredients.
Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). If using a glass dish, preheat the oven to 325 degrees F (165 degrees C). Coat a 9x13-inch baking dish with cooking spray.
Mix graham cracker crumbs and butter in a bowl until well combined. Transfer the mixture to the prepared baking dish and press onto the bottom.
Pour sweetened condensed milk on graham cracker crust.
Sprinkle with an even layer of chocolate chips, coconut, and nuts.
Press toppings down firmly with the back of a fork.
Bake in the preheated oven until lightly browned, about 25 minutes. Cool completely, then cut into 36 bars or diamonds.
Serve and enjoy!
recipes.title: Magic Cookie Bars from Eagle Brand

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Lunch. The page has moved, so this comes from a 2018 web archive copy. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Preheat the oven to 425°F. Season and oil the chicken in a small dish and bake 10 minutes, turn, and bake 10–15 more until done. Rest 10 minutes and slice.
Cook the rice and let it cool.
Toss the rice with the peppers, onion and corn.
Shake the vinaigrette and toss it through.
Divide among 4 containers, top with chicken, and refrigerate.
recipes.title: Make-Ahead Chicken Fajita Lunch Bowls

ingredients.item: chopped mango and green onions, to garnish

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Calories, protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Preheat the oven to 400°F and spray a 9x13 pan.
Season the salmon, cover with foil, and bake 15–17 minutes until opaque (uncover for the last few minutes to brown).
Meanwhile, pulse the mango, garlic, chipotles, ketchup, brown sugar and vinegar until smooth.
Spread 1–2 tbsp sauce on each fillet and garnish with mango and green onions.
recipes.title: Mango Chipotle Barbecue Salmon

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Breakfast. Calories, protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Heat the oil in a medium skillet.
Sauté the onion, garlic and peppers about 5 minutes until starting to soften.
Add the beef and spices and cook, breaking it up, until no longer pink.
Scramble the eggs with salt and pepper in a small bowl.
Push the meat aside, pour the eggs into the middle of the pan, and gently mix everything as they set.
Divide into 4 containers and top with cilantro, avocado and jalapeño.
recipes.title: Meal Prep Taco Breakfast Scramble (Whole30)

ingredients.item: zero-calorie mayo (e.g. Walden Farms) or regular mayo
chunk light tuna in water, drained

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Lunch. Protein is the site's figure; calories and weight are estimates (with zero-calorie mayo; regular mayo adds about 180 kcal).
steps: Mix the tuna, avocado, mayo, lemon-pepper and celery. (Double it and split into two containers for two lunches.)
Pack with a rice cake for scooping.
recipes.title: Meal Prep Tuna Avocado Lunch with Brown Rice Cakes

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Lunch (Tasty via BuzzFeed). Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Cook the chicken in 2 tbsp oil over medium-high with 1 tsp each salt, pepper and oregano until no longer pink. Set aside.
Sauté the carrots 2–3 minutes, then the zucchini and squash 1 minute.
Add the kale, the other 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp each salt and pepper and cook until wilted.
Push the vegetables aside, cook the garlic in the center 30 seconds, and mix in.
Stir in the pasta, chicken and remaining oregano. Cool 10 minutes before packing; keeps 4 days.
recipes.title: Meal-Prep Garlic Chicken and Veggie Pasta

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Lunch. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Combine everything, season, and chill.
Serve in lettuce leaves, on a baguette, or with whole-grain crackers.
recipes.title: Mediterranean Tuna Salad

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Put the potatoes and carrots in a 5-quart slow cooker.
Halve the roast, mix the mustard with the rosemary, garlic salt, thyme and pepper, and rub it over the meat.
Set the roast on the vegetables, top with the onion and broth, and cook on Low 6–8 hours until tender. Sprinkle with fresh thyme.
recipes.title: Melt-in-Your-Mouth Slow Cooker Pot Roast

ingredients.item: dried oregano, garlic powder, onion powder, divided

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Anti-Inflammatory. The site's 278 kcal per serving is low for a pound of beef, two sweet potatoes and an avocado in 4 servings, so calories and protein are my estimates. Weight is an estimate.
steps: Brown the beef over medium with half the seasonings and set aside, keeping most of the fat in the pan.
Cook the sweet potatoes until soft and lightly crisp, then the onion until translucent, then the kale 2–3 minutes. Add the rest of the seasoning.
Return the beef to reheat.
Top with lime, cilantro, radishes and avocado.
recipes.title: Mexican Breakfast Skillet (Paleo, Whole30, AIP)

ingredients.item: boneless skinless chicken breasts, grilled and chopped

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Mexican (Kraft). The Kraft page is gone, so this comes from a 2015 web archive copy. Using light ranch, 2% cheese and light sour cream saves about 40 calories. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Heat the grill to medium.
Mix the chicken, coleslaw, cheese, tomatoes, ranch, lime juice and chili powder.
Spoon down the centers of the tortillas, fold in the sides, and roll up burrito style.
Grill seam side down 8–9 minutes, turning, until golden on all sides. Serve with salsa and sour cream.
recipes.title: Mexican Grilled Chicken Wrap

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Calories and protein are my estimates from the ingredients.
steps: Line a baking sheet with parchment.
Whisk the sugar and oil, then the eggs and vanilla.
Whisk the dry ingredients separately, then mix into the wet just until combined. Stir in the chocolate. The dough will be loose.
Scoop 2-tbsp balls 1 1/2 inches apart and chill 10–15 minutes.
Preheat the oven to 350°F, flatten the cookies slightly, and bake about 8 minutes until the edges are set.
recipes.title: Mexican Hot Chocolate Cookies

recipes.notes: From the BuzzFeed/Tasty list 7 Quick Dinners To Make This Week (pinned on Jessica Lynn's Pasta board). The recipe gives no amounts. The calorie, protein and weight figures are my estimate for one bowl with about 1 cup rice, 1/2 cup beans and 1/2 avocado.
steps: Add cilantro lime rice to a bowl, top with black beans, tomatoes, onion, cilantro and avocado, squeeze lime over everything, and serve warm.
recipes.title: Mexican Rice Bowl

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. The live page is gone, so this comes from a 2017 web archive copy. A serving is one boat. Calories, protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Grease a 9x13 dish. Halve the zucchini lengthwise, hollow out the centers, brush the tops with 1 tsp oil, and set skin side down in the dish.
Cook the onion and peppers in 1 tbsp oil over medium 2–3 minutes, then add the rice, corn, beans, salsa, chili powder and cumin and cook 5 minutes.
Preheat the oven to 400°F. Stir 1/4 cup cilantro and salt into the filling.
Fill the zucchini, sprinkle with cheese, cover with foil, and bake 25 minutes.
Uncover and broil about 5 minutes until bubbly. Cool 5–10 minutes and top with the remaining cilantro.
recipes.title: Mexican Zucchini Burrito Boats

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Breakfast. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Melt the butter in a ramekin and brush it over all sides.
Mix in the almond flour, baking powder and salt, then whisk in the egg white.
Microwave 90 seconds. Cool 30 seconds before turning out.
recipes.title: Microwave English Muffin (Low Carb)

ingredients.item: sweetener of choice (monkfruit, coconut sugar, maple syrup, honey, etc.)
toppings of choice: Greek yogurt, peanut butter, chocolate chips, whipped cream, ice cream, berries

recipes.notes: No ingredient amounts were given in the recipe text, so quantities are blank. Calories are a rough estimate for one serving with a light topping of Greek yogurt and peanut butter. Dairy-free yogurt and allergen-friendly chocolate chips (such as Enjoy Life) can be used. Cacao powder can replace cocoa powder but is slightly more bitter.
steps: In a small bowl, mix all of the ingredients except the chocolate chips together, then stir in the chocolate chips.
Lightly grease a small microwave-safe dish, such as a glass food storage container.
Pour the batter into the dish and smooth it out.
Microwave for 90 seconds for a lava-cake style brownie with an under-cooked center.
For a more baked brownie, microwave in ten-second intervals until it reaches your desired doneness; 90 to 120 seconds total works best.
Add toppings of choice, such as Greek yogurt, peanut butter, chocolate chips, whipped cream, ice cream or berries, and enjoy.
recipes.title: Microwave Protein Brownie

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Soup. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Sauté the oil, butter, onion, celery, carrots and garlic in a large pot 7–10 minutes over medium.
Add the tomatoes, broth, zucchini, green beans, both beans and Italian seasoning and bring to a boil.
Simmer partly covered 10 minutes.
Add the pasta and simmer uncovered 15–20 minutes, stirring now and then, until tender.
Season well, stir in basil, and top with Parmesan. Thin with broth if needed.
recipes.title: Minestrone Soup

ingredients.item: optional mix-ins: cut-up sausage, chocolate chips, a dab of jelly or syrup, fruit

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Breakfast. This is a technique, not an exact recipe. Nutrition assumes batter from about 1 cup of mix making 12 plain minis, so calories, protein and weight are rough estimates.
steps: Preheat the oven to 350°F.
Mix up your pancake batter.
Spray a muffin tin with nonstick spray and fill each cup 1/4–1/3 full.
Add a topping to each cup (or leave plain).
Bake 10–12 minutes and serve.
recipes.title: Mini Pancakes in a Muffin Tin

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Calories and protein are my estimates from the ingredients.
steps: Preheat the oven to 350°F.
Roll the dough into a 12-inch circle, cut twelve 3-inch rounds, and press into a 12-cup muffin pan. Chill while you make the filling.
Mix the corn syrup, brown sugar, butter, egg and vanilla, then the pecans.
Spoon about 1 tablespoon into each crust without overfilling.
Bake about 25 minutes until set. Cool 10 minutes in the pan, then on a rack. Freezes 2–3 months.
recipes.title: Mini Pecan Pies

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. The live recipe card didn't load, so this comes from a 2021 web archive copy. Calories and protein are the site's figures per serving (24 g).
steps: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Spray two mini muffin tins with baking spray, set aside.

Roll out pie dough on a baking mat or lightly floured surface. Using a 3" circle or flower shape cookie cutter, cut out 24 pieces. Gently press into the wells of the prepared muffin tins. Place in the refrigerator to chill.
Meanwhile, in a large mixing bowl, whisk together the pumpkin puree, heavy cream, egg, sugars, pumpkin pie spice, cinnamon, salt and vanilla.
Remove the tins from the refrigerator and fill each crust with 1.5 tablespoons of filling (you can use a #40 cookie scoop to do this). Tap the tins on the counter to create a smooth, even filling.

Place in the oven and bake for 18-22 minutes or until the crust begins to turn golden brown in color. Remove from the oven and allow to cool in the tins for 15 minutes before transferring to a wire rack to cool completely.
Top with whipped cream and a sprinkle of cinnamon, if desired. Serve room temperature or chilled.
recipes.title: Mini Pumpkin Pie Recipe

ingredients.item: mint leaves, plus more to garnish

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Drinks. Calories and weight are estimates.
steps: Lightly muddle the mint in a cocktail shaker until fragrant. Add the rum, lime juice, simple syrup and a handful of ice and shake.
Strain into an ice-filled glass, top with club soda, and garnish with lime and mint.
recipes.title: Mint Mojito

ingredients.item: lime wedges and cilantro, to garnish

recipes.notes: From the Beauty and the Foodie roundup Low Carb Slow Cooker Meals (George Stella's recipe). The original site is gone, so this came from an archived copy. Calories and protein are the site's figures; serving weight is an estimate.
steps: Put everything in the slow cooker and cook on HIGH 4–5 hours, until the meat flakes easily.
Remove the pork, reserving the liquid, and shred with two forks.
Serve hot, drizzled with some cooking liquid and garnished with lime and cilantro.
recipes.title: Mojo Pulled Pork

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Calories and protein are the site's figures per serving (1 Slice).
steps: 1. Grease a 9 inch pie pan and preheat oven to 350 degrees.
2. To make cookie dough, cream butter and sugars together until light and fluffy, about 3-4 minutes.
3. Mix in peanut butter, eggs and vanilla extract.
4. Add oats, flour, baking soda and making powder and mix until combined.
5. Stir in M&Ms and chocolate chips. Set cookie dough aside.
6. To make cheesecake, beat cream cheese, brown sugar and peanut butter until smooth.
7. Add egg and milk and beat until combined.
8. Press about 3/4 of cookie dough evenly into the pie pan and up the sides.
9. Spread cheesecake mixture evenly over cookie dough.
10. Spread remaining cookie dough on top by dropping spoonfuls of cookie dough on top of cheesecake.
11. Top with a sprinkle of M&Ms
12. Bake for 20-25 minutes, then refrigerate until firm.
13. To make icing, cream butter until smooth.
14. Add peanut butter and mix until smooth.
15. Add powdered sugar and mix until smooth.
16. Add water or milk as needed to get the right consistency for the icing.
17. Pipe icing around the edges of the pie.
18. Serve with chocolate sauce, if desired.
recipes.title: Monster Cookie Cheesecake Pie

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Calories and protein are my estimates from the ingredients.
steps: Beat the cream cheese, butter and peanut butter until smooth.
Mix in the powdered sugar, brown sugar, flour and vanilla.
Stir in oats until it's as thick as you like (start with 1 1/2 cups), then the M&Ms and chocolate chips.
Refrigerate until serving. Serve with pretzels, graham crackers or apple slices.

steps: In a medium bowl, add 1 1/2 cups oats, peanut butter, pumpkin, chia seeds, honey, vanilla, and cinnamon. Stir to combine well. You want the mixture to be soft but not too sticky. If you pick up a generous spoonful, you should be able to roll it into a ball and only make a minimal mess (it should stick together when rolled but still feel tacky on your hands). Depending on the type of oats you used (old-fashioned or quick oats), you made need to add up to a half cup more oats and stir until you reach the desired consistency. Again, it's ok if it's a little sticky because the oats will absorb some of the moisture after a little time passes, but unworkable sticky isn't the goal.
When the mixture is workable, add the chocolate chips and stir to combine.
Scoop a large spoonful into your hand and roll into balls. Repeat with remaining dough. Keep these in the fridge for up to a week, or in the freezer for much longer.

steps: In a large mixing bowl, whip your heavy cream over medium high speed for about 5 minutes until stiff peaks start to form. (It may take longer or shorter depending how fast you're doing it, you want it stiff, but a few minutes too long and you'll turn it into butter)
In another bowl, combine your condensed milk and cocoa powder.
Pour your whipped cream into your chocolate condensed milk mixture and fold everything together till combined.
Melt your peanut butter in the microwave for about 30 seconds.

Pour one third of your ice cream into a 9x5in loaf pan. Drizzle one third of your peanut butter over the ice cream and sprinkle with a third of the peanut butter cup pieces. Repeat with another third ice cream, peanut butter and peanut butter cups. And then repeat with the final ice cream, peanut butter and peanut butter cup pieces.

steps: In a medium size saucepan, combine 4 Tablespoons (1/4 cup) of the creamy peanut butter and peanut butter chips. Heat over low heat until completely melted. Remove from heat and set aside to cool a bit.

In a large bowl using a hand mixer or the bowl of a stand mixer fitted with the whisk attachment, beat the heavy cream, sweetened condensed milk, vanilla extract, and remaining 2 Tablespoons of the peanut butter on high speed until smooth and thick (about 3-4 minutes).

Spoon 1/3 of the ice cream into the bottom of a freezer-safe container or bowl (I prefer a loaf pan). Layer half of the melted peanut butter chips evenly over the ice cream, using a spatula to spread it around. Spoon another 1/3 of the ice cream on top of the peanut butter layer, and repeat layering with remaining melted peanut butter chips and 1/3 of the ice cream. Submerge a butter knife into the container and run it up and down the length of the container to "swirl" the peanut butter. Cover tightly and freeze overnight, or at least 8 hours. Ice cream can be stored in the freezer for up to 2 weeks.

steps: Make the Brownie Batter
Preheat oven to 350F. Line an 8-inch square pan with aluminum foil leaving overhang and spray with cooking spray, or grease and flour the pan; set aside.

In a large microwave-safe bowl, add the butter, chocolate, and heat on high power to melt, about 2 minutes. Stop to check and stir after 1 minute. Heat in 15-second increments until chocolate has melted and mixture can be stirred smooth. Allow mixture to cool momentarily before adding the eggs so they don’t scramble.

Add the eggs, sugar, vanilla, optional coffee, optional espresso granules (neither make brownies taste like coffee and both enhance and round out the chocolate flavor), optional salt, and whisk vigorously to combine.
Add the flour, most of the diced Oreos, reserving a small handful to be sprinkled on top, and stir until smooth and combined without overmixing.
Turn half the batter out into prepared pan, smoothing the top lightly with a spatula as necessary; set aside while you make the Cream Cheese Filling.
Make the Cream Cheese Filling
In a medium bowl, add the cream cheese, confectioners’ sugar, vanilla, and beat with an electric hand mixer until smooth and combined, or whisk vigorously to combine.

Turn filling out over brownie base to create an even, smooth, flat layer. Take your time spreading the cream cheese over all areas with a knife or spatula. Tip – Rather than allowing the cream cheese to ‘plop’ out of the mixing bowl in one area of the pan, try to dollop it out in small ‘clumps’, which makes spreading it neatly much easier.
Turn out remaining brownie batter over cream cheese layer and take your times spreading the batter over bare patches and into the corners. Using the Tip from Step 7 is helpful here, too.
Evenly sprinkle the reserved handful of Oreos over the top.
Bake for about 30 minutes, or until center has just set and is no longer glossy.* (see note below)

Allow brownies to cool in pan on top of a wire rack for at least 2 hours. Then cover with a sheet of foil to prevent fridge smells, and place pan in fridge for at least 2 hours, or until sufficiently chilled for slicing. Do not rush the cooling process because the cream cheese will ooze everywhere and the brownies need time to really set up before slicing.

Lift brownies out using foil overhang, slice, and serve. Brownies will keep airtight in the fridge for up to 10 days, or in the freezer for up to 6 months. I prefer these brownies slightly chilled and store them in the fridge.
