Add flour, baking powder, pumpkin pie spice, and salt. Stir just until blended.
Spoon batter into a greased 8x8 inch baking pan.
Prepare streusel by mixing ingredients together with a fork or pastry blender until they resemble coarse crumbs.
Sprinkle streusel topping evenly over batter
Bake at 350° for 50-60 minutes, until top is golden brown and toothpick inserted in center comes out clean.
recipes.title: Pumpkin Coffee Cake

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. The live site blocks automated access, so the recipe came from an archived copy (web.archive.org, November 2016). Servings (18 muffins) and time are the site's; calories, protein and serving weight are estimates.
steps: Preheat the oven to 375°F and line a muffin pan with paper baking cups.
In a medium bowl, whisk the flour, pumpkin spice, baking soda and salt until well combined. Set aside.
In a large bowl, whisk together the pumpkin, sugar and brown sugar.
Beat in the eggs, vegetable oil and vanilla extract. Slowly whisk in the flour mixture until there are no lumps. Fill the muffin cups 3/4 full.
In a medium bowl, beat the cream cheese until smooth. Add the sugar, egg yolk and vanilla extract and beat until well combined.
Top each muffin with about 1 tablespoon of the cream cheese mixture and swirl it into the batter with a toothpick.
Bake 18 to 20 minutes, until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean.
Serve at room temperature or slightly chilled. Store in an airtight container in the fridge.
recipes.title: Pumpkin Cream Cheese Swirl Muffins

ingredients.item: hearty white bread (rustic French or brioche)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Breakfast. Calories and protein are the site's figures per slice; weight is an estimate.
steps: Preheat the oven to 225°F and an electric griddle to 350°F (or a nonstick skillet over medium).
Whisk the pumpkin, eggs, brown sugar, vanilla and spices in a shallow dish, then whisk in the half and half.
Soak each slice on both sides, butter the griddle, and add the bread.
Cook until golden underneath, butter the griddle again, flip, and cook the other side.
Keep warm in the oven up to 10 minutes (it also helps the centers finish cooking).
Serve warm with maple syrup.
recipes.title: Pumpkin French Toast

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Calories and protein are the site's figures per serving (1 serving).
steps: In a large saucepan, whisk together the brown sugar, spices, and salt.
Add the egg yolks and whisk well until smooth.
Add the pumpkin puree, and whisk again until smooth.
Slowly add the cream and the milk, whisking until everything is well incorporated.

Set the pan over medium/low heat and cook for about 10-12 minutes, stirring constantly with a whisk or a silicone spoonula until the mixture is steaming, thickened slightly, and just about to come to a boil.
Remove from the heat and pour the mixture through a fine mesh strainer into a bowl.
Stir in the vanilla extract and the alcohol (if using). Chill the mixture in the refrigerator until completely cold (you can do this overnight if you like.)
Process in your ice cream machine according to its directions.
Spoon the soft ice cream into a container and enjoy as soft serve or freeze until firm. This will take several hours.
recipes.title: Pumpkin Ice Cream

ingredients.item: each ground ginger, nutmeg and cloves

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Calories and protein are my estimates from the ingredients.
steps: Preheat the oven to 350°F and grease 24 muffin cups.
Beat the butter and sugar 2 minutes, then the pumpkin and eggs. Mix in the flour, leaveners, spices and salt.
Fill the cups about 2/3 full. Mix the streusel with a fork and sprinkle on top.
Bake 17–19 minutes, cool 10 minutes in the pan, then on a rack.
Whisk the glaze and drizzle over (skip the glaze if freezing).
recipes.title: Pumpkin Muffins with Toffee Streusel and Maple Glaze

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Breakfast. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Preheat the oven to 350°F and line two baking sheets with silicone mats (or spray them).
Whisk the dry ingredients (oats through salt) in a medium bowl.
Whisk the wet ingredients (eggs through vanilla) in another bowl and slowly stir into the dry.
Scrape down the bowl so it's evenly mixed, then stir in the walnuts.
Drop by large spoonfuls 2 inches apart and bake 10 minutes. Cool completely on a rack.
recipes.title: Pumpkin Oatmeal Breakfast Cookies (Gluten-Free)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Breakfast. Calories, protein and weight are estimates, including the pecans and maple syrup.
steps: Combine the oats and milk in a small saucepan over medium heat.
Bring to a boil, lower the heat, and simmer, stirring now and then, 3–5 minutes until as thick as you like. Stir in the pumpkin, vanilla, cinnamon and nutmeg and heat through, about 1 minute.
Serve right away topped with pecans and maple syrup.
recipes.title: Pumpkin Pie Oatmeal (Stovetop)

ingredients.item: unsweetened vanilla almond milk (or any milk)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Breakfast. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Mix the yogurt, almond milk, pumpkin, vanilla and 1 tbsp maple syrup.
Stir in the oats, chia and pumpkin spice; add more maple if you like. Pour into a jar and refrigerate 4 hours or overnight.
recipes.title: Pumpkin Pie Overnight Oats with Chia

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Smoothies. The recipe is printed on the pin's picture (by BlenderBottle); the pin links to a product page, so there's no recipe link. Calories, protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Shake everything in a shaker bottle (or blend) until smooth.
recipes.title: Pumpkin Pie Protein Shake

ingredients.item: full-fat coconut milk, chilled overnight (whipped cream)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Smoothies. Calories, protein and weight are estimates for the smoothie with protein powder, without the whipped cream.
steps: Blend all the smoothie ingredients until smooth, thinning with almond milk.
For the cream, open the chilled can upside down, pour off the liquid, and whip the solid coconut fat until smooth with a little sweetener.
Top the smoothie with coconut whipped cream and a dash of cinnamon or nutmeg.
recipes.title: Pumpkin Pie Protein Smoothie (Vegan) with Coconut Whipped Cream
recipes.totalTime: 5 min (plus overnight chilling for the cream)

ingredients.item: whipped cream and a pinch of nutmeg

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Smoothies. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Blend the pumpkin, banana, ice, yogurt, spice, agave and milk until smooth.
Top with whipped cream and nutmeg.
recipes.title: Pumpkin Pie Smoothie
Pumpkin Pie Tacos
steps: Preheat the oven to 400°F. Cut 3–4 rounds from each tortilla with a 4–4½ inch cookie cutter, for about 20 shells.
Stir the sugar and cinnamon together on a plate. Prick each round 4–5 times with a fork to prevent air bubbles.
Brush both sides of the rounds with melted butter, then coat them in the cinnamon sugar.
Flip a muffin tin upside down and tuck the rounds between the cups. Bake 10 minutes, until just golden, and let cool in the pan.
While the shells cool, beat the cream, powdered sugar and vanilla with a mixer until stiff peaks form.
In a large bowl, beat the cream cheese and powdered sugar on medium-high until smooth. Add the pumpkin, vanilla and pumpkin pie spice and mix until fully combined.
Pipe or spoon the filling into the cooled shells, top with whipped cream, and sprinkle with cinnamon and/or chopped pecans. Serve right away.
recipes.notes: Shells can be made ahead and kept in an airtight container in the fridge up to 3 days (they soften over time). Use pure pumpkin, not pie filling. Requested by Doug Green.

ingredients.item: honey, agave or sweetener of choice

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Smoothies. Calories, protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Blend everything until well combined. Taste and adjust the sweetener.
recipes.title: Pumpkin Protein Shake

ingredients.item: coconut yogurt or whipped coconut cream to top (optional)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Breakfast. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Stir everything together in a bowl for 1–2 minutes until well mixed.
Cover and refrigerate at least 2 hours or overnight.
Top with coconut yogurt or whipped coconut cream and a sprinkle of cinnamon.
recipes.title: Pumpkin Spice Latte Chia Pudding

ingredients.item: unsalted butter, cut into pieces and refrigerated

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Calories and protein are the site's figures per serving (1 serving).
steps: Add powdered sugar, pumpkin pie spice and almond meal to a food processor and pulse 7-8 times. Sift through a fine mesh sieve.
Add egg whites and cream of tartar to the bowl of a stand mixer. Start beating on speed 6, until mo more greenish liquid could be seen.
Continue beating on speed 6 and slowly add in the granulated sugar. Beat on speed 8, until stiff peaks. Do not over beat.
Add the almond mixture in 3 increments, folding between each addition. The mixture should be at lava consistency. Fill a piping bag, fitted with wilton N12 tip with the mixture.
Pipe mixture oven prepared baking sheets, lined with parchment paper or silpat mats.
Slam sheets 5-6 times on the counter, to release air. Let the cookies dry at room temperature for 45 minutes. Preheat your oven to 325 (170 C) F.

Bake sheets of macarons one at a time, for 11-13 minutes, until fully cooked, but not burned. Check at 11 minutes of baking, if the tops slide, they need 1-2 more minutes. Let the macarons cool for 10m minutes, before you remove them from the baking sheets.
Fill a medium saucepan with 3 inches (7.5 cm) of water. Bring to a boil and reduce to simmer.
In the bowl of your stand mixer combine egg whites and sugar. Whisk to combine. Place the bowl over the simmering water.

Start to continuously whisk gently, being careful, because the bowl will become hot quickly.Every few minutes check the temperature of the mixture (while still whisking). Once the temperature reaches 160 F, remove from heat and attach to the mixer. (Be careful as the bowl is hot!).
Turn the stand mixer fitted with the whisk attachment on high and start whisking. Remove butter from the fridge.
Whip the mixture until the bowl is cool to the touch (about 10 minutes) and it has the texture of marshmallow fluff.
Beating on medium high start adding the butter, one piece at a time, until incorporated.
Add pumpkin pie spice, vanilla and pumpkin puree and mix until combined.
Fill a piping back with the buttercream. (Store in the fridge for up to 5 days or freeze for up to 30 days).
Pipe 2 tsp buttercream to one shell and stick the other one to it. Store macarons in an air-tight container for 5 days in the fridge, or freeze for up to 60 days.
recipes.title: Pumpkin Spice Macarons Recipe

ingredients.item: olive oil, plus more to drizzle
ground cayenne, plus more to top

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Apps. Makes about 3 cups; a serving is 1/4 cup. Calories, protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Blend everything until smooth, stopping to stir once or twice.
Drizzle with olive oil and sprinkle with cayenne or paprika. Serve with pita or baked tortilla chips.
recipes.title: Quick & Easy Homemade Hummus (No Tahini)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Calories and protein are my estimates from the ingredients.
steps: Preheat the oven to 350°F.
Make the cookie dough per the package with the butter and egg, press it evenly onto a cookie sheet, and prick with a fork.
Bake about 12 minutes until lightly browned and cool completely.
Beat the marshmallow cream and cream cheese until smooth and spread over the crust.
Cover with fruit and refrigerate until serving.
recipes.title: Quick and Easy Fruit Pizza

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Snacks. Calories, protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Preheat the oven to 425°F.
Stir the 1 1/2 cups flour, milk, oil, baking powder, sugar and salt into a soft dough.
Sprinkle the extra 2 tbsp flour on the counter, divide the dough in two, and knead. Cover with an upturned bowl 15 minutes.
Divide into 8 balls, roll each into a foot-long rope, and twist into pretzels on a sprayed sheet.
Brush with the egg, add toppings, and bake 9–11 minutes until lightly golden.
recipes.title: Quick Homemade Soft Pretzels (No Yeast)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Breakfast. Calories and protein are the site's figures; time and weight are estimates.
steps: Cut the apples into 1/2-inch cubes.
On Sauté, melt the butter and cook the apples 3 minutes.
Cancel Sauté.
Add everything else.
Set to Porridge for 1 minute with the valve on Sealing.
When it beeps, carefully turn the valve to Venting (use a wooden spoon) and let it vent fully before opening.
recipes.title: Quick Instant Pot Apple Cinnamon Oatmeal

recipes.notes: From the BuzzFeed/Tasty list 7 Quick Dinners To Make This Week (pinned on Jessica Lynn's Pasta board). Calories, protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Cook the soba noodles per the package, then drain and rinse right away in cold water.
Blend the tahini, oil, sugar, vinegar, soy sauce, red pepper flakes, ginger and garlic until very smooth, adding the hot water last with the motor running until it's the consistency you like.
Pour sauce over the noodles and top with snap peas, green onions and sesame seeds. Best cold or at room temperature.
recipes.title: Quick Sesame Soba Noodles

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Meal Prep. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Cut the tops off the peppers and scrape out the ribs and seeds.
Mix the quinoa, both beans, enchilada sauce, spices and 1 cup cheese, and fill the peppers.
Pour 1/2 cup water into the crockpot, stand the peppers in it, and cook on low 6 hours or high 3.
Top with the remaining cheese, cover a few minutes to melt, and serve with toppings.
recipes.title: Quinoa Black Bean Crockpot Stuffed Peppers

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Calories, protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Stir the quinoa, carrot and olives together.
Lay the tortilla flat and cover with spinach, then the quinoa mixture.
Add a line of feta down the middle with avocado slices on either side.
Fold in the bottom, roll up, and slice in half.
recipes.title: Quinoa Wrap with Avocado, Spinach and Feta

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Serves 6–8. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Bring the broth to a boil and add the frozen cauliflower.
Boil 8–10 minutes and drain off excess liquid.
Add the cheeses and butter (and a splash more broth if too thick) and mash like mashed potatoes.
recipes.title: Rachael Ray's Smashed Cauliflower

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Lunch. Makes 10 rolls; the site's serving is 5 rolls. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Slice the peppers as thin as possible, cut the carrot into fine matchsticks, shred the cabbage, and thinly slice the avocado. (Everything but the avocado can be prepped days ahead.)
Whisk the vinegar, sugar and sesame oil; separately whisk the mayo with sriracha.
Soften a wrapper in very warm water 15–25 seconds (still slightly stiff) and lay it flat.
Lay peppers, carrot and cabbage on the lower middle, avocado below, microgreens on top, and a spoonful of dressing.
Fold in the sides and roll up tightly. Repeat and serve with the sriracha mayo.
recipes.title: Rainbow Vegetable Spring Rolls

ingredients.item: canned tomato purée or whole canned tomatoes
sugar or a few drops red wine vinegar (if needed)

recipes.notes: From the BuzzFeed/Tasty list 7 Quick Dinners To Make This Week (pinned on Jessica Lynn's Pasta board). Calories, protein and weight are estimates without mozzarella.
steps: Trim the ramps, separate bulbs from leaves, thinly slice the bulbs and cut the leaves into 1/2-inch ribbons.

Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large skillet over medium heat, add red pepper flakes if using, and sauté the bulbs 4–5 minutes until translucent but still a bit crisp. Add the leaves for barely 1 minute until wilted. Season with salt.
Heat the oven as hot as it goes. Dust a baking sheet with cornmeal and stretch the dough very thin into an 11–12-inch round or rectangle.
Purée or chop the tomatoes and mix with the garlic, salt and pepper flakes; adjust with a drop of vinegar or pinch of sugar. Spread thinly over the dough (1/4–1/3 cup).
Add the mozzarella if using, scatter on the ramps, season, and drizzle with the remaining oil. Bake 10–12 minutes until golden.
Scatter immediately with pecorino and slice.
recipes.title: Ramp Pizza

ingredients.item: crescent roll dough, pressed into 8 rectangles
ranch dressing, plus more for dipping

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Preheat the oven to 375°F.
Spread about 2 tsp ranch on each dough rectangle and add a slice of cheese, 2 slices bacon and a chicken tender.
Roll up and set seam side down on a greased sheet.
Bake 15–20 minutes until golden. Serve with extra ranch.
recipes.title: Ranch Chicken Club Roll-Ups

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Anti-Inflammatory. Calories, protein and weight are estimates per tablespoon.
steps: Mix everything in a small bowl and refrigerate.
recipes.title: Ranch Dip (AIP, Paleo, Whole30, Keto)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. The live recipe card didn't load, so this comes from a 2021 web archive copy. Calories and protein are my estimates from the ingredients.
steps: In a medium bowl beat butter medium speed for about 30 seconds. Add the the 2/3 cup granulated sugar and 1/2 teaspoon almond extract. Beat until well combined. Beat in as much flour as you can with electric mixer and then using a wooden spoon stir in any remaining flour. Cover and chill for 1 hour or until dough is easy to handle.

Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Shape dough into 1-inch balls. Place balls 2 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheets. Using your thumb, press an indentation into the center of each ball. Spoon about 1/2 teaspoon of the jam into each indentation and then sprinkle with sugar. Bake about 10 minutes or until edges are light brown. Cool on cookie sheets for 1 minute. Transfer cookies to wire racks to finish cooling.
For icing, in a medium bowl combine powdered sugar, 1 teaspoon water and 1 1/2 teaspoons almond extract. Add enough of the remaining water to make a drizzling consistency. Drizzle cookies with icing.
recipes.title: Raspberry Almond Shortbread Cookies

ingredients.item: unsweetened almond milk, (or milk of choice)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Calories and protein are the site's figures per serving (1 serving).
steps: In a small bowl combine the almond meal, coconut sugar, and melted coconut oil until it becomes crumbly in texture, set aside.
In a blender add the cream cheese, yogurt, milk, powdered sugar, vanilla, and raspberries, and blend until smooth.
Pour the raspberry filling into popsicles molds leaving about 1/2 an inch at the top. Equally spoon the almond meal mixture onto the top of each popsicle and gently pack it down.

Place the top on the popsicle mold and insert the popsicle sticks. Freeze for 4 hours or overnight, until they are hard. If the popsicles won't release from the mold run them under hot water for about 10 seconds.
recipes.title: Raspberry Cheesecake Yogurt Popsicles

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Calories and protein are the site's figures per serving (1 slice).
steps: Preheat oven to 350 F. Grease 9 inch springform pan and line the bottom with parchment paper. Set aside.
To make the filling: Mix together the cream cheese and sugar on medium-low speed until creamy. Add egg white and mix on low just to combine. Set aside.
To make the cake batter: In a bowl stir together flour, baking powder, baking soda and salt, set aside.

With an electric mixer cream together the butter and sugar on medium-low speed. Add egg and egg yolk and vanilla. Slowly mix in the flour mixture alternating with the sour cream. Transfer the batter into the prepared pan and smooth with a spatula. Spread the cream cheese filling on top. Place raspberries onto cream cheese filling.
To make the topping: Combine sugar, flour and chilled cubed butter in a bowl. Stir with a fork or pastry blender until the mixture is crumbly.( Make sure the streusel is in pea-sized crumbs)
Sprinkle the streusel on top of raspberries.
Bake for 40-45 minutes until a cake tester inserted in the center comes out clean. Cool on a rack, run a thin knife around the cake and loose ring of springform pan.
Store in the fridge.
recipes.title: Raspberry Cream Cheese Coffee Cake

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Calories are the site's figures.
steps: In a large bowl, mix together cake mix, yogurt, and cool whip until completely combined and there are no lumps. Cover with plastic wrap, and refrigerate for 4 hours.
Garnish with sprinkles, and serve with animal crackers for dipping.
recipes.title: Re-Create Dunkaroos With This Funfetti Dip

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. The live recipe card didn't load, so this comes from a 2021 web archive copy. Calories and protein are my estimates from the ingredients.
steps: Pulse the powdered sugar and the almond flour in a food processor to form a fine powder. Sift three times into a large mixing bowl. Set aside.

Place the egg whites in the bowl of a stand mixer (or large, metal mixing bowl). Sprinkle the cream of tartar over the eggs and hand mix the two together with the whisk attachment for the stand mixer (or hand mixer). Fasten the whisk attachment and beat the mixture on medium speed until foamy. Slowly add the granulated sugar and continue to beat on medium speed until soft peaks form. Increase the speed to high and beat until stiff peaks form.

Sift 1/3 of the almond mixture into the bowl with the meringue. Add the red velvet cake emulsion and 2 to 3 drops of red gel food coloring. Fold the ingredients together with a large spatula until incorporated. Continue sifting and folding until all the almond mixture is incorporated into the meringue and the mixture should drip slowly off the spatula; like lava flowing. (Think conditioner dripping out of a bottle. That works for me.)

Transfer the batter to a large piping bag fitted with a 1/2 inch tip and pipe 1 1/3 inch rounds onto a silpat covered baking sheet. There are several different templates out there. Two that I like are here and here.
Preheat oven to 325.

You’re going to LOVE this next part! Once all the batter has been piped or your sheets are full, grab the edges of the pan, secure the silpat with your thumbs (or any extra batter) and rap the pans on the counter. That’s right! You heard me! Bang them on the counter!! This releases any remaining air bubbles in the meringue. Continue rapping the sheets, turning occasionally, until no more air bubbles surface. Allow the macaron to rest on the counter at least 30 minutes or more depending on the humidity level of your kitchen.

Once they’ve rested and the tops are no longer sticky to the touch, bake at 325 for 7 to 9 minutes. Rotate the pans front to back and top to bottom and bake an additional 7 to 9 minutes. Do the wiggle test to see if the meringue is cooked; carefully grab the top of the shell and if it moves easily from side to side when wiggled. This indicates that the meringue isn’t completely cooked. Continue to cook in 2 to 3 minutes intervals until they no longer wiggle.
Remove from heat and allow to cool completely before filling.

Combine the butter, cream cheese, and powdered sugar together in a medium mixing bowl and beat until combined. Add the vanilla extract and continue to beat until the mixture is light, fluffy, and no longer grainy.

Place the filling in a piping bag fitted with a plain tip (or glam it up and use a star tip like I did) and pipe the filling onto one shell, almost to the edge. Top with another shell and allow to rest before serving.
recipes.title: Red Velvet Cake Macaron

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. The live recipe card didn't load, so this comes from a 2021 web archive copy. Calories and protein are my estimates from the ingredients.
steps: Preheat the oven to 350°F (177°C). Spray 8×8 baking pan with nonstick spray. Set aside.

In a small bowl, beat the 2 eggs together. Set aside. Melt the butter in a large microwave safe bowl in 30 second increments until melted. Stir in 1 cup sugar, 2 teaspoons vanilla extract, cocoa powder, salt, food coloring, and vinegar. Mix each of those ingredients into the batter in that order. Whisk in the eggs, then fold in the flour until completely incorporated. Do not overmix. Pour the brownie batter into prepared baking pan, leaving about 3-4 Tablespoons for the top.

With a hand-held mixer on medium speed, beat the softened cream cheese, 1/4 cup sugar, egg yolk, and 1/2 teaspoon vanilla in a medium bowl until completely smooth – about 1 minute. Dollop spoonfuls of the cream cheese mixture on top of the prepared brownie batter. Cover with the last few Tablespoons of brownie batter. Glide a knife through the layers as best you can (both layers are pretty thick), creating a swirl pattern.

Bake the brownies for 28-30 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in the middle comes out clean. Allow the brownies to cool completely before cutting into squares. Cover brownies and store at room temperature for 3 days or in the refrigerator for up to 6 days.
recipes.title: Red Velvet Cheesecake Swirl Brownies

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Calories and protein are the site's figures per serving (1).
steps: In a medium tall bowl, (I use my 8 cup measuring cup), using an electric mixer, whip cream cheese until it becomes smooth. It may bind up in the beaters, but continue as is and it will loosen up. Add the dry pudding mix and continue beating until well combined.

With the mixer running on low speed, slowly add the creamer, 1 tablespoon at a time, to the cream cheese mixture. Be sure the creamer is completely combined before adding another tablespoon.Repeat until all of the creamer has been added to the mixture and the mixture is completely smooth. Refrigerate while you prepare the fruit.

In a large bowl, combine lemon juice and bananas. Stir to coat bananas completely; pour off any excess lemon juice. Add strawberries and blueberries. Gently stir to combine. Fold the cheesecake mixture into the fruit.
Serve immediately, or cover and refrigerate until ready to serve.
recipes.title: Red White and Blue Cheesecake Salad

ingredients.item: fruity or sweet red wine (e.g. boxed pinot noir)
berries frozen in ice cube molds with water

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Drinks (The Kitchn). Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Freeze berries in ice cube molds with water ahead of time.
Stir the wine, vodka, pomegranate juice and blackberry liqueur in a large pitcher or punch bowl and chill (up to a day ahead).
To serve, add regular ice and the berry ice cubes, top with ginger beer, taste, and stir gently.
Pour into iced glasses and garnish with berry skewers.
recipes.title: Red Wine, Blackberry & Ginger Pitcher Cocktail

ingredients.item: JELL-O No Bake Cheesecake mix, plus what the box calls for (or your own no-bake cheesecake)
Reese's peanut butter cups, unwrapped with the bottom paper removed
mini chocolate chips, for sprinkling on top
graham cracker crumbs (store-bought, homemade, or the crumb packet from the box), for sprinkling on top

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Recipe from the live Oh Bite It page. The site gives no servings, time or nutrition, so servings (12), time, calories, protein and serving weight are estimates (assuming full-size Reese's cups and whole milk for the mix).
steps: Line a cupcake pan with paper liners.
Mix up the no-bake cheesecake according to the box directions, or use your own favorite no-bake recipe.
Unwrap the Reese's cups and remember to remove the bottom paper.
Drop one peanut butter cup into each liner and pour the cheesecake mixture over it.
Refrigerate for at least one hour to chill.
Sprinkle with the graham cracker crumbs and/or mini chocolate chips and serve.
recipes.title: Reese's Bottom No-Bake Mini Cheesecakes

ingredients.item: mini Reese's peanut butter cups, ( divided and chopped)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Calories and protein are the site's figures per serving (1 serving).
steps: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit. Spray a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish with non-stick cooking spray and set aside. Chop 1 (12-ounce) bag mini Reese's peanut butter cups, into fourths and divide them in half.
In a microwave-safe bowl or over a double broiler, melt ¾ cup butter and 6 ounces chopped dark chocolate. Stirring every 30 seconds being careful not to let the chocolate burn.
Whisk 1 ½ cups granulated sugar and ½ cup packed brown sugar into the melted chocolate mixture. Then add 1 ½ teaspoons vanilla extract and 3 large eggs until it is fully incorporated.
Stir in 1 cup all-purpose flour until incorporated. Fold in half of the chopped Reese's Peanut butter cups then pour the mixture into your prepared pan.

In a stand mixer using the paddle attachment, cream together 1 (8-ounce) package cream cheese, and ¼ cup softened butter for about 2 minutes until fluffy. Mix in 1 egg, ½ cup granulated sugar, ½ teaspoon salt, and ½ teaspoon vanilla extract on high for another 2 minutes. Mix in the 1 cup creamy peanut butter, for about 2 minutes.
Pour the cream cheese layer over the brownie layer and spread it out so that it is smooth on the top and completely covers the brownie layer.
Bake for 35-40 minutes. The top and edges should be slightly golden and the center is set.
Let the bars completely cool then refrigerate for at least an hour before adding the chocolate layer on top.

To make the chocolate layer, in a microwave-safe bowl, add 1 (12-ounce) bag milk chocolate chips. Melt 30 seconds at a time until melted and smooth. Pour over the top of the peanut butter cheesecake layer and spread evenly. Sprinkle the rest of the chopped peanut butter cups on top.
Place the bars in the refrigerator to cool until the chocolate is set. Cut into squares and serve.
recipes.title: Reese's Cheesecake Brownies

ingredients.item: Chex cereal (about 8 cups; chocolate flavor used, but any will work)
semi sweet chocolate chips (or bittersweet or milk chocolate chips)
creamy peanut butter (or 1 cup Reese's peanut butter chips)

recipes.notes: Store in an airtight container for up to one week. The 15 minute setting time is not included in the stated total time of 10 minutes.
steps: Combine the Chex cereal and peanuts in a very large bowl and set aside.
Divide the powdered sugar between two large, gallon size ziploc bags and set aside.
Line a large baking sheet or surface with parchment paper and set aside.
Combine the chocolate chips, peanut butter and butter in a microwave safe container and melt together on medium heat in the microwave in 30 second bursts, stirring in between until smooth.
Drizzle the mixture over the Chex and peanuts and toss gently to combine, making sure it is well coated.
Gently fold in the Reese's Minis.
Transfer half of the chocolate-coated cereal mixture into one bag with powdered sugar and half into the other bag. Close each bag tightly and gently shake until the mixture is fully coated.
Spread the contents of both bags onto the parchment lined surface and let set up for 15 minutes.
Sprinkle on the Reese's Pieces and Reese's Miniatures, plus additional peanuts, peanut butter chips and Reese's Pieces if desired.
Toss gently to combine and store in an airtight container for up to one week.
recipes.title: Reese's Muddy Buddies

ingredients.item: devils food cake mix plus ingredients to make cake
bag Reese's peanut butter cups miniatures

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Calories and protein are the site's figures per serving (1).
steps: Prepare cake according to directions on box. Bake in 2 greased and floured 9" round pans. Cool completely.
For frosting: Beat together butter, peanut butter, vanilla and salt. Add powdered sugar and enough cream to reach spreading consistency.
To assemble: Place one cake layer on a plate, flat side up. Spread with a layer of frosting. If desired, sprinkle with a few finely chopped Reese's peanut butter cups.
Top with remaining cake layer. Frost top and sides of cake. Decorate with halved Reese's peanut butter cups.
Finely chop any remaining peanut butter cups and sprinkle them in the center.
recipes.title: Reese's Peanut Butter Chocolate Cake

ingredients.item: Melted peanut butter chips (about ¼ cup)
almond flour I recommend Bob’s Red Mill
unsweetened cocoa powder Hershey’s is the best!
egg whites roughly two eggs at room temperature

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Calories and protein are the site's figures per serving (1).
steps: First, weigh out all of your ingredients.
Next, sift together your almond flour, powdered sugar( remember to remove 2 tbsp and replace with 2 tbsp cocoa powder), and cocoa powder in a large bowl and set aside.
Add your egg whites to the bowl of your mixer and start mixing on a medium speed until they get frothy. Add in the salt.
Gradually add in your sugar to the egg whites and mix on a medium speed until you get a soft peak consistency.
After the egg whites are the right consistency, add about 1/3 of the dry mixture to the egg whites and fold in until there are no dry spots left.

Add in the remaining dry mixture to the meringue and fold in until there are no dry spots. Begin to check for the “ribbon” stage, where the batter falls off in ribbons and you can make a figure 8 without it breaking off. Once you get to this consistency stop folding.
Prepare your piping bag with a small round tip. Place your bag in a large cup to make it easier to add your batter. Slowly add in your batter.
Place a silicon mat on a baking sheet.
Hold your piping bag completely vertical when piping and lift straight up. Making about 1 1/2 to 2 inch circles.
After you have piped all the batter, bang the baking sheet on the counter 10-20 times (seriously) to remove all air bubbles. Use a toothpick or something sharp to pop them.
Now it is time to let them dry. Leave them sitting on the counter for 30-60 minutes until you can touch them and you can feel a “shell” form over them. No batter should come off on your finger.
preheat your oven to 300 degrees F. and bake your macarons for 15-18 minutes or until lightly browned. When you touch the top of the macaron it should not wiggle around on the “feet”.
Allow them to cool COMPLETELY before taking them off the baking sheet.
Melt the peanut butter chips with about 1 tsp vegetable shortening and add to a ziplock bag, being careful not to burn yourself it will be warm.
Cut a small hole in one corner of the bag. Drizzle over the top of the macaron shells. Allow to harden before moving on to the filling.
Place the butter and peanut butter in the bowl of your stand mixer with a paddle attachment and cream until light and fluffy. Add in the confectioners sugar and mix until combined.
Add in the vanilla extract, and cream and mix until combined.
Place in a pipping bag with a star tip and set aside
Pipe a generous amount of buttercream on half of the macaron shells
Sandwich them with the remaining macaron shells.
Keep in an airtight container in the refrigerator for 24-48 hours to allow them to “mature”. Be sure to allow to come to room temperature before serving.
Enjoy!
recipes.title: Reese's Peanut Butter Cup Macarons Recipe

ingredients.item: Oreo or chocolate graham cracker pie crust
melted peanut butter and hot fudge topping (optional)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Calories and protein are my estimates from the ingredients.
steps: Whip the cream with 3/4 cup powdered sugar and the vanilla to stiff peaks.
Cream the cream cheese, 1 cup powdered sugar and peanut butter, then fold in half the whipped cream.
Spread in the crust and top with the rest of the whipped cream, chopped Reese's, and peanut butter and fudge drizzles if you like.
Chill until firm, about 4 hours. Keep refrigerated.
recipes.title: Reese's Peanut Butter Pie

ingredients.item: Tablespoons Butter (melted plus 1 T. butter to grease pan)
whole Peanut Butter Cups (Cut Into Quarters)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Calories and protein are my estimates from the ingredients. Servings (12) are my estimate.
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F.

Butter a 9-inch springform pan (must be about 3" tall or overflow problems!), line with a parchment round and butter the parchment. *Note, some people had trouble with a 9inch pan so you may want to try a 10 inch but mine worked perfectly in the 9 inch and many commented it worked fine for them, too. Just a heads up!
Stir together butter, sugar and vanilla in a bowl.
Add eggs.
Stir in flour, cocoa, baking powder and salt.
Spread in prepared pan. Bake about 25 minutes.
Remove from oven and sprinkle on choc chips, peanut butter chips and the peanut butter cups. Lower oven to 325!!!!! Pour the cheesecake batter right on top (directions below)
Beat cream cheese in bowl of mixer until smooth.
Add eggs, one at a time.
Add sugar, peanut butter and cream. Mix until smooth.
Add vanilla.
Pour filling into pan. Make sure you lowered oven to 325 at this point

Wrap foil around springform sides and set in large roasting pan. Add hot water to roasting pan so it comes up 1 inch the sides of the pan. (You are making a water bath) Place entire roasting pan in the oven.
Bake at 325 for 90 minutes.
Let cool 1 hour.
Run knife around edge and chill at least 4 hours.

Microwave cream till hot. Add chips and let sit a minute. Whisk chips until melted and smooth. Drizzle all over the top reserving some. Use the reserved chocolate to dip the peanut butter cup halves into and stick them on the cake. Keep chilled!
recipes.title: Reese’s Peanut Butter Cup Cheesecake On A Brownie Crust

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Calories and protein are my estimates from the ingredients. Servings (12) are my estimate.
steps: In the bowl of a stand mixer, cream together butter and brown sugar until smooth.
Add in the cream cheese and cream together again, about 2 minutes. Your cream cheese must be soft in order to mix in well.
Add the peanut butter, vanilla, powdered sugar, salt and vanilla and then mix again until everything is well incorporated.
Taste and if you would like it sweeter, add more powdered sugar.
Fold in your chopped PB cups.
Refrigerate for at least 4 hours, but best if overnight.
Before serving, remove from fridge and let soften for about 15 minutes.
Enjoy!
recipes.title: REESE’S Peanut Butter Cup Dip

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Sides. If the coconut milk didn't separate, use 1/2 cup of the mixed can instead. The site's 584 kcal looks like the whole recipe, so calories, protein and weight are my estimates per serving.
steps: Boil the cauliflower and garlic in a large pot of water until fork tender, 10–15 minutes, then drain.
Open the chilled coconut milk upside down and pour off the clear water, keeping the solid cream.
Melt the butter and coconut cream in the pot with the salt, pepper and parsley.
Add the cauliflower and garlic and blend with an immersion blender to the texture you like.
recipes.title: Rich and Creamy Mashed Cauliflower (Whole30)
recipes.totalTime: 30 min (plus chilling the coconut milk overnight)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Sides. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Preheat the oven to 400°F and spray a large rimmed baking sheet.
Halve thick carrots lengthwise and cut diagonally into 1 1/2-inch pieces; put on the sheet with the broccoli.
Mix the seasonings, drizzle the vegetables with oil, sprinkle with the spice mix, toss, and spread out.
Roast 20 minutes, tossing halfway, until browned and tender. Sprinkle with parmesan.
recipes.title: Roasted Broccoli and Carrots

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Soup. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Preheat the oven to 425°F. Halve the squash lengthwise, scoop out the seeds, rub the flesh with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt, and roast flat side down on parchment 40–45 minutes.
Meanwhile cook the onion in the remaining oil 3–4 minutes, then the garlic and ginger 30 seconds.
Add the coconut milk, broth, remaining salt, cayenne and cinnamon, cover, and simmer on low 5 minutes.
Scoop the squash from the skin and blend with the coconut milk mixture until smooth.
Reheat 2–3 minutes and garnish.
recipes.title: Roasted Butternut Squash Soup with Coconut Milk (No Peeling)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Mexican. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Preheat the oven to 425°F and line a rimmed sheet with parchment.
Toss the zucchini with the oil and seasonings and spread out.
Roast 25 minutes until browned.
Finish with lime juice, cotija and cilantro.
recipes.title: Roasted Mexican Zucchini

ingredients.item: boneless skinless chicken breast or tenders
jarred roasted red peppers with juices

recipes.notes: From the Delish roundup 12 Slow-Cooker Flat Belly Foods. Calories and protein are the site's figures; serving weight is an estimate.
steps: Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium heat and sauté the onion, bell pepper, celery and garlic 3–5 minutes.
Put the vegetables and beans in the slow cooker, lay the chicken on top, and sprinkle with the chili powder, cumin and salt.
Purée the roasted peppers with their juices until very smooth and add with the broth. Cover and cook on LOW 6–8 hours or HIGH 3–4 hours.
Remove the chicken, shred it, stir it back in and serve warm.
recipes.title: Roasted Red Pepper Chicken Chili

ingredients.item: red bell peppers (or as many as you like)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Pasta. Calories and protein are the site's figures; serving weight is an estimate.
steps: Preheat the oven to 425°F with a rack in the upper third. Line a baking sheet with parchment.
Halve the peppers and remove the stems, membranes and seeds.
Lay the halves cut-side down on the sheet.
Roast 30–35 minutes, until the skins blacken in spots and loosen.
Move to a glass bowl, cover, and rest 10–15 minutes until cool enough to handle.
Peel off the skins and slice or chop.
recipes.title: Roasted Red Peppers

ingredients.item: pre-cooked chicken, turkey or pork sausage

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Preheat the oven to 450°F (400°F if your oven runs hot) and spray a sheet pan.
Whisk the oil, balsamic, garlic powder and pepper.
Toss the sweet potatoes with half and roast 15 minutes.
Add the sausage, sliced 3/4 inch thick, and roast 10 minutes.
Toss the broccoli with the rest of the dressing, flip the sausage, tuck in the broccoli, and roast 15 minutes more until browned. Season and serve.
recipes.title: Roasted Sweet Potatoes, Sausage and Broccoli Sheet Pan Meal

ingredients.item: chicken bouillon cube for 1 cup water (béchamel)
mixed vegetables to roast: zucchini, yellow squash, carrots, chopped spinach
regular lasagna noodles (not no-boil), for a 13x9 pan

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. The vegetable amounts are flexible. Calories, protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Béchamel: melt the butter, whisk in the flour 1 minute, then slowly whisk in the milk. Add the nutmeg, white pepper and bouillon and cook, whisking, until slightly thick. Cool, stirring now and then.
Chop the vegetables evenly, toss half at a time with oil, salt, pepper and garlic, and roast at 400°F, stirring, until soft (or lightly caramelized).
Boil the noodles 5 minutes, shock in ice water, and dry on towels.

In a sprayed 13x9, spread a thin layer of béchamel, then layer noodles, béchamel, vegetables, and a little parmesan and mozzarella. Repeat to 6 noodle layers; finish with béchamel and the rest of the cheese (no vegetables).
Cover tightly with foil (it can be refrigerated a day; bring to room temp for an hour).
Bake at 350°F 50 minutes, uncover, and bake until golden. Rest 15 minutes before slicing.
recipes.title: Roasted Vegetable Lasagna with Béchamel

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Calories and protein are the site's figures.
steps: In a large bowl, cream the butter and confectioners' sugar until light and fluffy, five to seven minutes.
Combine the flour, rosemary and salt, then gradually add this dry mixture to the creamed mixture and mix well.
Shape the dough into two 8-1/4-inch rolls, then securely wrap each roll. Refrigerate the rolls overnight.
Preheat the oven to 350°F. Cut the dough into 1/4-inch slices, then place the slices 2 inches apart on ungreased baking sheets.
Bake the cookies for 11 to 13 minutes or until the edges begin to brown. Let the cookies cool in the pan for one minute before removing them to wire racks to cool completely.
recipes.title: Rosemary Shortbread Cookies

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Snacks. A serving is 2 balls. The live page is blank, so this comes from a 2019 web archive copy. Calories, protein, weight and servings are estimates.
steps: Melt the peanut butter and honey together, then take off the heat and stir in the vanilla.
Mix in the rest of the ingredients thoroughly.
Roll heaping teaspoons into tight balls (oil or wash your hands if they get sticky), or press into a pan and cut into bars.
recipes.title: Runner's Fuel Protein & Chia Seed Balls

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Calories and protein are my estimates from the ingredients.
steps: Preheat the oven to 350°F and line an 8x8 dish.
Beat the butter and sugar, then the egg and vanilla.
Mix in the baking soda, salt, flour and graham crumbs.
Press 3/4 of the dough into the dish, spread with marshmallow cream, and sprinkle with chocolate chips.
Press the rest of the dough on top and bake 20 minutes. Cool before cutting.
recipes.title: S'mores Cookie Bars

ingredients.item: (113 grams) unsalted butter (softened at room temperature)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Calories and protein are my estimates from the ingredients.
steps: In a food processor, combine the powdered sugar, almond flour, and graham crackers. Process until completely fine.
In a stand mixer fitted with a whisk attachment or using a handheld mixer, beat the egg whites until thickened. Add the granulated sugar and continue to beat until stiff peaks form.

Gently fold the beaten egg whites into the ground almond and graham cracker mixture until combined, but be careful not to overmix. It should be the consistency of “molten lava” but not runny, about 40-65 folds.
Transfer the batter to a piping bag fitted with a 0.4 inch (10 millimeter) circular tip.
On a parchment lined baking sheet, pipe 1 1/2 inch (4 centimeter) circles at least 2 inches (5 centimeters) apart. Repeat with remaining baking sheets.
Firmly tap the baking sheets against the counter to remove excess bubbles. Allow to rest uncovered 30-40 minutes to form a shell.
Preheat oven to 300˚F (150˚C).
Bake the macarons in preheated oven until the tops become firm, 15-20 minutes. Allow to cool before removing from baking sheet.
Pour cream into small saucepan over medium heat. Right before coming to a boil, remove from heat and add the chocolate chips. Allow to rest for 30 seconds before mixing until smooth.
Transfer to a small bowl, cover, and refrigerate, whisking occasionally, until firm enough to pipe.
In a large bowl, beat together the butter and marshmallow fluff until smooth.
Slowly beat in the powdered sugar. Beat in just enough milk to make a smooth and light marshmallow buttercream. Refrigerate until needed.
Pair the cooled macaron shells based on the closest matched shapes.
On the bottom of one of the shells, pipe a small dollop of chocolate ganache, then another dollop of the marshmallow buttercream.
Gently cover with with bottom of the other macaron shell. Lightly press together until the chocolate reaches the edges. Repeat with remaining pairs.
Refrigerate in single layers for 24 hours and up to a week. Bring to room temperature for 1 hour before serving.
recipes.title: S'mores Macarons

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Apps. Calories, protein and weight are estimates per pinwheel.
steps: Lay 12 salami slices in 3 slightly overlapping rows of 4.
Spread with half the cream cheese and sprinkle with half the peppers.
Roll tightly into a log and wrap in plastic. Repeat for a second log.
Chill at least an hour, then slice into pinwheels.
recipes.title: Salami Cream Cheese Pinwheels

ingredients.item: ground beef (or half pork, half beef)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Heat the broiler and set a rack in a foil-lined rimmed sheet.
Gently mix the meatball ingredients (don't overmix) and shape 20 one-tablespoon balls.
Broil 10 minutes, flip and broil 3 more until cooked (or air fry at 375°F 8–10 minutes).
Meanwhile, sauté the onion in the oil about 5 minutes. Whisk the remaining gravy ingredients, add to the pan, and simmer 4–5 minutes until thick.
Pour the gravy over the meatballs. Great over mashed potatoes. Keeps a week in the fridge or 3 months frozen.
recipes.title: Salisbury Steak Meatballs (Whole30, Paleo)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Anti-Inflammatory. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Preheat the oven to 225°F.
Slice the zucchini about 1/16 inch thin on a mandoline.
Whisk the vinegar, oil, salt and pepper and toss the slices to coat both sides.
Spread in a single layer on two parchment-lined sheets and bake at least 2 hours until crisp.
Sprinkle with dill right away and cool completely.
recipes.title: Salt and Vinegar Zucchini Chips

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Calories and protein are my estimates from the ingredients.
steps: Preheat the oven to 350°F. Line a 9x13 pan with foil and coat well with nonstick spray.
Beat the butter and both sugars until fluffy, about 2 minutes. Add the eggs, vanilla, salt and baking soda and mix well.
On low speed, mix in the flour, then the chocolate chips.
Press half the dough into the pan.
Melt the condensed milk and caramels together over medium-low heat, stirring until smooth, and pour over the dough.
Drop the rest of the dough over the caramel in small clumps and bake 25–30 minutes until the center is just set.
Sprinkle with flaked salt, cool completely, then lift out by the foil and cut. Keeps 3 days airtight.
recipes.title: Salted Caramel Chocolate Chip Cookie Bars

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Preheat the oven to 350°F and line a rimmed sheet.
Microwave the whole squash 5 minutes to soften, halve it lengthwise, and scoop out the seeds.
Drizzle each half with 1 tbsp oil, season, and roast about 1 hour until it shreds.
Meanwhile brown the sausage, add the peppers and onion until soft, then the garlic and Italian seasoning 30 seconds. Add the sauce and simmer until thick.
Fluff the squash strands, fill each half with the sausage sauce, top with cheese, and broil until melted and browned. Each half serves 2.
recipes.title: Sausage and Peppers Stuffed Spaghetti Squash

ingredients.item: sweet Italian or breakfast sausage (no sugar for Whole30)
chopped sun-dried tomatoes, softened in hot water

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Lunch. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Rub the sweet potatoes with a little fat and salt and bake on foil at 400°F 1–1 1/2 hours until very soft (can be done ahead).
Brown the sausage in the oil with the pepper flakes, add the onion until translucent, then the garlic, sun-dried tomatoes and Italian seasoning for about 2 minutes.
Halve the potatoes, scoop out the insides (leave a thin layer), and mix with the sausage. Salt to taste.
Refill the skins and bake at 400°F 15–20 minutes until browned and crisp.
recipes.title: Sausage Pizza Twice Baked Sweet Potatoes (Paleo, Whole30)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Calories and protein are the site's figures per pepper; weight is an estimate.
steps: Preheat the oven to 350°F.
Cut the stems off the peppers, slit each down one side (don't halve them), and remove the seeds. Wash your hands well afterward.
Sauté the onion and garlic in the butter with salt and pepper 3–5 minutes.
Mix the sausage, cream cheese, parmesan, egg, Italian seasoning and red pepper with the onions by hand until even.
Pour the marinara into a 9x13 dish. Press the filling into each pepper all the way to the tip and lay them in the sauce.
Cover tightly with foil and bake 55 minutes.
Uncover, top with the shredded cheese, and bake 5 minutes more to melt. Serve with the sauce and parsley.
recipes.title: Sausage Stuffed Banana Peppers

recipes.notes: Calories and protein are the site's figures per serving; serving weight is an estimate.
steps: Cook the tortellini in a large pot of boiling water per the package, then drain and set aside.
Cook the brats in a large saucepan until cooked through. Remove, slice and set aside.
Leave the sausage juices in the pan and melt the butter in them.
Add the garlic and red pepper flakes and cook, stirring, about 1 minute.
Whisk in the flour and cook until lightly browned, about 1 minute.
Gradually whisk in the milk and cream and cook until slightly thickened, 2–3 minutes.
Stir in the cream cheese and Parmesan until melted, adding a splash more milk if it's too thick.
Stir in the sausage and tortellini, season with salt and pepper, and serve right away.
recipes.title: Sausage Tortellini Alfredo

recipes.notes: Calories and protein are the site's figures per serving; serving weight is an estimate.
steps: Heat the oil in a large pot or Dutch oven over medium-high heat and sauté the onion 3–4 minutes until soft.
Add the sausage and garlic and cook, breaking up the sausage, until browned, 4–5 minutes. Drain excess grease.
Stir in the tomatoes, broth, basil, salt and pepper. Bring to a boil, then cover and simmer on low 20–30 minutes.
Add the tortellini and cook about 5 minutes until tender.
Stir in the spinach, cover, turn off the heat, and let sit 1–2 minutes until wilted.
Serve topped with Parmesan, with a cheesy crostini if you like.

For the crostini: slice the baguette 1/2 inch thick, butter one side, and toast butter-side down in a hot skillet until golden. Flip, top with Parmesan, and cook until golden underneath, covering briefly to melt the cheese.
recipes.title: Sausage Tortellini Soup with Spinach

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Lunch. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Pulse half the chickpeas in a food processor until broken down but not puréed.
Heat the oil in a 12-inch high-sided skillet over medium and cook the onion 4–5 minutes, then the peppers, spices and salt until soft.
Add all the chickpeas and cook about 5 minutes, then wilt in the spinach, about 3 minutes.
Fill each pita half with 3/4–1 cup of the mixture.
To make ahead: cool the filling, stuff the pitas, wrap each in foil, and refrigerate up to 3 days or freeze up to 3 months. Reheat in foil at 325°F.
recipes.title: Scrambled Chickpea and Spinach Pitas (Freezer-Friendly)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Pasta. Calories and protein are the site's figures (2 rich servings); serving weight is an estimate.
steps: Cook the ravioli per the package and set aside.
Heat the oil in a large pan and sauté the spinach and mushrooms until the spinach cooks down. Add the minced garlic, salt and pepper and cook until fragrant.
Stir in the broth.
Add the cream, Worcestershire, pressed garlic, salt and pepper and stir well.
Add the shrimp and scallops and cook, flipping once, until the shrimp start to turn pink.
Gently stir in the ravioli and cook until the shrimp are done.
Stir in the cheese, cook 1 minute more and serve right away.
recipes.title: Seafood Ravioli with Spinach, Mushrooms & Garlic Cream Sauce

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Pasta. Nutrition is the site's figure per shell; serving weight is an estimate.
steps: Preheat the oven to 350°F and spray a baking dish.
Cook the shells 1 minute less than al dente, drain on paper towels, and cover with damp towels.
Melt the butter in a saucepan and sauté the onion and mushrooms 5 minutes; remove, leaving the butter.
Whisk the flour into the butter until bubbly, then whisk in the milk, half and half, white pepper and salt. Simmer 5 minutes.
Whisk the egg yolks into 1/2 cup of the hot sauce, then whisk that back into the pan; it will thicken.
Stir in the Worcestershire and sherry and remove from the heat.
Toss the seafood with the mushrooms, parsley and 3/4 cup sauce, stuff the shells, and arrange in the dish.
Ladle the rest of the sauce over and top with Parmesan.
Bake 10 minutes until the cheese melts.
recipes.title: Seafood Stuffed Shells in Sherry Cream Sauce

ingredients.item: salsa, lime juice, hot sauce, cilantro, sour cream

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Mexican. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Pour the beans and their liquid into a small saucepan and stir in the seasonings.
Heat over low to medium-low, stirring often, 5–10 minutes until hot.
Adjust the seasoning and serve with a slotted spoon.
recipes.title: Seasoned Black Beans

ingredients.item: finely grated zucchini (I firmly packed it in)
brown sugar (What? They're still brownies after all.)
flour (I used Oat Flour but all-purpose flour would be fine)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Calories and protein are my estimates from the ingredients. Servings (16) are my estimate.
steps: Preheat the oven to 350ºF. Grease a 9x13 inch pan.
Mix together the zucchini, sugar, applesauce, eggs, and vanilla.
Stir together the remaining ingredients and add to the wet ingredients, stirring until combined.
Stir in the chocolate chips and/or nuts if using.
Bake for about 55 minutes.
Frost with the frosting if desired.
recipes.title: Secretly Healthy Zucchini Brownies

ingredients.item: mild chili powder (start with 2 if using another brand)
dark red kidney beans, rinsed and drained
toppings: cheese, avocado, tortilla chips, cilantro, sour cream

recipes.notes: From the Meal Prep on Fleek roundup 31 Slow Cooker Meal Prep Recipes. The site's version is a stovetop recipe; to slow cook, brown the turkey and vegetables, then cook everything on LOW 6–8 hours. Nutrition is the site's figure for 1 1/2 cups.
steps: Heat the oil in a large pot over medium-high heat and sauté the onion, garlic and red pepper 5–7 minutes.
Add the turkey and cook until no longer pink. Stir in the chili powder, cumin, oregano, cayenne and salt for about 20 seconds.
Add the tomatoes, broth, beans and corn. Bring to a boil, then simmer 30–45 minutes until thickened. Adjust the seasoning.
Serve with your favorite toppings.
recipes.title: Seriously the Best Healthy Turkey Chili

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Asian. Calories and protein are the site's figures per roll; weight is an estimate.
steps: Rinse the rice until the water runs clear, cook it, then fold in the seasoning and cool 20 minutes.
Cut the crab into 1/4-inch strips and slice the avocado.
With wet fingertips, spread a palm-size ball of rice over a nori sheet, leaving 1/2 inch bare on one edge, and flip it rice side down.
Lay 2 avocado slices, 4 tbsp crab and a halved tempura shrimp down the middle and roll tightly from the rice-covered edge, sealing with the bare strip.
Top with shredded imitation crab and sesame seeds, slice, and drizzle with spicy mayo, teriyaki and sriracha. Sprinkle with green onion.
recipes.title: Shaggy Dog Sushi Roll (Copycat)

ingredients.item: medjool dates (or 1/4 cup honey or sugar) (sauce)
boneless skinless chicken breasts or thighs, in strips
sesame oil, sesame seeds and/or green onions, to top

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Asian. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Preheat the oven to 425°F and blend the sauce ingredients smooth.
Spread the chicken, broccoli and pepper on a sheet pan, pour about 1/2 cup sauce over the chicken and a few spoonfuls over the vegetables, and bake 10–15 minutes.
Meanwhile simmer another 1/2 cup sauce over medium-low until thick.
Drizzle over the chicken and vegetables and top with sesame oil, sesame seeds or scallions.
recipes.title: Sheet Pan Garlic Ginger Chicken and Broccoli

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Asian. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Preheat the oven to 400°F.
Arrange the salmon skin side down with the green beans and carrots on a prepared sheet; drizzle the vegetables with oil and season.
Whisk the soy sauce, chili sauce, honey, ginger, garlic and green onions and spoon over the salmon.
Bake 10 minutes, then broil 3–5 minutes until the salmon flakes.
recipes.title: Sheet Pan Ginger Soy Glazed Salmon

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Meal Prep. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Preheat the oven to 400°F.
Whisk the honey, orange juice and zest, 1 tbsp oil, ginger, garlic, red pepper, salt and pepper, and toss with the chicken.
Toss the broccoli florets with 2 tbsp oil, salt, pepper and garlic powder and spread at the edges of a parchment-lined sheet pan.
Put the chicken in the center and pour over the rest of the marinade.
Bake 15–20 minutes until the chicken reaches 165°F. Blot any extra liquid and serve with rice, with an extra drizzle of honey.
recipes.title: Sheet Pan Orange Chicken and Broccoli

recipes.notes: Example recipe — delete it once you've added your own.
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C).
Toss the potatoes with 1 tbsp oil, salt and pepper and spread on a sheet pan. Roast 10 minutes.
Mix the remaining oil with garlic, lemon zest, lemon juice and oregano. Rub over the chicken.
Add the chicken and green beans to the pan and roast 25–30 minutes, until the chicken reaches 165°F.
Rest 5 minutes and serve with the pan juices spooned over.
recipes.title: Sheet-Pan Lemon Garlic Chicken

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Meal Prep (Taste of Home). Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Preheat the oven to 425°F. Mix the eggs, tomato juice, oats, onion and salt, then the beef. Shape six 4x2 1/2-inch loaves on a sheet pan.
Mix the glaze and brush over the loaves.
Toss the potatoes with 2 tbsp oil and half the garlic salt and pepper, add to the pan, and bake 25 minutes.
Toss the asparagus with the rest of the oil and seasoning, add to the pan, and bake 15–20 minutes until the meat reaches 160°F.
Rest 5 minutes before serving.
recipes.title: Sheet-Pan Mini Meat Loaf

ingredients.item: large raw shrimp, peeled and deveined

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Serves 3–4. Calories, protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Whisk the lemon sauce ingredients and set aside.
Cook the shrimp in 2 tbsp oil over medium-high about 3 minutes, turning, until just opaque. Season with 1/4 tsp salt and set aside.
Cook the asparagus in the other 2 tbsp oil until tender-crisp and starting to brown. Season and stir in the ginger and garlic.
Pour in the sauce, return the shrimp, and simmer about a minute until thick.
recipes.title: Shrimp and Asparagus Stir Fry with Lemon Sauce

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Lunch (Tasty via BuzzFeed). Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Cook the shrimp in the oil over medium-high with 1/2 tsp salt, the pepper and spices until just pink, about 2 minutes. Remove.
Toss the lettuce, shrimp, tomatoes, jalapeño, onion, cilantro, avocado, remaining salt and lime juice.
Top with tortilla strips.
recipes.title: Shrimp and Avocado Taco Salad

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Apps. Calories and protein are the site's figures per tablespoon-size serving; weight is an estimate.
steps: Scoop the avocados into a bowl, add the lemon juice, garlic salt and cumin, and mash to the texture you like. Serve right away.
recipes.title: Simple Guacamole with Lemon

ingredients.item: red, yellow or Yukon gold potatoes, 1-inch cubes
chopped fresh herbs (rosemary, parsley, thyme or basil) or 2 tsp dried

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Sides. Calories are the site's figure; protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Preheat the oven to 425°F.
Optional: soak the cubed potatoes in cold water 20–60 minutes for fluffier insides; drain and dry well.
Toss with the oil, garlic powder, herbs, paprika, salt and pepper.
Roast in a single layer 30–35 minutes until browned and tender.
recipes.title: Simple Herb Oven Roasted Potatoes

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Serves 4–6. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Preheat the oven to 350°F and line a rimmed sheet with foil.
Melt the butter on the sheet in the oven, 3–4 minutes.
Lay the lemon slices on the butter and the shrimp on top.
Sprinkle with the Italian dressing mix and bake 15 minutes until lightly golden.
Serve as is or over pasta or rice with the lemon butter drizzled on top.
recipes.title: Simple Italian Baked Shrimp

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Calories and protein are the site's figures per serving (1 serving).
steps: In a medium bowl, combine flour and salt.
Stir in oil and water, mixing until just combined and form dough into a ball.
(Optional: Chill dough 30 minutes before rolling out or pressing into shape.)
Place dough into a greased pie pan. (You may also choose to roll out your pie crust on a floured surface if desired.)
Press dough out evenly until it covers entire pie pan including the sides. Make sure you press it thin where the side and bottom meet. Crimp edges if desired.
recipes.title: Simple Pie Crust

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Calories and protein are my estimates from the ingredients.
steps: Preheat the oven to 350°F.
Whisk the egg about a minute until bubbly, then stir in everything else (the batter is very thick).
Spread in a buttered 8-inch cast iron skillet and bake about 18 minutes, until the edges pull away and a toothpick shows crumbs, not batter. Serve warm with ice cream.
recipes.title: Skillet Brownie for Two

ingredients.item: skinless salmon fillets, about 1 inch thick

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Let the salmon sit out 10 minutes.

Sauce: melt 1 tsp butter in a small pan over medium and cook the garlic 1–2 minutes until golden. Add the broth and lemon juice and reduce by half, about 3 minutes. Whisk in the rest of the butter and the honey.
Pat the salmon dry and season.
Sear in the oil in a 12-inch nonstick skillet over medium-high about 4 minutes until golden, flip, and cook 2–3 minutes more.
Drizzle with the sauce and sprinkle with parsley.
recipes.title: Skillet Salmon with Garlic Lemon Butter Sauce

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. The original recipe is no longer online, so this is a similar recipe from MedlinePlus (NIH). A heart-healthy recipe from the NIH. A serving is 1 1/2 cups.
steps: Brown the ground beef in a large sauté pan and drain off the fat.
Add all the remaining ingredients and mix well.
Cover and bring to a boil over medium heat.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer 35 minutes. Serve hot.
recipes.title: Quick Beef Casserole

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Drizzle the bread with oil and toast under the broiler until crisp.
Rub the chicken with the garlic powder, parsley and salt and pan-fry in a little oil until golden and cooked. Then fry the bacon in the same pan until crisp.
Whisk the dressing ingredients and season.
Toss the lettuce with the sliced chicken, bacon, eggs, avocado, shaved parmesan and bread, then the dressing.
recipes.title: Skinny Chicken and Avocado Caesar Salad

ingredients.item: boneless skinless chicken breasts, bite-size pieces

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Casseroles. SkinnyMs blocks automated reading, so this came from an archived copy. Calories and protein are the site's figures; serving weight is an estimate.
steps: Cook the pasta per the package and drain. Preheat the oven to 375°F. Mix the pasta, marinara, tomatoes and raw chicken in a 9x13 dish. Cover and bake 30 minutes.
Meanwhile, mix the panko, Parmesan and Italian seasoning.
Stir in the mozzarella, sprinkle the crumb mixture over the top, and bake uncovered 10–15 minutes more, until the chicken is cooked and the top is crisp.
recipes.title: Skinny Chicken Parmesan Casserole

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Put the chicken, beans, corn, salsa, taco seasoning and water (if the salsa isn't saucy) in a slow cooker and cook on High about 3 hours. Shred.
Preheat the oven to 400°F. Soften the tortillas in the microwave 3 at a time, about 25 seconds.
Fill each with a few spoonfuls of filling, roll, and set seam side down in a baking dish. Spread the remaining filling over the top.
Sprinkle with cheese and bake 15–20 minutes until bubbly.
Drizzle with crema and top with avocado, cilantro and Cotija.
recipes.title: Skinny Crockpot Chicken Enchiladas

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Calories and protein are the site's figures per serving (1 grams).
steps: Fold together the peanut butter and 1/2 c. Fat Free whipped topping. Add the remaining Cool Whip in two seperate portions, folding well after each addition.
Scoop or pipe the mixture using a resealable bag with a small slit, into mini muffin liners.
Set them in a cake pan to freeze for an hour and them pop them in a resealable bag to store in the freezer for up to 2 months.
recipes.title: Skinny Frozen Peanut Butter Whips

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Apps. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Beat the cream cheese, yogurt, salsa and taco seasoning smooth.
Spread in a 2-quart dish or pie plate and refrigerate 1–24 hours.
Top with the lettuce, cheese, tomato, avocado, green onions and olives. Serve with chips.
recipes.title: Skinny Layered Taco Dip

ingredients.item: Healthy Request cream of chicken soup

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Put the chicken in the slow cooker and top with the onion and celery.
Whisk the soup, milk and seasonings and pour over. Cook on High 4 hours or Low 8.
About 30 minutes before serving, shred the chicken, return it, and stir in the vegetables and parsley. Cook 30 minutes more.
Bake the biscuits per the package at 400°F.
Serve a heaping cup of the filling topped with a biscuit.
recipes.title: Skinny Slow Cooker Chicken Pot Pie

ingredients.item: boneless skinless chicken breast, bite-size cubes
sesame seeds and green onions, to serve

recipes.notes: From the Delish roundup 12 Slow-Cooker Flat Belly Foods (pinned on Jessica Lynn's Slow Cooker board). Calories and protein are the site's figures; serving weight is an estimate.
steps: Shake the chicken with the salt and pepper in a zip-top bag.
Brown the chicken in the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat, 5–7 minutes, and move to the slow cooker.
Whisk the soy sauce, water, honey, hoisin, garlic, ginger and red pepper flakes and pour over the chicken.
Cover and cook on LOW 2–4 hours or HIGH 1–3 hours.
About 30 minutes before serving, stir in the cornstarch mixed with 2 tbsp water, then add the bell pepper, zucchini, cashews and dried chilies.
Cook on HIGH 20–30 minutes more until the vegetables are tender and the sauce thickens; thin with water if needed.
Sprinkle with sesame seeds and green onions and serve over rice, quinoa or noodles.
recipes.title: Skinny Slow Cooker Kung Pao Chicken

ingredients.item: quartered artichoke hearts, drained and chopped
diced jalapeños, drained (or not, for more heat)
frozen spinach, thawed and squeezed dry

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Apps. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Melt the cream cheese, yogurt, butter and parmesan together in a medium pot over medium, stirring often until smooth and lightly bubbling.
Stir in the artichokes, jalapeños and spinach, then the garlic.
Let it bubble a few minutes and serve.
recipes.title: Skinny Spinach and Artichoke Dip (Stovetop)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. The pin linked to Southern Bite's home page; this is the recipe it showed. Calories, protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Preheat the oven to 350°F. Halve the peppers top to bottom (leave the stems on) and scoop out the seeds.
Set them in a sprayed baking dish.
Brown the beef, drain, and stir in the sauce. Spoon into the peppers.
Cover tightly with foil and bake 25–30 minutes until the peppers are tender.
Uncover, add the cheese, and bake 3–5 minutes to melt. (Freeze before baking for a make-ahead meal.)
recipes.title: Sloppy Joe Stuffed Peppers

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Preheat the oven to 325°F.
Whisk the vinegar, Worcestershire, water, ketchup, salt, paprika, chili powder and sugar.
Spread the beef in a lidded Dutch oven or roasting pan, scatter the onion over, and pour on the sauce.
Cover and bake 2 1/2 hours, stirring at 1 and 2 hours.
Uncover and bake 30 minutes more.
recipes.title: Slow Braised Barbequed Beef Bites

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. The current version of this page uses rice (it was originally a paleo recipe). Serves 4–6. Calories, protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Cut the tops off the peppers and remove the seeds and membranes.
Mix all the filling ingredients except the cheese and pack them firmly into the peppers.
Slow cooker: stand them in a sprayed 6-quart cooker and cook on High 3–4 hours or Low 6–8. Add the cheese for the last 5 minutes.
Instant Pot: pour in the water, add the trivet and peppers, and cook on High pressure 13 minutes, quick release. Add the cheese and cover 5 minutes to melt.
recipes.title: Slow Cooker (or Instant Pot) Stuffed Peppers

ingredients.item: cooking oil, to coat the slow cooker

recipes.notes: From the MyFitnessPal roundup 15 Slow Cooker Recipes Under 375 Calories. Nutrition is the site's figure for about 6 oz (1 cup).
steps: Lightly oil the slow cooker. Layer half the hash browns, then half the bacon, half the cheese and a third of the green onions. Save some bacon and onion for garnish and repeat the layers.
Whisk the eggs, milk, salt and pepper and pour slowly over the top. Cook until the eggs are set, 2–3 hours on HIGH or 4–5 on LOW.
Sprinkle with the remaining bacon and onions and serve, with hot sauce if you like.
recipes.title: Slow Cooker Bacon, Egg & Hash Brown Casserole

recipes.notes: From the Beauty and the Foodie roundup Low Carb Slow Cooker Meals. SkinnyMs blocks automated reading, so only the link is saved. Open it, copy the recipe, and use Add details to paste it in.
steps: Pour the olive oil on the bottom of the slow cooker, add the chicken breasts, and season each breast with salt and pepper.
Put the sliced onion on top of the chicken, then add all the dried herbs and the garlic cloves.
Pour in the vinegar and top with the diced tomatoes.
Cook on high for 4 hours, and serve over angel hair pasta.
recipes.title: Slow Cooker Balsamic Chicken

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Put the onion in the slow cooker with the chicken on top. Add the oil and season.
Add the tomatoes, garlic and basil and pour the balsamic over.
Cook on Low 6 hours or High 3.
recipes.title: Slow Cooker Balsamic Chicken with Tomatoes

recipes.notes: From the Meal Prep on Fleek roundup 31 Slow Cooker Meal Prep Recipes. Calories and protein are the site's figures; serving weight is an estimate.
steps: Put the chicken, barbecue sauce and cranberries in the slow cooker.
Cook on HIGH 4–6 hours.
Shred the chicken and mix in some of the sauce.
Serve over the lentils.
recipes.title: Slow Cooker BBQ Chicken with Lentils

recipes.notes: Total time is based on the high setting (4 hr) plus about 20 min for prep and browning the beef; on low it takes about 10 hr 20 min. The recipe does not state servings, so 8 is an estimate. Cayenne at 1 tablespoon makes this quite spicy.
steps: Brown the beef and drain the grease.
Combine all ingredients in a slow cooker.
Cook on low for 10 hours or on high for 4 hours.
recipes.title: Slow Cooker Beef Chili

recipes.notes: From the MyFitnessPal roundup 15 Slow Cooker Recipes Under 375 Calories. Calories and protein are the site's figures; serving weight is an estimate.
steps: Brown the beef in the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat, 6–8 minutes. Move it to a 6-quart slow cooker and stir in the stock, onion, garlic, chili powder, chipotles, salt and tomatoes. Cook on LOW 7–8 hours until the beef is tender.
Stir in the beans for the last 30 minutes. Serve topped with sour cream, radishes, green onions and cilantro.
recipes.title: Slow Cooker Beef Chili

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Calories and protein are the site's figures, without rice; weight is an estimate.
steps: Mix everything in a 4-quart slow cooker.
Cover and cook on Low 7–8 hours.
Serve over hot rice.
recipes.title: Slow Cooker Beef Tips and Rice

ingredients.item: dried black beans, sorted and rinsed

recipes.notes: From the MyFitnessPal roundup 15 Slow Cooker Recipes Under 375 Calories. Calories and protein are the site's figures; serving weight is an estimate.
steps: Cover the beans with 2 inches of water and soak 12 hours; drain. (Quick soak: boil 5 minutes, then cover off the heat for 1 hour and drain.)
Combine the beans, onion, bell pepper and garlic in a 4-quart slow cooker. Stir in the broth and cumin. Cook on LOW 10 hours or HIGH 5 hours until the beans are tender.
Stir in the chipotle, cilantro, lime juice and salt.
Blend with an immersion blender about 30 seconds for a thicker, smoother soup (or blend in batches with the lid vented).
