Top each serving with 1 tsp sour cream, 2 tbsp avocado and a cilantro sprig.
recipes.title: Slow Cooker Black Bean Soup

ingredients.item: dry red wine (Pinot Noir or Merlot)

recipes.notes: From the MyFitnessPal roundup 15 Slow Cooker Recipes Under 375 Calories (this one is above 375). Calories and protein are the site's figures; serving weight is an estimate including bone.
steps: Season the oxtails with pepper and salt. Brown them in the oil in a large nonstick pan over medium-high heat, in batches, about 10 minutes. Move to the slow cooker.

Pour off the fat. Cook the tomato paste in the pan 2–3 minutes, stirring, until it starts to brown. Add the wine and simmer 1 minute, scraping up the browned bits. Stir in the broth, garlic, rosemary and bay leaves.
Pour over the oxtails and tuck the celery and onion around them. Cook on LOW 8–9 hours (or HIGH 4–5) until 190–205°F inside, adding the carrots and parsnip for the last 2–3 hours.
Lift the oxtails and vegetables into a serving bowl with a slotted spoon, discard the herbs, and cover with foil.
Skim the fat from the cooking liquid, pour it into a small saucepan, bring to a boil and simmer 4 minutes.
Stir the cornstarch with 2 tbsp water, add to the liquid and simmer until thickened, about 2 minutes. Season and pour over the oxtails and vegetables.
recipes.title: Slow Cooker Braised Oxtail and Carrots

recipes.notes: From the Meal Prep on Fleek roundup 31 Slow Cooker Meal Prep Recipes. The live site blocks automated reading, so this came from an archived copy. Calories, protein and weight are estimates, not counting rice.
steps: Grease the slow cooker. Add the steak, broth, soy sauce, brown sugar, sesame oil, garlic and chili flakes. Cover and cook on HIGH 2–3 hours or LOW 4–5 hours.
Whisk the cornstarch with the cold water, stir into the slow cooker, cover and cook 20–25 minutes more.
Microwave the broccoli in a vented container with 1/2 inch of water for 3 minutes, drain, and stir into the beef. Serve over rice.
recipes.title: Slow Cooker Broccoli Beef

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Soup. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Melt the butter in a large skillet over medium and sauté the onion 3–4 minutes. Add the garlic and flour, season lightly, and cook 2 minutes, stirring.
Slowly whisk in the evaporated milk and cook, stirring, until it starts to thicken.
Pour into the slow cooker with the broth, broccoli and thyme. Cook on low 5–6 hours.
Turn to warm or off and stir in the cream, cheddar and parmesan. Season and serve.
recipes.title: Slow Cooker Broccoli Cheese Soup

recipes.notes: From the Delish roundup 12 Slow-Cooker Flat Belly Foods. Nutrition is the site's figure for 1 potato with 2 tbsp dressing; serving weight is an estimate.
steps: Spray the slow cooker and put the chicken in the bottom.

Melt the hot sauce, coconut oil, salt, garlic powder and cayenne together (microwave about 45 seconds or a small saucepan) and pour over the chicken. Cook on HIGH 1 1/2–2 1/2 hours or LOW 4–5 hours, until 165°F. Remove and shred.
About 30 minutes before the chicken is done, prick the sweet potatoes and bake on a foil-lined sheet at 400°F for 45–60 minutes until tender.
Whisk the cornstarch slurry into the cooking liquid and cook on HIGH 30 minutes, stirring once, until thick. Return the chicken and toss.
Whisk the dressing ingredients. Split the sweet potatoes, fill with buffalo chicken, drizzle with dressing and top with green onions.
recipes.title: Slow Cooker Buffalo Chicken Stuffed Sweet Potatoes

recipes.notes: From the Meal Prep on Fleek roundup 31 Slow Cooker Meal Prep Recipes. Nutrition is the site's figure for 1/6 of the recipe (about 2/3 cup); serving weight is an estimate.
steps: Heat the coconut oil in a sauté pan over medium heat and cook the onion until translucent and tender. Add the garlic, ginger, spices and salt and cook 1 minute until fragrant. Stir in the coconut milk and tomato paste until smooth.
Put the chicken in the slow cooker and pour the sauce over.
Cook on HIGH 3–4 hours or LOW 6–8 hours.
Shred or dice the chicken into the sauce, squeeze in the lime, top with cilantro, and serve with vegetables, rice or naan.
recipes.title: Slow Cooker Butter Chicken (Paleo)

recipes.notes: From the MyFitnessPal roundup 15 Slow Cooker Recipes Under 375 Calories. Calories and protein are the site's figures; serving weight is an estimate.
steps: In a 6-quart slow cooker, stir together the stock, onion, carrots, celery, wild rice, salt, pepper, mushrooms and garlic. Nestle in the chicken, thyme and bay leaves. Cook on LOW about 7 hours (or HIGH 3–4) until the chicken and rice are tender.
Remove the chicken and turn the heat to HIGH. Discard the bones and shred the meat. Discard the thyme and bay leaves.
Whisk the milk and flour until completely smooth, then slowly stir into the soup.
Cook on HIGH until thickened, 10–20 minutes. Stir in the chicken and serve garnished with parsley.
recipes.title: Slow Cooker Chicken & Wild Rice Stew

ingredients.item: boneless skinless chicken breasts, bite-size pieces

recipes.notes: From the MyFitnessPal roundup 15 Slow Cooker Recipes Under 375 Calories. Calories and protein are the site's figures; serving weight is an estimate.
steps: Coat the slow cooker with cooking spray. Put the onion, carrots and garlic in the bottom and top with the chicken, lentils and black beans. Stir in the broth, chili powder, cumin and salt.
Cook on HIGH 4 hours or LOW 8 hours, adding the tomato sauce for about the last hour. Stir before serving.
Top each serving with 1 tbsp sour cream, 1 tbsp cheddar and a few cilantro leaves.
recipes.title: Slow Cooker Chicken and Lentil Chili

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Mexican. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Brown the ground chicken in a skillet.
Put it in the slow cooker with the quinoa, beans, corn, tomatoes, garlic, onion, jalapeño, water, enchilada sauce, seasoning, salt and pepper. Stir.
Cover and cook on high about 3 hours until the liquid is absorbed.
Stir, adjust the seasoning, stir in half the cheese and sprinkle the rest on top. Cover until melted.
Top with green onions and cilantro.
recipes.title: Slow Cooker Chicken Enchilada Quinoa

ingredients.item: petite diced tomatoes with green chilies
bell peppers (red, yellow and green), cored and sliced
optional toppings: cilantro, sour cream, salsa, guacamole or avocado, shredded Mexican cheese

recipes.notes: From Pinterest board Foods I do like. Nutrition is the site's figure per serving (2 tortillas).
steps: Spread half the tomatoes in the bottom of the slow cooker. Top with half the peppers and onions, sprinkle in the garlic, and lay the chicken on top.
Whisk the chili powder, cumin, paprika, coriander, salt and pepper. Sprinkle half over the chicken, flip, and sprinkle on the rest. Top with the remaining tomatoes, peppers and onions.
Cover and cook on HIGH 2–3 hours or LOW 4–6 hours, until the chicken is cooked and the vegetables are tender.
Remove the chicken and slice or shred it. Ladle out and discard about 1 cup of the liquid.
Whisk the lime juice and honey, add to the slow cooker with the chicken, season with salt and toss gently. Serve warm in tortillas with toppings.
recipes.title: Slow Cooker Chicken Fajitas

recipes.notes: From the Meal Prep on Fleek roundup 31 Slow Cooker Meal Prep Recipes (pinned on Jessica Lynn's Slow Cooker board). Calories, protein and weight are estimates including the zucchini noodles.
steps: Cut the chicken into 1-inch pieces.

Put the chicken, mushrooms, onion and garlic in the slow cooker. Add the coconut milk, broth, celery seed, thyme, 1 tbsp parsley, salt and pepper and mix well. Cover and cook 4 hours on HIGH or 8 hours on LOW.
Adjust the salt and pepper and garnish with the remaining parsley.
For the zucchini noodles, boil them in lightly salted water 1 minute, drain well, and serve with the chicken.
recipes.title: Slow Cooker Chicken Stroganoff with Zucchini Noodles

ingredients.item: low-sodium black beans, rinsed and drained

recipes.notes: From the MyFitnessPal roundup 15 Slow Cooker Recipes Under 375 Calories. Calories and protein are the site's figures; serving weight is an estimate.
steps: Season the chicken with salt and pepper.
Put the chicken, broth, beans and salsa in the slow cooker. Cook on LOW 8 hours or HIGH 4 hours. Remove the chicken, shred it, and return it to the soup.
Ladle into bowls, top with avocado and tortilla chips, and serve right away.
recipes.title: Slow Cooker Chicken Tortilla Soup

ingredients.item: assorted dried chilies (guajillo, ancho, New Mexico)

recipes.notes: From the Beauty and the Foodie roundup Low Carb Slow Cooker Meals. Calories and protein are the site's figures; serving weight is an estimate.
steps: Split the dried chilies and discard the seeds (keep a few for heat).
Toast the chilies briefly over a burner or in a hot pan, about 15 seconds in a few spots, without burning.
Soak them in about 4 cups hot tap water to soften.
Heat a large sauté pan over medium-high and set the slow cooker to LOW.
Season the beef with salt, pepper and cumin.
Sear the beef in batches in a little oil until well browned, moving each batch to the slow cooker.
Blend the onion, garlic, fresh peppers and oregano with a little salt and pepper.
Add the soaked chilies (save the water) and purée, adding just a splash of chili water if needed.
Add the sauce to the slow cooker and stir in the beef.
Cover and cook on LOW 8 hours.
Serve with your favorite sides and grilled low-carb tortillas.
recipes.title: Slow Cooker Chile Colorado

ingredients.item: toppings: cheddar, sour cream, green onions, corn chips

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Soup. The site's 220 kcal per serving is low for a pound of beef, 30 oz of chili beans and 8 oz of pasta in 8 servings, so calories and protein are my estimates. Weight is an estimate.
steps: Brown the beef and drain. Put it in a 6-quart or larger slow cooker and stir in everything except the pasta.
Cook 4 hours on high or 8 on low.
Stir in the uncooked macaroni for the last 15 minutes (it keeps cooking in the heat, so don't overdo it).
Serve right away with toppings.
recipes.title: Slow Cooker Chili Mac

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Use it in tacos, bowls, or the chipotle pulled pork lettuce wraps. Calories, protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Pulse the onion, garlic, oil, citrus juices and spices in a mini food processor until mostly smooth.
Coat the pork with the marinade in a gallon zip bag and refrigerate overnight.
Put the pork and marinade in the slow cooker with the broth and cook on Low 8 hours until it shreds easily.
recipes.title: Slow Cooker Chipotle Pulled Pork

recipes.notes: From the Beauty and the Foodie roundup Low Carb Slow Cooker Meals (pinned on Jessica Lynn's Slow Cooker board). Calories and protein are the site's figures; serving weight is an estimate.
steps: Peel 6 strips of just the orange rind (no pith), about 3/4 by 3 inches. Juice the orange and discard the rest.
Blend the orange juice and rind, achiote paste, lime juice, jalapeños, cumin, coriander, cinnamon, cloves, cilantro, garlic, salt and pepper until smooth.
Puncture the pork deeply 20–30 times all over with a paring knife.
Rub the achiote mixture all over the pork, pushing some into the holes, pour the rest over, cover and refrigerate overnight.
Optional: line the slow cooker with banana leaves, leaving big flaps hanging over the sides.
Put the pork in, pour the marinade over, and fold the leaves over the top.
Cook on LOW 8–9 hours.
When it shreds easily, remove and shred the pork, adding enough juice to keep it moist.
Optional: reduce the remaining juice in a pan to a thin sauce and drizzle over. Serve with pickled onions and salsa.
recipes.title: Slow Cooker Cochinita Pibil

ingredients.item: sweet potato, peeled and chopped (about 3 cups)

recipes.notes: From the Meal Prep on Fleek roundup 31 Slow Cooker Meal Prep Recipes. Calories and protein are the site's figures; serving weight is an estimate.
steps: Add everything to the slow cooker and stir well.
Cook on HIGH 3–4 hours, until the sweet potato is cooked through and the curry has thickened.
recipes.title: Slow Cooker Coconut Quinoa Curry

recipes.notes: From the Beauty and the Foodie roundup Low Carb Slow Cooker Meals. Calories and protein are the site's figures; serving weight is an estimate.
steps: Mix the smoked salt, pepper, paprika and celery seed.
Stir the arrowroot with the cold water.
Bring the coffee, broth and Worcestershire to a low boil in a saucepan, stir in the slurry, then the garlic and onion. Stir 2 minutes over medium heat and remove from the heat.
Brush the roast with oil and rub all over with the seasoning.
Sear the roast on all sides in a hot frying pan until a brown crust forms, then put it in the slow cooker and pour the coffee mixture over.
Add the chopped vegetables, cover, and cook 8 hours on LOW or 4–6 on HIGH.
recipes.title: Slow Cooker Coffee Roasted Beef and Veggies

ingredients.item: shredded cheddar, plus more to serve

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Calories and protein are the site's figures, without rice; weight is an estimate.
steps: Stir the soups, broth and seasonings together in a sprayed 6-quart slow cooker.
Lay the chicken on top, cover, and cook on Low 4–6 hours or High 3.
With 30 minutes left, shred the chicken and stir in the broccoli, sour cream and cheddar. Cook 30 minutes until the broccoli is tender.
Serve over rice with more cheese.
recipes.title: Slow Cooker Creamy Chicken and Broccoli over Rice

ingredients.item: heavy cream or half and half, warmed

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Soup. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Microwave the onion, flour, basil, garlic, tomato paste and oil 5 minutes, stirring every 90 seconds, and scrape into the slow cooker.
Add the broth, tomatoes, chicken, salt and pepper.
Cook on low 4–6 hours or high 3–4 until the chicken is tender.
Remove the chicken and stir in the tortellini, spinach, Parmesan and warm cream.
Shred the chicken, return it, and cook on high about 10 minutes until the tortellini are done.
recipes.title: Slow Cooker Creamy Tortellini, Spinach and Chicken Soup

recipes.notes: From the Meal Prep on Fleek roundup 31 Slow Cooker Meal Prep Recipes. Calories and protein are the site's figures; serving weight is an estimate.
steps: Peel the eggplant and cut into 1/3-inch rounds. Layer in a colander, salting each layer, and let sit 30 minutes, then pat dry.
Spread 1/2 cup sauce in the bottom of the slow cooker.
Whisk the eggs and milk in a shallow bowl. Mix the breadcrumbs, Parmesan and Italian seasoning in another. Dip the eggplant in egg, then crumbs.
Layer a third of the slices in the slow cooker, then 1 cup sauce and mozzarella. Repeat two more times. Cook on LOW 8 hours.
Top with fresh basil if you like.
recipes.title: Slow Cooker Eggplant Parmesan

ingredients.item: chicken stock or slow cooker liquid (sauce)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Calories, protein, weight and servings are estimates.
steps: Put the thawed chicken in the slow cooker with the butter, scatter in the garlic, and sprinkle with salt.
Cook on Low 6 hours and move the chicken to a platter.
Warm the stock (or cooker liquid) with the cream cheese and salt over medium-low until smooth and creamy.
Pour over the chicken.
recipes.title: Slow Cooker Garlic Butter Chicken with Cream Cheese Sauce

recipes.notes: From the 40 Aprons roundup Whole30 Slow Cooker Recipes. Only broil the insert if it is oven-safe. Calories and protein are the site's figures; serving weight is an estimate of carved meat with gravy.
steps: Pulse the parsley and garlic in a food processor, then add the butter and salt and pulse to combine.
Pat the chicken dry and loosen the skin over the breast and legs with your fingers.
Spread the garlic butter evenly under the skin, a tablespoon or two at a time.
Put half the garlic head inside the cavity.
Tie the legs together tightly with kitchen twine.
Sprinkle with a little more salt.
Make a foil rack (a ring or a few foil balls) in the bottom of the slow cooker and add the other half of the garlic head.
Set the chicken on the rack breast-side down and cover.
Cook on LOW 4–5 hours, until it reads 160°F.
Carefully flip the chicken breast-up, brush with the oil, and broil the ceramic insert about 10 inches from the heat until the skin browns.
Move the chicken to a board and tent with foil. Return the insert to the base on HIGH.
For gravy, remove the garlic, whisk the flour into the drippings until smooth, add the stock and cook 10–15 minutes (or finish in a saucepan) until thick.
Carve and serve with plenty of gravy.
recipes.title: Slow Cooker Garlic Butter Whole Chicken with Gravy

ingredients.item: boneless skinless chicken breasts or thighs (frozen OK)

recipes.notes: From the Beauty and the Foodie roundup Low Carb Slow Cooker Meals. The site also gives an Instant Pot slow-cook method. Nutrition is the site's figure for 1 thigh; serving weight is an estimate.
steps: Blend all the sauce ingredients until smooth.
Put the chicken in the slow cooker.
Pour the sauce over, cover, and cook 4–6 hours on HIGH or 6–8 hours on LOW.
recipes.title: Slow Cooker Garlic Chipotle Lime Chicken

ingredients.item: fresh herbs, minced (rosemary, sage, thyme, parsley)

recipes.notes: From the 40 Aprons roundup Whole30 Slow Cooker Recipes. Calories and protein are the site's figures; serving weight is an estimate.
steps: Put the cauliflower in the slow cooker, top with the garlic and broth, and add water to cover.
Cook on LOW 6 hours or HIGH 3 hours. Drain and return the cauliflower to the slow cooker.
Add the ghee and mash with an immersion blender.
Season with salt, stir in the herbs, and keep warm until serving.
recipes.title: Slow Cooker Garlic Herb Cauliflower Mash

recipes.notes: From the Beauty and the Foodie roundup Low Carb Slow Cooker Meals. Calories and protein are the site's figures; serving weight is an estimate including bone.
steps: Put the broth, celery, onion, peppers, garlic, bay leaves, salt and pepper in the slow cooker on LOW.
Mix the thyme, paprika and cayenne and season the chicken with it plus salt and pepper.
Sear the chicken skin-side down in a hot skillet without crowding, turning until well browned, and add to the slow cooker.
Brown the andouille in the same pan and add it.
Stir-fry the okra in the chicken fat about 2 minutes and add it.
Stir and level everything in the slow cooker.
Cover and cook on LOW 8 hours.
Season the broth, then push the shrimp under the liquid and let sit 8–10 minutes until cooked.
Serve over cauliflower rice.
recipes.title: Slow Cooker Gumbo-esque Stew

ingredients.item: beef stew meat or chuck, 1–1 1/2 inch chunks

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Soup. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Season the beef and brown it in the oil over medium-high, 4–5 minutes per side, in batches.
Put the beef and drippings in the slow cooker or Instant Pot with the onion, garlic, potatoes, carrots, broths, soy sauce, tomato paste, thyme and bay leaf.
Slow cook on low 6–7 hours or high 3–4, or pressure cook 35 minutes with a 10-minute natural release.
Stir in the cornstarch slurry and cook on high 30 minutes to thicken.
Stir in the peas and garnish with parsley.
To freeze: split the browned beef and other ingredients (not the peas, thickener or parsley) between two freezer bags. Thaw overnight and slow cook on low 7–8 hours or high 4–5.
recipes.title: Slow Cooker Homemade Beef Stew (Freezer Meal)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Two thighs per serving. Calories, protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Mix the soy sauce, honey, ketchup, garlic, basil, oregano, pepper flakes and pepper.
Put the chicken, potatoes, carrots and sauce in a 6-quart slow cooker. Cook on Low 7–8 hours or High 3–4, basting every hour. Add the green beans for the last 30 minutes.
Broil the thighs skin side up on a sheet 3–4 minutes until crisp.
Serve with the vegetables and parsley.
recipes.title: Slow Cooker Honey Garlic Chicken and Veggies

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Slow Cooker. Calories and protein are the site's figures; serving weight is an estimate.
steps: Spray the slow cooker with nonstick spray and lay the chicken in the bottom.
Whisk the broth, honey, Sriracha and garlic paste.
Pour over the chicken, cover, and cook on LOW 5–6 hours or HIGH 2–4 hours until it shreds easily.
Remove and shred the chicken. Whisk the cornstarch into the sauce in the slow cooker until smooth.
Return the chicken to the sauce, toss to coat and serve.
recipes.title: Slow Cooker Honey Sriracha Chicken

recipes.notes: From the Meal Prep on Fleek roundup 31 Slow Cooker Meal Prep Recipes. Calories and protein are the site's figures; serving weight is an estimate.
steps: Sear the pork on all sides in hot olive oil in a skillet over high heat.
Stir the remaining carnitas ingredients together for the marinade.
Put the pork and marinade in the slow cooker and cook on LOW 3–4 hours.
Shred the tender pork with two forks and return it to the juices.
Pulse the cauliflower in a food processor until it looks like rice; don't overprocess.
Cook the cauliflower quickly in a hot pan with the oil, cumin, lime juice and salt, stirring, a few minutes until just softened.
Pack into meal prep containers with the pork and toppings in separate sections, or serve right away.
recipes.title: Slow Cooker Keto Pork Carnitas Bowls

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Asian. The site lists 240 kcal and 24 g protein, which is low for 3 chicken breasts over 4 servings, so calories, protein and weight are my estimates.
steps: Brown the chicken in a little oil over medium 2–3 minutes and move to a greased slow cooker.
Whisk the sauce ingredients, pour over, and cook on High 3–4 hours or Low 5–6.
10–15 minutes before serving, sauté the pepper, zucchini and garlic in a little oil 2–3 minutes and add to the cooker.
Stir in the cornstarch mixed with the cold water and let thicken 5–10 minutes. Serve over rice with peanuts and green onions.
recipes.title: Slow Cooker Kung Pao Chicken (with Zucchini)

ingredients.item: rice or buttered egg noodles, for serving

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Slow Cooker. Calories, protein and weight are estimates, not counting rice or noodles.
steps: Spray the slow cooker with nonstick spray.
Put the chicken in the slow cooker.
Add all the remaining ingredients and cover.
Cook on LOW 6–8 hours.
Serve over rice or buttered egg noodles.
recipes.title: Slow Cooker Lemon Garlic Chicken

recipes.notes: From the Meal Prep on Fleek roundup 31 Slow Cooker Meal Prep Recipes. Calories and protein are the site's figures; serving weight is an estimate of carved meat.
steps: Pat the chicken very dry inside and out. Rub the outside with oil and season inside and out with salt and pepper.
Stuff the cavity with the garlic, half the lemon slices and the thyme.
Set a rack (or balls of foil) in the slow cooker, lay a few lemon slices on it, and put the chicken on top. Cover with the remaining lemon slices.
Cover and cook on LOW 5–6 hours or HIGH 3 hours.
Optional: broil on a lined pan about 5 minutes to brown the skin (carve first for more even crisping).
Carve and serve with vegetables and your favorite sauce.
recipes.title: Slow Cooker Lemon Garlic Whole Chicken

recipes.notes: From the MyFitnessPal roundup 15 Slow Cooker Recipes Under 375 Calories. Calories and protein are the site's figures; serving weight is an estimate including the salad.
steps: Season the chicken with the salt, pepper, garlic and oregano. Arrange in one layer in the slow cooker and pour the lemon juice and broth over. Cook on HIGH 3–4 hours or LOW 6–7 hours, until tender and 165°F.
Meanwhile, toss the tomatoes, cucumbers, onion and 2 tbsp feta. Whisk the olive oil and vinegar, drizzle over and toss. Refrigerate.
Divide the salad among 4 plates, add a chicken thigh to each, and top each thigh with 1 tbsp feta.
recipes.title: Slow Cooker Lemon Greek Chicken

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Calories, protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Mix the oregano, seasoned salt and pepper and rub over the chicken.
Brown the chicken in the oil in a nonstick skillet over medium, about 3 minutes per side, and move to the slow cooker.
Add the water, lemon juice, garlic and stock to the skillet, bring to a gentle boil, and pour over the chicken.
Cook on Low 4–5 hours. Add the parsley, baste, and cook on High 15–30 minutes more if needed.
recipes.title: Slow Cooker Lemon-Garlic Chicken (Diabetic-Friendly)

ingredients.item: toppings: shredded cheese, Greek yogurt or sour cream, avocado, green onion, cilantro

recipes.notes: From the Meal Prep on Fleek roundup 31 Slow Cooker Meal Prep Recipes. Calories, protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Put everything in the slow cooker. Cook on LOW 8 hours or HIGH 4 hours.
Serve with your favorite toppings.
recipes.title: Slow Cooker Lentil and Quinoa Chili

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Sides. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Simmer the potatoes in water 10–15 minutes until tender and drain.
Mash with the cream cheese, sour cream, butter and milk until smooth.
Stir in the bacon, cheeses, green onions and seasonings, cover, and refrigerate overnight (right in the slow cooker crock saves a dish).
Cook in a greased 3–4 quart slow cooker on Low 3–3 1/2 hours, stirring every 45–60 minutes.
recipes.title: Slow Cooker Loaded Mashed Potatoes (Make-Ahead)

recipes.notes: From the Beauty and the Foodie roundup Low Carb Slow Cooker Meals. Ditch the Carbs is now Thinlicious and the page is gone, so this came from an archived copy. Calories and protein are the site's figures; serving weight is an estimate.
steps: Mix the coconut cream and all the spices in the slow cooker.
Add the onion and beef and stir.
Cook on LOW 8–10 hours or HIGH 4–6 hours.
Fold in the greens 5 minutes before serving.
recipes.title: Slow Cooker Malaysian Beef Curry

ingredients.item: Yukon Gold or red potatoes, 1-inch pieces (peeled if you like)
plain Greek yogurt or sour cream
optional add-ins: bacon, cheddar, blue cheese, green onions or chives

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Avoid russets; they turn grayish. Serves 6–8. Calories, protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Put the potatoes and stock in the slow cooker and top with the butter and garlic. Cook on High 3–4 hours until soft.
Mash, then stir in the yogurt, salt and pepper and enough warm milk to get the creaminess you like. Add any extras.
recipes.title: Slow Cooker Mashed Potatoes

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Calories and protein are the site's figures, including the vegetables; weight is an estimate.
steps: Beat the eggs, mix in the milk, breadcrumbs, salt, onion and sage, then the meat.
Shape a loaf in the middle of the slow cooker and surround it with the potatoes and carrots.
Cook on Low 5–6 hours.
Mix the glaze, spread it over the meatloaf, and cook 30 minutes on High.
recipes.title: Slow Cooker Meatloaf with Potatoes and Carrots

recipes.notes: From the MyFitnessPal roundup 15 Slow Cooker Recipes Under 375 Calories. Calories and protein are the site's figures; serving weight is an estimate for a large bowl.
steps: Combine the broth, tomatoes, beans, carrots, celery, onion, Italian seasoning, bay leaves, 1/8 tsp salt and the pepper in the slow cooker. Cook on LOW 6–8 hours or HIGH 3–4 hours.
30 minutes before serving, add the water and stir in the pasta, zucchini and spinach. Cover and keep cooking.
Remove the bay leaves, season with salt and pepper, and serve sprinkled with Parmesan and basil.
recipes.title: Slow Cooker Minestrone

recipes.notes: From the MyFitnessPal roundup 15 Slow Cooker Recipes Under 375 Calories (pinned on Jessica Lynn's Slow Cooker board). Calories and protein are the site's figures; serving weight is an estimate.
steps: Whisk the apple juice, soy milk, cinnamon and allspice in the slow cooker. Stir in the oats and millet.
Cover and cook on LOW 7 hours, until thick.
Stir well to redistribute the grains, top with the berries and serve warm.
recipes.title: Slow Cooker Oat Porridge with Berries

ingredients.item: boneless beef chuck roast, cut into 1" cubes

recipes.notes: From the Meal Prep on Fleek roundup 31 Slow Cooker Meal Prep Recipes. The browser wasn't allowed to open this page, so only the link is saved. Open it, copy the recipe, and use Add details to paste it in.
steps: Cut beef into 1-inch pieces and season with salt and pepper, then place in the slow cooker.
In a small bowl whisk tomato paste into the beef broth, then pour over the beef along with the wine.
Add carrots, onion and mushrooms along with garlic and remaining seasonings.
Give the ingredients a good stir, cover and cook on low 4-6 hours or on high 2-3 hours, until the meat is cooked through and the veggies are tender.
Remove bay leaves before serving and garnish with fresh parsley if desired.
recipes.title: Slow Cooker Paleo Beef Stew

ingredients.item: shredded or finely minced white onion

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner (originally from Following in My Shoes). That domain now shows spam, so the link has been removed; this came from a 2018 web archive copy. Calories, protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Shred the carrots and zucchini, mince the onion, and wring them dry in a towel.
Mix the vegetables with the beef, prosciutto, garlic and seasonings.
Stir the sauce ingredients together in the bottom of the slow cooker.
Core the peppers (keep them as tall as you can) and pack them tightly with the filling.
Stand them in the center of the cooker, away from the sides, and cook on Low 3–4 hours to 155–160°F inside.
Move to a baking dish, top with mozzarella if you like, and broil 2–3 minutes. Serve with the sauce from the cooker.
recipes.title: Slow Cooker Paleo Italian Stuffed Peppers

ingredients.item: toppings: sugar-free kimchi, sesame seeds, bean sprouts, green onion, red cabbage

recipes.notes: From the 40 Aprons roundup Whole30 Slow Cooker Recipes. Calories and protein are the site's figures; serving weight is an estimate with cauliflower rice and egg.
steps: Heat both oils in a large pan over high heat and brown the beef on all sides. Move to a 7-quart slow cooker.
Stir in 4 tsp tapioca starch to coat the beef, then add the carrots, broth, apple juice, coconut aminos, garlic, ginger, chili paste and pepper.
Cover and cook on LOW 6 hours.
Stir the rice vinegar and apple juice together, add the cucumber slices, cover and refrigerate.

After 6 hours, whisk the remaining 4 tsp tapioca starch with 8 tsp of the hot cooking liquid until smooth, then whisk it into the slow cooker. Add the mushrooms and cook about 2 hours more, until tender.
Boil the eggs 7 minutes, then cover with cold water.
Serve over cauliflower rice topped with the drained cucumbers, kimchi, sesame seeds, green onion, bean sprouts and cabbage, with a sliced egg on top.
recipes.title: Slow Cooker Paleo Korean Beef Stew

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Soup. Calories and protein are the site's figures per 1 cup; weight is an estimate.
steps: Put everything except the coconut milk in the slow cooker and stir.
Cook 5 hours on low or 3 on high.
Blend until smooth.
Season, stir in the coconut milk, and top with pumpkin seeds, pepper and a sprinkle of sugar.
recipes.title: Slow Cooker Panera Autumn Squash Soup (Copycat)

recipes.notes: From the MyFitnessPal roundup 15 Slow Cooker Recipes Under 375 Calories. Calories and protein are the site's figures; serving weight is an estimate.
steps: In a 6-quart slow cooker, whisk the coconut milk, peanut butter, vinegar, brown sugar, soy sauce, curry paste and lemongrass paste until smooth. Stir in the onion and garlic, add the chicken and stir to coat.
Cook on LOW 3 1/2–4 hours or HIGH 2–2 1/2 hours, until the chicken reaches 165°F.
Slice or shred the chicken. Pour the cooking liquid into a small saucepan, whisk in the cornstarch mixed with 1 tbsp cold water, and simmer over medium heat until thickened, about 2 minutes.
Meanwhile, microwave the broccoli with 2 tbsp water 2–3 minutes until crisp-tender (or steam about 3 minutes). Drain.
Divide the chicken and broccoli among bowls, pour the sauce over and serve.
recipes.title: Slow Cooker Peanut Chicken with Broccoli

recipes.notes: From the Beauty and the Foodie roundup Low Carb Slow Cooker Meals (Low Carbing Among Friends). Calories and protein are the site's figures; serving weight is an estimate.
steps: Brown the beef in bacon fat.
Mix the tomatoes, stock, water, soy sauce, sweetener, liquid smoke and cornstarch.
Put the beef and peppers in the slow cooker, pour the sauce over, and cook on LOW 6–8 hours.
recipes.title: Slow Cooker Pepper Steak

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Calories and protein are the site's figures per 1-cup serving; weight is an estimate.
steps: Put the chicken in the slow cooker and season the tops.
Stir the broth, tomato paste, Italian seasoning, basil and pepper flakes together and pour over.
Add the pepperoni and olives, cover, and cook on High 3 hours or Low 6 until it shreds easily.
Shred in the cooker and let it soak up the liquid about 30 minutes more.
recipes.title: Slow Cooker Pepperoni and Chicken

recipes.notes: From the Beauty and the Foodie roundup Low Carb Slow Cooker Meals. The original site now redirects somewhere unsafe, so this came from an archived copy and the link points to the archive. Calories, protein and weight are estimates (with 1/4 cup gravy).
steps: Mix the salt, pepper and garlic and rub all over the roast.
Put the sliced onions in the slow cooker with the water and coconut aminos.
Set the roast on top and cover.
Cook on LOW 4–6 hours, until cooked through.
Rest the roast before slicing.
Blend the cooking liquid and onions until smooth and serve the gravy over the pork.
recipes.title: Slow Cooker Pork Loin with Onion Gravy

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Slow Cooker. Calories and protein are the site's figures; serving weight is an estimate with vegetables.
steps: Heat a large cast iron pan, add the oil, season the roast with salt and pepper, and sear 4–5 minutes per side.
Move the roast to a 6-quart slow cooker.
Sauté the onion and garlic in the same pan until the onion starts to soften.
Turn off the heat, add the broth, scrape up the browned bits, and stir in the salt and pepper.
Pour the onion mixture over the roast.
Arrange the potatoes and carrots around and on top, tucking in the herb sprigs.
Cover and cook on LOW 7–9 hours (about 8 for fall-apart tender).
Discard the herb sprigs and serve the roast with the vegetables. Use the juices for gravy if you like.
recipes.title: Slow Cooker Pork Roast

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Anti-Inflammatory. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Sear the seasoned roast in the oil over medium 2–3 minutes per side and put it in the slow cooker.
Sauté the onion and garlic 3–4 minutes and add them.
Add the parsnips, carrots, herbs, bay leaves, broth, coconut aminos and vinegar. Cook on low 7 hours.
Whisk the arrowroot with about 1 tbsp water, stir it in, and cook 1 hour more.
Remove the bay leaves. Serve the shredded beef with the vegetables and broth, topped with parsley.
recipes.title: Slow Cooker Pot Roast with Carrots and Parsnips (Paleo, AIP)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Sides. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Spray the slow cooker, add the potatoes, cover, and cook 2–3 hours on High or 5–6 on Low.
Add the sour cream, milk, garlic, salt and pepper and beat with a hand mixer. Season and serve plain or with gravy, cheese or bacon.
recipes.title: Slow Cooker Red Skin Mashed Potatoes

ingredients.item: Bartlett pear, peeled, cored and chopped

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Soup. Calories, protein, weight and servings are estimates.
steps: Preheat the oven to 350°F. Cut the pumpkin into quarters (save the seeds), coat the insides with ghee, and bake shell side down in a pan with 1/2 cup water 20–25 minutes.
Cool, scoop the flesh from the shell, and mash.
Put 4 cups pumpkin and everything else in the slow cooker and cook on low 5–6 hours.
Purée and garnish with pepitas.
recipes.title: Slow Cooker Roasted Pumpkin Coconut Soup (Paleo)

recipes.notes: From the Meal Prep on Fleek roundup 31 Slow Cooker Meal Prep Recipes. The site lists 130 kcal per serving, which seems low with the peas and avocado, so calories, protein and weight are my estimates.
steps: Put the chicken, salsa and black-eyed peas in the slow cooker.
Cook on HIGH 4 hours.
Shred the chicken.
Serve with fresh diced avocado, and corn tortillas if you like.
recipes.title: Slow Cooker Salsa Chicken with Black-Eyed Peas

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Slow Cooker (Hamilton Beach test kitchen recipe). Serves 8–10. Calories, protein and weight are estimates, not counting rolls or pasta.
steps: Stir the tomato puree, garlic, sugar, oregano, salt, black pepper and crushed red pepper together.
Add the sauce, sausage, peppers and onion to the slow cooker and stir to coat.
Cover and cook on HIGH 3–4 hours or LOW 7–8 hours.
Stir in the basil. Serve on sub rolls or over pasta.
recipes.title: Slow Cooker Sausage, Peppers & Onions

ingredients.item: Great Northern beans, drained and rinsed

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Soup. Calories, protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Brown the sausage in the oil in a large skillet over medium-high, 3–4 minutes.
Put the sausage, garlic, onion, carrots, celery, beans, oregano and bay leaves in a 6-quart slow cooker and season.
Add the broth and 2 cups water. Cook on low 7–8 hours or high 3–4.
Stir in the spinach until wilted and serve topped with Parmesan.
recipes.title: Slow Cooker Sausage, Spinach and White Bean Soup

ingredients.item: boneless skinless chicken thighs or breasts
unsweetened or sugar-free apricot or peach jam

recipes.notes: From the Beauty and the Foodie roundup Low Carb Slow Cooker Meals (pinned on Jessica Lynn's Slow Cooker board). Calories and protein are the site's figures; serving weight is an estimate.
steps: In a 5–6 quart slow cooker, combine the tomato purée, jam, broth, coconut aminos, sesame oil, sweetener, ginger, red pepper flakes, garlic and onion.
Stir to mix.
Add the chicken and toss to coat.
Scatter the bell pepper over the chicken.
Cover and cook on HIGH 4+ hours or LOW 5 1/2–6 hours.
Sprinkle with scallions and sesame seeds before serving.
recipes.title: Slow Cooker Sesame Ginger Chicken

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Put the chicken in a lightly greased slow cooker.
Mix the wing sauce and ranch seasoning and pour over. Cook on Low 6–8 hours.
Shred in the cooker and stir in the butter until melted.
Melt a cheese slice on each bun top under the broiler 1–2 minutes.
Pile on the chicken and top with dressing.
recipes.title: Slow Cooker Shredded Buffalo Chicken Sandwiches

ingredients.item: steak, cut into strips against the grain
gluten-free bake mix (or almond and coconut flour)

recipes.notes: From the Beauty and the Foodie roundup Low Carb Slow Cooker Meals (Low Carbing Among Friends). Calories and protein are the site's figures; serving weight is an estimate.
steps: Toss the steak strips with the bake mix in a large bowl and put them in the bottom of the slow cooker.
Mix the tomatoes, stock, salt, soy sauce, molasses, pepper, green peppers and onion and pour over the steak. Cook on LOW 8–10 hours.
Serve over mashed cauliflower if you like.
recipes.title: Slow Cooker Smothered Steak Strips

ingredients.item: chili beans in mild chili sauce, undrained
frozen tri-color pepper and onion blend
optional: sour cream, guacamole or avocado, lime, cilantro

recipes.notes: From the Meal Prep on Fleek roundup 31 Slow Cooker Meal Prep Recipes. The live site blocks automated reading, so this came from an archived copy. Calories and protein are the site's figures; serving weight is an estimate.
steps: Spray the slow cooker generously. Rinse the quinoa. Seed and finely mince the jalapeño if using.
Add the chili beans and tomatoes, then the black beans, corn, quinoa, garlic, stock, jalapeño, frozen peppers and onions, fajita seasoning, cumin and chili powder. Stir and cover.
Cook on HIGH 2 1/2–4 hours (about 3 1/2 in most cookers), until the quinoa has popped and most of the liquid is absorbed. Don't overcook. Stir gently and let stand uncovered 5–10 minutes.
Sprinkle with cheese to melt, adjust the seasoning, and serve with sour cream, avocado, cilantro and lime.
recipes.title: Slow Cooker Southwestern Fajita Quinoa

ingredients.item: gluten-free chicken meatballs (such as Al Fresco)

recipes.notes: From the Meal Prep on Fleek roundup 31 Slow Cooker Meal Prep Recipes. The live site blocks automated reading, so this came from an archived copy. Calories and protein are the site's figures; serving weight is an estimate.
steps: Halve the squash crosswise and set it cut-side down in a 6-quart slow cooker.
Purée the tomatoes, salt, garlic powder, pepper and oregano and pour into the slow cooker.
Arrange the meatballs in the sauce around the squash. Cook on LOW 6–7 hours or HIGH 3–4 hours.
Lift out the squash with tongs and gloves, discard the seeds, scoop the strands into a sieve and drain a few minutes. Toss with the butter or oil.
Divide among 4 plates and top with sauce and meatballs.
recipes.title: Slow Cooker Spaghetti Squash and Meatballs

ingredients.item: cream cheese, reduced-fat but not fat-free
artichoke hearts, can, preservative-free or 6-8 artichoke hearts from a jar, drained and chopped
grape tomatoes or cherry tomatoes, chopped

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Slow Cooker. The site blocks automated reading, so only the link is saved. Open it, copy the recipe, and use Add details to paste it in.
steps: Place spinach, chicken broth, and chicken breasts in a 4-quart slow cooker.
Sprinkle with garlic, onion, and salt and pepper.
Cover and cook on low for 6-8 hours, or on high for 4-6 hours.
Just before serving, gently remove the chicken breasts from the slow cooker and place on serving platters.
Stir in the cream cheese, parmesan cheese, and artichokes until creamy.
Spoon the sauce over the chicken.
Top with tomatoes and sprinkle with extra parmesan cheese, if desired.
recipes.title: Slow Cooker Spinach Artichoke Chicken

ingredients.item: ground chipotle or ancho chili powder

recipes.notes: From the 40 Aprons roundup Whole30 Slow Cooker Recipes. Nutrition is the site's figure for 1 cup.
steps: Brown the beef in a large skillet over medium heat and drain the fat.
Move the beef to the slow cooker and add everything else.
Stir, cover, and cook on HIGH 4 hours or LOW 6–8 hours, until the sweet potatoes are tender. Adjust the seasoning.
Serve with your favorite toppings.
recipes.title: Slow Cooker Sweet Potato Chili

ingredients.item: hot cooked jasmine or basmati rice

recipes.notes: From the MyFitnessPal roundup 15 Slow Cooker Recipes Under 375 Calories. Calories and protein are the site's figures (with rice); serving weight is an estimate.
steps: Combine the onion, bell pepper, sweet potatoes, garlic and ginger in a 4-quart slow cooker.

Stir the broth, coconut milk, curry powder and salt together and pour over the vegetables. Cook on HIGH 4 hours or LOW 8 hours, until the sweet potatoes are tender. Stir in the basil, lime zest, lime juice and chickpeas.
Serve over rice, topped with 1 tbsp yogurt each and more basil if you like.
recipes.title: Slow Cooker Sweet Potato Curry

ingredients.item: optional: sliced scallions, toasted sesame seeds

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Asian. Makes about 4 cups shredded chicken. Calories, protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Lay the chicken in the slow cooker.
Whisk the garlic, onion, honey, soy sauce, vinegar, ginger and pepper and pour over. Cook on High 4–5 hours until cooked through.
Move the chicken out and shred it. Pour the sauce into a saucepan, whisk in the cornstarch mixed with the cold water, and boil until thick.
Toss the chicken with the sauce and top with scallions and sesame seeds.
recipes.title: Slow Cooker Teriyaki Chicken

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Spray the slow cooker and stir in the uncooked macaroni, cheeses, evaporated milk and milk until the pasta is nearly covered.
Cover and cook on Low 1 1/2 hours until the cheese is melted and the pasta is cooked.
Stir in the mustard, salt, pepper and cayenne until everything is coated.
recipes.title: Slow Cooker Three Cheese Macaroni and Cheese

recipes.notes: From the Delish roundup 12 Slow-Cooker Flat Belly Foods. Servings, calories, protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Put the turkey and marinara in the slow cooker and break the turkey up with a spoon. Stir in the garlic powder and oregano and cook on LOW 3 hours.
Spiralize the zucchini and pat dry. Toss into the sauce and cook on LOW 30 minutes more. Season with salt and pepper.
recipes.title: Slow Cooker Turkey Bolognese & Zucchini Noodles

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Slow Cooker. Nutrition is the site's figure for an 8 oz serving.
steps: Pat the turkey dry and rub the spices all over both sides, adding more if needed.
Pour the broth into the slow cooker, add the onions, set the turkey on top and put the butter on it.
Cook on LOW 3–4 hours, until it reaches at least 165°F.
Carefully lift out the turkey; it will be very tender.
For crispy skin, air-fry 3–4 minutes at 400°F or broil 3–5 minutes.
Rest 20 minutes before slicing.
recipes.title: Slow Cooker Turkey Breast

ingredients.item: turkey sausage, ground or out of casing

recipes.notes: From the Meal Prep on Fleek roundup 31 Slow Cooker Meal Prep Recipes. The site also gives an Instant Pot method. Calories, protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Heat the broiler.
Mix the ground turkey and sausage well in a large bowl.
Mix the herbs, onion and garlic powders, salt and almond meal, add to the meat, and mix by hand. Add the egg and mix well.
Shape into large meatballs, about 1 1/2–2 inches.
Broil on a sheet pan just 2–3 minutes so they hold together.
Put the meatballs in the slow cooker and top with the tomatoes, onion, garlic, salt and vinegar.
Cook on LOW 5–6 hours.
Serve with fresh basil, or over spaghetti squash or zucchini noodles.
recipes.title: Slow Cooker Turkey Meatballs in Marinara

ingredients.item: full-fat canned coconut milk (or heavy cream)

recipes.notes: From the Meal Prep on Fleek roundup 31 Slow Cooker Meal Prep Recipes (pinned on Jessica Lynn's Slow Cooker board). Calories and protein are the site's figures; serving weight is an estimate.
steps: Mix the spices into the ground pork and brown it in a skillet, with a little oil if needed.
Put the pork, garlic, potatoes, onion and 4 cups chicken stock in the slow cooker.
Cook on HIGH 3–4 hours (LOW 5–6) until the potatoes are soft.
Stir in the coconut milk (or cream) and kale.
Cook on HIGH 30 minutes more, until the broth thickens slightly; mash a few potatoes to thicken more.
Season with salt and pepper.
Top with bacon (and Parmesan if using) just before serving.
recipes.title: Slow Cooker Zuppa Toscana (Noshtastic)

ingredients.item: baby red potatoes, halved (quartered if large)

recipes.notes: From the Delish roundup 12 Slow-Cooker Flat Belly Foods (pinned on Jessica Lynn's Slow Cooker board), read from an archived copy. Delish lists nutrition for the whole recipe; the per-serving numbers here divide it by 4. Serving weight is an estimate.
steps: Spread the Brussels sprouts and potatoes in the slow cooker and lay the chicken on top.
Whisk the vinegar, broth, brown sugar, mustard, thyme, rosemary, oregano and red pepper flakes, and season generously with salt and pepper.
Pour over the chicken and vegetables and scatter the garlic on top.
Cover and cook on HIGH until the chicken is fall-apart tender, 4 1/2–5 hours.
Garnish with parsley and serve with the juices.
recipes.title: Slow-Cooker Balsamic Chicken

ingredients.item: maple syrup, plus more for serving

recipes.notes: From the Delish roundup 12 Slow-Cooker Flat Belly Foods, read from an archived copy. Serves 8–10. Calories, protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Butter the inside of the slow cooker.
Add everything except the blueberries and coconut. Cook on HIGH 4 hours or LOW 8 hours, stirring occasionally.
For the last 10 minutes, switch to WARM and gently stir in the blueberries and coconut.
Serve topped with maple syrup.
recipes.title: Slow-Cooker Blueberry Oatmeal

recipes.notes: From the Delish roundup 12 Slow-Cooker Flat Belly Foods, read from an archived copy. Calories, protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Lay the eggplant on a paper towel-lined sheet, salt each piece, let sit 30 minutes and pat dry.
Spread about a third of the sauce in the slow cooker. Whisk the eggs in one bowl; mix the panko, garlic powder, Italian seasoning, salt and pepper in another.
Dip each slice in egg, then crumbs. Layer slices in the slow cooker and top with sauce and mozzarella. Repeat 2 more times. Cook on HIGH 4–5 hours.
Sprinkle with Parmesan and garnish with basil.
recipes.title: Slow-Cooker Eggplant Parmesan (Delish)

recipes.notes: From the Delish roundup 12 Slow-Cooker Flat Belly Foods, read from an archived copy. Delish lists nutrition for the whole recipe; the per-serving numbers divide it by 4. Serving weight is an estimate.
steps: Sear the chicken in a large skillet over high heat until golden, 2 minutes per side. Season and put in the slow cooker.
Add the onions, garlic, carrots, sugar, zest and juice of 1 lemon, thyme and broth; season. Cover and cook on LOW 6–7 hours or HIGH 3–4 hours.
Add the peas and cover 2–3 minutes until warm. Add the remaining lemon zest and juice and serve.
recipes.title: Slow-Cooker Lemon-Garlic Chicken (Delish)

recipes.notes: From the Delish roundup 12 Slow-Cooker Flat Belly Foods, read from an archived copy. Delish lists nutrition for the whole recipe; the per-serving numbers divide it by 6. Serving weight is an estimate.
steps: Combine the chicken, quinoa, 1 1/2 cups broth, garlic and carrots in the slow cooker and season generously.
Cook on HIGH 4 hours, until the chicken shreds easily. Shred it, add the asparagus and peas, and cook 30 minutes more until tender.
Pour in the remaining 1/2 cup broth and stir until creamy.
recipes.title: Slow-Cooker Quinoa Risotto with Chicken, Carrots and Asparagus

ingredients.item: shredded cheddar and sliced green onions, for garnish

recipes.notes: From the Delish roundup 12 Slow-Cooker Flat Belly Foods, read from an archived copy. Calories and protein are the site's figures; serving weight is an estimate.
steps: Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the onion and pepper until starting to soften, about 4 minutes. Add the turkey and cook until golden (it needn't be cooked through). Season, stir in the garlic and tomato paste, cook 2 minutes, and move to the slow cooker.
Add the tomatoes, beans, broth, chili powder, cumin and oregano. Cook on HIGH 4 hours, until thickened. Season to taste.
Garnish with cheese and green onion.
recipes.title: Slow-Cooker Turkey Chili (Delish)

ingredients.item: refrigerated chocolate chip cookie dough (or homemade)
brownie mix, plus what the box calls for

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Calories and protein are my estimates from the ingredients.
steps: Grease a 9x13 dish and press the cookie dough evenly over the bottom.
Cover with a layer of whole Oreos.
Mix the brownie batter per the box and pour over the Oreos.
Bake per the brownie box directions, checking with a toothpick (they can be a bit gooey). Best served warm.
recipes.title: Slutty Brownies (Cookie Dough, Oreo, Brownie)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Apps. The site lists 109 kcal, which is low for this much cream cheese and cheese over 10 servings, so calories, protein and weight are my estimates.
steps: Preheat a pellet smoker to 300°F.
Stir the chicken, cream cheese, sour cream, buffalo sauce, cheddar and ranch seasoning together.
Spread in a cast iron skillet and top with the mozzarella.
Smoke about 1 hour.
Top with green onions and serve hot with dippers (hold it in a slow cooker on Warm for a party).
recipes.title: Smoked Buffalo Chicken Dip

ingredients.item: russet potatoes, peeled, sliced 1/4 inch or thinner

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Calories, protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Preheat the oven to 350°F and spray a 13x9 dish.
Whisk the soup and milk smooth and set aside 1 cup.
Layer 1/4 of the soup mixture, a layer of potatoes and seasoning, and repeat to 3 layers topped with soup. Cover tightly with foil and bake 30 minutes.
Meanwhile cook the bacon in 1/2-inch pieces until crisp; set aside. Season the chicken and sear it in the drippings (not cooked through).
Uncover, lay the chicken on the potatoes, pour over the reserved soup, re-cover, and bake 30 minutes more.
Uncover, top with the cheese and bacon, and bake 5 minutes until bubbly.
recipes.title: Smothered Chicken Casserole with Cheesy Potatoes & Bacon

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. The live recipe card didn't load, so this comes from a 2021 web archive copy. Calories and protein are my estimates from the ingredients.
steps: Preheat oven to 350F degrees.
Line (2) muffin tins with 24 cupcake liners.
Set aside.
In a medium bowl, mix flour, baking powder, 1 teaspoon cinnamon, and salt.
Set aside.
In large bowl, beat shortening with electric mixer on medium speed for 30 seconds.
Gradually add sugar.
Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition.
Beat in vanilla extract.
Slowly add flour mixture, and milk and mixing until just combined.
DO NOT OVERMIX!
Pour the cupcake batter into the cupcake liners (about 3/4 the way full).
Bake 18 to 20 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean.
Allow cupcakes to cool before frosting.
To make the frosting:Mix softened butter on medium speed with an electric or stand mixer.
Beat for 30 seconds until smooth and creamy.
Add powdered sugar, heavy whipping cream and vanilla extract.
Increase to high-speed and beat for 3 minutes.
Add more cream if needed for spreading consistency.
Mix in ground cinnamon.
Frost cupcakes using a piping bag or knife.
Sprinkle top of cupcakes with cinnamon-sugar.
recipes.title: Snickerdoodle Cupcakes with Cinnamon Frosting

ingredients.item: blanched almond slices, ground, or almond flour

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Weigh the ingredients; the blogger says it matters. The archived page cuts off before the bake time and buttercream steps, so those are the usual macaron method. Calories and protein are my estimates from the ingredients.
steps: If using almond slices, grind with the powdered sugar in a food processor about 3 minutes (stop before it turns to butter).
Sift the almond flour and powdered sugar into a large bowl, regrinding any pieces that won't pass.
Whip the egg whites, sugar and salt in a stand mixer: 3 minutes on medium, 3 on medium-high, 3 on high, then 1 on the highest speed, until the meringue clings to the whisk.
Fold in the dry ingredients with a fold-and-smash motion until the batter is lava-like and a dropped spoonful reincorporates in about 20 seconds.
Pipe even circles onto parchment-lined sheets with a 1/2-inch round tip, holding the bag straight up.
Rap the sheets hard on the counter, let rest until a skin forms, and bake at about 300°F until the shells lift cleanly. Cool completely.
Beat the butter, confectioners' sugar, cream, vanilla, salt and cinnamon into a fluffy buttercream, sandwich the shells, and dust with cinnamon.
recipes.title: Snickerdoodle Macarons

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Sides. Calories and weight are estimates per 2 tbsp.
steps: Slice the peppers into rings (remove the seeds if you prefer) and pack into 2 pint jars with the garlic.
Boil both vinegars with the sugar, celery seed and mustard seed, stirring until the sugar dissolves.
Pour the brine over the peppers, leaving 1/2 inch headspace. Wipe the rims and close.
Cool, then refrigerate a week before eating.
To can instead: process in a boiling water bath 10 minutes up to 1,000 ft (15 min to 6,000 ft, 20 min above), cool 12–24 hours, and check the seals.
recipes.title: So Easy Pickled Banana Peppers (Sweet Brine)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Calories and protein are the site's figures.
steps: Preheat the oven to 350°F and line baking sheets.
Stir the butter, oil, pumpkin, sugars, vanilla and eggs until smooth, then slowly mix in the dry ingredients just until combined (chill 10–15 minutes if sticky).
Scoop 1 1/2-tablespoon portions and flatten to 1/2 inch with a sugared glass.
Bake 8–9 minutes until set. Rest a few minutes, then move to a rack.
Whisk the glaze and spread about 1 1/2 teaspoons on each warm cookie. Let set a few hours.
recipes.title: Soft Glazed Pumpkin Sugar Cookies

ingredients.item: miniature peanut butter cups cut into forths (approximately 15 cups)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. The live recipe card didn't load, so this comes from a 2021 web archive copy. Calories and protein are the site's figures per serving (1 serving).
steps: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F.
In large bowl of an electric mixer, cream butter and peanut butter.
Add granulated sugar and brown sugar and beat until creamy.
Add eggs and vanilla and combine.
In another bowl, combine oats, flour, baking powder, baking soda, and salt.
Slowly add flour mixture to butter mixture and beat until combined.
Stir in M&Ms and peanut butter cups by hand.
I used a 2 tablespoon spring release scoop to scoop the cookie dough onto an ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake at 350 degrees 13 to 14 minutes until edges are crispy and center is set but still soft.
Cool for 2 minutes on cookie sheet, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely.
Store in an airtight container for 3 days.
recipes.title: Soft Peanut Butter Oatmeal Cookie Recipe

ingredients.item: canned pumpkin puree (blotted dry with paper towels)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Calories and protein are the site's figures per serving (1 cookie).
steps: Preheat oven to 350 F degrees. Line a large cookie sheet with parchment paper.

In a large bowl with an electric mixer, or bowl of a stand mixer with the paddle attachment, beat butter on medium-high speed for 1 minute. Add sugar, baking powder, baking soda, salt, cinnamon, and pumpkin pie spice and beat until well combined, scraping down the sides of the bowl as needed.

Add the egg and vanilla then beat well, until no yellow streaks remain. Add the pumpkin pure and beat again until incorporated. With the mixer running on low, add the flour turn up to medium speed until completely incorporated. The dough will be slightly wet.

Use a heaping tablespoon or medium cookie scoop to drop the cookie dough balls a few inches apart on prepared cookie sheet. Bake for 10 to 12 minutes or until tops are set and no longer look wet. Allow to cool on cookie sheet for a few minutes then transfer to wire rack to cool completely.

To make the frosting, beat together the softened butter and cream cheese in a large bowl until smooth and all of the lumps are gone. Sift in the powdered sugar then add the vanilla. Beat until smooth and creamy, about 2 minutes. Frost cooled cookies with cream cheese frosting.
recipes.title: Soft Pumpkin Cookies

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Calories and protein are my estimates from the ingredients.
steps: Stir together the flour, baking soda, baking powder, cinnamon, nutmeg and salt.
Beat the sugar and butter until blended, then the pumpkin, egg and vanilla until smooth. Gradually beat in the flour mixture.
Drop rounded scoops onto lined or greased sheets and bake at 350°F for 15–18 minutes until the edges are firm. Cool completely.
Beat the cream cheese and butter smooth, then the powdered sugar, cinnamon and vanilla until fluffy. Frost the cookies and refrigerate leftovers.
recipes.title: Soft Pumpkin Cookies with Cinnamon Cream Cheese Frosting

ingredients.item: top round sirloin steaks, 3–4 inch pieces

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Calories, protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Season the steak, brown it in batches in the hot oil, and move to the slow cooker.
Add 2 cups water and the bouillon to the hot pan over medium-high.
Shake the remaining 1 cup water with the flour, garlic powder and onion powder in a lidded jar until smooth, and stir into the pan until the gravy thickens.
Pour over the steaks and cook on High 4 hours or Low 6–8 until fork tender.
Serve with mashed potatoes, egg noodles or brown rice.
recipes.title: Southern Slow Steaks

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Mexican. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Mix the salsa ingredients if making your own.
Spray a 9x13 pan. Mix the chicken with 1 cup salsa and the sour cream.
Layer half the chicken mixture, 1 cup crushed chips and 1 cup cheese. Repeat.
Bake at 425°F 12–15 minutes until bubbly.
recipes.title: Southwest Chicken Bake

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Breakfast. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Preheat the oven to 375°F.
Cook the sausage and onion in a large skillet over medium until the sausage is no longer pink. Add the pepper, beans, chiles and half of each spice and mix.
Mix in the cheddar, mozzarella and hash browns.
Whisk the eggs, cream and remaining spices.
Brush a 3-quart (11x8.5x3-inch) dish with the melted butter.
Layer half the sausage mixture, then half the egg; repeat.
Bake uncovered 40–50 minutes until the center is set. Cool about 30 minutes before slicing.
recipes.title: Southwestern Breakfast Casserole

ingredients.item: lemon pepper, garlic powder and salt, to taste

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. The site is gone, so this comes from a 2016 web archive copy. Calories, protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Season the salmon with lemon pepper, garlic powder and salt.
Stir the soy sauce, brown sugar, water and oil until the sugar dissolves.
Marinate the salmon in a zip bag at least 2 hours.
Grill on an oiled grate over medium 6–8 minutes per side until it flakes (discard the marinade), or wrap in foil and bake at 425°F about 15 minutes.
recipes.title: Soy Sauce and Brown Sugar Salmon

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Calories, protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Preheat the oven to 400°F and line a rimmed sheet with parchment.
Trim the ends of the squash, cut into 1-inch rings, and cut out the seeds. Oil and season both sides and roast about 30 minutes until tender. Cool 10 minutes.
Cook the bacon over medium about 2 minutes, then on low about 5 more until crisp.
Turn up to medium and deglaze with the vinegar, then add the maple syrup and wilt in the spinach a handful at a time. Turn off the heat.
Peel the squash rings, pull the strands into the skillet, add the goat cheese, and toss.
recipes.title: Spaghetti Squash with Bacon, Spinach and Goat Cheese

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Budget Meals. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Cook the pasta al dente in well-salted water, saving 1/2 cup of the water before draining.
Melt 1 tbsp butter in a large skillet, cook the pepper flakes and 1 clove garlic 30–60 seconds, then toast the breadcrumbs 1–2 minutes until golden. Set aside and wipe the pan.
Melt 2 tbsp butter and cook the mushrooms and oregano 3–4 minutes until browned. Season and add the rest of the garlic for 1 minute.
Lower the heat, add the last 2 tbsp butter, the pasta and Parmesan, and toss, loosening with pasta water.
Serve topped with the breadcrumbs, parsley and more Parmesan.
recipes.title: Spaghetti with Mushrooms, Oregano, and Garlicky Breadcrumbs

ingredients.item: medium raw shrimp, peeled and deveined
olive oil (plus 2 tbsp for the shrimp)
onion (or 1/4 cup green onion), finely chopped

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Pasta. Calories and protein are the site's figures; serving weight is an estimate.
steps: Pat the shrimp dry, season lightly, and sauté in 2 tbsp oil over medium-high heat just until cooked, about 3 minutes, flipping halfway. Set aside.

Put the tomatoes, onion, chili flakes, basil, garlic and butter in a heavy pan and season. Add the wine and cook over medium-high heat until soft and most of the wine has evaporated (about 1/4 cup liquid left).
Cook the pasta al dente in salted water with 1 tbsp oil, rinse and drain.
Stir the cream into the sauce, add the shrimp and warm gently 2 minutes. Season.
Toss the pasta with the sauce and serve sprinkled with Parmesan.
recipes.title: Spaghetti with Shrimp in a Creamy Tomato Sauce

ingredients.item: boneless cooked beef (e.g. leftover chuck roast), thick slices or cubes
Roma tomatoes, chopped (or 1 1/2 cups canned, no sugar)

recipes.notes: From the Beauty and the Foodie roundup Low Carb Slow Cooker Meals. The author cooks it on the stovetop or in a pressure cooker and gives no slow cooker times. Calories and protein are the site's figures; serving weight is an estimate.
steps: Put the meat and grated carrot in a pot or pressure cooker with water to cover well (about 3 cups).
Bring to a boil, then simmer 45–60 minutes (20 minutes under pressure) until tender.
Add everything else, bring back to a boil and cook about 20 minutes (10 under pressure) until the vegetables are just tender.
Thicken the liquid slightly with your favorite thickener. Serve over mashed cauliflower or zucchini noodles.
recipes.title: Spanish Stewed Beef

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Calories and protein are the site's figures per serving (1 serving).
steps: In a small bowl, stir together flour, baking soda, baking powder, cinnamon, cardamom, ginger, cloves and allspice. Set aside.
In a large mixing bowl, cream together butter and sugar until smooth. Beat in the egg and vanilla. Gradually blend in dry ingredients.
Scoop the dough into about 18-20 1-1/2" inch balls.
In a small bowl, combine the ingredients for the chai spice.
Roll the dough balls in the chai spice and place on an ungreased cookie sheet.
Slightly flatten the top of each cookie with the bottom of a glass that has been dipped in sugar.*
Refrigerate the cookies for at least 1 hour.
Sprinkle the top of the cookies with extra chai spice right before baking.
Bake at 375 degrees for 10 minutes, removing the cookies just before the edges get brown.
Allow the cookies to cool for 5 minutes, then move them to a flat surface to cool.
Store in an airtight container.
recipes.title: Spiced Chai Sugar Cookies

ingredients.item: black aged garlic or fresh garlic, sliced

recipes.notes: From the Beauty and the Foodie roundup Low Carb Slow Cooker Meals. The site's current version is slow-roasted in the oven, not a slow cooker. Calories are the site's figure; protein is worked out from its macro split; serving weight is an estimate.
steps: Preheat the oven to 300°F (fan) or 340°F (conventional).
Put the lamb in a baking dish with the vinegars, garlic and rosemary, season with salt and add the water. Cover and roast about 2 hours (at least 30 minutes per 1.1 lb).
Uncover, baste, raise the oven to 400°F (fan) or 425°F (conventional) and roast 30–45 minutes more, basting once or twice.
Rest a few minutes, shred while warm, and pour the pan juices over.
Serve in lettuce leaves. Keeps 4 days in the fridge.
recipes.title: Spiced Slow-Roasted Leg of Lamb

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Apps. Calories are the site's figure; protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Mash the avocados with the lime juice.
Stir in the sour cream and everything else until combined.
Refrigerate until serving.
recipes.title: Spicy Avocado Bacon Ranch Dip

ingredients.item: cilantro and sesame seeds, to garnish

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Asian. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Whisk the sauce ingredients.
Cook the pasta until just al dente and drain.
Meanwhile cook the onion, broccoli and carrots in the oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium 6–8 minutes until crisp-tender.
Add the pasta and sauce and toss about a minute. Off the heat, toss in the cashews.
Top with cilantro and sesame seeds.
recipes.title: Spicy Broccoli Carrot Noodle Stir-Fry

ingredients.item: cooked short-grain brown rice (1/2 cup uncooked)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Apps. Calories are the site's figure; the site lists 10 g protein, which is low for 2 oz of shrimp each, so protein and weight are my estimates.
steps: Stir the vinegar into the cooked rice and spread it on a sheet pan to cool.
Cut the shrimp into 1-inch pieces. Mix the cucumber with the chives, and the mayo with the sriracha.
In a 1-cup measure, layer 1/4 cup cucumber, 2 tbsp avocado, 1/4 of the shrimp, then 1/3 cup rice.
Turn out onto a plate, sprinkle with furikake, and drizzle with 1 tsp soy sauce and the sriracha mayo. Repeat.
recipes.title: Spicy California Shrimp Stacks

ingredients.item: spicy seasoning: cumin, chili powder, cayenne

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Calories and protein are the site's figures with bun and sauces; weight is an estimate.
steps: Preheat the oven to 400°F. Cook the quinoa with only 1 cup water so it stays light.
Roast the cauliflower florets with 1 tbsp oil and spices 20–30 minutes; cool, then pulse into small sticky pieces (not purée).
Mix with the quinoa, garlic salt, breadcrumbs, cheese, eggs, salt and a little more spice. Form 10 patties.
Pan-fry in an oiled nonstick pan over medium until golden on both sides, flipping carefully.
Toss the cilantro and cabbage with lime juice, a little oil and salt.
Build on buns with green sauce, the burger, slaw and chipotle mayo.
recipes.title: Spicy Cauliflower Quinoa Burgers

recipes.notes: From the Beauty and the Foodie roundup Low Carb Slow Cooker Meals (pinned on Jessica Lynn's Slow Cooker board). Calories and protein are the site's figures; serving weight is an estimate.
steps: Put everything in a 4-quart or larger slow cooker crock.
Marinate in the fridge at least 6 hours or overnight.
Let the crock sit at room temperature 15–20 minutes so it doesn't crack.
Set it in the base and turn on LOW.
Cook on LOW 6–8 hours.
recipes.title: Spicy Crock Pot Chicken Chili Pepper Stew

ingredients.item: green onions and sesame seeds, to top

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Asian. The site lists 505 kcal, which is low for a packet of ramen plus 1/4 cup peanut butter each, so calories, protein and weight are my estimates.
steps: Cook the noodles per the package and set aside.
Heat the sesame oil over medium until it crackles, cook the garlic 1–2 minutes, then the pepper flakes 1 minute.
Lower the heat and whisk in the brown sugar, soy sauce, gochujang and vinegar.
Whisk in the water and peanut butter and simmer, whisking, 2–3 minutes until thick enough to coat the noodles.
Toss in the noodles and top with green onions and sesame seeds.
recipes.title: Spicy Peanut Ramen

ingredients.item: toppings: cucumber, avocado, nori strips, lemon, scallions

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Asian. This was a video pin with no website, so the recipe came from the pin's description and the link goes to the pin. It's one big bowl; calories, protein and weight are estimates with about 1 cup rice and half an avocado. Split it for two lighter bowls.
steps: Cut the salmon into small cubes (a little bigger than for spicy rolls, smaller than poke).
Mix the mayo, sriracha, sesame oil, soy sauce, serrano, scallions and sugar, then fold in the salmon.
Serve over sushi rice with cucumber, avocado, nori strips, lemon and scallions.
recipes.title: Spicy Salmon Bowl

ingredients.item: mild Ro-Tel tomatoes and green chiles

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Pasta. Calories and protein are the site's figures; serving weight is an estimate.
steps: Heat the oil in an oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat. Brown the sausage and onion about 4 minutes, then add the garlic for 30 seconds.
Add the broth, tomatoes, cream, pasta, salt and pepper. Bring to a boil, cover, and simmer on medium-low about 15 minutes until the pasta is tender.
Stir in 1/2 cup cheese, top with the rest and the scallions, and broil until melted and bubbly.
recipes.title: Spicy Sausage Pasta

ingredients.item: fully cooked smoked sausage, sliced 1/4 inch

recipes.notes: From Pinterest board Foods I do like. Calories and protein are the site's figures; serving weight is an estimate.
steps: Cook the pasta until just al dente; drain.
Meanwhile, melt the butter in a large skillet over medium heat. Cook the garlic 1–2 minutes until fragrant, then stir in the flour.
Whisk in the broth until smooth, then stir in the half and half.
Add the salt, pepper, cayenne and red pepper flakes and simmer until thickened, about 5 minutes.
Stir in the Parmesan and 1 cup mozzarella until melted and smooth.
Add the sausage, parsley and pasta. Season with more salt and pepper if needed.
Preheat the broiler. Pour into a greased 9x13 baking dish and top with the remaining 1 cup mozzarella.
Broil 2–3 minutes until bubbly and golden.
recipes.title: Spicy Smoked Sausage Alfredo Bake

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Asian. Calories and protein are the site's figures per 2 tbsp.
steps: Mix everything together.
Refrigerate an hour before serving. Keeps 2 weeks.
recipes.title: Spicy Sriracha Mayo

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Calories and protein are the site's figures per taco; weight is an estimate.
steps: Whisk the ranch and sriracha.
Toss the cabbage, jalapeño, vinegar, honey, salt, juice of half the lime and cilantro for the slaw.
Pat the shrimp dry and toss with the spices.
Sauté in the oil over medium-high about 2 minutes per side until opaque, then roughly chop.
Fill warm tortillas (doubled if they tear) with shrimp, sauce and slaw. Serve with lime wedges.
recipes.title: Spicy Sriracha Shrimp Tacos with Cilantro Lime Slaw

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Lunch. The page is gone, so this comes from a 2018 web archive copy. Calories, protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Mix the tuna, mayo, soy sauce and sriracha.
Divide between the wraps, add the vegetables, and roll up.
recipes.title: Spicy Tuna Wraps

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Mexican. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Wrap the tortillas in foil and warm at 300°F for 15 minutes.
Finely chop the spinach (food processor or knife) and heat with the beans in a skillet about 3 minutes until wilted.
Divide the spinach and beans among the wraps, add 1/4 cup rice each, then lettuce, cheese, salsa and yogurt.
Fold into a pocket or roll like a burrito.
recipes.title: Spinach & Bean Burrito Wrap

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Lunch (pinned twice). Regular cheese and pesto work too. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Spread pesto over half of each tortilla.
Add a light layer of mozzarella (and feta), then tomato and spinach, and a little more mozzarella to hold it together.
Fold and cook in a skillet over medium about 5 minutes per side until melted and crisp.
recipes.title: Spinach & Tomato Quesadilla with Pesto (Vegan)

ingredients.item: frozen chopped spinach, thawed and drained

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Apps. Makes about 60 pinwheels; a serving here is 5. Calories and protein come from the site's whole-recipe totals divided by 12; weight is an estimate.
steps: Preheat the oven to 400°F.
Split each package of dough in half at the center perforation and press each rectangle flat, sealing the perforations.
Spread with 1/4 of the cheese and sprinkle with spinach.
Roll up from the long side, roll back and forth to seal, and cut into 3/4-inch slices (about 15 per roll).
Bake an inch apart on an ungreased sheet 10–12 minutes until lightly browned.
recipes.title: Spinach Crescent Pinwheels

recipes.notes: From Pinterest board Foods I do like. Servings, calories, protein and weight are estimates. It has a spicy kick; use less Cajun seasoning and more breadcrumbs to tame it.
steps: Preheat the oven to 350°F.
If using fresh spinach, wash, stem and cut large leaves into strips. Boil in lightly salted water 10–15 minutes until tender, then drain well.
Mix the spinach, pepper jack and cream cheese (microwave briefly to melt together if needed).
Combine the Cajun seasoning and breadcrumbs and sprinkle over both sides of the chicken.
Put a spoonful of the spinach mixture in the middle of each piece, roll up, and secure with toothpicks.
Bake 18–25 minutes until cooked through; covering with foil keeps it moist.
Remove the toothpicks and serve. Great with grilled zucchini.
recipes.title: Spinach Dip Stuffed Chicken Breast

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Breakfast. The recipe gives no serving count, so 8 is assumed. Calories, protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Generously spray a 9x13 dish and spread the spinach in it.
Whisk the pesto into the egg whites.
Stir in half the feta plus salt and pepper, and pour over the spinach.
Scatter the tomatoes and remaining feta on top.
Bake at 350°F for 30–40 minutes until set.
Cool 5 minutes, then slice and serve warm.
recipes.title: Spinach Pesto Feta Egg Casserole

ingredients.item: cold butter, ghee or palm shortening, in pieces (crust)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Breakfast. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Crust: Pulse the crust ingredients except the egg in a food processor, then add the egg and pulse until a dough forms.
Wrap the sticky dough and chill at least 1 hour (or up to a day).
Preheat the oven to 375°F.
Roll the dough between tapioca-dusted parchment sheets into an 11–12 inch circle and flip it into a pie dish, pressing it in.
Patch and crimp the edges, chill 10 minutes, prick all over with a fork, and bake 10 minutes until just set.
Filling: Cook the bacon in a large skillet until crisp; drain, keeping 1 tbsp fat.
Lower to medium-low, cook the onion about a minute, then the garlic 30 seconds.
Add the spinach, season lightly and heat through. Crumble in the bacon.
Whisk the eggs, milk, salt, pepper and nutritional yeast.
Stir in the spinach mixture, pour into the crust, and bake 30–35 minutes until the center is set (tent with foil if the crust browns too fast).
Rest 15–20 minutes before slicing.
recipes.title: Spinach Quiche with Bacon (Paleo, Dairy-Free)
recipes.totalTime: 2 hr 15 min (incl. 1 hr chilling the crust)

recipes.notes: From Pinterest board Foods I do like. Read from an archived copy of the page (the live site blocks automated visits). Serve with a salad and crusty bread. Calories, protein and weight are estimates.
