steps: Cook the pasta according to the package; drain and set aside.
Cut the chicken into bite-size pieces. Mix the Sriracha seasoning, garlic powder, onion powder and salt and sprinkle over the chicken.
Sauté the chicken in the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat for 5 minutes, turning occasionally.
Add the cream and bring to a boil. Reduce the heat and simmer gently 3–4 minutes until it starts to thicken.
Remove from the heat and stir in the Parmesan and parsley.
Add the pasta and toss.
recipes.title: Sriracha Chicken Alfredo

ingredients.item: sour cream, plus more for dipping

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. A serving is half a quesadilla. Calories, protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Mix the chicken, sriracha, sour cream and cheese.
Heat 1 tsp oil in a large skillet over medium, add a tortilla, spread 1/4 of the filling on half, sprinkle with cilantro, and fold.
Cook about 2 minutes until browned, flip, and cook 2 minutes more until melted.
Repeat, cut each into 4 wedges, and serve with sour cream.
recipes.title: Sriracha Chicken Quesadillas

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Apps. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Process the chickpeas, oil, tahini, lemon juice, garlic, salt and cumin until smooth, adding 1/4–1/2 cup water (or more oil) as needed.
Blend in 1 tbsp sriracha, then more to taste.
recipes.title: Sriracha Hummus

ingredients.item: garlic powder, sea salt, black pepper

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Makes one generous serving; double for two. Calories, protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Heat a nonstick pan over high. Season the steak with the garlic powder, salt, pepper and steak sauce if using.
Sear 2–3 minutes per side (move it to a fresh spot when you flip) to your liking, then rest a few minutes and cut into cubes.
Lower to medium and cook the peppers and onion 2 minutes, then the garlic and zucchini about 5 minutes, stirring.
Add the steak back and cook 1–2 minutes more.
recipes.title: Steak & Veggies One Pan Meal

ingredients.item: 95% lean ground beef (or venison or turkey)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Soup. The blog is gone, so this comes from a 2016 web archive copy. Makes about 8 cups. Calories are the blogger's figure for a heaping 1 1/2-cup bowl; protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Cook the rice and set aside.
Brown the meat in a large soup pot and drain.
Lower the heat, add the peppers, onion and garlic, and cook about 5 minutes until slightly tender.
Add the tomatoes, broth, tomato sauce, chili powder, salt and pepper, cover, and simmer 5 minutes.
Add the rice and simmer on low 25 minutes. (To freeze, leave out the rice and add it after thawing.)
recipes.title: Stick-to-Your-Ribs Beef, Pepper & Rice Soup

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Asian. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Combine the chicken with the marinade ingredients and marinate at least 30 minutes (or overnight).

Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large skillet over medium-high, add the chicken flat side down with the marinade, and cook undisturbed 5 minutes. Flip and cook 5–8 minutes, then flip again, lower the heat, and turn the thighs in the thickening sauce. Remove.
Add the other 1 tbsp oil to the pan juices and cook the green beans with the salt, mustard powder and pepper flakes until crisp-tender.
Portion into containers; keeps 4 days.
recipes.title: Sticky Asian Chicken Thighs & Spicy Green Beans (Whole30)

ingredients.item: frozen unsweetened strawberries, slightly thawed and diced

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Breakfast. The live page's recipe card doesn't load, so this comes from a 2020 web archive copy. For vegan, use non-dairy milk and agave. Calories are the site's figure; protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Preheat the oven to 300°F and lightly spray an 8-inch square pan.
Mix the coconut oil, banana, milk and honey in a large bowl.
Stir in the oats until coated, then gently fold in the strawberries.
Press into the pan and bake 15–19 minutes.
Cool completely in the pan, then slice into 10 bars. Keep covered in the fridge.
recipes.title: Strawberry Banana Granola Bars

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Drinks. Calories are the site's figure; protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Rub the juiced lime half around the rims of two rocks glasses, dip them in the salt, and fill with ice.
Blend the strawberries, tequila, Cointreau, lime juice and honey until smooth.
Finely chop and muddle the basil in a shaker, add the margarita, and stir well.
Pour into the glasses. (Frozen version: blend the basil and 6–8 ice cubes in with everything else.)
recipes.title: Strawberry Basil Margarita

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. The recipe is in the pin's description (no link), which cuts off partway through the last step, so the cream cheese step and bake time are my best guess. Calories and protein are estimates.
steps: Preheat the oven to 375°F and line an 8x8 pan with parchment.
Mix the flour, sugar, salt and baking powder, then work in the butter with a masher, fork or your hands until crumbly. Mix in the egg and vanilla until crumbly again.
Press half the crumb into the pan.
Mix the filling ingredients and spread over the crust, then dot with the softened cream cheese.
Crumble the rest of the dough on top and bake until golden and bubbling, about 35–45 minutes. Cool before cutting.
recipes.title: Strawberry Cheesecake Crumb Bars

ingredients.item: strawberries, hulled and cut into small pieces
unsalted butter-chilled and cut into small pieces

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Calories and protein are my estimates from the ingredients.
steps: Chop up strawberries in small pieces, then blot them with a clean towel to rid excess moisture. Place the chopped strawberries in the freezer as you work on the rest.
Pre-heat oven to 375 F and line baking sheets with parchment paper or silicone baking mat.
In a large bowl, whisk together flour, baking powder, salt, and sugar. Add butter to flour mixture and using your fingers or a pastry cutter, combine until a crumbly mixture is formed.
Add vanilla in cream and stir, then add this mixture in flour mixture. Stir until the mixture is dough-like. The mixture will be thick, sticky, and chunky.

Stir in strawberries. I found it easier to combine the dough and strawberries when first tear the dough in small chunks with my fingers. Some strawberries won’t combine into the dough at all. But that’s ok. You can add them to the dough balls when shaping the cookies before baking.

Using 1 ½ tablespoons cookie scoop drop dough on the prepared baking sheet leaving 2 inches space apart. Don’t need to roll each ball, but shape them with your fingers. Slightly press each cookie with your palm because they won’t spread too much during baking. Stick few more strawberry pieces on each cookie dough ball.
Sprinkle cookies with coarse sugar.
Bake cookies for 16-18 minutes, until just golden around edges.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes on the pan, then transfer to wire racks to cool completely.
recipes.title: Strawberry Shortcake Cookies

ingredients.item: cold butter (do not substitute for margarine)
sugar (* plus a little extra for sprinkling on top)
chopped strawberries (washed and chopped into 1/8 inch bites)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Calories and protein are my estimates from the ingredients.
steps: In a large mixing bowl, sift flour, salt and baking powder.
Cut butter into small pieces and mix into flour with a pastry cutter (or two knives, or your hands) until the mixture is crumbly.
Stir in sugar. Add milk and stir until just combined.
Gently fold in chopped strawberries.

Scoop into well greased or parchment lined muffin tins, sprinkle tops with a pinch of sugar each, and bake at 400 for 20 minutes. The tops will be slightly golden and a toothpick or fork inserted should come out clean.
recipes.title: Strawberry Shortcake Muffins Recipe

ingredients.item: mashed white or Japanese sweet potato (dough)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Anti-Inflammatory. Makes 8–10 small cakes; a serving is about 2. You'll likely have extra beef filling to serve on the side. Calories, protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Brown the beef in the oil with the dried herbs, salt, onion and garlic powder 3–4 minutes. Add the mushrooms 1–2 minutes, then wilt in the kale and parsley.
Bake the sweet potatoes until tender, peel, and mash smooth. Mix 2 cups with the cassava flour and salt into a pliable dough.
Roll the dough 1/4 inch thick between parchment and cut 2 3/4–3 inch rounds.
Put about 1 tbsp filling on half the rounds, top with the rest, and seal the edges with wet fingers.
Fry 3–4 at a time in the oil over medium 4–5 minutes, flip, cover, and cook 3–4 minutes until golden.
Mash the crema ingredients together and serve with the cakes.
recipes.title: Stuffed Sweet Potato Cakes with Ground Beef (AIP, Paleo)

ingredients.item: corn and black bean salsa (or any salsa), divided

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Mexican. Makes 40–45 shells; a serving is 2 shells. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Cook the shells and lay them out separately on parchment.
Brown the meat and drain. Stir in the chilies, 1 cup salsa and taco seasoning, then fold in the cheese.
Stuff each shell. To freeze, bag them now.
To bake, pour 1 cup salsa into a baking dish, add the shells, cover with foil, and bake at 350°F 45 minutes. Uncover and bake 5–15 minutes more until bubbly.
Serve with toppings.
recipes.title: Stuffed Taco Shells (Freezer-Friendly)

ingredients.item: zucchini, halved lengthwise, centers scooped out and saved

recipes.notes: From the BuzzFeed/Tasty list 7 Quick Dinners To Make This Week (pinned on Jessica Lynn's Pasta board). Calories and protein are the site's figures (4 servings); serving weight is an estimate.
steps: Brown the beef with the peppers, onion and the scooped-out zucchini. Set the zucchini boats on a sprayed sheet pan.
Stir in the taco seasoning and water and simmer a few minutes.
In a large bowl, mix the beef with the cheddar, mascarpone and parsley.
Spoon into the zucchini boats.
Bake at 400°F 30 minutes; if the zucchini isn't tender, check again after 10 more minutes.
Sprinkle with mozzarella, return to the turned-off oven 3–5 minutes to melt, and top with green onion.
recipes.title: Stuffed Zucchini Boats

ingredients.item: stove top stuffing (prepared per box instructions)
chicken, cooked and cut up in bite-size pieces

recipes.notes: Servings, serving weight, calories and protein are estimates; the recipe does not state them. Total time is not stated, though baking takes 30 minutes plus time to cook the chicken and prepare the stuffing.
steps: Prepare the stove top stuffing per the box instructions and place it in the bottom of a 13 x 9 pan.
Put the cooked, bite-size chicken pieces on top of the stuffing.
Mix the can of cream of chicken soup with the can of chicken broth and pour over the chicken.
Top with shredded cheese.
Bake at 350 degrees for 1/2 hour.
recipes.title: Stuffing & Chicken Casserole

ingredients.item: toffee flavored liquid steiva (or vanilla stevia)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Calories and protein are the site's figures per serving (1 serving).
steps: Add all ingredients into a high powered blender.
Mix until combined well.
Taste and adjust sweetener if needed.
Pour mixture into an ice cream machine and follow manufacturers instructions.
Mine was perfectly churned within 20 minutes.
Freeze in an air tight container for about 1 hour or until hard enough to scoop.
Top with peanuts if desired!
recipes.title: Sugar Free Peanut Butter Cheesecake Ice Cream

ingredients.item: (3.4 oz. cheesecake or white chocolate pudding mix)
bananas (sliced (add just before serving or they brown))

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Calories and protein are my estimates from the ingredients.
steps: Place the whipped topping, pudding mix and yogurt into a large bowl. Whisk together. Cover and refrigerate until just before serving (at least an hour).
When you are ready to serve, slice the strawberries and bananas.
Remove whipped cream/pudding mixture from refrigerator and gently fold in sliced strawberries, berries, sliced bananas and marshmallows, and stir gently to combine.
Serve immediately.
recipes.title: Summer Berry Cheesecake Salad

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Lunch. Calories and weight are estimates.
steps: Pulse everything in a food processor or blender until smooth.
Serve over salad (great on cucumber noodles); keeps 10 days in the fridge.
recipes.title: Sun-Dried Tomato Vinaigrette

ingredients.item: boneless pork chops, 1/2 inch thick, trimmed

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Heat a thin layer of oil in a 10–12 inch heavy pan (cast iron is best) over medium-high.
Pound the chops between parchment to about 1/4 inch.
Set up three bowls: flour mixed with the salt, garlic powder, paprika and pepper; eggs whisked with the milk; panko mixed with the nutmeg.
Coat each chop in flour, then egg, then panko.
Fry 3–5 minutes per side until golden and 140°F inside. Salt as they come out and serve with lemon.
recipes.title: Super Easy Crispy Pork Schnitzel

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Halve the squash around the middle, scoop out the seeds, and set cut side down in a large slow cooker.
Pour the sauce around the squash and tuck the meatballs around it.
Cook on Low 5–6 hours or High 3–4, until a fork pierces the skin easily.
Lift out the squash with tongs and scrape out the strands. Serve with the sauce and meatballs.
recipes.title: Super Easy Crock Pot Spaghetti Squash and Meatballs

ingredients.item: marinara sauce (you won't use it all)
Parmesan and fresh parsley, for topping

recipes.notes: From the Delish roundup 12 Slow-Cooker Flat Belly Foods. Calories and protein are the site's figures; serving weight is an estimate.
steps: Spray the slow cooker and spread 1/2 cup sauce on the bottom.

Break noodles to mostly cover the bottom. Layer a third of the ricotta, vegetables, pesto, sauce and cheese, then more noodles. Repeat for three full layers, ending with noodles covered in a thin layer of sauce and a little cheese.
Cover and cook on HIGH 3 hours or LOW 5–6 hours.
Turn off the slow cooker and let it sit at least 1 hour so the liquid soaks in, then scoop or slice.
recipes.title: Super Easy Skinny Veggie Crockpot Lasagna

ingredients.item: coconut oil, plus more for frying

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Anti-Inflammatory. Calories, protein and weight are estimates per patty.
steps: Mix the tuna, sweet potato, onion, dill, lemon juice, coconut oil and salt.
Whisk the tapioca with the water and mix in.
Form 4 patties.
Fry in 1/2–1 tbsp hot coconut oil over medium 3–4 minutes per side until browned.
recipes.title: Sweet Potato and Dill Tuna Patties (AIP, Paleo, Whole30)

ingredients.item: mashed cooked sweet potato (may use canned sweet potato or pumpkin puree)
mini chocolate chips, plus additional for optional topping

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Calories and protein are the site's figures per serving (1 mini-muffin).
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F. Line a mini-muffin tin with liners or grease with oil or non-stick cooking spray.

Combine all of the ingredients in a bowl except for the chocolate chips. You may also use a standup mixer, blender, or food processor. If using a blender or food processor, you do not need to pre-mash the cooked sweet potato and avocado. Stir or blend the ingredients just until smooth.
Fold in 1/3 cup chocolate chips and optional walnuts.
Fill each muffin well with batter. Top with a few extra mini-chocolate chips if desired.

Bake in the oven for 14-16 minutes or until the brownie bites are slightly firm to touch. Remove from oven and let cool for about 15-20 minutes. Transfer muffins to a wire rack to finish cooling before enjoying. The brownie bites taste best after completely cooling.

For the optional drizzle: In a microwave-safe, small bowl, combine 3 tablespoons of mini chocolate chips and 1/2 teaspoon coconut oil. Microwave for 30 seconds. Stir and continue to microwave in 20 second intervals until chocolate is melted and drizzly, stirring after each interval. Top each brownie bite with a drizzle of the melted chocolate. Chocolate will harden after it cools.
recipes.title: Sweet Potato Avocado Brownie Bites

ingredients.item: sour cream or Greek yogurt, avocado, salsa, cilantro

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Mexican. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Boil the sweet potatoes about 8 minutes until fork-tender, drain, and mash.
Stir in the chili powder, cinnamon, cumin, paprika, 1/4 tsp salt and chipotle.
Sauté the onion and pepper in the oil 3 minutes, then the garlic and remaining salt about 5 minutes more.
Mix the vegetables and black beans into the sweet potato.
In a sprayed skillet over medium, fill half a tortilla with a heaping 1/2 cup filling and 3 tbsp cheese, fold, and cook 1–2 minutes per side until crisp.
recipes.title: Sweet Potato Black Bean Quesadillas

ingredients.item: sweet potatoes, peeled, in large chunks

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Sides. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Boil the sweet potatoes until very tender, drain, and mash with the stick of butter. Mix in the brown sugar, salt, cinnamon, vanilla and nutmeg.
Mix the topping: melted butter, brown sugar, flour, salt and pecans.
Spread the sweet potatoes in a greased 9x13, cover with the pecan topping, then the marshmallows.
Bake at 350°F 25–35 minutes until bubbly and the marshmallows are golden; watch closely at the end.
recipes.title: Sweet Potato Casserole with Pecans and Marshmallows

ingredients.item: sweet potato or yam, peeled and chopped

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Anti-Inflammatory. Calories and protein are the site's figures per popper; weight is an estimate.
steps: Preheat the oven to 350°F and oil a large baking sheet.
Pulse the sweet potato to rice-size pieces.
Mix with the chicken, tapioca and seasonings.
Shape into egg-shaped nuggets about 1 inch thick and place on the sheet.
Bake 40 minutes, flipping halfway.
recipes.title: Sweet Potato Chicken Poppers

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Lunch. Calories, protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Season the chicken with salt, pepper, oregano and garlic powder and cook covered in 1 tbsp oil over medium-high about 10 minutes until done. Keep warm.
Wipe the pan, add the other 1 tbsp oil, and cook the sweet potato noodles, tossing, until tender. Season.
Warm the sauce in a small pot.
Divide the noodles onto plates and top with sauce, the sliced chicken, parsley and parmesan.
recipes.title: Sweet Potato Noodles with Chicken and Tomato Basil Sauce

ingredients.item: chicken breasts (enough to cover the pan)

recipes.notes: From Pinterest board Foods I do like. Servings, calories, protein and weight are estimates (large breasts, not counting rice). To freeze: assemble through the soup layer and freeze; thaw overnight in the fridge, then add the stuffing and butter and bake.
steps: Cover the bottom of a baking dish with the chicken.
Lay the Swiss cheese over the chicken.
Mix the cream of chicken soup with the milk and pour it over.
Top with half a bag (or more) of stuffing mix.
Drizzle the melted butter on top.
Bake at 350°F for 45–60 minutes.
Serve over rice.
recipes.title: Swiss Cheese Chicken

ingredients.item: chocolate chips (semi-sweet, milk chocolate, or a combo)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Calories and protein are the site's figures per serving (1 serving).
steps: Adjust rack to center position of oven and place 8-inch cast iron skillet on rack. Preheat oven to 450°F with skillet inside. Once oven is preheated, use a pot holder to remove hot skillet from the oven. Place pat of butter in the skillet and use a pot holder to hold the handle and swirl the skillet so that the melted butter coats the bottom and sides.

Pour chocolate chips in an even layer into the bottom of the skillet. Taking care not to burn fingers on the sides of the skillet, arrange marshmallow halves over the surface of the chocolate chips, covering the chocolate completely.
Bake for 5 to 7 minutes or until marshmallows are toasted to your preference (watch closely!). Use an oven mitt to remove the skillet from the oven and allow to rest for 5 minutes.
Serve immediately with graham cracker squares...but be careful, because the dip (and the skillet) will be very hot!
recipes.title: S’mores Dip (Easy + Decadent)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Apps. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Heat everything in a medium saucepan over medium-low, stirring constantly until the cheese melts.
Taste and add more cayenne or brine if you like. Serve hot with chips or fries.
recipes.title: Taco Bell Nacho Cheese (Copycat)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Apps. Works as a meal too. Calories, protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Dressing: mash the avocado smooth, mix in the sour cream, whisk in the milk, then the lemon juice, vinegar, garlic, parsley and salt.
Separate, rinse and dry the lettuce leaves.
Brown the beef, add the taco seasoning and water, and simmer 3 minutes.
Set everything out buffet style. Fill each leaf with beef, tomatoes, beans, olives and onion, sprinkle with cilantro, cheese and tortilla strips, and drizzle with the dressing.
recipes.title: Taco Salad Lettuce Wraps with Avocado Ranch

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Mexican. Calories, protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Preheat the oven to 400°F and bring a large pot of water to a boil. Scoop the seeds out of the squash, chopping and keeping 3/4 cup.
Boil the squash halves 1 minute and drain on paper towels.
Spread the salsa in a large baking dish and arrange the squash cut side up.
Brown the turkey, then add the seasoning, onion, pepper, reserved squash, tomato sauce and water. Cover and simmer 20 minutes.
Fill the boats, top with cheese, cover with foil and bake 35 minutes until the squash is soft. Garnish and serve with salsa.
recipes.title: Taco Stuffed Summer Squash Boats

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Anti-Inflammatory. A serving is 1 tbsp. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight and servings are estimates.
steps: Put everything in a mason jar and blend with an immersion blender until creamy.
Adjust the seasoning and refrigerate in the jar.
recipes.title: Tangy & Creamy Avocado Mayo

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Calories and protein are my estimates from the ingredients. Servings (12) are my estimate.
steps: Preheat oven to 350˚F.
Put AP flour, almond flour and sugar & salt in food processor and pulse to combine.
Add butter & vanilla extract and pulse until it resembles coarse meal.
Butter an 8x8 pan, pour everything into the pan, flatten with a offset spatula. Then, press firmly with your hands & spatula.
Bake in the oven for 30-35 minutes at 350˚F until lightly browned. Check at 30 min. mark.
Let it chill until cool. It can take a while so be patient!
recipes.title: Ted Lasso's Biscuit Recipe

recipes.notes: From Pinterest board Foods I do like. Calories, protein and weight are estimates including the cream sauce.
steps: Whisk the cornstarch with 1/4 cup water and set aside.
In a small saucepan over medium heat, bring the soy sauce, brown sugar, ginger, garlic powder, honey and 1 cup water to a simmer.
Stir in the cornstarch mixture and cook until thick enough to coat a spoon, about 2 minutes. Cool to room temperature.
Marinate the salmon in the teriyaki sauce in a zip-top bag for at least 30 minutes or overnight, turning occasionally.
Preheat the oven to 400°F and coat a 9x13 baking dish with nonstick spray.
Put the salmon and marinade in the dish and bake until it flakes easily, about 20 minutes.
For the Sriracha cream sauce, whisk the mayonnaise, 2 tbsp Sriracha and condensed milk.

steps: In a large measuring cup or bowl, mix together the milk, water, melted butter, sugar, and yeast.

In a stand mixer fitted with the dough hook, add the flour and salt. With the mixer on low speed, add the milk mixture. Increase to medium speed and knead until the dough is smooth, 5 to 7 minutes. Add additional flour a couple tablespoons at a time only if the dough is sticking to the bottom of the sides of the bowl. After kneading, the dough should be soft, supple and slightly sticky without leaving a lot of dough residue on your fingers.
Place the dough in a lightly greased bowl, cover, and let the dough rise until doubled, 1 to 2 hours.
Spread the softened butter evenly in a 12-cup bundt pan, using a pastry brush or piece of wax or parchment paper to ensure all the nooks and crannies of the pan are well-buttered. Set aside.

Lightly punch down the dough. On a very lightly floured or greased countertop, press the dough into a thick rectangle or square, about 8 or 9 inches across. Use a bench scraper or pizza cutter to cut the dough into 64 small pieces.
Roll each piece into a round ball shape. It doesn't have to be perfect.
Combine the brown sugar and cinnamon in a bowl or shallow dish.

Dip the dough pieces in melted butter and then roll evenly in the sugar mixture. Place the dough pieces in the prepared Bundt pan, offsetting the dough balls so they aren't stacked exactly on top of each other.
Cover the Bundt pan and let the bread rise until noticeably puffy and nearly doubled, 1 to 2 hours.

Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F. Uncover the bundt pan and bake until the bread is golden brown and the bread is baked through, 30 to 35 minutes. An instant-read thermometer inserted into the bread should read 190 to 200 degrees F.
Cool the monkey bread in the pan for no longer than 5 minutes (any longer and the bread will be too sticky and hard to remove!). Turn the bread onto a platter.
In a small bowl, whisk the confectioners' sugar and milk together until smooth. Drizzle the glaze over the top and sides of the warm monkey bread. Serve warm.

steps: With a hand mixer, cream together the peanut butter, butter, white sugar and brown sugar until blended.

Scoop tablespoonfuls of dough and roll into balls.
Place cookies 2 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheets (I used parchment paper since my cookies tend to burn on my darker pans). Press each ball once with a fork.
Bake for 8-10 minutes at 375. Don’t overcook! These cookies are much better soft and just barely cooked all the way through! Enjoy!

steps: Preheat oven to 350°F (180°C). Prepare a 9 inch cake pan with parchment paper in the bottom and baking spray on the sides. Set aside.
Combine the flour, cocoa powder, baking soda and salt in a medium sized bowl and set aside.
Cream the butter and sugars together in a large mixer bowl on medium speed until light in color and fluffy, 2-3 minutes. You should be able to see the change in color and texture and know it’s ready.
Add the egg and vanilla extract and mix until well combined.

Add the dry ingredients to the butter mixture and mix until the dough is just well combined. Do not over mix. Once it’s well combined, use a rubber spatula to help it come together to form a more cohesive ball.
Stir in the chocolate chips. Dough will be thick.
Press the cookie dough evenly into the cake pan and bake for 18-20 minutes, or until the top of the cookie is no longer glossy.
Allow to cool completely in the pan. It will firm up as it cools.
Once cool, quickly invert the cookie onto a cooling rack. Quickly place another cooling rack on the bottom of the cookie (which is now facing up) and invert again, so that the cookie cake is upright.

Preheat oven to 350°F (180°C). Prepare a 9 inch cake pan with parchment paper in the bottom and baking spray on the sides. Set aside.
Cream the butter and sugars together in a large mixer bowl on medium speed until light in color and fluffy, 2-3 minutes. You should be able to see the change in color and texture and know it’s ready.
Add the egg and vanilla extract and mix until well combined.

Add the cake mix and flour to the butter mixture and mix until the dough is just well combined. Do not over mix. Once it’s well combined, use a rubber spatula to help it come together to form a more cohesive ball.
Stir in the sprinkles and white chocolate chips. Dough will be thick.

To make the buttercream, add the butter to a large mixer bowl and beat until smooth.
Add about half of the powdered sugar and mix until well combined and smooth.
Add the vanilla extract and a tablespoon of cream or water and mix until well combined and smooth.
Add the rest of the powdered sugar and mix until smooth. Add more cream or water to get the right consistency.
Use a sharp knife to remove the top raised edges from the cookie layers. The centers of the cookies fall a bit and it can be good to cut off the edges, so that the layers are even.
Place the double chocolate cookie cake on your cake plate. Pipe an even layer of buttercream on top of the cookie cake. I use my Ateco 844 tip.
Add the classic chocolate chip cookie cake to the top of the buttercream layer. Add another layer of buttercream on top of the cookie cake.
Add the funfetti cookie cake on top, then pipe swirls of buttercream around the top edge of the cake. I used my Ateco 844 tip.
Decorate the cake with some sprinkles, mini vanilla wafers and mini chocolate chip cookies.

steps: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Line a 9x13 pan with foil lined parchment paper.

steps: Preheat oven to 350°F.
Line 2 large baking sheets with parchment paper.
Put powdered sugar, almond flour, and salt in a food processor pulsing several times. Continue for about 30 seconds or pulse until the ingredients are fine and well combined.
Using a flour sifter, sift the above ingredients into a large bowl. Set aside.

Place the 3 egg whites in the clean bowl of a stand mixer fitted with a whisk attachment. Beat on medium speed until opaque and foamy, about 30 seconds. Now add a pinch of cream of tartar, increase the speed to medium-high, continue to beat until the egg whites are white in color and hold the line of the whisk, about 1 minute.

Continue to beat, slowly adding the granulated sugar, and vanilla extract...until the sugar is combined, the peaks are stiff, and the whites are shiny, about 1 minute more. Do not over whip. Transfer the meringue to a large bowl.

Now you will need to spoon half of the batter into pastry bag fitted with 1/2-inch plain round tip. Pipe batter onto each prepared sheet in 12 walnut-size mounds, spacing mounds apart because cookies will spread slightly.-
Take a rubber spatula, and now gently fold the dry mixture with the egg whites in four different scoops until the dry ingredients are just combined.

Now you will need to spoon half of the batter into pastry bag fitted with 1/2-inch plain round tip. Pipe batter onto each prepared sheet in 12 walnut-size mounds, spacing mounds apart because cookies will spread slightly.
Bake cookies, 1 sheet at a time, until firm to touch in the center and dry and cracked on top, about 7 minutes ..... pull the pan out and then rotate and bake for another 7 minutes.

optional 1 tbsp vegan butter or coconut butter, for richer taste

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Calories are the site's figures per serving (1 serving).
steps: *You can also add 2-3 tbsp of peanut butter to turn it into a peanut butter banana pudding.In a small pot over medium heat, combine banana, sweetener, optional ingredients, and 1 cup of the milk of choice. Whisk the remaining 1/4 cup milk with the cornstarch. Once banana mixture is warm, whisk in the cornstarch mixture. Cook on low heat, whisking occasionally, until thick. Turn off heat and stir in vanilla. (If not eating right away, you can take it off the heat before it's thick, let cool, then refrigerate. The pudding will thicken considerably in the fridge.) If a smoother texture is desired, feel free to use a hand blender. Serve hot or cold.View Nutrition Facts
recipes.title: Vegan Banana Pudding

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Meal Prep. A serving is one potato half. Calories, protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Preheat the oven to 400°F. Rub the potatoes with oil and salt and bake 1 hour.
Halve lengthwise and scoop out the insides, leaving a thin layer so the skins stand up.
Whip the potato with the ranch, butter and pepper until creamy, then fold in the broccoli.
Refill the skins and bake 17–20 minutes until lightly browned.
Top with extra broccoli, herbs or ranch. Keeps 5 days in the fridge or 3 months frozen.
recipes.title: Vegan Broccoli Ranch Twice-Baked Potatoes

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Calories and protein are the site's figures per taco; weight is an estimate.
steps: Preheat the oven to 425°F and line a sheet with parchment.
Toss the cauliflower with the oil, garlic powder, chili powder, pepper and 1/4 cup buffalo sauce. Roast 20 minutes, flipping halfway.
Warm the remaining buffalo sauce and toss with the roasted cauliflower.
Fill tortillas with romaine, avocado and cauliflower, drizzle with ranch, and top with cilantro or green onion.
recipes.title: Vegan Buffalo Cauliflower Tacos

ingredients.item: medium-sized ripe banana, mashed (100 g or 1/2 cup)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Calories and protein are my estimates from the ingredients.
steps: Preheat oven to 350ºF (176ºC) and line a large baking sheet with parchment paper or a non-stick baking mat. Set aside.
In a large mixing bowl, combine flour, oats, baking powder, and salt. Set aside.
In a medium-sized mixing bowl, whisk together coconut oil, banana, sugar, and vanilla.
Add wet ingredients to dry ingredients, mixing until just combined. Do not overmix. Fold in chocolate chips.
Using a rounded tablespoon, drop dough onto prepared baking sheets, and flatten them slightly.
Bake 12-14 minutes, or until edges begin to turn golden brown.
Remove from oven and let cool for 5 minutes before transferring to a cooling rack to cool completely. Store cookies in an airtight container at room temperature for up to a week.
recipes.title: Vegan Chocolate Chip Banana Bread Oatmeal Cookies

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Anti-Inflammatory. The recipe lists spinach but doesn't say when to add it, so I added it with the strawberries. Calories, protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Blend the almond milk, banana and kale on high.
Add the strawberries, cucumber and spinach and blend smooth.
Thin with more milk or ice as needed. Serves 1–2.
recipes.title: Vegan Detox Green Monster Smoothie

ingredients.item: plain unsweetened coconut yogurt (I used the brand Riviera as it is thick and creamy)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. Calories and protein are my estimates from the ingredients.
steps: Prepare your ice cream maker attachment by freezing it overnight.
When ready to make the frozen yogurt, in a mixing bowl combine the yogurt, sugar and vanilla extract and whisk until it is completely combined.
Fix the paddle attachment and frozen ice cream bowl onto the KitchenAid as according to the directions.
Add the yogurt mix and mix on STIR setting for 15-20 minutes, until thick and creamy.

Serve immediately with your favourite toppings- I love shredded coconut, fresh blueberries and a drizzle of maple syrup! I prefer to enjoy right away as I find that gives the best texture. If you have extra, store in a container in the freezer. *You will need to remove from the freezer to thaw for a few minutes before attempting to scoop as it will freeze quite solid.
recipes.title: Vegan Frozen Yogurt in the KitchenAid Ice Cream Attachment

ingredients.item: yellow onion, in large chunks (cheese sauce)
butternut squash, peeled, in large chunks (cheese sauce)
salsa and lime wedges, to serve

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Apps. Serves 6–8. Calories, protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Boil the onion and squash in a few inches of salted water, then cover and simmer 10 minutes until very tender. Reserve 1/4 cup water and drain.
Purée with the garlic, adding water as needed, then stream in the oil until smooth and bright yellow. Season with salt.
Heat the broiler. Spread the chips on a sheet pan and broil 1–2 minutes until hot and lightly golden.
Drizzle with the squash 'cheese' and top with the beans, corn, tomatoes, jalapeño, red onion, cilantro and avocado. Serve right away with salsa and lime.
recipes.title: Vegan Nachos with Butternut Squash Cheese

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Mexican. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Mash the avocado with the garlic, salt, pepper, lime juice and red pepper.
Stir in the cilantro, beans, corn and onion.
Spread on half of each tortilla and fold over.
Cook in 1 tbsp hot oil until browned on both sides. Serve with salsa.
recipes.title: Vegan Quesadillas with Black Beans and Avocado

ingredients.item: to serve: chipotle sauce, pickled onions, guacamole

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Calories and protein are the site's figures per patty; weight is an estimate.
steps: Bake the sweet potatoes cut side down on a sprayed foil-lined sheet at 400°F 30–35 minutes until tender; scoop out the flesh.
Rinse the quinoa and simmer in 1 cup water 10–15 minutes until tender.
Mix the flax and all the spices.
Mash the beans and sweet potato until slightly chunky, then mix in the quinoa and spices.
Form 8 patties (a heaping 1/3 cup each).
Bake on a sprayed parchment-lined sheet at 400°F 20 minutes, flip carefully, and bake 20 minutes more.
recipes.title: Vegan Sweet Potato Black Bean Burgers

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Pasta. Calories and protein are the site's figures; serving weight is an estimate.
steps: Cook the pasta in well-salted water. Reserve 2–3 cups pasta water before draining.
Meanwhile, put one drained can of beans and one undrained can in a food processor with 1 tbsp oil and a pinch of salt and blend 1–2 minutes until creamy.
Cook the onion in the remaining oil over medium-low heat 7–8 minutes until soft.
Add the garlic, chili flakes and thyme and cook 1 minute more.
Stir in the bean purée with a little pasta water, add the spinach, and simmer a minute until wilted.
Toss in the pasta, sun-dried tomatoes and roasted pepper, season, and serve right away.
recipes.title: Vegan White Bean Pasta

ingredients.item: fresh steamed thin chow mein noodles
chicken broth (vegetable broth to keep it vegetarian)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Asian. The page is gone, and its 2016 web archive copy only listed ingredients (the method was on another site), so the steps are a standard stir-fry method. Calories, protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Heat the oil in a wok or large skillet over high and stir-fry the cabbage and carrots 2–3 minutes until just tender.
Add the noodles and toss to heat through.
Stir in the broth, soy sauce, sesame oil and lo mein sauce and toss until the noodles soak up most of the liquid.
Toss in the green onions and serve.
recipes.title: Vegetable Chow Mein

recipes.notes: From the Meal Prep on Fleek roundup 31 Slow Cooker Meal Prep Recipes. The site's current version is a stovetop recipe, not a slow cooker one. Nutrition is the site's figure for 1 cup.
steps: Heat the oil in a large pot over medium heat and cook the onion and garlic about 3 minutes.
Add the cabbage, carrots and green beans and cook 5 minutes more.
Stir in the peppers, cauliflower, tomatoes with juices, broth, tomato paste, bay leaves and seasonings. Bring to a boil, then simmer 8–10 minutes.
Add the zucchini and simmer about 5 minutes more, until soft.
Remove the bay leaves and serve.
recipes.title: Vegetable Soup (Spend With Pennies)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Breakfast. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Preheat the oven to 350°F and spray a 9x13 baking dish.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large skillet over medium and cook the mushrooms until tender, about 5 minutes. Put them in the dish.
Heat the remaining oil and cook the onion and pepper until tender. Add the broccoli and break it into small pieces as it heats.
Add the vegetables to the dish.
Whisk the eggs, yogurt, garlic and onion powders, salt and pepper.
Pour over the vegetables, add the cheese, and stir gently a couple of times (save some cheese for the top if you like).
Bake 45–55 minutes until the center is set. Top with green onions if you like.
recipes.title: Vegetarian Breakfast Casserole

ingredients.item: mini red and orange pepper, diced
cilantro, lime juice, salsa, sour cream, to serve

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Lunch. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Prick the sweet potato, rub with 1 tsp oil, wrap in a paper towel, and microwave about 8 minutes until very tender; mash.
Cook the peppers and jalapeño in the remaining oil 5–7 minutes, then the beans, corn and taco seasoning 3 minutes.
Butter one side of each tortilla. On the other side spread about 3 tbsp sweet potato, half a mashed avocado, 1/4 cup filling and cheese.
Cook butter side down over medium until browned and melted, folding in half. Serve with cilantro, lime, salsa and sour cream.
recipes.title: Vegetarian Quesadillas with Black Beans and Sweet Potato

recipes.notes: From the Meal Prep on Fleek roundup 31 Slow Cooker Meal Prep Recipes. Calories and protein are the site's figures; serving weight is an estimate.
steps: Heat the oil in a nonstick skillet over medium heat and cook the onion, garlic and mushrooms until starting to soften, 4–5 minutes.
Add to a 6-quart slow cooker with the zucchini, crushed tomatoes, tomato paste, broth, bay leaves, basil, oregano, red pepper flakes, salt and pepper.
Cook on LOW 7 hours or HIGH 3 1/2–4 hours.
Mix the ricotta, mozzarella, parsley, basil and salt for the topping; refrigerate.
When the soup is done, cook the lasagna noodles per the package, drain, break into pieces if you like, and add to the soup.
Stir in the spinach until wilted, then mix in half the ricotta topping.
Ladle into bowls and top with a dollop of the remaining ricotta mixture and more herbs.
recipes.title: Vegetarian Slow Cooker Lasagna Soup

ingredients.item: eggs (1 for the cakes, 6 to fry)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Breakfast. Each serving is 2 cakes with 2 eggs. Calories and protein are the site's figures; time and weight are estimates.
steps: Preheat the oven to 350°F and line a baking sheet with sprayed parchment.
Grate the zucchini, carrot and pepper on the large holes of a box grater, toss with the salt in a sieve, and let stand 20 minutes. Wring dry in a clean towel.
Stir the vegetables with the almond flour, ricotta, mozzarella, green onions, 1 egg, sun-dried tomatoes, Italian seasoning, garlic powder and pepper.
Pack into a 1/2-cup measure and turn out onto the sheet to make 6 cakes, pressing each to about 3 1/2 inches across.
Bake 25–30 minutes until browned at the edges and firm. (They keep 5 days; reheat in a skillet about 4 minutes per side.)
Meanwhile, fry the remaining 6 eggs in a sprayed nonstick skillet to your liking and top each cake with one.
recipes.title: Veggie Hashbrown Ricotta Cakes and Eggs

ingredients.item: chickpeas, rinsed, drained and patted dry
sliced mushrooms, drained and squeezed completely dry
salted pretzels, ground into fine crumbs

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Lunch. Calories, protein and weight are estimates per 5–6 nuggets with sauce.
steps: Mix the flax with the water and rest 10 minutes. Grind the pretzels into fine crumbs on a plate.
Pulse the chickpeas, green onion, parsley, salt, pepper and garlic to a coarse mix; move to a bowl.
Process the carrot and mushrooms (squeezed very dry) until finely minced and add to the chickpeas.
Stir in the flax egg, flour and panko (add more if too wet; it should be sticky but workable).
Scoop 1 tbsp portions, shape into nuggets, and coat in pretzel crumbs (makes about 22).
Pan-fry in batches over medium-high until golden on both sides. Drain.
Mix the dipping sauce and serve.
recipes.title: Veggie Nuggets with Vegan Honey Mustard

ingredients.item: cottage cheese, small or large curd

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Desserts. The original recipe is no longer online, so this is a similar recipe from Live Eat Learn. A serving is about 2 heaping tablespoons. Keeps 3–4 days in the fridge, or freeze in single portions. Not for baking.
steps: Blend the cottage cheese, brown sugar, vanilla and protein powder until completely smooth and creamy.
Stir in the almond meal and chocolate chips.
Cover and chill in the fridge for about an hour before serving.
recipes.title: High-Protein Cottage Cheese Cookie Dough

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Lunch. Calories, protein and weight are estimates for the cheese-and-pickle bun only, without fillings.
steps: Preheat the oven to 400°F and pat the pickles dry between paper towels.
Sprinkle 1/2 cup cheddar in a circle on a parchment-lined sheet, lay the pickles on it, and cover with the remaining cheddar.
Bake 16–20 minutes until golden and crisp at the edges.
Cool 10 minutes on the sheet (key for crispness), then fold or layer with your fillings.
recipes.title: Viral Pickle Sandwich (Cheese-Crisp Bun)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Breakfast. Calories and protein are the site's figures; serving weight is an estimate.
steps: Heat a large skillet and stir-fry the onion and carrot in the oil 5 minutes over medium heat.
Add the garlic, paprika, coriander and cumin and stir-fry 2 minutes.
Add the tomato sauce (and the 1/2 cup water swished in the jar for a thinner sauce).
Add the beans, bring to a gentle boil, and simmer 5 minutes. Season.
Make 4–6 wells and crack an egg into each, nudging sauce around the whites. Season the eggs.
Cover and simmer 5–10 minutes until the eggs are done to your liking. Top with feta and parsley and serve with toasted baguette.
recipes.title: White Bean Shakshuka with Feta

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Casseroles. Servings, calories, protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Preheat the oven to 350°F.
Heat a large pan over medium heat.
Cook the bacon until slightly crispy, then set aside and chop.
Pour off all but 1 tbsp of the bacon fat.
Cook the onion in the bacon fat 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the beef and cook 5–7 minutes, breaking it up, until browned.
Stir in the tomatoes, BBQ sauce and pickles and bring to a simmer. Season, remove from the heat and stir in the bacon.
Blend the cashews, water and nutritional yeast until smooth and creamy. Season with salt and pepper.
Spread the frozen hash browns in a 13x9 dish and toss with 1/2 tsp salt.
Spread the beef mixture over the hash browns and drizzle with the cashew cheese. Cover with foil and bake 30 minutes.
Top with thinly sliced lettuce before serving.
recipes.title: Whole30 BBQ Bacon Cheeseburger Casserole

ingredients.item: ripe bananas, plus more to garnish
ground cinnamon, plus more to garnish

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Breakfast. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Blend the milk, bananas, cinnamon and vanilla until smooth.
Pour into a large mason jar or container.
Add the chia seeds, close the lid and shake until evenly mixed with no lumps.
Refrigerate 2 hours to overnight, until thick.
Serve with banana slices and cinnamon (or banana and toasted coconut). Keeps 2 days covered in the fridge.
recipes.title: Whole30 Chia Pudding with Banana (Blended)

ingredients.item: bone broth or low-sodium chicken broth
toppings: jalapeños, green onions, avocado, cilantro, lime

recipes.notes: From the 40 Aprons roundup Whole30 Slow Cooker Recipes. The site also gives Instant Pot (10 min) and stovetop (25 min) methods. Calories and protein are the site's figures; serving weight is an estimate.
steps: Melt the ghee in a large sauté pan over medium heat. Sauté the onion and peppers with a big pinch of salt until soft, 5–7 minutes. Add the garlic for 1 minute.
Add the beef and cook until no longer pink.
Move the meat and vegetables to the slow cooker.
Stir in all the spices.
Add the tomatoes, broth, coconut milk and green chilies and stir well.
Cover and cook on LOW about 8 hours. Season with salt and pepper and serve with toppings.
recipes.title: Whole30 Creamy Taco Soup

recipes.notes: From the Meal Prep on Fleek roundup 31 Slow Cooker Meal Prep Recipes. Calories and protein are the site's figures; serving weight is an estimate.
steps: Thinly slice the potatoes with a mandoline.
Layer the potatoes over the bottom of the slow cooker.
Whisk the eggs with the coconut milk, salt and pepper.
Layer half the sausage, mushrooms, peppers, spinach and egg mixture, then repeat to make 2 layers over the potatoes.
Cook on HIGH 2 hours.
recipes.title: Whole30 Crockpot Breakfast Casserole

recipes.notes: From the 40 Aprons roundup Whole30 Slow Cooker Recipes. Calories and protein are the site's figures; serving weight is an estimate.
steps: Spray the slow cooker with coconut oil and add the potatoes and garlic. Stir in 2 cups almond milk, 2 tsp salt and plenty of pepper.
Cover and cook 4–5 hours on HIGH until completely tender, then switch to WARM.
Remove the garlic if you like, sprinkle in the garlic and onion powders, and mash to your preferred smoothness.
Heat the remaining 1/2 cup almond milk, the coconut milk and ghee. Stir into the potatoes 1/4 cup at a time, letting them absorb it. Season with more salt.
Keep on WARM up to 4 hours, adding a splash of the milk mixture if they dry out. Garnish with parsley.
recipes.title: Whole30 Crockpot Mashed Potatoes

ingredients.item: toppings: cooked bacon, red onion, green onion, avocado, paleo ranch, tomatoes

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Casseroles. The site lists 265 kcal and 21 g protein, which looks low for 1 lb chicken and 6 eggs across 4 servings, so calories, protein and weight here are my estimates.
steps: Preheat the oven to 400°F.
Mix the grated cauliflower and eggs well in a large bowl.
Stir in the rest of the ingredients and pour into a casserole dish.
Bake 45–60 minutes depending on the dish (about 1 hour in a 2.5-quart round dish).
Add your toppings and serve.
recipes.title: Whole30 Paleo Buffalo Chicken Casserole

ingredients.item: boneless skinless chicken breasts or thighs, bite-size
sesame seeds (omit for AIP) and green onions, to serve

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Anti-Inflammatory. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Blend the sauce ingredients smooth.
Season the chicken and brown it in the oil over medium-high about 3 minutes; remove.
Cook the garlic 1 minute, pour in the sauce, and scrape the pan.
Simmer 1 minute until thick, return the chicken, and simmer 2 minutes.
Top with sesame seeds and green onions and serve with cauliflower rice.
recipes.title: Whole30 Pineapple Teriyaki Chicken

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Anti-Inflammatory. A serving is 2 tbsp. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Blend the coconut milk, yogurt, oil and vinegar until emulsified.
Add the herbs and seasonings and pulse a few times.
Keeps a week in a sealed jar in the fridge.
recipes.title: Whole30 Ranch Dressing (AIP, Paleo)

ingredients.item: avocado oil, plus more as needed
Rotel tomatoes with green chilies, drained

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Mexican. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Preheat the oven to 350°F. Halve the peppers top to bottom, remove the seeds, and bake cut side up on a greased sheet 15 minutes. Pour off any water.
Brown the beef and drain.
Add the oil and onion and cook 5 minutes, then the taco seasoning, tomato paste and garlic for 1 minute.
Add the Rotel and cauliflower rice and sauté about 5 minutes until cooked. Season.
Fill the peppers and bake 15–20 minutes until tender (cover loosely with foil if browning). Top with guacamole, cilantro and jalapeños.
recipes.title: Whole30 Taco Stuffed Peppers

ingredients.item: chicken breasts, pounded to 1/2 inch and cut in strips

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Preheat the oven to 425°F and grease a baking sheet.
Shake the chicken strips with the flour in a zip bag, dip in the eggs whisked with water, and coat in panko.
Lay on the sheet, spray heavily with cooking spray, and bake 15–20 minutes until browned and cooked.
Melt the butter, stir in the brown sugar and hot sauce, and bring to a boil. Off the heat, stir in the garlic powder and water.
Toss the strips in the sauce. Serve with ranch.
recipes.title: Winger's Sticky Fingers (Copycat)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Pasta. Calories and protein are the site's figures; serving weight is an estimate.
steps: In a large Dutch oven, cook the sausage, beef, onion and garlic over medium heat until browned.
Stir in the crushed tomatoes, tomato paste, tomato sauce and water.
Add the sugar, basil, fennel, Italian seasoning, 2 tsp salt, pepper and 2 tbsp parsley.
Simmer covered at least 1 1/2 hours, stirring occasionally.
If using regular noodles, cook and drain them.
Mix the ricotta, egg, remaining parsley and 1/2 tsp salt.
Preheat the oven to 375°F.
Spread 1 1/2 cups sauce in a 9x13 dish. Layer noodles, half the ricotta, a third of the mozzarella and 1/4 cup Parmesan.
Add 1 1/2 cups sauce, then noodles, the rest of the ricotta, half the remaining mozzarella and 1/4 cup Parmesan.
Add 1 1/2 cups sauce and a final layer of noodles.
Top with 1 1/2 cups sauce and the remaining mozzarella and Parmesan.
Cover with foil and bake 25 minutes, then uncover and bake 25 minutes more.
Rest 15 minutes before serving.
recipes.title: World's Best Lasagna

ingredients.item: yellow squash, shredded and squeezed dry

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Sides. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Shred the squash, squeeze out the water, and measure 2 cups.
Preheat the oven to 400°F and line a cookie sheet.
Whisk the flour, baking powder, baking soda, salt, garlic powder and rosemary.
Add the squash, milk, butter and cheese and mix gently (by hand if needed) without overmixing.
Pat out to about 2 inches thick on a floured board and cut with a floured glass, re-rolling the scraps.
Bake about 15 minutes until golden.
recipes.title: Yellow Squash Cheddar Biscuits

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Asian. The site is gone, so this comes from a 2013 web archive copy. Calories and weight are estimates per 2 tbsp.
steps: Mix everything well in a small bowl.
Cover and refrigerate about 30 minutes.
recipes.title: Yum Yum Sauce (Hibachi Copycat)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Dinner. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Brown the beef with salt and drain.
Sauté the onion and garlic in the oil 2 minutes, return the meat, add the tomatoes, basil, salt and pepper, and simmer covered on low 30–40 minutes (keep it thick; no added water).
Lightly salt the zucchini slices, wait 10 minutes, and blot dry. Grill 2–3 minutes per side and drain on paper towels.
Preheat the oven to 375°F and mix the ricotta, parmesan and egg.
In a 9x12 dish: 1/2 cup sauce, a layer of zucchini, 1/2 cup ricotta mixture, 1 cup mozzarella; repeat, ending with zucchini, sauce and mozzarella.
Cover with foil and bake 30 minutes, uncover and bake 15 minutes more. Rest 5–10 minutes.
recipes.title: Zucchini Lasagna (No Noodles, High Protein)

ingredients.item: large zucchini, 1/4 inch thick (or 1 medium cut on the diagonal)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Apps. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Slice the zucchini 1/4 inch thick, spray both sides with oil, and season.
Broil or grill about 2 minutes per side.
Top with sauce and cheese and broil a minute or two more (don't burn the cheese).
recipes.title: Zucchini Pizza Bites

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Meal Prep (Taste of Home). Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Preheat the oven to 400°F. Salt the zucchini in a colander, let stand 10 minutes, and squeeze dry.
Mix with the eggs, Parmesan and half the mozzarella and cheddar. Press into a greased 13x9 dish and bake 20 minutes.
Meanwhile brown the beef and onion, drain, and stir in the tomato sauce.
Spoon the meat sauce over the crust, top with the remaining cheese and the pepper, and bake about 20 minutes until hot.
recipes.title: Zucchini Pizza Casserole

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Soup. Calories, protein and weight are estimates.
steps: Brown the sausage in a large pot, breaking it up. Remove it, keeping 1 tbsp grease in the pot.
Sauté the onion 5 minutes, then the garlic 1 minute.
Add the potatoes, stock and sausage, bring to a simmer, and cook 10 minutes until the potatoes are tender.
Stir in the kale and cream and simmer 5 minutes. Season.
Serve topped with bacon.
recipes.title: Zuppa Toscana (Olive Garden Copycat)

recipes.notes: From Jessica Lynn's Pinterest board Soup. Calories and protein are the site's figures; weight is an estimate.
steps: Crisp the bacon in a large pot over medium-high, 5–8 minutes, and drain on paper towels, keeping the fat.
Brown the sausage in the fat over medium with red pepper, 5–8 minutes. Remove with a slotted spoon.
Cook the onion until translucent, then the garlic 45 seconds. Add the potatoes and season.
Add the broth, boil, then cook on medium about 10 minutes until the potatoes are tender.
Add the coconut milk and sausage for 5 minutes, then the kale and bacon for a minute until wilted. Season. Keeps 5 days or freezes 1 month.
recipes.title: Zuppa Toscana (Paleo, Whole30, Keto Option)
